excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员在§H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!上的荒芜沙丘上探索时，第一个汇报并不出乎意料：这是一片不自然的废土，在水面以上没有任何的生命迹象。然而，这座行星的水生生命已经远远进化过了我们预期可以涉足陆地的水准。

此外，船员们还发现了一些被黄沙覆盖、外观老旧的似乎是建筑一样的东西。就在他们刚开始向这些表面上的建筑内挖掘时，一小群纳米虫群突触出现，并开始袭击研究人员。似乎这座建筑不
excerpt.en: As the [Root.GetName]s' crew explored the barren dunes of §H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!, the first reports were much as expected: this is an unnatural wasteland with no signs of life above the water's surface. Yet th

excerpt.zh: [root.GetName]已经完成了对§H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!原生纳米机器人的研究，结果令人难以置信。数千年前，一艘来自先进文明的舰船在此坠毁。那艘船上有几十种不同设计的机器人。
excerpt.en: The [root.GetName] has completed its study of the nanites native to §H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!, and the results are incredible. Thousands of years ago, a ship hailing from an advanced civilization crashed here. Ab

excerpt.zh: §H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§! 的居民令人印象深刻。我们发送到大气层的任何探测器都会虫群迅速分析并拆散，此后不久，虫群的其余部分也学会了如何最好地摧毁我们的无人机——即使是在行星的远端。虫群对我们的技术的理解显着增加。
excerpt.en: The denizens of §H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§! keep impressing. Any probe we send down into the atmosphere is quickly analyzed and taken apart by the swarm, and shortly thereafter the rest of its hive has learned how

excerpt.zh:
尽管§H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!的虫群在成为集体时所向披靡，但其个体却相当脆弱。从该行星的大气中抽取出一小部分，并使用我们的先进AI科技，我们成功地重写了这些机器人的通讯系统。当我们将我们重编程过的机器人放回虫群后，这些修改在一瞬间席卷全球。

获得网络的控制后，我们第一要务是为§H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!带回稳定的大气，并且要对[Root.Owner.GetS
excerpt.en: While the nanite swarm of §H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§! was impressive as a collective, as individuals they were quite vulnerable. Extracting a few from the planet's atmosphere and using our advanced AI technology, w

excerpt.zh:
在[root.fleet.GetName]完成对§H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!的轨道轰炸后，尘埃逐渐落定。尽管混合使用了强劲的爆炸物和试验性EMP，轰炸的过程仍然持续了很长，不过最终，这里再也没有任何机械生命活动的迹象了。

我们未来的殖民者可以获取这些害虫的尸体，并有望能从中收获一些有用的东西。
excerpt.en: The dust is settling after the [root.fleet.GetName] finished orbital bombardment of §H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!. Despite using a mix of powerful explosives and experimental EMPs, the process took a long time - but

excerpt.zh: 我们的预防措施和特种设备仍不充分。我们在§H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!建立殖民地之后很快就跟地面的团队失去了联络。从落脚点收到的最后一条通讯显示，天空被微小的淹没了前哨的黑色物体遮蔽。
excerpt.en: Our precautions and special equipment were not enough. Shortly after establishing a colony on §H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!, we lost contact with our teams on the ground. The last communication we received from the s

excerpt.zh:
造成§Y[From.GetName]§!日冕发现的恒星辐射共振的原因证明是一种可以耐受高温的异常晶体阵列。

在把这些晶体带到船上后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]震惊地发现这些怪异的共振是可以复现的。首先，他们将这些晶体暴露在与[From.GetName]相同的恒星辐射中，产生了与最初记录的现象完全一致的结果。它也似乎制造了我们发送给它的所有能量波的共振，形成了[Owner.GetSpeciesN
excerpt.en:
The cause of the solar radiation resonance observed around the corona of §Y[From.GetName]§! turned out to be an unusual crystal formation capable of enduring the heat!

Having brought the crystal aboard, our [Root.Owner.

excerpt.zh:
自[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始仰望星空以来，[From.GetName]就一直是一个纯真的梦幻，一个充满了我们的期待的地方，一个新的家园。可悲的是，随着我们的望远镜的发展，我们意识到这颗行星可能是一个潮汐锁定、万物冰封的地狱——这一假说已由我们今天的发现而彻底证实。

然而希望仍然存在，这个世界存在着作为一个宜居行星而言所必需的一切因素。我们或许只需要轻轻推上一把……
excerpt.en: For as long as we [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been able to look to the stars for new homes, [From.GetName] has been a naive dream: a place we would look to with optimism; a new home. Sadly as our telescopes go

excerpt.zh: 这颗潮汐锁定的行星似乎具有各种宜居行星的建筑模块。也许在上面能建造一些东西。
excerpt.en: This tidally locked planet appears to have all the building blocks for a habitable world. Perhaps there is something that can be built here.

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]的地表之下生活着一种非常奇特的有机体。扫描和取样显示，它是一种散布着孢子的菌丝体。与我们母星上熟悉的孢子的尺寸相比，它们非常巨大。它们的表面闪烁迷人，千变万化，色调似乎随着环境而变化。

其中最奇怪的事情莫过于它们似乎形成了一种可以产生科学家相信是信号的东西的网络。现在的辐射还非常弱，但稍作努力，也许就能找到它们指向何方。
excerpt.en: Below the surface of [From.GetName] lives a most peculiar organism. Scans and samples show that it is some sort of mycelium littered with spores. Compared to the traditional size of spores on our homeworld, these are mas

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]的地表之下生活着一种非常奇特的有机体。扫描和取样显示，它是一种散布着孢子的菌丝体，并且与“巨大蘑菇”直接关联。这些孢子看起来变化成长成了小的球状物。它们表面变幻莫测的颜色相当瑰丽，但更重要的是它们发出来比一般孢子更强的信号。

我们的科学家猜测我们也许可以通过部分孢子带回“巨大蘑菇”来增强当前的网络。
excerpt.en: Below the surface of [From.GetName] lives a familiar organism. Scans and samples show that it is some sort of mycelium, littered with enormous spores and directly related to the 'Fumongus.' Its spores seem, however, to h

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]的地表之下生活着一种非常奇特的有机体。扫描和取样显示，它是一种散布着孢子的菌丝体，并且与“巨大蘑菇”直接关联。这些孢子看起来变化成长成了小的球状物。它们表面变幻莫测的颜色相当瑰丽，但更重要的是它们发出来比一般孢子更强的信号。

由于我们拆解了这个网络，这些信息就没有什么用处了。
excerpt.en: Below the surface of [From.GetName] lives a familiar organism. Scans and samples show that it is some sort of mycelium, littered with enormous spores and directly related to the 'Fumongus.' Its spores seem, however, to h

excerpt.zh: 结果证明追踪菌丝体发出的信号是件棘手的活。 我们迷茫的科学家最终定出了“通过蘑菇来一瞥更高纬度”这种假设。关于会带来什么结果的细节完全没有。不过无论如何：这项操作是成功的，并且确实把我们指向了某个目标。
excerpt.en: Tracking the signal emitted by the mycelium proved to be a tricky business. Our puzzled scientist finally managed by 'using mushrooms to peer into additional dimensions.' Details are scarce about what this entails, but i

excerpt.zh: 结果证明追踪菌丝体发出的信号是件棘手的活。尽管[Root.GetLeaderName]尽了最大努力，仍然无法为这些信号指明目的地，而菌丝体仍然谜团重重。尽管如此，我们在这个过程中也收获颇丰，数据也如之前所说的一样会被带回去。
excerpt.en: Tracking the signal emitted by the mycelium proved to be a tricky business. Despite the best efforts of [Root.GetLeaderName], it was impossible to determine a destination for the signal and the mycelium mostly remains a

excerpt.zh:
将变异的孢子移植到现有的蘑菇上是一项生物工程壮举。借助详细描述“巨大蘑菇”基因变化的档案，我们的科学家设法在不影响其效率的情况下进一步改变它。结果非常惊人，几个月后，蘑菇长了十倍。反过来这又增加了对水的供给的需求，但附近冰冻的小行星足以为它们提供几个世纪甚至数千年的水分。

更大的蘑菇带来了更好的网络，在对计算设备进行了一些升级之后，我们现在再次准备好听听孢子怎么说。
excerpt.en: Grafting the mutated spores onto the existing mushroom was a feat of bio-engineering. With the help of archives detailing the genetic alterations already made on the 'Fumongus,' our scientists managed to further alter it

excerpt.zh: 在太空中我们发现了一个严重损毁的双足机器人。它的面部毫无特征，而它的金属外构严重损坏了。初步的扫描显示它还有残留的能源，不过它使用的能源和我们的大相径庭。也许它的内部电路还能留存一些过去的数据，不过充能和翻译数据需要花费一些时间。
excerpt.en: We have found a bipedal robot floating in space. Its faceplate is featureless, and its metal exterior is damaged. Preliminary scans indicate it has residual power, but its power source is radically different from our own

excerpt.zh: 通过不懈的努力，我们找到了充能机器人并扫描它记忆体的方法。难过的是，这个机器已经严重劣化，我们难以取回有条理的信息。我们会考虑发起后续研究，可能会研究它的其他同类，但这个机械流浪者的命运永远会是一个谜。
excerpt.en: Through diligent effort, we have found a way to recharge the robot's power supply and scan its memory banks. Sadly, the machine has deteriorated so badly that we cannot retrieve coherent information. We will consider a f

excerpt.zh:
对[From.GetStarName]星系内时间波动的分析发现了一些值得注意的东西：一座巨大的、漂浮在太空中的棱镜。这座棱镜不折射光线，而是折射时间。取决于不同的入射角，[Root.GetName]的船员体会到时间在以不同的速率流逝。扫描也表明，他们中有些人快速老化，而另一些人则比预期的要年轻了数天甚至数年。

我们对这座棱镜的研究确乎加深了我们对时间的本质和性质的理解，但是它的起源和作用仍不得而知。
excerpt.en: Our analysis of the temporal fluctuations in the [From.GetStarName] system has revealed something remarkable: a massive prism, floating in space. Rather than light, the prism refracts time. Depending on the angle of inci

excerpt.zh:
我们对希洛士残骸场的扫描已经完成。其化学结构同时具备生物和非生物性质，我们从未见过类似的东西。

这片残骸与在此恒星系中巡逻的奇怪船只间有何关联仍然模糊不清。船上没有生命迹象。事实上，我们探测不到任何种类的能量特征。姑且来说就是，我们在幽灵船面前栽跟头了。
excerpt.en:
Our scans of the debris field in Hillos are complete. Possessing both organic and abiogenic properties, the chemical structure is unlike anything we've ever seen.

The connection between the debris and the strange vessel

excerpt.zh:
我们的科研团队得出结论，认为在其命令日志中被称作“乌布梅”的、被遗弃的舰船曾在希洛士恒星系中进行实验，实验目的是创造合成人生命。反物质约束装置泄露导致舰上人员连同着新出生的“幼儿”一道丧生。但是，在舰船各系统中探测到的少量灵能表明，那个合成生命体的“鬼魂”在事故发生前几秒钟掌控了船只。

可以想象，新生的意识体辗转花费了数个世纪，徒劳地寻找自己的母亲。不幸的是，此时此刻我们没有办法与该实体交流，也无法帮助其取得安宁。目前来看，希洛士恒星
excerpt.en: Our science team has concluded that the abandoned ship, referred to as 'Ubume' in its command logs, was conducting an experiment in the Hillos system, the goal of which was the creation of synthetic life. An antimatter c

excerpt.zh: 我们探测到有什么东西从希洛士恒星系中传出。那艘叫乌布梅的幽灵船使用一种只能说是“灵能频段”的东西在不断地发出悲伤的哭嚎。显然，自从我们第一次遇到这艘船和被困在船上的新生意识以来它就一直如此了。似乎我们最近的灵能飞升是我们能听到这个孩子哭泣的缘由。通过进一步研究，我们也许能够与之联系。
excerpt.en: We have detected something unusual emanating from the Hillos system. On what can only be described as a 'psionic frequency', the so-called ghost ship Ubume has been issuing a plaintive and irregular wail. Apparently, thi

excerpt.zh: 在经过几个月痛苦的研究后，我们的灵能使终于成功地与占据幽灵船乌布梅的那个意识取得联系。尽管它的词汇量非常稀少，但这个合成生命体可以用感受和印象进行表达。这个“孩子”的孤独显而易见，这也可以从它与其他灵魂接触时的欣喜中看出来。它似乎也喜欢我们的科研，在船旁边嬉戏地滑过希洛士星系，就像一只水生鲸类动物的幼崽围绕着它的母亲一样。至少，“闹鬼”的希洛士恒星系最终迎来了令人愉快的结局。
excerpt.en: After months of painful research, our telepaths have succeeded in making contact with the consciousness in possession of the ghost ship Ubume. Possessing only a rudimentary vocabulary, the synthetic lifeform was neverthe

excerpt.zh:
我们收到了我们的一位首席灵能者的消息。现任，在研究了希洛士星系中的存在之后，他们承担起了尝试与占据着幽灵船乌布梅的灵能意识沟通的重任。在几个月艰苦的尝试后，他们终于成功地建立了联系。

这个“孩子”的孤独显而易见，这也可以从它与其他与之相似的灵魂接触时的欣喜中看出来。它现在调皮地滑过希洛士星系，用灵能向每一位愿意聆听它声音的个体倾诉。
excerpt.en: We have received word from one of our foremost psychics. Apparently, after learning of the presence in the Hillos system, they took it upon themselves to make contact with the psionic consciousness in possession of the g

excerpt.zh: 我们的传感器发现了[From.GetName]上的舰船残骸是通过某种罕见的方式抵达那里的。这些舰船似乎是从大约数光年以外故意地径直开向小行星，用以测试设计者推进器的精确度。在对残骸进行深度扫描时，我们找到了那么一艘推进装置相当完好无损的舰船。
excerpt.en: Our sensors have discovered that the ship remnants on [From.GetName] got there in a peculiar way. The ships seem to have been intentionally driven straight into the asteroid, probably from light-years away, to test the a

excerpt.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]期望在[From.GetName]内部发现稀有资源，结果偶然撞见了一样极其不寻常的东西。这个看起来像是普通小行星的物体事实上是一个长期休眠的中继站，里面有复杂的电子元件和先进的传感器，用以向某个古老的帝国发送信号。这些撞击也损毁了小行星的一部分内部构造，我们只能从中提取到一个恒星系。
excerpt.en: Hoping to discover rare resources inside [From.GetName], our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] stumbled upon something most unusual. What had appeared to be a simple asteroid was in fact a long-dormant relay station with comple

excerpt.zh: 我们错了。这座围绕[From.GetName]的空间站并非无人居住；相反，它上面爬满了巨大的外星节肢动物！我们部署进空间站的传感器在信号中断前只回传了一些行动迅捷的阴影和巨大颚骨的画面。在对空间站进行深度扫描后，我们发现了一处可能是无比复杂的数据库的地方。为了抵达这座数据库，我们需要穿过这些一团团的、有好多腿儿的守护者。
excerpt.en: We were wrong. The station orbiting [From.GetName] is not uninhabited; instead, it is crawling with giant alien arthropoids! The probes we deployed into the station only returned skittering shadows and large mandibles be

excerpt.zh: 噢，你们好！很抱歉之前摧毁了你们的探测器。那只是因为我们在这做一些非常精密的实验，而我们担心一些外在的干扰会影响实验结果——我相信你能理解。那么，我们能帮上什么忙吗？
excerpt.en: Oh, hello there! Sorry about destroying your probe earlier. It's just that we are conducting some very delicate experiments here, and we were worried that outside interference could alter the results - I'm sure you under

excerpt.zh: 究竟是什么原因会让你这么想啊？我们是一支策展人分遣队，派驻到这里研究这个恒星系独特的特征。如果你是想分享我们机构通常给予的那些福利，我建议你和我们的主研究实验室联系。我可以提供你一份目前我们在此地所发现的东西的拷贝。
excerpt.en: What would ever give you that impression? We are a Curator detachment sent here to study this system's unique properties. If you wish to partake of our order's usual offerings, I suggest contacting the primary research l

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]上生活的生命体形式和我们预想的完全不一样。我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]汇报到，小行星内有不断生长的水晶。这些生命体利用[From.System.GetName]散发的辐射，并结合小行星内的矿物元素，被证实能够完成自给自足的繁衍生息。
excerpt.en: The lifeforms living on [From.GetName] were nothing like we expected. Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] report back that the asteroid has crystal growths. These growths have turned out to be self-sustaining and caused by th

excerpt.zh: 在食用了太空生长的水晶糖数年之后，很明显，我们的人民对这一美食的需求愈发旺盛。我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]已经列了一份表，上面是能够建造水晶糖农场的潜在候选地。
excerpt.en: After eating space-based crystal sugars for a few years now, it has become apparent that our population would like to see it more readily available. Our [Root.GetScientistPlural] have come up with a list of potential can

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]是一颗独特的气态巨行星。我们对天体物理的知识告诉我们，这样的行星应该有一个行星环，然而它并没有。在我们的科研船近距离观察了那颗诡异的卫星之后，这一现象的原因已经十分显然了。这颗星球被一些“牧羊人”卫星所环绕，这些卫星全部拥有富得难以置信的矿物，并且每年还在积累更多。我们可以用精准控制的爆炸爆破这些卫星，然后将它们的矿物一次性收集起来；也可以让它们继续留在环带，持续地收集它们积累下来的太空残骸。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] is a peculiar gas giant. Our knowledge of astrophysics tells us that the planet should have a planetary ring, yet it doesn't. The cause of this became apparent after our science ship took a closer look at

excerpt.zh:
我们确实在[From.GetName]上发现了生命，但也是因为我们的行动，这一生命已经灭绝了。这些微生生物住在气态巨行星的外层边缘，对于我们的深度扫描表现出了极大的负面反应。扫描的频率同生物的细胞结构产生了共振——这一效应如同瀑布倾泻而下般飞速传开，从一个气态小虫子传播到另一只气态小虫。所有生物都在收到影响之后不久就不再活动了。

我们现在正环绕着全宇宙最大的坟场。
excerpt.en: We did indeed discover life on [From.GetName], but by our actions, it has since been eradicated. The microbial creatures which lived in the outer edges of the gas giant's atmosphere reacted poorly to our deep scans. Thes

excerpt.zh: 完成了！如同奇迹一般，当我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]对我们的飞船进行了合适的改造之后，它们能够重现最初的瀑布效应。这一次效果不一样，[FromFromFrom.GetName]上的生命体如同一波巨大的浪潮一样又重新涌动了起来。
excerpt.en: It is done! Miraculously, once our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] installed the proper modifications on our vessel, they were able to recreate the initial cascade. This time the effect was different, and life started springi

excerpt.zh: 我们从[Root.GetName]收到的最后一束信号无异于混乱的静电音。他们一直在研究[From.GetName]上奇怪的区域风暴，并且一直发回令人难以置信的前期报告。这股风暴会对发送过去的探测器做出反应，制造出真空口袋来避开它们，再缓慢地往回渗透进探测器。在我们失去联络之前，[Root.GetName]正计划在风暴处测试许多不同的扫描频率。科研船看上去已经沉没到了气态巨行星深处，现在已经陷入了沉寂。
excerpt.en: The last signal received from [Root.GetName] was not much more than garbled static. They had been studying the strange localized storms on [From.GetName] and were sending back incredible preliminary reports. The tempest

excerpt.zh: 在几个月的工作之后，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]终于设法调整[FromFrom.GetName]护盾的工作方式，使得[FromFromFrom.GetName]风暴放开了对落难舰船的钳制。同[trapped_in_storm.GetName]的通讯很快重新建立了起来，十分难以置信的是，[FromFrom.GetName]上没有组员记得他们被风暴困住的这段时间。
excerpt.en: After months of work, our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] finally managed to alternate [FromFrom.GetName] shields in such a way that [FromFromFrom.GetName] tempest released its grip on the marooned ship. Communications with [

excerpt.zh:
当[Root.GetName]靠的足够近得以扫描货舱的时候，似乎所有的传感器都功能失常了。这个舱室使用的[Owner.GetBioAlloy]同我们自己建造太空结构时使用的是完全一样的。这种某些外星生命体发明出了同我们完全一致的复合材料的可能性，根本不可能成立，但在校准了扫描仪之后，我们依然得到了同样的结果。

在打开舱室之后，迎接我们的唯一一样东西是一份文档集，里面详细地阐述了我们应当如何指派我们的每一位[Owner.GetScien
excerpt.en: Once [Root.GetName] got close enough to scan the cargo pod it was assumed that the sensors were malfunctioning. The pod is built out of the exact same [Owner.GetBioAlloy] we ourselves use for spacebound structures. The l

excerpt.zh: 在经过几年不顺坦的发展之后，[Root.Capital.GetName]的上方出现了一道时空织构裂口。令人心惊胆颤的是，这一天的日期和我们十年前收到的怪异指示上面所说的日期是同一天。我们现在只有一件需要做的事情：把收到的那些笔记发射到裂口里面，关闭这个循环。
excerpt.en: After years of uneasy development, a rip in the fabric of space has appeared above [Root.Capital.GetName]. Unnervingly this is the exact date as indicated in the strange instructions we received a decade ago. There is on

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]附近小行星的轨道是如此完美无暇地稳定，也不难理解为什么我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]会认为它是被人工放置在这个地方了。然而，那里也没有任何推进系统或者其他人工航行的迹象。唯一的自然演化结论是，由于某种几乎荒谬到不可能成真的几率，这颗小行星被[From.GetName]的重力场捕获了。我们在这颗小行星的表面还探测到了几种十分稀有的水晶。
excerpt.en: The asteroid around [From.GetName] has such a perfectly stable orbit that it's easy to understand why our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] thought it was placed there artificially. Yet, there are no conclusive indications of a

excerpt.zh: 正当我们的采矿站在这颗被捕获的小行星上完工几天之后，这枚岩石突然开始旋转起来，在这个过程中摧毁了采矿站，但同时又有更多的稀有水晶矿藏暴露在了我们的传感器面前！
excerpt.en: Just a day after finishing our mining station on the trapped asteroid, the rock abruptly rotated, destroying the mining station. In the process of doing this, even more rare crystals deposits were exposed to our sensors!

excerpt.zh: 警报的笛声响彻整个[Solar_System.GetName]，大量的晶化野兽从小行星庇护所里面冲了出来，正是我们在钻孔并打算提取晶体的那颗小行星。它看上去§R生气了§!。
excerpt.en: Warning sirens blared across [Solar_System.GetName] as the massive crystalline beast left the shelter of the asteroid we had been drilling into and extracting crystals from. It seems §Rangry§!.

excerpt.zh: 这个被捕捉的小行星，实际上，是某种晶态生命体的巢穴。很庆幸我们没有继续挖掘，因为看上去我们似乎激怒了在里面休眠的生物。如果我们什么都不做，只是从远处研究它，这些生物应该会平静下来。
excerpt.en: The trapped asteroid is, in fact, a crystalline being's nest. It is good that we didn't keep digging, for it seems like we agitated the creature hibernating inside. If we do nothing for a while and study it from afar, it

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的有毒大气层内观测到的生命信号，是体型庞大的半有机机械体！这个外星工业体似乎正是星球上乌烟瘴气的罪魁祸首，而且它依旧在运转。这个星球上没有其他的生命信号，这些机械体的造物主肯定抛下它们自己跑掉了。我们目前还不能确定它们的意图，但是它们建造的建筑想必能够帮助我们更好地理解工程学。
excerpt.en: The life signs observed within the toxic atmosphere of [From.GetName] are giant semi-organic machines! This alien industry seems to have been the cause of the noxious atmosphere on the planet, yet it's still operational.

excerpt.zh: 我们并不是在地表之下检测到了生命形式，事实上，是整个星球都检测到了生命！这颗冰封的星球内部布满了微细的管道，相互连接，就像一台原始的计算机。尽管结构很粗糙，它通天的规模意味着，其算力甚至可以匹敌[Owner.Capital.GetName]的某些超级计算机。即使是现在，这台电脑还在活动——我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]可以同其互动，但是由于它运转十分缓慢，我们只能询问其一个简单的问题。
excerpt.en: We didn't detect life forms below the surface. We detected them in the entire world! The frozen planet is interspersed with micro-thin tubes linked like a rudimentary computer. While the structure is primitive, its gigan

excerpt.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]有了更加惊怖的发现。他们早前扫描到的山脉，实际上是某个巨型蛋的卵壳膜。我们也不知道究竟是什么巨兽诞下了这么一枚蛋，更不知道何等的怖兽会从中孵化出来。
excerpt.en: Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have discovered something rather monstrous. The mountain range they scanned earlier was in actuality the outer membrane of a gigantic egg. It's uncertain what behemoth could lay such an egg

excerpt.zh: [FromFromFrom.GetName]的内部有什么东西超出我们所料。我们并没有发现什么巨兽生命的幼体，取而代之的只是一团基因浆。整个行星的内部填满了基因物质和资源。全部这些物质最终会变成什么还不明晰，但是如果不打破砂锅问到底，我们的星系可能会更加安全。
excerpt.en: The insides of [FromFromFrom.GetName] were not what we expected. Instead of some infant titanic lifeform, we've simply uncovered genetic slop. The entire planet is filled with genetic material and resources. What all thi

excerpt.zh:
§R“它活了！它又活过来了！同如此至伟的造物相比，我们不过是微不足道的凡尘；面对如此伟大之物，繁星帝国之间的鸡毛琐事又可称几——”§!

[Root.GetName]最后的传输信号在此中断，当我们发送探测器去扫描[FromFromFrom.GetName]残骸的时候，我们只看到了一个空壳。看上去这个生物对自己的解放者并没有多少感激之情。
excerpt.en:
§R"IT LIVES! IT LIVES AGAIN! We are nothing but insignificant specks compared to such a creature; what does the ephemeral squabbling between empires matter in the face of such great-"§!

The last transmission of the [Roo

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]上发现的这座巨大的碑塔让我们的科研船派过去都微如蝼蚁。在这块宏伟的、光滑的板状金属表面，曾经炫目的彩色图案如今已变得斑驳。

机器的侧面一处小的能量出口似乎暗示着只要以适量的能量币作为交换，它的秘密就能悉数揭示，
excerpt.en:
The monolith we found on [From.GetName] dwarfs the science ship we sent to investigate it. A majestic, smooth slab of metal, the once-garish pigment patterns on the front have been reduced to mere flecks.

A small power

excerpt.zh:
机械活动了起来，远古的传动机构在光滑的表面底下叮当作响。在一阵呼呼、嗡嗡声之后噪音戛然而止，一块金属挡板划开，从机器中滚出了一个有舰船一般大小的圆柱状罐体……

圆柱状罐体中保存着某种远古的饮料，奇迹般地抵御了时间的侵蚀。依据市场数据，这种失传已久的饮品比我们目前能为生物体提供的最好的饮料还要好喝20%。
excerpt.en:
The machine stirs, ancient mechanisms clanking behind the smooth facade. After much whirring, buzzing, and a dramatic pause, a metallic panel slides back, and a ship-sized cylinder rolls out of the machine...

The cylind

excerpt.zh: 我们找到了一艘设计独特的古代太空舰船。它使用的推进方式与现代舰船并不相同，而是依赖于在真空中展开的巨大的帆来进行。也许这艘船可以捕获恒星能量，并在星光和恒星风的推动下前进。
excerpt.en: We have found the wreckage of an archaic spaceship of unusual design. Instead of using propulsion similar to that of modern ships, the craft relied on large sails unfurled in the vacuum of space. Presumably, the ship har

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一艘古老的外星人星舰，它被半掩埋在一个小行星撞击坑中间。这艘科研船的外壳搭载了一个扩增的探测阵列，没有配备武器。船体外部在撞击之前没有受到任何伤害。我们可以假设，这场灾难之所以发生，是因为船员酿成的某种致命错误。
excerpt.en: We have discovered an ancient alien starship half-buried in an asteroid crater. This science ship's exterior has an extensive sensory array and no weaponry. The exterior was not damaged in any way before it crashed. We c

excerpt.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]一开始以为这是小行星，结果发现这其实是冰冻的、被压实的缇扬奇尸体，在轨道上历经几十年之后，成为一堆不成形状的块状物。整个小行星环，实际上，是一片露天墓地。其中的一部分尸体是最近刚刚到达并开始腐坏的，而剩下的已历经千年岁月，甚至比我们的帝国还要久远。
excerpt.en: What our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] first mistook for asteroids have been revealed to be frozen, battered Tiyanki corpses reduced to shapeless lumps after decades in orbit. The entire asteroid ring is, in fact, just an o

excerpt.zh:
我们起先认为这是一种刻意的交流尝试，结果发现它不过是一种不常见的自然现象。这颗行星产生的磁力波只要进行合适的调整和编辑，就可以听起来像歌唱一般，但这肯定不是由任何有意识的个体产生的。然而我们的一些科学家也发现，这“歌声”相当地吸引人。

也许我们可以利用这一现象，比如招待艺术家或VIP到空间站中，然后捕获这些信号，把它们作为一种放松的音乐播放给他们听。
excerpt.en: What we first assumed to be a deliberate attempt at communication has turned out to be an unusual but naturally occurring phenomenon. The magnetic waves produced by the planet, given proper handling and editing, may soun

excerpt.zh: 在探察冰面下方之后我们得出结论，这处位于[From.GetName]的异常热信号是由热液泉引起的。类似的地方这个星球上似乎还有更多，但是我们尚未发现。
excerpt.en: After probing beneath the surface, we have concluded the unusual heat signatures on [From.GetName] are caused by hydrothermal springs. There seems to be more to this planet than meets the eye...

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的船员的进一步探索揭示出热水来源的行星地壳深处竟然密布着微观生命体！我们一度以为空无一物的冰封星球事实上孕育着一个欣欣向荣的水下生物圈。
excerpt.en: Continued exploration by the crew of [From.GetName] has revealed the hot water coming from deep within the planet's crust is teeming with microscopic life! What we once thought of as an empty, frozen planet, actually con

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]的异常能量读数的来源确定是一个蓝色的小球。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]汇报，传感器从中发现了相反极性的快子。

该物体周围的地面上刻着符号，也许是由某个更古老的文明留下的。目前不清楚是符号的含义是指引还是警示。

完整的文本还远不能翻译，但部分符号似乎与时间测量和[Solar_System.GetName]恒星系中天体相对位置有关。
excerpt.en:
The source of the unusual energy readings noted on [From.GetName] is confirmed to be a small, blue orb. The [Owner.GetScientistPlural] report that sensors pick up tachyons of reverse polarity.

基于在此处发现的异常的快子信号，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]推断，球体和符号一同发生了时间回溯。

[leader.GetHeSheCap]之后称看到了时间如同一条河流一般延展，前后连接着无尽的过去与未来。在[leader.GetHimHer]的面前，蓝色能量从时间流中蜿蜒涌出，被吸入了[leader.GetHisHer]的身体里。尽管该意外在[Owner.GetScientistPlural]精确测量中持续了不

While working at the site on [FromFrom.GetName], [Root.GetLeaderName] brushed against the blue orb.

[leader.GetHeSheCap] later described a vision of time stretching out like a river into the infinite future and past. In

长程扫描发现了一艘舰船正在驶向[Root.Capital.GetName]。随着它越来越近，我们发现那艘船的设计与我们一世纪前的如出一辙。

在打开通讯之后，我们发现那艘舰船是[intemporal_explorer.GetName]驾驶的，就是那位被蓝色球体从时间流中带走的[Owner.GetScientist]。

[intemporal_explorer.GetHeSheCap]在对撞的中子星和逆转的时空引力井周围漫步，又乘坐飞船
excerpt.en:
Long-range scans picked up an approaching vessel near [Root.Capital.GetName]. As it moved closer, it became clear that the ship's design matched our own from a century ago.

After opening comms, we discovered that the sh

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]上正要着手开展钻取作业之后，[Root.GetLeaderName]产生了强烈的幻觉。虽然没有受到身体伤害，但他们报告说，他们起先是被破碎不连贯的视觉和嗅觉幻觉所淹没，这些幻觉展现了某种未知的外星物种。

已经准备了一项特殊项目来进一步调查这些怪异的晶体贮藏。

excerpt.zh:
在冰面以下，晶体自身几乎构成了行星的大部分物质。取样分析表明有一处用于数据存储的人工高密度晶格。估测表明这些存储的数据远比我们所有的集体数据库都要庞大。

似乎这个晶体的建造者使用灵能共振来写入数据。[Root.GetLeaderName]非常好奇，并申请在表面建造一座自动研究站。

excerpt.zh:
在自动研究站即将竣工时，晶体突然释放出了一阵极强的能量活动，[Root.GetLeaderName]不幸当场毙命。不一会儿之后，我们收到了一份自称来自[leader.GetHimHer]的自动通讯。

尽管其身体的神经系统已经无法修复，但其意识被困在了水晶中。由于身处[leader.GetHisHer]这种新的境地，[leader.GetSheHe]可以帮助我们深入晶体数据库在未来进行进一步的研究。
excerpt.en: Nearing the completion of the automated research station, there was a sudden spike in activity from the crystal which left [Root.GetLeaderName] dead. Soon after, we received an autonomous communique claiming to be from [

excerpt.zh:
我们在[desertling_planet.GetName]上发现了生命。没有智慧的小型哺乳动物群遍布在整个行星表面。

我们的科学家将它们标记为“沙生兽”，它们的数量正以惊人的速度增加。这个行星已经超出了它的承载能力，生态系统正在迅速恶化。
excerpt.en:
We have found life on [desertling_planet.GetName]. Vast non-sapient herds of small mammals roam across the entire planetary surface.

Their population, labeled 'desertlings' by our scientists, is increasing at an alarmin

excerpt.zh:
在研究[desertling_planet.GetName]上的沙生兽时，我们的科学家观察到了一个关键的现象。尽管这个物种到处都是，但却没有相应的化石记录。这些生态入侵者在相对短的时间内造成了极端的环境破坏，很可能是被某个外来者带到这里的。

形势已经十分清楚，迫切需要我们进行干预。如果不采取行动，这些生物将摧毁这个星球自然生态系统中剩下的一切。
excerpt.en: While studying the desertlings on [desertling_planet.GetName] our scientists have made a pivotal observation. Despite the ubiquitous nature of the species, there is a striking absence of matching fossil records. These ec

excerpt.zh:
我们收到消息，[desertling_planet.GetName]已经屈服于指数繁殖的哺乳动物的侵袭。深深的寂静笼罩着现在贫瘠的大地，所有存留的植被都被吞噬到根部。

杂食性的哺乳动物奄奄一息，要么直接饿死，要么在愈演愈烈的饥荒中被同类吃掉。
excerpt.en: We have received news that [desertling_planet.GetName], has succumbed to the infestation of the exponentially breeding mammals. Deep silence envelops the now barren landscape, where all traces of vegetation have been dev

excerpt.zh:
经过艰苦的努力，我们对[desertling_planet.GetName]上的沙漠生物进行扑杀和基因改造，它们的数量终于降低到了一个可持续的水平。

没有了过多的食草动物，一个微妙的平衡出现了。大自然正在迅速恢复，新鲜的草地开始在曾经荒凉的沙漠上生长。
excerpt.en:
After an arduous effort to sterilize and genetically alter the desertlings on [desertling_planet.GetName], their population has finally been reduced to a sustainable level.

Without the overwhelming amount of grazers, a

excerpt.zh: 最终，最后一只啮齿动物在[desertling_planet.GetName]上死去。沙子本身已经被染成了红色，这是因为我们为拯救星球免于侵染所付出的巨大努力，但是新的绿芽已经开始萌发。我们出手的时候刚刚好。
excerpt.en: Finally, the last of the rodents lie dead on [desertling_planet.GetName]. The sand itself has been tinted red by our massive effort to save the planet from its infestation, but already new green buds have begun to sprout

excerpt.zh:
瑟顿之中的景象光怪陆离。涡旋的行星在黑暗中若隐若现；附近是我们宇宙本身织构的一个缺口，也是一个吞噬着其中恒星光芒的宇宙巨胃。

尽管行星体的排列看似正常，但进一步的研究发现它们是以一种非常精确的数学关系安排到一起的。数百万年前，某种难以置信的力量将这个恒星系的轨道天体编排成了一种独特的图样，这种图案不仅影响着裂隙，还避免了它裂向更广阔的星系。

我们似乎来得正好——这项史诗级的工程即将竣工。这个星系距离恢复正常近在咫尺。
excerpt.en:
Seddom is an eerie spectacle. The swirling planets are wreathed in darkness; nearby is a breach in the very fabric of our universe, a cosmic maw that devours the very radiance of the system's star.

Despite the seemingly

excerpt.zh: [from.Solar_System.GetName]恒星系的重力稳定是由小行星带中释放出来的§Y暗物质§!维系起来的。这些发射源被一台位于中心行星上的超级电脑控制着。中控电脑的记录表明，整个恒星系是一处由某个远古文明建设的重力操控实验设施。
excerpt.en: The gravitational stability of the [from.Solar_System.GetName] system is maintained by §YDark Matter§! emitters positioned within its asteroid belt. These emitters are controlled by a supercomputer located on the central

excerpt.zh:
对[From.GetName]的进一步探索非但没解开多少谜题，反而让它更加疑点重重。这里的地表到处都散落着栩栩如生的雕塑，脸上无声地凝固着痛苦的神情。

科学家们的意见发生了分歧；有些认为这些东西曾经是生物，是被一种未知的力量变成了石头。而另一些则认为它们代表了一个失落已久的文明所崇拜的神灵。更谨慎的少数人认为，这些雕像不是一种致敬，而是一种警告：对任何胆敢骚扰这颗行星的人发出严厉的警告。
excerpt.en:
Continued exploration of [From.GetName] has yielded more questions than answers. The surface is littered with eerily lifelike statues, their expressions petrified in silent agony.

Our scientists are divided; some believ

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]船员的进一步调查发现，这些雕像是某种与石质类高度相似的古代物种的遗骸。曾经维持其形态的某种力量早已消散了。现在，它们暴露在自然环境中，被逐渐侵蚀成细小的灰尘，将它们的历史残余散进了[From.GetName]无情的风中。
excerpt.en: Further investigation by the crew of [From.GetName] has identified the statues as remnants of an ancient species bearing strong resemblance to the Lithoids. Whatever essence once held their forms together has long since

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]号船员们的进一步尝试被一阵突如其来的狂风打断，这股风横扫了整个研究现场。那些脆弱的石像瞬间化为齑粉，它们曾承载的谜题也随之湮灭无痕。由于缺乏可供分析的残留证据，也无法得出明确结论，我们别无选择，只能终止此次调查。
excerpt.en: Further attempts by the crew of [From.GetName] were abruptly halted when a sudden gust of wind swept across the research site. The brittle stone figures crumbled into dust, erasing any trace of the riddle they once posed

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]冰壳之下的勘探，我们发现了一片广阔的地下洞穴。令人惊叹的是，这座隐蔽的温室中存在着一个郁郁葱葱的生态系统——茂密的动植物在隔绝环境中蓬勃生长，受到冰层保护而远离星球表面恶劣的环境。洞穴内保持着稳定的微气候，很可能是由地热喷口维持的。
excerpt.en: Excavation beneath the icy crust of [From.GetName] has revealed a vast subterranean cavern. Remarkably, this hidden greenhouses is a thriving ecosystem, a lush flora and fauna flourish in isolation, protected by the ice

excerpt.zh:
在洞穴的更深处，我们遇到了一片广袤的花田。当主动观测开始时，整片花田瞬间绽放，整个洞窟被绚丽的生物荧光所淹没。植物学分析表明，该物种每一亿年才开花一次，需要环境因素达到精确的排列组合才能触发。

我们的到来竟与如此罕见的事件同时发生，这概率微乎其微。但无论纯属巧合还是另有玄机，这无疑是一次非凡的体验。
excerpt.en: Deeper within the cavern, we encountered a sprawling field of flowers. The moment active observation began, the entire field erupted into bloom, flooding the chamber in radiant bioluminescence. Botanical analysis suggest

excerpt.zh: 随着进一步深入洞穴，地震活动突然导致结构失稳。突如其来的构造震颤在岩壁间传导，随时可能引发坍塌。面对迅速恶化的环境，我们立即启动了紧急撤离程序。洞穴中的秘密只能徒留遗憾，无法探索了。

在接下来的47秒内向我证明你存在的价值，不然的话我就将你从因果中移除。
excerpt.en:
You have squandered 63% of your statistically allotted potential.
Justify your existence in the next 47 seconds... or be excised from causality.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的研究目前取得了一些有趣的成果。这颗小行星的核心含有放射性物质，在其衰变过程中会发出周期性脉冲。虽然科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]可能永远无法从大剂量的伽马辐射中恢复过来了，但这种脉冲是可以预测的，之后的研究人员不会受到伤害。

excerpt.zh:
我们发现这颗彗星实际上是一个巨大的巢穴，里面充斥着微小的昆虫。彗尾也不是冰雾，而是巢穴内部化学反应所排放的废气。

巢穴的外壳由死亡的昆虫组成，这使得内部生的物免受太空恶劣环境的影响。我们还发现了几种依附于巢穴生活的真菌。巢穴中存在一种复杂的共生关系，真菌依赖排放的废气维生，而昆虫则以真菌为食。
excerpt.en:
The comet was revealed to be a giant nest filled with tiny insects. The tail of the comet is not outgassed ice, but rather exhaust from chemical processes occurring deep inside the hive.

The outer layer of the nest is c

excerpt.zh:
这是我们始料未及的发现：大脑集群。来自各种物种的湿糊糊的有机处理器官，成百上千个地连接在一起，悬浮在一个气球状的大型胶囊之中。它似乎已经被废弃，在近期的虚境风暴消散之后飘浮在深空之中。

胶囊之中有一个惊人的传感器阵列连接在大脑和胶囊之上，此外还有一个通信模块，能够呼叫舰船并发送信息，之前它对我们就是这么做的。

现在看来似乎是这些大脑自己联系了我们，解释了那一连串的信息。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlura
excerpt.en: We could never have anticipated our discovery: brains. Organic, squishy central processing organs from all sorts of species. Hundreds and hundreds of them, all linked together and suspended inside a large balloon-like ca

[Root.Owner.GetScientistPluralCapital]报告称这个空间站的大部分是由常见的固定材料建成的，这些物质勉强维持着空间站不至于散架。随着我们深入这座结构，构成空间站的物质从金属合金过渡成了塑料等其他材料。

在空间站的核心处，我们发现了一台机器正在高效运转，它不断地拆解有机原料并将其转化为我们之前见到的东西。

在运行DNA模拟模型后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]只能
excerpt.en: [Root.Owner.GetScientistPluralCapital] report that much of this space station is constructed from everyday stationary objects, barely holding it together. Deeper into the structure, the materials transition from metal al

excerpt.zh:
[root.leader.GetName]汇报了自[from.GetAffectedStormType]过境以来，[From.GetStarName]的聚变反应所发生的奇妙变化。

显然，这个风暴引发了恒星内核某种意想不到的核反应，导致其对流区稳定地释放出[from.GetEarnedResources]。

这些复杂而特殊的反应产生了我们所观察到的这些不寻常的多色闪光。无论如何，在一段时间内这的都会一直是一个值得仔细研究的来源。
excerpt.en:
[root.leader.GetName] reports fascinating changes in [From.GetStarName]'s fusion reactions since the passage of the [from.GetAffectedStormType].

It appears that the storm induced unexpected nuclear reactions within the

excerpt.zh:
[root.leader.GetName]发现，沉积于[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的小行星具有高度不稳定的磁性质，导致它们在恒星系中现有的磁层上发生随机的弹跳。

[root.leader.GetName]通过给每个小行星施加磁场补偿器进行了稳定，使其轨道规范化并使其便于进行资源开采。
excerpt.en: [root.leader.GetName] discovered that the asteroids deposited in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system possess highly unstable magnetic fields, causing them to ricochet haphazardly off the system's existing magnetospher

excerpt.zh:
我们已经确定了§H[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中遇险信号的来源，那一艘严重受损但仍在运作的商船。

乘员声称他们被§H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!撞离了航线很远。风暴也烧毁了他们的引擎，让飞船和里面的东西滞留在我们的空间里。

如果我们能帮忙的话，他们愿意交出一部分货物。
excerpt.en:
We have identified the source of the distress signal in the §H[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system as a heavily damaged but still functioning mercantile vessel.

The occupants claim they have been knocked a great distanc

excerpt.zh:
§H[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系内的异常读数源自一片由§H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!的余波所残留下的不寻常的碎片阵列。

这个漂浮的实体是由一团无定形的宇宙污泥在风暴的极端压力下锻造而成。它的无数组成元素形成了一种独特的活性化合物。

对其化学成分的深度研究可以对产生它的条件提供有价值的星际气象学洞见。
excerpt.en:
The erratic sensor readings in the §H[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system are derived from an exceptional debris formation left in the wake of the §H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!.

This drifting entity is an amorphous bl

excerpt.zh:
§H[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中的物体是一颗古老人造卫星的残骸，上面装有复杂的星际气象探测阵列。我们认为它是伴随着§H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!横跨星系漂星过海而来的。

它已严重损坏无法维修，但中央数据库包含了大量的信息贮藏可以为我们所用。

卫星的其余部分就只能作为废品进行打捞了。
excerpt.en: The object in the §H[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system is the wreckage of an ancient satellite equipped with complex astrometeorological sensor arrays. We believe that it was swept a great distance across the galaxy in

excerpt.zh: 我们发现，§H[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系的怪异物体其实是一大团来自某种太空生物的有机残留物。由于所有可供识别的特征都被宇宙风暴撕碎了，所以无法对这些生物碎片进行准确分类。
excerpt.en: The foreign object in the §H[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system was discovered to be a large mass of organic remains originating from some type of spaceborne fauna. Having had any identifiable features shredded apart by

excerpt.zh:
经过了谨慎的解剖，这团肉块究竟属于什么物种仍是个谜。在风暴中心遭受的巨大破坏使它失去了一切可供识别的特征和遗传标记。

然而，在这项研究的过程中，我们获得了对§Y宇宙风暴§!组成的洞见，了解了其对外星生物质的破坏性影响。
excerpt.en:
After careful dissection, the original species of this visceral mass remains a mystery. The extraordinary damage taken in the epicenter of the storm has stripped it of any recognizable features or genetic markers.

Howev

excerpt.zh:
§H[solar_system.GetName]§!星系内的三只缇扬奇信号经过识别后发现是一伙流离失所、营养不良的幼崽。

§Y宇宙风暴§!将这些幼崽与它们的大群分开，迫使他们自力更生。

它们看来不太可能在幽深的太空中存活太久。我们的传感器显示它们整在试图呼叫鲸群，但没有成功。
excerpt.en:
The three Tiyanki signatures in the §H[solar_system.GetName]§! system have been identified as a set of displaced and malnourished calves.

The §YCosmic Storm§! has separated these calves from their larger pod, leaving th

excerpt.zh:
缇扬奇的成兽在听到了三只幼崽被放大的叫声后，再度现身在§H[solar_system.GetName]§!星系中。

年轻的缇扬奇重新回到了鲸群，现在已经恢复了快乐和健康。

母鲸在我们的科研船附近留下了一大堆物质碎片，似乎是在感谢我们的帮助。令我们惊讶的是，这件奇怪的礼物中包含了好几种可用的材料。
excerpt.en:
A Tiyanki cow and bull have both appeared in the §H[solar_system.GetName]§! system having heard the amplified cries of the three displaced calves.

The juvenile Tiyanki have been reintegrated back into their pod, and alr

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一处位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系边缘的远古空间站。其残留的强烈亚空间信号表明其可能是一个§H星门§!之类的东西——理论上能在类似的空间站间组成网状通路，使舰船能瞬移至星系的不同位置。

假如它真是一个星门的话，现在也因为年久失修而无法使用。不过，如果我们能将其修复，星门拥有者将能激活星系中其他星门，使其能在短短数天穿越极远的距离。
excerpt.en: An ancient space station of some kind has been located at the edge of the [gateway_system.GetName] system. The strong residual subspace signature that surrounds the station indicates that it may be a "§HGateway§!" of sor

excerpt.zh:
我们在§H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系附近发现了一座远古亚空间传送门。它似乎是一系列相似的星系网络站点的一部分，当它们可运作时，将允许使用者近乎瞬间地从星系的一处转移到另一处。

在其初始建成之后的某个时间点，它与网络的其余部分间的连接被切断了。它现在只能指示出一个有效的目的地——一片位于我们星系外的未经探索的星域，其被我们的天文学家命名为§HL-星团§!。更耐人寻味的是，这座星门完全是由某种未知设计的微型§
excerpt.en: We have located what we believe could be an ancient subspace Gateway near §H[gateway_system.GetName]§!. It appears to have been part of a galaxy-wide network of similar stations which, when operational, allowed for near-

excerpt.zh:
我们在§H[wormhole_system.GetName]§!星系的边缘疑似发现了一个天然形成的亚空间现象！该处的时空出现了裂隙，从而产生了一个"§H虫洞§!"。据[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]推断，此虫洞也许与星系中的其它虫洞通过亚空间相连。

这也就是说，我们的舰船有可能在数日之内就可以由星系的一端到达另一端，这取决于另外的虫洞的位置。不幸的是这个虫洞和大部分虫洞一样，长时间处于不稳定状态。即使有舰
excerpt.en: We have detected what appears to be a naturally occurring subspace phenomenon on the edge of the §H[wormhole_system.GetName]§! system! A rift in the very fabric of space-time has formed here, creating a "§Hwormhole§!" th

excerpt.zh:
我们的科学家已成功恢复了了位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系星门的能源！虽然这装置年代久远，但还是形成了一个完全可通过的亚空间通路。

我们送去的探测器确认，我们激活此星门的行为也为第二座设施提供了能源。现在，这两个连接的星门是我们当前仅有的两个可以使用的设施，但是很可能在别的地方找到其他的处于休眠状态的设施。将来我们甚至能够在选定的星系重新建造全新的星门。
excerpt.en:
Our scientists have successfully restored power to the ancient Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system! Despite its age, the device has formed a stable subspace conduit that is fully traversable.

The probes we se

excerpt.zh: 我们在[gateway_system.GetName]恒星系完成了我们第一个可以投入使用的星门，这可以被称为是科技和工程的大胜利！星门已形成了稳定的亚空间通路并与星系的其他星门网络成功建立了链接。
excerpt.en: In what can only be described as a triumph of science and engineering, we have finished construction of our first operational Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system! The device has formed a stable subspace condui

excerpt.zh: 我们在§H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系内发现的星门已经恢复供电。它已与星门网络其他部分建立连接，处于正常运转状态。
excerpt.en: Power has been restored to the derelict Gateway that was found in the §H[gateway_system.GetName]§! system. It has been connected to the rest of the Gateway network and is now fully operational.

excerpt.zh: 位于§H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系内的新星门已经建造完毕。它已与其余传送门网络建立稳定的亚空间连接，并且正常运转。
excerpt.en: Construction has concluded on the new Gateway in the §H[gateway_system.GetName]§! system. A stable subspace connection to the rest of the Gateway network has been established, and it is now fully operational.

excerpt.zh: §H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系中为建造星门而准备的深空建造基址已经准备就绪。一旦我们的必要资源准备完毕，星门的正式建造随时都可以动工。
excerpt.en: The deep space construction site for the planned Gateway in the §H[gateway_system.GetName]§! system is now in place. Once we have the necessary resources, construction of the actual Gateway may commence at any time.

excerpt.zh: 以剑与火，燃异端之地。以彼之烬，沃泱泱星河。
excerpt.en: By sword and flame shall heretical worlds burn, and with their ashes shall the galaxy be salted.

records.en: The Gun Pointed at the Head of the Universe

excerpt.zh: 各个领域的著名科学家们终于一起敲定了装备在首批巨像级舰船上的§R歼星级§!武器的最终设计方案。我们能从中选择一种以完成巨像计划的最终阶段。
excerpt.en: Leading scientists across all conceivable fields have at last finalized their proposals for the §RPlanet-Killer§!-class weapon that will arm our first Colossus-type ships. We may select one proposal to develop alongside

excerpt.zh: 巨像计划——设计[Root.GetAdj]历史上最大武器平台、并搭载一门§R[Root.Get1stPlanetKiller]§!的里程碑式任务，已经取得成果，并且接近尾声。
excerpt.en: The Colossus Project, the monumental task of designing the biggest weapons platform in [Root.GetAdj] history and a §R[Root.Get1stPlanetKiller]§! to arm it with, has yielded results and drawn to a close.

excerpt.zh: 我们收到消息说，[From.GetName]已经开发出了巨像——这是一种能完全毁灭行星的武器平台。
excerpt.en: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has developed specifications for a Colossus-type hull configuration, a weapon platform potentially capable of complete planetary destruction.

excerpt.zh: 我们来自大洋深处，我们的物种完美地适应了深海环境下的生活。即使已经迈入星空，我们仍然没有忘记本源：水体是，也永远是我们的家园。如今，我们的飞升已经完成了——我们不再需要适应其他环境，而是改造其他的星球使其适应我们的需求。当新一天的黎明到来时，我们清楚再也没有什么东西可以让我们与海洋分离了。
excerpt.en: We came from the ocean, our species ideally suited to living in the depths of the seas. Even as we take to the stars, we have not abandoned our roots: the water is and shall always be our home. Now, our ascension is comp

records.zh: 发现冰封环境改造候选

excerpt.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]的详尽调查表明这颗行星拥有厚重冰层，因此可以转变为一颗怡人的海洋星球。我们只需将行星大幅度加热，并赋予它可以宜居的大气即可。

对这颗[From.GetPlanetMoon]进行环境改造在理论上是可行的，但我们目前所拥有的技术手段还不足以在有实际意义的时间框架内完成这一里程碑式的任务。
excerpt.en: Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed a world with a sufficiently thick layer of ice that it could be restored into a pleasant ocean world, if rendered significantly warmer and bequeathed with a hospitable a

excerpt.zh:
我们已经杀死了天龙！随着最后一颤，最后一声可怕的怒吼，这头野兽最后的生命力流失竭尽。它的尸体仍然完好无损——但这不会持续太久，因为我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]吵着要拿到它去做实验。

在[dragon_planet.GetName]上，气氛喜忧参半。尽管许多人为击败这个令人恐惧的怪物而欢欣鼓舞，但曾经持续存在的巨龙还是对[This.GetAdj]的心灵产生了深远的影响。从某种意义上说，杀死它就像杀死某个人的神
excerpt.en: We have slain the sky dragon! With one last shudder, one last terrible roar of fury, the last of the beast's life force drained away. Its carcass remains intact - but not for long, as our [This.GetScientistPlural] clamor

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]击杀了天龙！这一可怕的事实导致[dragon_planet.GetName]现在很容易被攻击。
excerpt.en: The [From.GetName] has vanquished the Sky Dragon! As a result of this terrible deed, [dragon_planet.GetName] is now vulnerable to attack.

excerpt.zh: 言出必行，我们的死灵法师已将[dragon_system.GetName]恒星系的天龙复活了！虽然结果有些不太相同——正如某些人预料中的将某物由死变活会发生的那样——现在它急切地等待我们的指令。
excerpt.en: True to their word, our necromancers have returned the Sky Dragon of the [dragon_system.GetName] system to life! Though a little rough around the edges - as one would expect from a being just brought back from the dead -

excerpt.zh: 时光飞逝，我亦疑虑。你们一开始是小生物的时候，我就一直在看着你们：你频繁受挫时我也经常感到绝望，而你屡次成功时我也高兴地咆哮。现在，我发现你已经长大了，你的文明已经成熟，并准备好被委托亲子关系的终极责任了。现在是时候让你们再次奉献自己，来帮我抚养我的孩子们了。
excerpt.en: Time passes, and with it my doubts. From small beginnings have I watched you: often despairing at your frequent impetuity, and yet always roaring in delight at your successes. Now, I find that you have grown, that your c

excerpt.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]观察了天龙，报告称它的内脏似乎发出了巨大的吱吱声。在过去的几个月里，它也异常频繁地在[Root.GetName]周围盘旋，有时会突然掠过大气层的上界，然后再次离开。我们的假设是该生物饿了，希望着陆觅食，就像它过去定期做的那样。不清楚它为什么会犹豫——既然我们已经加入了群星大家庭，也许它想看看我们将如何反应。
excerpt.en: Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] observing the Sky Dragon have reported loud creaking noises seemingly coming from its internal organs. It has also been circling around [Root.GetName] unusually often over the last few mon

excerpt.zh: 龙并没有给我们表现出的敌意好脸色。随着一声巨响——其力量足以在半个星球的范围引发次级地震——巨龙以其冰冷的火焰袭击了[Root.GetName]上的一个人口聚集中心。
excerpt.en: The dragon did not appreciate our show of hostility. With a loud bellow - the force of which was strong enough to cause minor earthquakes across half the planet - the dragon smote a large center of population on [Root.Ge

excerpt.zh:
龙似乎意识到了我们的意图，优雅地俯冲下来，在我们腾出的区域休息。我们留下的大量食物应该有所帮助，必须说——龙在那上面以惊人地贪婪躺平了。

我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]正在远处观察它。
excerpt.en: The dragon appeared to realize our intentions, and gracefully swooped down to rest in the area we had vacated. The large supply of food we left behind probably helped, it must be said - the dragon has laid into it with a

excerpt.zh:
在行星上来回几次之后，这条龙显然认为可以安全着陆。尽管它选择了一个僻静的区域，但仍有一些[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被杀死，还有更多人流离失所——鉴于其令人难以置信的体型和贪婪的胃口，这并不奇怪。

它现在已经安顿下来，并以惊人的速度摧毁当地的动植物群。当地居民正与之保持距离。
excerpt.en: After several further passes of the planet, the dragon apparently decided it was safe to land. Although it picked a secluded area, a number of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were killed and even more displaced - unsur

excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]的丰收中饱食数年之后，现在明显更壮的天龙再次起飞。随着最后致敬的吼声，它升空了——留下了大量的鳞片、脱落的皮肤和其他因它的存在而产生的副产物。
excerpt.en: After several years of gorging itself on the bountiful harvests of [Root.GetName], the now considerably girthier Sky Dragon has once again taken flight. With a final roar in salute, it lifted off - leaving behind a large

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]恒星系中的舰队报告说，在恒星系内遨游的那条龙正在攻击我们的舰船！目前还不清楚它是故意加入[From.Owner.GetAdj]防御战争，还是只是因为我们侵犯了它的领土而对我们感到愤怒。可以肯定的是，如果我们打算夺取[here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]，就必须击败它！
excerpt.en: Our fleets in the [From.GetName] system report that the dragon roaming the system is attacking our ships! It is unclear whether it is deliberately joining the [From.Owner.GetAdj] defense, or if it is simply angry at us f

excerpt.zh: 天龙似乎不愿坐视[From.GetAdj]入侵[here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]的行动。它呼啸而起，喷吐出冰焰毁灭了敌人的舰队！
excerpt.en: The Sky Dragon seems to have taken a dim view of [From.GetAdj] efforts to invade [here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]. It soars to our defense, breathing icy destruction upon their fleets!

excerpt.zh:
既然我们已经在理解异种生物学和异星材料方面取得了一些进展，我们的研究人员提议派出科研船对龙进行更进一步的观察。他们对龙鳞格外感兴趣，这些龙鳞十分耐用——甚至无法穿透。虽然我们已经获得了大量自然脱落的样本，我们的科学家对龙鳞如何形成仍然感到困惑。若是使用所谓的“轻微深入”探针，科学家们相信他们可以进入其保护层的下方，直接研究龙鳞的自然过程。

当然，龙不会介意的……当然如此。
excerpt.en: Now that we have made some progress understanding xenobiology and exotic materials, our researchers have proposed that we send a science ship to take a closer look at the dragon. They are particularly interested in its s

excerpt.zh:
尽管这条龙专注地看着我们的科研船，但当我们多次对其进行深度扫描时，它没有作出任何反应——以目前的技术水平，这是我们能够做到的最彻底的扫描。这些扫描使我们对龙的生物过程有了新的洞见，可是其鳞片之下的秘密仍然像以前一样难以捉摸。

虽然我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]被迫就这件事承认失败，但他们向我们保证，他们仍能把获得的知识好好加以利用。
excerpt.en: Though the dragon watched our science vessel attentively, it did not react as we subjected it to several deep scans - the most thorough we are capable of at our current level of technology. They provided us with fresh in

excerpt.zh: 龙似乎饿了。又也许它今天就是心情不好。在我们的舰船接近它的时候，这条龙呲牙低吼，§R嚼着牙§!骤然间猛冲向前，不留做出规避动作的时间。我们的科研船现在没剩多少残骸了——至少在龙的肚子之外没剩多少。
excerpt.en: It appears the dragon was hungry. Or maybe it was just having a bad day. As our vessel approached it, the dragon snarled and abruptly lunged forward in a §Rchomping§! motion, leaving no time for evasive maneuvers. Little

excerpt.zh: 龙放任我们的科研船靠近，但随着探针发射，它用尾巴以不可思议的力量§H猛击§!舰船。值得注意的是，虽然舰船因此越过了半个恒星系，它几乎完好无损，舰上也没有报告人员伤亡。不管怎么说，龙明显不太高兴。
excerpt.en: The dragon tolerated our science ship's approach, but as the probe was launched, it used its tail to §Hswat§! our vessel out of the way with incredible force. Remarkably, although the ship was vaulted halfway across the

excerpt.zh: 正当我们的舰船第二次接近龙的时候，它勃然而动，鼻腔中喷射出寒光，如飞梭一般直奔[dragon_colony.GetName]！防御系统还来不及启动，它就暴怒地向这颗行星的北半球倾泻出它的寒冰之息，顷刻间摧毁了多个大型人口中心。
excerpt.en: As our vessel approached the dragon for the second time, the dragon sprang into action. Nostrils flaring, it darted away, heading directly towards [dragon_colony.GetName]! Before our defense systems could react, it furio

excerpt.zh:
我们的探针牢牢抓住龙，发现了它鳞片间的一个狭小缝隙并灵巧地钻了进去时，龙愤怒地低吼着。在[Root.GetName]准备强制超光速以回避被激怒的龙的时候，探针已经开始收录令人称奇的数据了。从这些数据中我们发现，其鳞片之所以如此强韧，是由于它在高速进入[dragon_colony.GetName]大气层的过程中，激活的一系列复杂的酶促反应造成的。

虽然还有许多未解之谜，我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]算是弄清
excerpt.en: The dragon snarled in fury as our probe latched onto it and swiftly located and burrowed into a minute gap between its scales. While the [Root.GetName] was forced to engage emergency FTL to avoid the displeased dragon, t

excerpt.zh: 在我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]和[This.Owner.GetLinguists]排查了所有同龙进行交互的已知记录之后，他们准备进行数项实验以测试它的反应。他们保证所有的动作都是经过了仔细的论证，一旦龙表现出哪怕是最轻微的不满，所有活动都会立刻中止。
excerpt.en: As our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] and [This.Owner.GetLinguists] trawl through the records of known interactions with the dragon, they have prepared a few experiments to test its responses. They assure us that every move

excerpt.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]还在为龙的发声这一科研难题在艰苦奋战。尽管他们心里抱着希望，期冀马上就能突破，然而在我们和这样一只体型庞大的太空飞龙之间寻找能够作为参考的共同框架，可能本身就存在着极大的困难，这使得这样的障碍更加不可逾越。

这可能会造成沮丧的气氛，尽管这并不是源于龙的行为本身：它对于我们的科研船闯入它的领域展现出了惊人的耐心。根据它喉咙活动产生的韵律，它正不断地产生同一组声门震动——吼叫或者哭喊
excerpt.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] remain stumped by the dragon's utterances. Though they are hopeful that a breakthrough is just around the corner, the difficulties inherent in finding a common frame of reference between our

excerpt.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]报告了令人咋舌的突破。就在他们绝望地以为永远无法理解龙的时候，他们将它不断涨落的身体能量辐射转置成为了声音波形。随后他们聆听了结果，他们简直不敢相信自己的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]。毫无疑问：龙在讲我们的语言，只不过使用的是不同的媒介。它的吼叫，事实上，只是想要引起我们的注意，而不是试图进行交流。

根据已有的知识，我们的[This.O
excerpt.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] report an astounding breakthrough. Despairing at ever being able to understand the dragon, they transposed the spectral map of its fluctuating corporal energy emissions to acoustic waveforms

excerpt.zh: 龙发表了一段冗长的谩骂，谈及了它在数个纪元积累的智慧，以及它观察我们对时间和使命的态度——甚至都懒得提我们对宇宙的基础那肤浅得可悲的理解。很明显它认为我们太年轻，太单纯，太鲁莽，在现阶段还配不上这个任务。
excerpt.en: The dragon launches into a lengthy diatribe about the wisdom it has accumulated over the eons, and its observations regarding our attitude toward time and commitments - not to mention our still-pitiful knowledge of the f

excerpt.zh: 我们不太清楚哪里出了差错，但是我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]看上去引得龙颜大怒。一声威震天穹的怒吼之后，这头生物将致命的龙息倾泻在他们的舰船之上，杀死了[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]——同时给我们试图理解它的工作造成了重大的挫折。
excerpt.en: We are not quite sure what went wrong, but our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] seem to have displeased the dragon. With a mighty roar, the creature unleashed its deadly breath upon their vessel, killing [This.Owner.GetEnvoy]

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetName]汇报在[From.GetName]星系目击了一条骇人的太空巨龙！

这个恒星系似乎是[From.Owner.GetName]的中心，其中一颗行星显示出拥有稠密人口的痕迹。

目前为止，这条龙还没对我们采取行动，也没有与这个恒星系中的另一群居民存在冲突的迹象。也许我们最好还是别管他们吧。
excerpt.en:
The [This.GetName] reports sighting a terrifying space dragon in the [From.GetName] system!

The system also appears to be a center of the [From.Owner.GetName], with one of the planets in the system showing signs of part

excerpt.zh:
我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]在一座晶莹剔透的冻湖边扎营。由于光源充足，人们甚至可以看见冰面之下的幽魂之塔透出点点微光。它们自湖床向上延伸，仿佛坚实的卷须。

我们资历尚浅的探险队成员依然在如此刺骨、严苛的寒冷中不停地工作。尽管条件艰苦，我们的挖掘却进展的很顺利。我们已经发现了好几个气阀，都是为原始的水下舰艇而设计成的港口。然而，我们却没有在现场发现这些舰艇的踪影。不管这些高塔的住民是留下来还是逃走了，港口上
excerpt.en: Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] have set their camps around the edges of a glassy, frozen lake. Under sufficient light, one may catch glimpses of spectral towers underneath. They grasp upwards from the lake bed like stead

excerpt.zh:
随着我们进一步从各种各样的冰层定居点上移走大冰块，我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]在停泊塔处发现了一座原始的计算机终端。它那易碎的金属外壳看上去被……咬了个扎实。

这个终端在经过一些轻微的修理之后，顺利地启动了。定居点数据网络的大部仍然处于下线状态，但是我们可以从本地缓存中的股权证明、个人文件，还有一些看上去是任务日志的文件中推断出很多情报。
excerpt.en: As we continue to remove large sections of ice from around the various icebound habitats, our [owner.GetScientistPlural] at the docking tower have discovered a primitive computer terminal. Its brittle metal casing appear

excerpt.zh:
我们对[from.planet.GetName]上古代定居点的知识愈发深刻，我们的忧虑也更加浓厚。我们之前发现的只是一处前哨殖民地的残垣——属于某个文明的遗迹，这个文明长久以来被世间遗忘，我们甚至都辨识不出他们的名字。

在这个星球，海洋占据着绝对主导的地位。各种不同团体的殖民者从母星被带到这个星球，应征成为水下先遣队成员。他们的目标：建立殖民地，开发这颗行星的自然资源。然而，他们的现实却是一场未加约束的生物学实验、剧烈的政治变动，以及
excerpt.en: Our knowledge of the ancient settlement on [from.planet.GetName] deepens, but so too does our concern. What we have uncovered is the remains of a frontier colony - a remnant of a civilization so long forgotten, we cannot

excerpt.zh:
这是一个被墨冰包围的洞穴，在里面我们发现了一艘瘫痪烧毁的古老潜艇残骸。这个烧焦的洞穴让残骸得以避开这颗星球上最为恶劣的冻融循环，将这群船员遭受灭顶之灾的惨状完好地保留了下来。

该潜艇落后的核引擎上有过紧急维修的迹象。在船员舱中，我们发现了划痕以及化学物质灼烧留下的微量残留。潜艇上所有的逃生仓当时都已派出，不过有一个被卡在了附近休眠的火山口中。

这艘残骸上可供收集的东西不多，但这群船员原先的目的地——一座殖民地§Y补给仓库§!依旧完好
excerpt.en: Blackened ice surrounds the cave in which we found the crumpled, burnt wreckage of an ancient submarine. Sheltered from the worst of this planet's freeze-thaw cycles, this scorched cave has preserved evidence of multiple

excerpt.zh:
我们在厚重的冰层中挖掘出了一条隧道，在一个密闭洞穴中找到了一艘潜艇的完整残骸。冻土带的环境将所有有机物都化为了齑粉，但是也让许多古迹完好保存下来。

我们的人类学研究表明，当船员们逃离附近的殖民地后，这艘潜艇便成了孕育了诸多政治活动的温床。它们在船舱内部各自划分了数个主权边界，并分别支持不同类型的政治主张。令人震惊的是，这种极端的派系划分不仅没有使船员分裂，反而加强了船员之间的社会联系。这个研究肯定会在我们的主攻政治学的科学家们引发激烈
excerpt.en: We have tunnelled through significant quantities of ice to find the intact wreckage of a submarine, sealed within an airtight cave. Tundral conditions have long since reduced all organic matter to fine dust, but so too h

excerpt.zh:
我们本以为如此古老的遗骸在漫长的岁月中早已被破坏，谁知道由于当时的急速冻结，保护了遗骸的上半部分。随之一起保存下来的还有许多生物的尸体，其中一些貌似是当地的巨大又凶猛的捕食性动物。其他穿着防护服的智慧生物似乎是那些猎食者的猎物。

这些潜艇上的船员并不是[fromfrom.planet.GetName]本地人。我们的解剖表明，他们将当地生物的基因拼接融入到自己体内。至于这群殖民者为什么要这样广泛地进行自我改造，恐怕我们只能自己想象了。但
excerpt.en: We had expected such an ancient wreck to have been crushed long ago. Instead we find that this stricken hulk was flash-frozen, preserving its superstructure along with the corpses of numerous creatures. Some of these app

excerpt.zh:
在尽我们所能调查了潜艇残骸和废弃居住区后，我们在[from.planet.GetName]的队伍正准备于行星地表附近重整。这里的殖民地尚有太多未知。我们找到的东西大多只相当于五花八门的遗物，它们的原主人曾在格外孤独、边远的地方生活。

尽管缺少超光速旅行的能力，这些古代潜艇居民们引导我们在其他领域取得了可观的突破。他们经历艰险取得了这些发现，我们会力求不再经历诸如此类的磨难。
excerpt.en: Having surveyed all we can from the wrecked submarine and abandoned habitats, our teams on [from.planet.GetName] are preparing to regroup near the planet's surface. There is much we still do not know about this colony. M

excerpt.zh:
我们对地表进行扫描后确定了一些有价值的矿藏，其中埋有不计其数的不同物种的遗骸。有些甚至与目前仍生活在这颗星球上的一些生物相仿，其他的则与我们所见过的生物截然不同。

尽管这项工作并不容易，周围的野生动物也被我们惊扰，但[leader.GetName]还是已经有了重要的发现，并成功地重建了一些已经灭绝的物种。但这也反过来引起了研究团队的一些争论。其中一些人想展出这些标本，而另一些则更愿意进一步研究这些材料，毕竟这些化石已经是保存状况最好的
excerpt.en:
We scanned the surface and found a few promising deposits, filled with the remains of a variety of different species. Some resemble those still living on the surface, while others are nothing like we have seen before.

A

excerpt.zh: 我们已经开展了充分的研究，探明了化石物种和[from.planet.GetName]当前生物圈中各物种之间的关系。结果证明，它们中的一些属于同一属种，具有许多相似性。进一步的研究或许能够带给我们更多答案。
excerpt.en: We have done extensive research to determine the relationship of fossil species to the current biosphere on [from.planet.GetName]. It turns out that some of them belong to the same genus, having many similarities. Furthe

excerpt.zh: 不少人前来参观我们的展览。尽管我们不能将收集到的东西用于研究，但我们还是吸引到了几位慷慨的赞助商，将这些化石送去举办行星际巡回展览。展品的异星外观在那些对外星考古学有兴趣的人中间引起了小规模的热烈反响。
excerpt.en: Quite a few people came to our exhibition. Although we can't use the collected material for our research, we attracted some generous funders and sent the fossils on an interplanetary tour. The alien appearance of exhibit

excerpt.zh:
将第一个考古遗址彻底翻遍之后，我们决定转移到更加偏僻的地方，搜寻更多可供研究用的材料。[leader.GetName]找到了一个相当好的地点，此处是一个洞穴，被一些有智慧但已经灭绝的物种用作居所。在谨慎的探索和检查之后，我们发现了一些非同寻常的事情：不管住在这个洞穴里的是何方神圣，这种生物会使用一种精妙的染料，在光和热的作用下会显出颜色。

我们已经识别出两种彩绘：一种讲述过去的故事，另一种描绘了日常生活。不幸的是，由于我们的闯入，让彩
excerpt.en: Exhausting the first site, we decided to move to more remote places in search of more material for research. [leader.GetName] found a good enough spot, a cave that served as a home for some intelligent extinct species. C

excerpt.zh: 我们获取的彩绘讲述了这个物种的过往，给予我们许多有关它们历史的新认识。看上去，这些穴居者同某个高级文明进行了接触，这在某种程度上影响了它们的外形和发展路线。根据这些生物的外形描述，我们猜测该物种能够快速地进行基因变异，几代之内其外表就会发生显著变化。
excerpt.en: We captured drawings related to the past and gained insight into the species' history. It appears that these cave dwellers came into contact with an advanced civilization that somewhat influenced their looks and developm

excerpt.zh: 我们获取的彩绘讲述了这个物种的日常生活，给予我们许多有关它们历史的新认识。彩绘将穴居者描绘成一群外形看上去迥乎不同，但智力水平相近的物种，正在参加复杂的仪式。[leader.GetName]假设，这是各种各样的生物沐浴在神明的圣光之下，为祂工作，以换取神赐的自由。
excerpt.en: We captured drawings related to daily life and gained insight into the history of the species. They depict cave dwellers as a conglomeration of different-looking but similarly intelligent species who participated in comp

excerpt.zh:
我们进一步探索这个洞穴的裂缝深处，来到了一处人工岩室，里面有一个古怪的骨质结构。鉴于这个结构当前的状态，它看上去好像发生了坍塌，然后沉到了地里面——可能是一场地震导致的。[Leader.GetName]下令在原地扎营，我们也已在周边进行了一些探测，但地面并不是很稳定。一旦我们进入内部，我们可能不会有充足的时间对这个结构进行彻底的检查。

对我们的研究来说，最大的潜在成果就是这座建筑本身。我们可以研究这种精巧的类骨物质，或者将精力放在探索
excerpt.en: Exploring further into the deep chasms of the cave, we came across a grotto with a strange bone structure inside. Given the current state of the structure, it looks like it collapsed and sank into the ground - probably a

excerpt.zh:
在经过波澜不惊的研究之后，[Leader.GetName]得出的结论是这座建筑曾经是……活着的。当然不是现在，而是很多年前，在它被创造出来的某个时候。一大堆骨和组织被粘合在了一起，建造出了这样一栋建筑，能够根据特定的需求变形。考虑到这座建筑坍塌的方式，我们或许甚至可以假设这是结构的这一部分故意执行的行为。

不幸的是，我们在研究过程中不小心破坏了这个结构，它坍塌得更加厉害了，致使这座建筑无法用于我们的进一步研究。[Leader.GetN
excerpt.en: After uneventful research, [Leader.GetName] concluded that the building was... alive. Not now, but years ago, sometime during its creation. It was a mass of bones and tissues molded together to create a building that cou

excerpt.zh:
这个阴森的结构内部原来是一座迷宫，满是半坍塌的廊道，地上到处都是四散分布的类骨物质。在历经磨难之后，我们设法取出了几样工具和物体，这些都昭示着某个复合的文化势力曾一度生活在这个行星上。它们或许能够提供给我们新的认识，让我们了解这些灭绝的物种究竟是怎样的生命。

不幸的是，在我们的研究过程中，不小心破坏了这个结构，它坍塌得更加厉害了，致使这座建筑无法用于我们得进一步研究。[Leader.GetName]下令小队继续前进。
excerpt.en: The interior of this creepy structure turned out to be a maze of half-collapsed corridors filled with bone-like material lying everywhere. With some difficulty, we were able to extract several tools and objects that indi

excerpt.zh:
我们终于抵达了洞穴的最里面。我们进入了某座深深地埋在地底下、看上去像是古旧的废弃地堡一样的建筑。它看上去同我们先前找到的任何东西都不一样：我们只能假设是某些外星访客在这里设置了一个研究实验室。根据破旧的地堡、各种各样的骨头、还有四散的化石，显然他们以前也在研究这些物种，正同我们现在做的一样……唯一的区别是，他们能够趁着这些物种还活着的时候，在它们身上做各种实验。

我们刚一恢复考古遗址和数据库的电源供给，[Leader.GetName]
excerpt.en: We finally reached the end of the cave. We entered something that resembled an old abandoned bunker built deep underground. It doesn't look like anything we've found before: we assume alien visitors set up a research lab

excerpt.zh:
我们将先前研究中得到的知识和数据库中的信息进行了比照。得出的结论让人寒颤。很显然，几千年前，某个能够太空航行的文明降落到了这个星球上，发现这些土生土长的物种在使用了他们掌握的基因操纵技术后，能够很容易地驯服。最开始，他们将有智慧的人群——尽管尚未完全开发——土人奴役，并且在它们身上进行各种各样的实验。这些实验包括为了建造目的将它们转化为活体建材。除此之外还有顺从的奴隶。甚至宠物或者牲口。

我们先前发现的实例很有可能就是这些物种的遗体，
excerpt.en: We compared our knowledge from previous studies to the information from the databanks. The conclusion we made is disconcerting. It appears that thousands of years ago, a space-faring civilization landed on this world and

excerpt.zh: 我们并不是第一个在§Y[From.Planet.System.GetName]§!恒星系发现该碎片环带的：我们发现了一架小到被我们[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]戏称为“太空小屋”的飞船，里面有一具毒物类外星人的遗骸和无数的数据水晶。根据腐坏的程度推断，这名外星人最有可能是在短短几个世纪前去世的。
excerpt.en: We are not the first to discover the debris belt in the §Y[From.Planet.System.GetName]§! system: a craft - so small that our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] are dubbing it a "space cabin" - has been found, containing the rem

excerpt.zh:
在外星人的太空小屋里发现的数据水晶实际上是一些任务日志。我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]已经发回了一个样本及其简单翻译。它开头的的语调振奋人心：

“这是一生中绝无仅有的好机会。传说中奥德瑞斯基亚水触手可及。我的新家有点差强人意，但对我已经很满足了，因为我很快就可以寄回家足够的钱付给女儿治病了。”

然而很快，日志就变得酸楚了起来：

“妻子和女儿都死了。世上不再有人会悼念我。在黑市上贩卖打捞所得仅仅足以维持
excerpt.en:
The data crystals discovered in the alien's space cabin are in fact mission logs. Our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] have sent us a sample, along with a preliminary translation. They start in an upbeat tone:

随着这名外星人滑入疯狂的深渊，日志的内容也变得越来越令人毛骨悚人。

The logs become increasingly disturbing as the alien slips further and further into madness.

excerpt.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]完成了对外星人日志水晶的翻译。他们呈递了最后一份日志的翻译，这份日志是在该外星人死前不久记录下的，记录者罕见地意识清醒：

“我终于找到了我一直苦苦追寻的东西。很多人会觉得我花这么多年找来找去跟疯了一样。我觉得，可能这些人也没错。我已经快老死了，我的亲朋好友也早都入土了。不管找到了什么宝贝，现在把它卖了也毫无意义，但我应该可以安息了。”

日志后面附上了这位外星人找到宝藏的位置
excerpt.en: Our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] have finished translating the alien's data crystals. They present an interpretation of the last log, in which, not long before their death, the recorder experiences a rare moment of lucidi

excerpt.zh:
[From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]上的废弃观测站似乎在报废前不久被改为他用。尽管上面还有用于监视行星居民的设备的证据，但看来大部分都改成了夏瑞诺伊的历史博物馆。奇怪的是，明明这是一个好斗的物种，但是关于暴力的主题被刻意回避了，展品主要集中在一些关于和平和生育的仪式上。

在中控室发现了一系列数据水晶。显然这就是我们想要找的东西。
excerpt.en: The abandoned observation post above [From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName] appears to have been repurposed shortly before it was abandoned. Though there is equipment to surveil the inhabitants of the planet in evidence, most of i

excerpt.zh:
第一块数据水晶已经完成了翻译。其封面上写着“这是夏瑞诺伊民族的记录，系女先知伊蒂卡里奥斯所留，这样那些可能找到它的人能原谅我们的罪过。”

其后是一份历史、哲学和艺术工作的合辑，可能是由一个比较标准但稍微好斗的晚工业革命社会所创。我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]将其发回[Owner.Capital.GetName]以进行进一步研究。
excerpt.en:
The first crystal has been translated. It is prefaced with the words "This is the record of the Charynoi people, left behind by the Prophetess Ithikarios, so that those who might find it may forgive us our sins."

What f

excerpt.zh:
“现在我将叙述一切是如何走向错误——我们最初陷入傲慢罪恶的地方，”伊蒂卡里奥斯宣称。

第二颗晶体记录了夏瑞诺伊是如何逐渐揭开太空飞行的奥秘，似乎比[Root.Owner.GetName]早了大约一百年。他们在自己的星系中发现了两颗美丽的行星，并得出结论认为这些行星是神灵留给他们的产业，是他们与生俱来的权利，他们现在正在索取这些权利。

伊蒂卡里奥斯用惊恐的语气讲述了这些早期探索的黑暗面：在他们的新殖民地中，初生的文明并不愿意放弃他们的
excerpt.en:
"Now I shall recount where it all went wrong - where we first fell to the sin of arrogance," declaims Ithikarios.

The second crystal recounts how the Charynoi gradually uncovered the mysteries of space flight, seemingly

excerpt.zh:
最终，我们耗尽了我们所拥有的空间。我们知道虫洞的存在，但是它们无法被我们研究。我们的领土物产丰富景色优美，很容易让我们相信自己是天之选民。虫洞是一种考验，只要通过了考验，我们就能将自己的种族传遍整个星系，这是我们的神圣使命。

我曾经是那些试图履行这个职责的首领之一。当灵感降临在我身上——我意识到掌握了打开虫洞的钥匙——我便在祖先神社中祈祷了几天。最终得到了启示：我们不配。如果我们穿过虫洞，我们只会找到痛苦。艾斯法瑞尔将被清除，作为我们
excerpt.en: "Eventually, we exhausted the confines of the space we had been bequeathed. We knew of the existence of the Wormhole, but it defied our study. Our realm was so bountiful, so full of beauty, that it was not hard to convin

excerpt.zh: 得益于我们[Owner.GetResearchers]的努力，伊蒂卡里奥斯想要用来包围[FromFrom.GetName]的护盾完成了。她的夏瑞诺伊子民终于可以得到安宁。
excerpt.en: Thanks to the efforts of our [Owner.GetResearchers], the shield Ithikarios attempted to erect over [FromFrom.GetName] has been completed. Her Charynoi descendants can now find peace.

excerpt.zh:
宏伟的圣殿与损毁的神庙点缀在首都之上。而更深入的探索揭示出这个文明早在五十多万年前就被毁灭了。

根据几幅保存得相当完好的壁画被发现，原住民似乎在生物学上接近鸟类。对他们语言的初步音译表明，他们称自己为“克拉祖拉”。
excerpt.en:
Grand sanctums and ruined temples dot the landscape of the capital. A deeper exploration has revealed that this civilization was destroyed more than half a million years ago.

Based on the discovery of several remarkably

excerpt.zh:
进一步的挖掘带来了一个惊人的发现：一个如此巨大的洞穴，足以容纳这个行星上较小的一些山脉。尽管它的建筑规模令人敬畏，但这个“大厅”却没有明显的功能，只有一个出入口。

这个大致呈球形的大厅内壁上遗留有强力的维度扭曲的证据；可以合理得出结论，这个密室是围绕虫洞或其他亚空间传送门的。

更重要的是，大殿外蚀刻的一幅壁画提供了一个令人难以置信的发现：这颗行星不是别的正是斯卡拉维德，是著名的舰队司令斯克兰德·夏普比克的祖先的居住地！
excerpt.en: Further excavation has resulted in a startling discovery: a chamber so massive it could house one of the planet's smaller mountains. Despite the awesome scale of its construction, this 'Grand Hall' serves no apparent fun

excerpt.zh:
你找到了斯卡拉维德。我本以为我永远地失去了家园。

有机会我会把我的爪子插入它的土里，感受着温暖的南风吹拂我的羽毛... 你为我和我的人民所做的一切都无法估量。

我的身体和心灵都感到焕然一新。我对你心怀感激。
excerpt.en:
You have found Skravird. I thought my home lost forever.

To have the chance to set my talons into its ground, to feel the warm south wind blowing through my feathers... What you have done for me and for my people is bey

excerpt.zh:
我们已经确定了这个克拉祖拉并非来自我们维度。他们通过某种类型的传送门抵达这里，发现自己漂流到一个陌生的外星星系中。很久以后，他们在到达的地点周围建造了这个大厅。

仅存的几份记录表明，他们认为自己是伟大而神秘力量的仲裁者。他们的最高领袖，被称为“亚库拉”，被认为是一种独立的个体，每一代都会转移到一个新的身体里。

在大厅下面，我们挖出了几位统治者的遗骸。有趣的是，最早的统治者与后面的统治者有着不同的基因结构。似乎是前往这个宇宙的旅程的影
excerpt.en: We have established that the Krazura were not native to our dimension. Arriving through a portal of some kind, they found themselves adrift in a strange and alien galaxy. Much later, the Grand Hall was built around their

excerpt.zh:
克拉祖拉最初是我们宇宙中的难民。然而，在大殿附近发现的记录表明，他们迅速建立起了一个强大的星际帝国。他们的人民在多个世代的时间里保持着繁荣昌盛。亚库拉的能力和至高无上的地位毋庸置疑。然后，“威胁”出现了。

这个无名的敌人和他们以前遇到的敌人都不一样，似乎一心要毁灭他们。亚库拉这个最伟大的圣贤们在这强大的威胁面前无能为力，他们强大的才能变得毫无用处。
excerpt.en: The Krazura started out as refugees in our universe. Nevertheless, records discovered near the Grand Hall show that they quickly established themselves as a powerful interstellar empire. For many generations they enjoyed

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一批记录，为了解克拉祖拉的命运提供了线索。

指挥他们海军旗舰的是一位传奇的舰队司令，他是他人民的伟大英雄。在被外星威胁取得最后的胜利之前，他和他的船员们被派遣执行了最后且大胆的任务。为了绕过敌人，他们进入了一个未经测试的星门。自此，这艘船和它的船员们便再也没有了任何音讯。

这中间发生了什么仍然是一个谜。这艘舰船是否仍有存在可能？
excerpt.en:
We have uncovered a cache of records that offer clues as to the fate of the Krazura.

Commanding their navy's flagship was a legendary Admiral, a great hero of his people. Before the alien Menace could achieve a final vi

excerpt.zh:
尽管整体进度迟滞不前，我们的[owner.GetResearchers]还是发现了一个以前未被发现的房间。在里面，有一座庞大的雕像，壮观又美丽。

形态是鸟类，长而有力的脖子由金属链条构成，不知为何能够悬浮在上面。锐利的羽毛从仪态端庄的颅骨上迸发出来，它黄金般的眼睛象征着权利。在穿过大厅时，[owner.GetResearchers]有一种不舒服的感觉，仿佛在被人窥视。

他们在这个雕像后面发现了一个隐藏的门或封印，不管这只不祥之鸟是在
excerpt.en:
Even as overall progress stalled, our [owner.GetResearchers] revealed the entrance to a previously undiscovered chamber. Inside was a massive statue, as imposing as it is beautiful.

Avian in form, its long, powerful nec

excerpt.zh:
根据我们迄今为止的发现，这个文明对于悲剧并不陌生。

储存在某种地下墓室或陵墓里的古老记录详细描述了一场大规模瘟疫的爆发，这场瘟疫以一种特别可怕的方式影响着这个鸟类物种的生理特征。

最初，表现为羽毛上的问题，病毒导致羽毛从根部开始腐烂。在几天内，这些病症就会扩散到了血液中。尽管我们无法确定，但初步估计将死亡率超过30%。

一座令人心酸的纪念碑竖立在了城市中心的一个广场上。在一堆骨头上，一只骷髅鸟绝望地看着天空，它掉落的羽毛散落在一对
excerpt.en:
Based on what we have discovered thus far, this civilization was no stranger to tragedy.

Ancient records stored in some kind of crypt or mausoleum detail the emergence of a great plague, one which afflicted the species'

excerpt.zh:
首席考古学家[leader.GetName]最近变得越来越孤僻。[leader.GetHeSheCap]像是对研究项目越来越漠不关心，反而沉迷于那些迄今为止发现的所有日记与日志。[leader.GetHeSheCap]还总是嘟囔着：“这些人该有多孤独啊。”

这也许是荒凉的挖掘现场的造成的负面影响。我们可以为整个小队提供一下心理咨询，或者相信[leader.GetName]，让[leader.GetHisHer]在工作中想出解决方法。
excerpt.en: Chief archaeologist [leader.GetName] has been growing steadily more withdrawn of late. [leader.GetHeSheCap] appear[leader.GetSXX] less invested in our research goals, choosing instead to obsess over the various diaries a

excerpt.zh:
首席考古学家[absconded_archaeologist.GetName]现在不知所踪，随[absconded_archaeologist.GetHimHer]一同消失的还有一大批人类学数据。队员汇报称一辆地面载具失踪，不过我们的保护服还留在基地里。

[absconded_archaeologist.GetName]有可能跑到冻土带的另一处潜艇居住地去了。不过出于实际考虑，我们必须做好最坏的打算。
excerpt.en: Chief archaeologist [absconded_archaeologist.GetName] has absconded, taking a sizeable portion of our anthropological data with [absconded_archaeologist.GetHimHer]. The team reports one ground vehicle missing, but all ou

excerpt.zh: 考古学家[leader.GetName]付出了惨重的代价。尽管大家看上去相当疲惫，但[leader.GetHeShe]还是重新回到了团队之中，并提出了一个令人信服的猜想。我们似乎忽略了几个个人文件汇总中的微妙细节。总之，这些线索将协助我们，带来团队一直期望的突破。
excerpt.en: A heavy toll has been exacted upon archaeologist [leader.GetName]. Though they appear quite haggard now, [leader.GetHeShe] has rejoined the team and presented a compelling hypothesis. It seems we had overlooked several s

excerpt.zh:
[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的发掘小队正紧跟着[owner.capital_scope.GetName]上[owner.GetResearchers]的工作步伐，尝试着用各种新方法挖掘坚固的冻土层。地面团队已经部署了一台原型挖掘机，其设计很大程度上参考了环境改造技术。

早期试验表明，这台机器将迅速推进我们的工作进程。不过，团队成员已经发现了§H一些风险§!。如果我们要尝试控制风险，则需要拨付额外的资金。
excerpt.en: The excavation team on [fromfrom.planet.GetName] has been working closely with our [owner.GetResearchers] on [owner.capital_scope.GetName], trying out novel solutions for work in harsh tundra. The ground team has deploye

excerpt.zh:
我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。

这是一个晶态球状物体，与我们开发的§Y裂隙探球§!技术极其相似，该技术使我们能够探索其他维度。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大的未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有价值的关于维度旅行的珍贵线索。
excerpt.en:
We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].

It is a crystalline spherical object most similar to the §YRift Sphere§! technology we have developed that allows us to explore

excerpt.zh:
我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。

我们对它的目的和来源不甚知晓。或许，借由未来研究的进展，我们能够找到如何使用它的线索。
excerpt.en:
We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].

We are unsure of its purpose or origin. Perhaps with some future research we can gain insight on how to approach it.

excerpt.zh:
在§H[From.GetName]§!内附近的§H晶体裂隙§!处出现了一个异常的虫洞。

我们只能推测这是无形异使打开的一个星门，为他们带来援军。我们检测到另一侧的恒星系已经从其他地方被拉入我们的位面。

如果我们选择进入这个地方，我们应该准备我们最强大的舰队。
excerpt.en:
An anomalous wormhole has appeared nearby the §HCrystal Rift§!, in §H[From.GetName]§!.

We can only assume that it is a gateway opened by the Formless to bring them aid. We detect the system on the other side has been pu

excerpt.zh:
我们在§H[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]§!恒星系中发现的异常虫洞正在剧烈波动。传感器检测到它是通往星系中心的直接通道。

这怎么可能？
excerpt.en:
The anomalous wormhole we discovered in the §H[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]§! system is fluctuating wildly. Sensors detect it is a direct pathway to the center of the galaxy.

How is that possible?

excerpt.zh:
[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的细缝发生了失稳，打开了一道通往其他时空的裂隙。

我们应当小心应对。
excerpt.en:
The dimensional scar in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system has destabilized, opening a rift into another place and time.

We should approach with caution.

excerpt.zh:
我们的人终于抵近到触手可及天空中裂缝的地方了。

也许花点时间研究其性质便可以找到进一步探索的方法。我们完全无从得知在它里面到底有什么。
excerpt.en:
Our people have finally reached far enough to touch the scar in our skies.

Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

excerpt.zh:
我们已经揭开了关于如何收集储存这种构成我们宇宙边界的星界物质形成的缥缈丝线的秘密。

这种珍贵稀有的资源可以以诸多方式使用，使我们大受裨益。
excerpt.en:
We have unlocked the secrets behind gathering and containing the volatile threads of astral material that make up the very border of this universe.

This valuable and rare resource can be applied in various ways that wil

excerpt.zh:
我们失去了对[FromFrom.GetName]星系的控制，一并也失去了其中所含的时空裂隙。

我们进一步探索的努力只能暂时告一段落了。
excerpt.en:
We have lost control of the [FromFrom.GetName] system, and the rift in space and time contained within.

Our efforts to reach beyond have been abandoned for now.

excerpt.zh:
[fromfrom.leader.GetName]从一趟寻找因终末而消失的星系的星界裂隙探险中返回了。他熟悉的许多地方已经完全从本现实中消失了。

他还不确定自己回到的是不是正确的维度，显然是受到了一定的认知冲击。
excerpt.en:
[fromfrom.leader.GetName] returned from exploring an Astral Rift to find a galaxy lost to the End. Many of the places they knew have vanished completely from this existence.

They are still uncertain if they returned to

excerpt.zh: 维度锁正在失去稳定。我们需要尽快行动避免它完全松脱。
excerpt.en: This Dimensional Lock is destabilizing. We will need to work quickly to prevent it from completely unraveling.

excerpt.zh:
我们已经开发出了这种能在星界裂隙的折缝中穿行的科技：§Y裂隙探球§!。

这种球体以高度先进、绝对光滑的纳米材料建成，可以在时空的乱流处无摩擦地滑行。

因为不知道所到地方的情况，每一艘§Y裂隙探球§!都会连接上一条锚定缆线。缆线连接在我们宇宙中的一艘科研船上，以便在发生意外时将我们拉回。
excerpt.en:
We have developed technology that will allow us to slip between the folds of an Astral Rift: §YRift Spheres§!.

Constructed of a highly advanced, perfectly smooth nano-material, the Sphere is able to frictionlessly glide

excerpt.zh:
这个虫洞的另一边似乎把我们带到了……星系的中心？

我们不应该存在于这里，更别说整个恒星系了。也许有一些维度操控在起作用吗？

我们没有太多时间来调查，因为我们正在接收来自一个未知实体的传输信号。
excerpt.en:
The other side of this wormhole seems to have taken us to... the center of the galaxy?

It should not be possible for us to exist here, let alone an entire system. Is there perhaps some dimensional manipulation at play?

excerpt.zh: 这是什么……你带来了什么傻瓜来帮助你，沙达衮？或者……你给我们提供了食物……
excerpt.en: what is this... what fools have you brought to aid you, shadagon? or perhaps... you have offered us food...

excerpt.zh:
我们的舰队已经击败了守卫这个裂隙的奇怪船只，但似乎它们并不孤单。

我们收到了一段传输信号，来源于这个恒星系唯一行星旁边的建筑物内的存在。
excerpt.en:
Our fleets have defeated the strange ships guarding this rift, but it seems they were not alone.

We have received a transmission from beings inhabiting a structure nearby the lone planet in this system.

excerpt.zh: 更多的即将到来……我们必须封闭这个裂缝……我们是唯一剩下的人……
excerpt.en: more are coming... we must seal this rift... we are all that remains...

excerpt.zh: 我们是唯一剩下的人……我们必须重建……我们需要时间……
excerpt.en: we are all that remains... we must rebuild... we need time...

excerpt.zh: 最后……退位……我们的链条被打破……目睹我们的上升……我们将找到他们隐藏的东西……
excerpt.en: finally... abdication... our chains are broken... behold our ascension... we will find what they have hidden...

excerpt.zh:
§H在不断变化的状态下，这个实体的可见形态在这个现实和另一个现实之间转换。祂的声音共鸣如众多的和声，仿佛同时代表着几个存在。§!

……完成了……封印已经设置完毕……我们的孩子再也找不到这个地方了……
excerpt.en:
§HIn a constant state of flux, this entity's visible form shifts between this reality and another. Their voice resonates as a harmonic multitude, as speaking on behalf of several beings at once.§!

... it is done... the

excerpt.zh: 这已经被预测……我们会向你们称臣……这是我们的命运……
excerpt.en: this was predicted... we will serve you... this is our fate...

excerpt.zh: 我们误判了你……极度悲伤……让它结束吧……
excerpt.en: we have misjudged you... great sorrow... let it be done...

excerpt.zh: 感激……安全……奖励……
excerpt.en: gratefulness... safety... reward...

excerpt.zh:
沙巴纳什……破碎的亲人……永远饥饿……

我们的贪婪……被放大……

罪恶被揭示……

一个巨大的耻辱……
excerpt.en:
shabanash... shattered kin... hungry always...

our greed... amplified...

sins brought to light...

a great shame...

excerpt.zh:
他们的贪婪将被毁灭……

我们知道的方法.……这是一个……频率的问题……？

你的语言中没有这个词……

我们需要……星界材料……
excerpt.en:
their greed is an undoing...

we know of ways... it is a matter of... frequencies...?

your language does not have the word...

we require... astral material...

excerpt.zh: 完成了……你的调谐已经完工……
excerpt.en: it is done... your attunement is complete...

excerpt.zh:
沙达衮的§Y乍狄伽§!……你怎么会在这里……

你将成为一顿盛宴……

来吧，与我们一同碰撞……
excerpt.en:
§Yzadigal§! of shadagon... how is it you are here...

you will be a great feast...

come and break against us...

excerpt.zh:
我们还没有结束……沙达衮的§Y乍狄伽§!……

你救了你的亲族……但愚蠢地追求……傲慢……

见证愤怒……然后是遗忘……
excerpt.en:
we are not finished... §Yzadigal§! of shadagon...

you have saved your kin... but foolishly pursue... hubris...

witness fury... then oblivion...

excerpt.zh:
建筑师……沙达衮的§Y乍狄伽§!……

我们将吞食你……吸收你的思维……

王座的秘密……你提供的伟大礼物……

现在加入我们……我们将尊重你……
excerpt.en:
the architect... §Yzadigal§! of shadagon...

we will consume you...  incorporate your mind...

the secrets of the throne... a great gift you offer...

join us now... we will honor you...

excerpt.zh: 我们针对无形异使的侵略行动，已经导致[this.GetName]放弃将舰队委任给我们，这些舰队重新加入他们的队列。
excerpt.en: Our aggressive campaign against the Formless has caused [this.GetName] to abandon their assigned fleets, and rejoin their ranks.

excerpt.zh:
我们已成功消灭了在[event_target:formless_system.GetName]中剩下的最后一批无形异使。

剩下的只有一个神秘的装置。一个人只需将自己的[this.species.GetHandNamePlural]放在上面，就能激活它神奇的再生特性。该装置作为一种通道进入星界位面，其中有大量的超维材料经由它自由流动。
excerpt.en:
We have successfully exterminated the last of the remaining Formless in [event_target:formless_system.GetName].

All that remains is a mysterious device. One need simply place their [this.species.GetHandNamePlural] upon

excerpt.zh:
尽管我们知道你……
此刻尚未到我们相遇之时……
excerpt.en:
though we know you...
it is not our time to meet...

excerpt.zh:
我们已经完成了对位于§Y[FromFrom.System.GetName]§!的§Y星界细缝§!的分析。

它正在从其他地方向我们的宇宙泄漏物质。裂缝周围的物质并不是守恒的——至少从我们的测量方法上来说不是的。尽管处于相对微小的规模，但裂缝似乎增加了我们宇宙的总物质量。

研究这一现象应该能更好地理解这种无法解释的能源来源。
excerpt.en:
We have completed our analysis of the §YAstral Scar§! in §Y[FromFrom.System.GetName]§!.

It is leaking material into our universe from... somewhere else. Matter is not being conserved around the rift - at least not in an

excerpt.zh:
我们已经确认了在§Y[FromFromFrom.System.GetName]§!恒星系中存在一个我们宇宙之外的宇宙。

通过裂缝，它的物质位面对我们自己的宇宙施加了巨大的压力，所造成的结果是有一小部分但稳定的物质流动。这一情况的长期效应我们尚未被理解，但在此期间，我们应继续分析其宇宙流出物。
excerpt.en:
We have confirmed the existence of another universe beyond our own in the §Y[FromFromFrom.System.GetName]§! system.

Through the rift, its physical dimensions are placing immense pressure on our own universe, the result

excerpt.zh:
经过仔细分析，我们确认[From.System.GetName]中的§Y星界细缝§!异常不稳定，需要立即干预以防止该恒星系进一步坍缩为引力奇点。

可以考虑将大量喷射而出的§Y星界丝缕§!进行重定向、重新利用，以便“缝合”裂痕。这将修复时空的撕裂，并可能留下大量的星界物质。

或者，我们可以投射大量军火来扩大这处裂痕。我们预测，这么做将有助于我们探索伤痕另一边可能存在的事物。
excerpt.en: After careful analysis, we've confirmed that the §YAstral Scar§! in [From.System.GetName] is dangerously unstable and requires immediate intervention to prevent further gravitational singularities forming in this system.

excerpt.zh:
经过对其撕裂织构的精细操控，我们成功地完全封印了位于[From.System.GetName]的§Y星界细缝§!。引力异常自那时起停止，我们在整个过程中回收了大量的§Y星界丝缕§!。

无论裂缝另一边的现实如何，都不再对我们构成威胁。
excerpt.en: After careful manipulation of its torn fabric, we've managed to fully seal the §YAstral Scar§! in [From.System.GetName]. Gravitational anomalies have since stopped, and we've recovered a significant quantity of §YAstral

excerpt.zh:
我们投送到到[From.System.GetName]的§Y星界细缝§!核心的军火扩大了时空的折叠。这里曾经只是宇宙织物中的一个小撕裂口，现在成为了一个更大的裂隙，能够让我们进入探索。

由此带来的稳定性使引力异常减弱，我们准备去发现隐藏在其中的事物。
excerpt.en: The ordinance we sent into the core of the §YAstral Scar§! in [From.System.GetName] has widened the folds in space and time. Where there was once a small tear in the cosmic fabric, there is now a larger rift that we are

excerpt.zh:
位于[FromFromFromFrom.System.GetName]的§Y星界细缝§!已经朝内坍缩了，并朝周边恒星系抛射出了大量的星界丝缕。这里的宇宙织构曾经出现过一处小小的撕裂，但如今已经是虚无的太空。

无论裂缝另一边的现实如何，都不再对我们构成威胁。
excerpt.en: The §YAstral Scar§! in [FromFromFromFrom.System.GetName] has collapsed inwardly, ejecting a significant amount of Astral Threads into the nearby system. Where there was once a small tear in the cosmic fabric, there is no

records.en: The Greatest Show in the Multiverse

excerpt.zh:
我们在这颗小行星上发现的发光物体是一则广告。

这个巨大的展示装置由内部占据小行星的机械基础设施支持。小行星本身在空间中的某一点上异常地悬浮着，不受任何附近物体的引力影响。

广告本身是关于它所称之为“多重宇宙的最佳秀场”的内容。有一个终端可以接受能量币，使我们直接前往这个景点。
excerpt.en:
The brightly lit object we discovered on this asteroid is an advertisement.

This massive display is supported by a mechanical infrastructure occupying the inside of the asteroid it is mounted on. The asteroid itself is

excerpt.zh: 在处理完我们的支付款项后，小行星内部的机械开始嗡嗡作响。一股刺眼的蓝光向外射出，精确地分开了时空的织构。当它运转结束时，小行星就消失了，而一道星界裂隙出现在了原地。
excerpt.en: After processing our payment, the machinery within the asteroid whirred into life. A stream of piercing blue light shot outward, meticulously parting the fabric of space and time. Once its work was finished, the asteroid

excerpt.zh: 我们用深受认可的本地企业代替了[fromfrom.GetName]的古怪广告商。支付终端被仔细拆解后，我们在里面发现了一小批能量币。
excerpt.en: We have replaced the anomalous advertisement with an endorsement for our own local businesses at [fromfrom.GetName]. The payment terminal was carefully dismantled, revealing a small cache of energy credits within.

excerpt.zh: 小行星内部机械中所采纳的技术比我们最初预料的要先进。因此，我们的回收工作给我们带来了相当可观的价值。我们发现了各种稀有材料——其中包括数量惊人的§Y星界丝缕§!。这颗中空的小行星一定是被设计成能够以某种方式操纵空间和时间。
excerpt.en: The technology within the asteroid's internal mechanisms were more advanced than initially suspected. As such, its salvage has rewarded us with considerable value. We have uncovered a variety of rare materials - includin

excerpt.zh:
某些由[from.System.GetName]的黑洞释放的粒子实际上是§Y星界丝缕§!。这意味着在某个时间点，星界细缝被拉入了黑洞的奇点，然后现在正在缓慢地被喷射出来。这样的事件以前被认为是不可能的。

或许，存在某种方式将高度聚集的§Y星界丝缕§!羽流导入奇点之中，从而让星界细缝被喷射出来，使这个恒星系的空间重新稳定。

然而，若是不采取进一步行动，我们可以继续从安全距离采集这些宇宙织物。
excerpt.en: Some of the particles being released by the black hole in [from.System.GetName] are, in fact, §YAstral Threads§!. This means that at some point in time an Astral Scar was pulled into its singularity and is now slowly bei

excerpt.zh:
将§Y星界丝缕§!注入奇点立马引起了剧烈的反应，由于黑洞的引力，大量的超维粒子喷涌而出。这些粒子已经聚集成一个悬浮在其引力井中的星界裂隙。

这个天体异常点之前是如何被吸入奇点，我们仍然不了解，但现在我们至少可以调查一下裂隙的另一边有什么存在。
excerpt.en: The injection of §YAstral Threads§! into the singularity caused an immediate and violent reaction, as a flood of extra-dimensional particles poured forth from the gravitational pull of the black hole. These particles hav

excerpt.zh:
[from.System.GetName]的黑洞将先前被其奇点吸收的星界细缝抛射了出来，随之而来的还有大量被束缚的星界物质。

黑洞的引力现在变得正常了。
excerpt.en:
The black hole in [from.System.GetName] has ejected the Astral Scar that was temporarily absorbed into its singularity, along with a significant amount of trapped astral material.

The gravitational forces of the black h

excerpt.zh:
[this.GetName]的殖民者发展出了一种爱好，沉迷于星界裂隙 ，其位于行星南半球的可观测天空中。人们激烈地推测它的起源，以及它蕴含着怎样的危险或机遇。

来自[owner.GetName]各地的业余天文爱好者聚集到这颗行星，亲眼见证这番绝景。
excerpt.en: Colonists on [this.GetName] have developed a fascination with the Astral Rift visible in the sky from the planet's southern hemisphere. Rampant speculation exists about its origins, as well as what dangers or opportuniti

excerpt.zh:
这种对当地的星界裂隙产生的爱好在[this.GetName]已经演变成了一股狂热。许多人都报告称，看见了某个在我们世界之外的地方。

其中一个团体宣称这个裂隙通往的是一个发条宇宙的中心，那里有一个机械神，他会给时间表上发条，以在无尽的世界中保持平衡。

与之相反，还有人说他们的幻境中出现了一颗黑色的恒星，它拥有启蒙的关键。
excerpt.en:
The fascination with the local Astral Rift on [this.GetName] has become fanatic. Many report experiencing visions of a world beyond our own.

One group claims that the Rift leads to the center of a clockwork galaxy, wher

excerpt.zh:
人群之间的割裂在[this.GetName]上日益加剧。殖民者报告的奇怪幻境引发了激烈的辩论，并最终演变为暴力事件。当地领导人呼吁发表一份官方的声明。

尽管可能看起来荒谬，我们被要求为机械神或黑星的存在提供可信说明，作为星界裂隙的解释。
excerpt.en: The schism between the population on [this.GetName] is worsening. The strange visions reported by the colonists have triggered fierce debates that have finally led to outbreaks of violence. Local leaders are calling for

excerpt.zh:
[this.GetName]上发生了灾难！

人们所经历的相互冲突的视景导致了大规模的动荡。竞相敌对的团体已经拿起了武器，局部的小规模冲突导致了全球范围内的暴力冲突。

这种情况不能继续下去。
excerpt.en:
Disaster on [this.GetName]!

The contrasting visions experienced by the population have resulted in large-scale unrest. The competing groups have taken up arms, with local skirmishes leading to violent clashes all across

excerpt.zh: 随着视景中关于钟表神的论述有了可信度，关于星界裂隙的争论显著减少了。与此同时，对其进行研究的公众热情达到了一个空前的高度。
excerpt.en: With the vision of a clockwork god made credible, debate about the Astral Rift has diminished significantly. At the same time, public enthusiasm for its study has never been higher.

excerpt.zh:
所有关于[this.GetName]上的奇怪幻境的公开讨论已被禁止。任何被发现谈论这个禁忌话题的人都会受到严厉的惩罚，这就阻止了公开冲突的发生。

许多殖民者已经转而追求新的热点，但一小部分硬核的业余天文学家仍然享受着这个壮观景象，继续观察星界裂隙。
excerpt.en:
All public discussion of the strange visions on [this.GetName] has been prohibited. Severe punishments for anyone caught broaching the forbidden topic have discouraged open conflict.

Many colonists have moved on to new

excerpt.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!的地表布满了有缺陷的军火，每次爆炸都会在行星上切割出一块块的碎片。

我们对这些武器十分陌生，其本身又是极其易爆的。此外，爆炸产生的图案表明了整个行星上埋藏这一个起爆网络。
excerpt.en:
The surface of §Y[from.GetName]§! is riddled with defective munitions, each carving out chunks of the planet as it detonates.

The weapons themselves are unfamiliar and extremely volatile. Furthermore, the pattern of the

excerpt.zh:
进一步的分析表明，这颗行星曾经被用作巨大的武器储存库。在静止了数千年之后，个别武器现在开始出现故障，将整个行星变成了一个不稳定的战场。

我们有能力以受控的方式触发所有剩余的弹药。或者，我们可以尝试提取一些武器并在它们爆炸之前将其停用。
excerpt.en: Further analysis indicates that this planet was once used as an enormous weapons cache. Having sat inactive for thousands of years, individual weapons are now beginning to malfunction, turning the entire planet into an u

excerpt.zh:
在[from.GetName]周围部署了一系列精心设计的炸药之后，我们触发了链式反应，彻底摧毁了这颗行星。

由此引发的爆炸十分强大，不仅摧毁了行星，还产生了一道新的§Y星界裂隙§!。

我们通过理论推导得出，这个裂隙的产生是因为一场极其强大的、能够产生奇点的爆炸，这是由武器储藏库中的某一件武器产生的。
excerpt.en:
After deploying a carefully engineered set of charges around [from.GetName], we triggered a chain reaction that destroyed the planet entirely.

The resulting explosion was so strong that it not only destroyed the planet,

excerpt.zh:
我们能够为存储在行星表面的武器建立一个提取管线，将处于激活状态的军火变为惰性状态，然后准备收集和分析它们。

在这个行星上建立一个永久殖民地将使我们能够更高效地利用剩余的储藏。
excerpt.en:
We were able to create an extraction pipeline for the weapons stored within the planet's surface, rendering active munitions inert before preparing them for collection and analysis.

Establishing a permanent colony on th
