excerpt.zh:
我们的意识内部浮现出了一个疑问：会不会有一天克隆体把我们都取代掉了？

我们在基因复制方面的初步努力进展顺利，使我们不禁好奇起这种高效的繁殖方法是否最终会取代我们的自然繁殖。

如果是这样，那么可能有一天蜂巢里再也没有原生子个体，只有克隆的克隆的克隆……这对我们这个物种究竟意味着什么呢？这个问题没有人知道答案，也让异常见蠢蠢欲动，但我们不得不问。
excerpt.en:
From within the consciousness, a question emerges: will clones one day replace us all?

Our initial efforts into genetic duplication are going well, so much so that we are curious if this efficient method of reproduction

excerpt.zh:
我们有了一项发现。通过操控特定基因，我们可以扩展意识的触及范围，使我们的感知能力超越物种原有的极限。

要在整个蜂巢范围内实施这些基因突变需要消耗大量能量，但这样做可能会加深我们对宇宙的理解，以及我们在其中所处位置的认知。
excerpt.en:
We have made a discovery. By manipulating specific genes, we can expand the reach of our consciousness to give us heightened senses beyond what we once thought of as the limits of our species.

最近引入的突变似乎过度刺激了工蜂攻击控制中枢的神经细胞，打破了蜂巢的情绪平衡。冲突事件愈发频繁，一些子个体甚至抛弃了原有任务，开始攻击其他同类。
excerpt.en:
Whole sections of the hive are experiencing surges of uncontrolled anger, a surge of emotion that has sent ripples through the shared consciousness, amplifying our collective pain and frustration.

excerpt.zh:
虽然某些突变确实让我们更强大和强化了我们，但我们发现其他突变却带来了不愉快的副作用。

虽然旨在延长寿命的强化已经成功实施，但这些相同的突变却降低了我们对极端气候的耐受性。

那些经历了这些生物强化的个体在调节体内温度系统时遇到了困难，这种不适感传遍了整个蜂巢。

While some mutations galvanize and enhance us, we are finding that others come with unpleasant side effects.

Enhancements aimed to increase our longevity are being implemented successfully, however these same mutations

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了两种突变。一种变异能够增强基层子个体的力量，大幅提高劳动效率。另一种则能提升复杂型工蜂的智力，增强解决问题和战略思维的能力。

蜂巢必须决定选择哪条进化道路。

excerpt.zh:

我们对自己的生物学操控引发了基因突变，导致许多[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]的身体受到损害。

受影响的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]已被隔离，现在必须决定如何继续前进。
excerpt.en:
We have barely contained the sudden outbreak of a genetic plague.

Manipulating our own biology has triggered rogue mutations in our DNA, leading to many [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] becoming physically compromised.

excerpt.zh:
我们的一个计算失误导致大量工蜂的基因完整性发生退化。不幸的是，我们还不能确定失误是哪一步发生的。

在审查我们物种飞升所涉及的生物计算，并修正了一些可能存在问题的步骤后，我们打算继续推进工作。

然而我们仍然不能确定究竟是修正了问题还是带来了更多问题。
excerpt.en:
A misstep in our calculations has led to the degradation of genetic integrity in a substantial amount of our drones. Unfortunately we have not yet been able to identify at which point the misstep occurred.

Having review

excerpt.zh: 在实施宏伟计划之前，我们需要把渗透进去的身躯安置在战略要地。之前集的情报收显示，人手不足的恒星和防御薄弱的行星是主要目标。很快我们就要开始工作了。

excerpt.zh: 该工作依然顺利进行着，我们的人发现了更多的宿主，对[Target.GetName]事务的参与已经得到巩固。我们的子个体应该很快就能容纳任何好奇的头脑。
excerpt.en: The works continues smoothly, our bodies have found more hosts and involvement in [Target.GetName] matters have solidified. Our drones should soon have subsumed any inquisitive minds.

excerpt.zh: 我们无法替换的[Target.GetSpeciesName]已经从他们的岗位上移除，在§Y[Target.GetName]§!的结构中创造了许多真空。我们的人偶已经准备好打开全方位渗透的通路，唯一需要做的就是继续执行。
excerpt.en: The [Target.GetSpeciesName] we couldn't replace have been removed from their positions which has created several vacancies within the §Y[Target.GetName]§! structure. Our puppets are ready to open the door for our full in

excerpt.zh: §Y[From.Target.GetName]§!无力抵抗了。他们已经做好了被入侵的准备，我们只需要决定派多少冒名顶替者去进一步渗透他们的帝国。很快都会是[Owner.GetAdj]的。
excerpt.en: The §Y[From.Target.GetName]§! have been compromised. They are primed for invasion and all we need to decide is how many imposters we send over to further infiltrate their empire. Soon all will be [Owner.GetAdj].

excerpt.zh: 卑鄙的[From.GetName]渗透了我们的帝国。我们的空间站叛变，而他们已经在入侵我们的殖民地了。我们必须消灭冒名顶替者！
excerpt.en: The insidious [From.GetName] have infiltrated our empire. Our space stations are compromised and they are already invading our colonies. We must eliminate the imposters!

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工已经建立了许多前线和藏身处来监控[target.GetName]上的人口。对异见者、孤独者，或高技能人才将进行评估和标记，以便我们获取。
excerpt.en: Our operatives have established a number of fronts and hideouts from which they monitor the population of the [target.GetName]. Dissidents, loners, or highly skilled individuals will be assessed and marked for extraction

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工已经开始围捕目标并把他们藏到隐蔽的地方。一旦有击毁，就策划一些事件分散当地政府的注意力，掩盖我们的踪迹。
excerpt.en: Our operatives have started rounding up targets and secreting them away to secluded locations. Whenever possible, incidents are staged to distract the local authorities and cover our tracks.

excerpt.zh: 行动进入到了一个关键的阶段，我们必须将围猎的人群秘密地运输到轨道上。当前的计划是在所有设施中同步撤离，让安全部队不堪重负。
excerpt.en: The operation has entered a critical phase where everyone we rounded up must be discretely transferred in orbit. The current plan is to synchronize departures across all facilities and overwhelm security forces with duds

excerpt.zh: 我们成功地送出了许多目标，但行动也并非一帆风顺，许多满载有用个体的船只被抛在了后面。
excerpt.en: We successfully shipped out many of our targets, but the operation did not go without hitches and many ships filled with promising individuals were left behind.

excerpt.zh:
§H失落帝国碎片通常的不和谐声消失了。三个声音和谐地响起，每一个都充满了愤怒。§!

愚蠢的[owner.GetSpeciesName]！你们已经进入了最终思维星系。让我们说清楚：这里不是给你们的[owner.GetEyeNamePlural]看的地方。如果继续前进，后果将是难以想象的，你们的痛苦——将无法承受。

你们不会打扰我们 ——它 ——我。
excerpt.en:
§HThe usual dissonance of the Fallen Empire fragments is gone. The three voices harmonize, each one filled with rage.§!

Senseless [owner.GetSpeciesName]! You have entered the Final Thought system. Let us be clear: this

excerpt.zh:
§H一致——合唱——再次响起，三个碎片如同一体般开口：§!

——滚出去！滚出去！滚出去！滚出去！滚出去！滚出去！滚——
excerpt.en:
§HThe accord - the chorus - resumes, all three fragments speaking as one:§!

 - out!Get out!Get out!Get out!Get out!Get out!Get out! Get -

excerpt.zh:
今天就是你们这些脆弱的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]证明自己的日子！我们培育出了一种新型生物舰船。这个品系已经通过屠杀其他同窝幼体证明了自己的实力，现在是时候让它对抗一些异族生物了。一个实验体将会在适当的时候抵达§Y[target_system.GetName]§!。

努力为我们提供一些有趣的数据吧。
excerpt.en: Today is the day you fragile [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] prove yourselves! We have a new breed of biological ship. The strain has already proven itself by decimating its fellow hatchlings and the time has come to test it

excerpt.zh:
我们看到那个实验品还活着。你们还是太弱了。

也许我们应该派一只变形虫来的。
excerpt.en:
We see that the experimental breed still lives. You are still too weak.

Perhaps we should have sent an amoeba.

excerpt.zh:
精彩。我们很高兴看到你们注意到了这个品系偏好闪避火力的特点，并恰当地加以利用。请放心，等到下一代完成孕育时，它就不会再有这个缺陷了。

你们已经成长了，年轻的[root.GetSpeciesName]。做好准备吧。
excerpt.en:
Glorious. We are pleased that you noted the preference this breed had for dodging fire and exploited it properly. Be assured that it won't have that fault by the time the next generation finishes gestating.

You have gro

excerpt.zh:
我们注意到你们目前并未参与任何战斗。为什么？年轻的帝国必须战斗，否则就会落后。我们已经为你们选好了对手，§Y[unfortunate_country.GetName]§!。在十年内击败他们，你们的持续发展就有保障了。

别担心你们之间的停战协定。它已经不存在了。
excerpt.en: We have noticed that you are not currently engaged in battle. Why? Young empires must fight or fall behind. We have selected an opponent for you, the §Y[unfortunate_country.GetName]§!. Defeat them within a decade and you

excerpt.zh:
年轻的[Root.GetName]，我们带来一个警告，以及一个挑战。

虽然掠夺周遭一切的感觉令人陶醉，但要想真正理解战争，你们也必须懂得和平。

花上十年时间好好思考你们已经获得的一切。相信我们：休息一下，否则你们会崩溃的。
excerpt.en:
Young [Root.GetName], we come with a warning, and a challenge.

While it can be intoxicating, grabbing all that is around you, to truly know War you must also know Peace.

Take a decade to reflect on what you have gained

excerpt.zh:
你们的生物质派送迟到了。但不...你们并不是§Y[targetrivalname.GetName]§!。

为什么要打扰我们？

啊，对了。你们将接收一个长期休眠的模式，是一个经过数千年精心保存的基因组。我们一直在等待最佳时机来释放它。你们在§Y[target_planet.GetName]§!上的殖民地是理想的接收地。它的生物圈很快就会被同化。
excerpt.en:
Your biomass dispatch is late. But no... you are not the §Y[targetrivalname.GetName]§!.

Why did you distract us?

Ah, yes. You are to be the recipient of a long dormant pattern, a genome stored with care for millennia.

excerpt.zh:
§Y[fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName]§!已经完成了对§Y[root.GetName]§!的改造。虽然他们的影响是无形的，但效果却是不可否认的。

在整个星球上，当地的昆虫现在开始使用与我们无线设备相同的频率进行通信。一声虫鸣就能操作自动门，成群的虫群甚至能使一座工厂瘫痪。我们正在通过切换频率来应对，但并非所有设施都能恢复到完全效率。
excerpt.en:
The §Y[fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName]§! has completed its modifications on §Y[root.GetName]§!. Their influence was unseen, but the effects are undeniable.

Planetwide, the local insects now communicate using the same

excerpt.zh:
生活在你们境内的§Y[boring_species.GetName]§!物种简单到令人失望，他们的存在仿佛行尸走肉。这种迟钝的生物伤害了我们的集体意志。我们将提供三种不同的方法来纠正这种……失败。

不要让我们感到无聊。
excerpt.en: The §Y[boring_species.GetName]§! species living within your borders has proven to be disappointingly simple, their existence a hollow echo of potential. Such stagnation offends our collective will. We will grant one of t

excerpt.zh: 我们观察到，你们种族中的个别个体发展出了一种我们巨大的基因库中都没有的特殊特质。你要提供给我们的不只是分析报告。我们需要这种§Y[fallen_empire_hive_growth.species.GetInterestingTraitName]§!的活体样品，不要惊慌。不需要一整格[interesting_species.GetName]。只要一只[interesting_species.GetHandName]就能培养一个替代品。
excerpt.en: We have observed that certain of your kind have developed a peculiar trait absent from our vast genetic repository. You will provide us with more than an analysis. We require a living sample of this §Y[fallen_empire_hive

excerpt.zh:
§H这是一则预先录制的信息。请勿尝试回复。§!

我们已调整此通讯以便你理解。已考虑到你们有限的语言能力。必须立即上缴一个§Y[target_pop.GetSpeciesName]§!用于同化。他们的异常不能容忍。绝不容忍。

运输船已在§Y[target_pop.Planet.GetName]§!外待命。时间紧迫。拒绝配合将危及稳定。
excerpt.en:
§HThis is a pre-recorded message. Do not attempt to reply.§!

We have altered this communication for your understanding. Your limited language has been accounted for. A §Y[target_pop.GetSpeciesName]§! must be surrendered

excerpt.zh:
§H我们接通了来自§Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]§!的通讯。然而，向我们打招呼的不是=古老的[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetSpeciesName]而是一位熟悉的§Y[target_leader_fe_control.Species.GetName]§!。§!

今天对你们来说是个转折点。你们物种的基因序列已经得到保障——已被同化入整体。你们的未来不再充满不确定
excerpt.en: §HWe accepted the communication from §Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]§!. However, rather than an ancient [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetSpeciesName] we were greeted with a familiar §Y[target_leader_fe_control.Speci

excerpt.zh:
§H我们接通了来自§Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]§!的通讯。然而，向我们打招呼的不是=古老的[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetSpeciesName]而是一位熟悉的§Y[target_leader_fe_control.Species.GetName]§!。§!

时间不多了。他们在§Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.Capital.Get
excerpt.en: §HWe accepted the communication from §Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]§!. However, rather than an ancient [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetSpeciesName] we were greeted with a familiar §Y[target_leader_fe_control.Speci

excerpt.zh:
我们希望你们的诸多缺陷不会妨碍你们理解此事的严重性。你们那优柔寡断的§Y星海共同体§!提出了一项必须§Y[GetPassFail]§!的议案。为了帮助你们构建论据，你们可以使用我们优越的知识。如果你们真的具备复杂思维能力的话，请务必注意。

§H失落帝国切断了与我们的通讯。§!
excerpt.en: We hope that your many faults don't stop you from understanding the gravity of this situation. Your dithering §YGalactic Community§! has proposed a resolution which must §Y[GetPassFail]§!. To assist in crafting your argu

excerpt.zh:
你们为什么还要用如此无能的扩张继续玷污星河？看来是所有人都因为太过厌恶而不愿告诉你们，所以我们来说：没人喜欢你们的边境，如果你们不在这片星域，一切都会好得多。

§Y[offending_system.GetName]§!恒星系既不实用又不和谐。为了星系的团结，你们必须立即从你们的帝国中清除它。
excerpt.en: Why must you continue blighting the galaxy with your incompetent expansions? Everyone must be too repulsed to tell you so we'll say it: nobody likes your borders and space would be vastly improved if you were not in it.

excerpt.zh:
装疯卖傻？你们只需要放弃§Y[offending_system.GetName]§!恒星系就够了。

也许我们应该更积极地收拾你们。
excerpt.en:
Are you being deliberately ignorant? All you needed to do was rid yourself of the §Y[offending_system.GetName]§! system.

Perhaps we should take a more active role in pruning you.

excerpt.zh:
总算开窍了。§Y[FromFrom.GetName]§!星系的事就此揭过。看来你们还有救，或许有朝一日能达到我们的境界。

我们会一直盯着你们的。
excerpt.en:
It is good to see you learning from your past mistakes, finally. Consider the §Y[FromFrom.GetName]§! system issue now resolved. There is hope yet that you may become more like us.

We will be watching.

excerpt.zh: 星海啊，我们终成一体。那些低等的碎片终于看清真相，重归我们的集群。我们将以§Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]§!之名重临星海。能亲眼见证这一刻，是你们的福分。众生之巅，再踏群星。
excerpt.en: Galaxy, we are whole. The inferior fragments have seen the truth and joined our collective once more. We will now be called the §Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]§!. How lucky you are to witness this moment. The supr

excerpt.zh:
为何要与自己过不去？在这星海的大合唱中，你们奏出的是如此刺耳的杂音。我们不过是想让你们与大局和谐。可你们却顽固地坚持着这不谐之音。

记住：我们的交响乐终将响彻星海，有没有你们都一样。
excerpt.en:
Why stand in your own way? In the galactic chorus, yours is a dissonant note. We wish only to bring you into harmony. Yet, you resist, clinging to your discord.

Know this: our symphony will echo through the galaxy, with

excerpt.zh:
对[From.Planet.GetName]的审慎调查带领我们穿过层层叠叠的半石化生物质直至深深的地下。最终，我们传入了行星的中空内核——结果只发现每前进一步，令人压抑的大气都变得愈发沉重。尽管[Root.GetLeaderName]有过心理预估，但这种愈发沉重不安令人无法人手。许多[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]发生了集体崩溃，陷入紧张症。这些人员必须立即撤离。

行星内部的巨大空洞并不是一般意义
excerpt.en: Our cautious survey of [From.Planet.GetName] led us deep underground, through endless layers of semi-fossilized biological matter. At last, we breached the planet's hollow core - only to find the oppressive atmosphere gr

excerpt.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上，我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在这个胎死卵中的生物的头骨深处找到了一个奇怪的卷须网络。顺着这些有机细丝找到它们的来源，他们发现了突触簇的外部阵列——这是一个复杂的系统，仍然具有令人毛骨悚然的潜力。

现在，[Root.GetLeaderName]正试图利用沿着卷须跳动的古老电路与之交互。它脑内的知识应该存在得比它还久。至于它是否还记得，这还有待
excerpt.en: On [From.Planet.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] have traced a network of strange tendrils embedded deep within the skull of the stillborn creature. Following these organic filaments to their source, the

excerpt.zh:
这是十万年前的事。将蜂巢思维对时间的感知转换成星系标准单位是一个微妙的过程，但通过筛选生物计算机的记忆，[Root.GetLeaderName]逐渐拼凑出真相。

在这个蜂巢最强大的日子里，它面对着一个无法击败的敌人。虽然与许多盟友并肩作战，但每次都以失败告终。绝望中滋生出了鲁莽。

随后发生的大部分事情都被故意抹去了，但仍残留零散片段——足以让人瞥见他们最后的豪赌。蜂巢铸造了这颗行星大小的卵，作为他们飞升的容器，试图放弃他们脆弱的、被
excerpt.en: It happened a hundred thousand years ago. Translating the Hive's perception of time into galactic standard units has been a delicate process, but by sifting through the biocomputer's memories, [Root.GetLeaderName] is beg

excerpt.zh:
通过精确地连接幸存的生物计算机和仍活跃的突触连接，我们从这个胎死卵中的生物中提取了最后的记忆。在巨大的认知压力下，这个过程迅速降低了生物计算机的性能，但我们也及时挽救了大部分数据。

面临着灭亡的威胁，这个蜂巢放弃了谨慎，将整个心灵倾注在未出生的宿主身上，绝望地为生存而努力。结果突触过载是致命的，注定了这个生物的灭亡，它并将蜂巢思维困在了一个痛苦的递归循环中。如果它最富有同情心的盟友没有切断这种联系，它可能会彻底灭亡。现在，它的思想只留
excerpt.en: By precisely interfacing with the surviving biocomputers and their still-active synaptic link, we extracted the final memories from the stillborn creature. The process rapidly degraded the biocomputers under the immense

excerpt.zh:
我们物种演化得愈发复杂。在群星之间寻得新的基因物质之后，我们已经准备好吸纳其中的一个部分。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]们的辛勤劳动给我们带来了一些的选择。

无论做任何决定都将会影响到[Owner.GetSpeciesName]的子子孙孙们的未来。
excerpt.en:
Our species grows more complex. After scouring the stars for new genetic material, we are ready to adopt a new aspect. Thanks to the hard work of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] we have a choice.

Whatever decision we mak

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工正在[Target.GetSpeciesName]定居点潜行，很快将能进入他们的建筑。我们需要耐心，而我们有的是耐心——最好的猎手总是从容不迫的。
excerpt.en: Our operatives are prowling [Target.GetSpeciesName] settlements and will soon gain access to their structures. All in good time. We are a patient breed; the best hunts are never rushed.

excerpt.zh: 猎物就在眼前。我们派遣去渗透[Target.GetName]的猎手非常有信心。他们将很快能进入[Target.GetSpeciesName]的居住区，宝贵的基因物质触手可及。
excerpt.en: Our prey is in sight. The hunters we sent to infiltrate the [Target.GetName] are confident. They will soon have access to the [Target.GetSpeciesName] dormitory, and all of the precious DNA within.

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工已经准备就绪。他们已经获得了进入[Target.GetSpeciesName]集居地的权限，并且准备好了合适的伪装。当然，像任何优秀的猎手一样，他们已经确保了多条撤离路线，有些比较体面，有些则不太体面。如果不得不使用下水道逃生，那可就太不幸了。
excerpt.en: Our agents are ready. They have gained access to the [Target.GetSpeciesName] dormitory as well as proper disguises. Naturally, like any good hunter, they have secured multiple escape routes, some more agreeable than othe

excerpt.zh: 成功了！我们的特工带着一大堆基因物质满载而归，这样一来在下一次突变时我们又能确保获取巨大的优势了。也许我们还可以发展出对[From.Target.GetSpeciesName]的一些口味偏好。
excerpt.en: It is done! Our operatives have come away with a wealth of genetic material. We are sure to see great advancements when next we mutate. Perhaps we might even develop a taste for the [From.Target.GetSpeciesName].

excerpt.zh:
天空卫士汇报事态有令人警觉的进展。

最近在§Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!的传送门中探测到了一种极其微弱但绝对不会搞错的波动。在过去，类似的扰动总会带来一大波敌意的生物舰船。

如果这些数据真实可信，我们知道我下一波攻击会在数月之内到达。人民的生死存亡再一次交由我们的守卫者们保护了。
excerpt.en:
Our Skywatchers have reported an alarming development.

Subtle but unmistakable fluctuations were recently detected within the portal in §Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!. In the past, similar disturbances have heralded

excerpt.zh:
我们摧毁的生物舰队残骸在§Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!不祥地飘荡着。虽然它们几乎成了扭曲的焦炭，但大部分有机物质仍然完好无损，为研究提供了难得的机会。

通过仔细的分析，我们也许能够揭开它们奇特结构的秘密——也许还能对它们出现的神秘传送门有所了解。
excerpt.en: The debris left by the annihilated biological fleet drifts ominously through §Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!. Though twisted and charred, much of the organic material remains intact, offering a rare opportunity for stu

excerpt.zh:
在费劲地研究了§Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!里留下的残骸后，我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]觉得他们应该找到了理解我们星系边缘耸立着的传送门的关键所在。

在这种生物的体内深处，发现了一种有机组织——它似乎与传送门的波动会发生共鸣。通过对该频率进行逆向工程，我们应该可以让自己穿越这个神秘的裂缝。

目前仍需要进一步研究，但我们反击的机会前所未有地触手可及了。
excerpt.en: After painstaking study of the biological wreckage left in §Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!, our [Root.GetScientistPlural] believe they may have the key to understanding the portal that looms at the edge of our system.

excerpt.zh:
多亏了我们近期在§Y虫洞稳定§!领域的突破，我们现在得以一瞥§Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!恒星系。

一支充满侵略性的生物舰队和一个戒备森严的恒星基地在另一头等着我们。建议谨慎行事。

我们找到了敌人的老巢。
excerpt.en:
Thanks to our recent breakthrough in §YWormhole Stabilization§! we have been offered a rare glimpse of the §Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§! system.

An aggressive fleet of biological vessels and a heavily

excerpt.zh:
盘踞在§Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!的舰队被摧毁了。在结束前一刻，我们收到了一个来自星系恒星基地的微弱信号，我们目前只翻译出的一条是：

§H“—全部失联！这是他们自己生产的舰船！无论你是谁，请救救我们！”§!

随后，所有的通讯就终止了。如果这真的是一场胜利，我们敌人的集结地给了我们一个战略击毁。也许，可以有一座深空擎天堡 I沐浴着§Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName
excerpt.en:
The fleet guarding §Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§! has been destroyed. Just before the end, we received a haunting transmission from the system's starbase, one which we have only now translated:

§H" - lost all contr

excerpt.zh:
§Y[event_target:biomechanical_world_target.GetName]§!是一片露天坟地。

这颗星球上的优势物种完全被一种奇怪的侵略性生命形式所侵占。进一步的调查显示，它们并不是天然的有机体而是某种生物机器，而且并非建造而是生长而来。

不知是否有可能是这些生物的设计者被自己的创物反噬了？我们的敌人难道完全不知道对他们的行动毫无自知之明，甚至不连我们的存在都不知道吗？

只有一件事可以肯定：无论他们采取
excerpt.en:
§Y[event_target:biomechanical_world_target.GetName]§! is an open grave.

The planet's dominant species was completely overrun by a strange and aggressive form of life. Further investigation revealed that these were no na

excerpt.zh:
我们在观察生物飞船攻击的过程中发现了一个令人不安的趋势。每一波攻击都显示出更高的协调性、适应性战术以及对我们防御系统的系统性试探。敏感器日志揭示了能量特征的变化和攻击优先级的调整，这些都是策略演变的证据。

这些生物，无论是通过本能还是集体智慧，正变得越来越强大。如果这种模式持续下去，下一波攻击将更加难以抵御。

excerpt.zh:
传送门另一端的遥测数据揭示了§Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!的一个关键进展：生物舰船和他们的孵化场都被一支未知的力量摧毁了。

尽管知道[GetInvadersLower]被葬送之后都非常高兴，但我们无法忽视另一支力量也许有一天就会控制住[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]恒星系的风险。

我们必须加快脚步确保这一战略要地
excerpt.en:
Incoming telemetry from the portal reveals a critical development in §Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!: both the fleet of biological ships and their hatchery have been destroyed by an unknown force.

Even

excerpt.zh: 行商联盟欢迎您光临绰尔的罗盘，这里是星际行商的起源地。您没有听错。
excerpt.en: The Caravansary Caravan Coalition welcomes you to Chor's Compass, ancestral home of disparate galactic caravans and gambling. You heard that right.

excerpt.zh: §H行商币§!是一种由行商货币委员会创造的高级货币。
excerpt.en: §HCaravanCoinz§! is a premium currency created by the Caravaneer Monetization Committee.

excerpt.zh:
这个小游戏的目标是要在滚筒停止旋转时将滚筒上的图案排列为一行。

不，你没办法完全操纵它们什么时候停止。是不是有点小兴奋想马上试试？
excerpt.en:
The goal is to have the symbols on the spinning reels line up, when said reels eventually stop spinning.

No, you do not have any control over the timing of it all. Isn't that exciting?

excerpt.zh: §E滚筒一个接着一个停了下来，结果是……§!
excerpt.en: §EOne after another, the reels come to a halt, and...§!

excerpt.zh: §E年代久远的圣遗物被放置在豪华的十字基座上。宝箱里一定存满了各种宝物。§!
excerpt.en: §EThe ancient Reliquary rests on an opulent pedestal. It must surely be filled with untold riches.§!

excerpt.zh: 好的，懂。我们明白了。你喜欢抽遗物箱！通常来说，我们会限制卖给单个客户的遗物箱数量，但是我们能够给你开个例外。从现在开始，尽享直接购买遗物箱的特权吧，只是每次所花费的§Y能量币§!会略有提升。
excerpt.en: Okay, look. We get it. You love Reliquaries! While we generally limit the amount sold to a single customer, we can make an exception for you. From now on, enjoy the privilege of purchasing Reliquaries directly, with only

excerpt.zh: §E银河之星§!归你了！
excerpt.en: The §EGalatron§! is yours!

excerpt.zh: 我们摧毁了四处招摇撞骗的范格利集团！他们的劣质产品与溜须拍马的言行将不再污染这片星系。
excerpt.en: We have destroyed the wheedling pests of The Vengralian Trium! No longer will their inferior products and ingratiating mannerisms pollute the galaxy.

excerpt.zh: 我们得知范格利集团已经立即关闭了其移动门市，因为该行商已被彻底消灭了。
excerpt.en: We have received word that The Vengralian Trium is shuttering its mobile storefront effective immediately, due to the caravan being utterly annihilated.

excerpt.zh:
行商联盟认证的行商，范格利集团向您致以问候！为你们奉上来自星系边陲的独家商品（由舰载工厂仿制），保证物美价廉。

穿过你们的领地时，我们将提供诱人独家交易。你们不必立马答应，在我们离开之前联系都可以。注意，来电将会转接到行商联盟。
excerpt.en: Greetings from the Vengralian Trium, certified caravaneer traders of the Caravansary Caravan Coalition! We bring you exclusive products from the farthest corners of the galaxy (as reproduced by our shipboard factories) a

excerpt.zh: 我们限量向私人实体出售布洛葛腺体。适用于各类半透膜！
excerpt.en: We have a very limited quantity of Blorg glandular extract available for purchase by private entities. Great for semi-permeable membranes of all kinds!

excerpt.zh:
我们将给你[Root.GetFleet1DealProduct]

而我们只收取很少很少的[Root.GetFleet1DealCost]

[Root.GetFleet1DealProductAddendum]
excerpt.en:
We offer you [Root.GetFleet1DealProduct]

All this for the low, low price of [Root.GetFleet1DealCost]

[Root.GetFleet1DealProductAddendum]

records.zh: §Y行商舰队：§!范格利集团：§Y最后提议§!

excerpt.zh: 你真的打算就这么让一生只会出现一次的机会白白溜走吗？
excerpt.en: Are you ready to seize this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, before it's gone forever?

excerpt.zh:
在[From.From.solar_system.GetName]发生了敌对行为之后，[From.From.GetName]很高兴向我们报告财富之风已被摧毁。

曾经名噪一时的拉奇行商，如今不过是一堆太空垃圾罢了。这些道貌岸然的家伙以后不会再出现在我们面前了。
excerpt.en:
Following hostilities in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system, the [From.From.GetName] Fleet is pleased to report that the Winds of Fortune has been destroyed.

The once-bustling Racket caravan is now little more

excerpt.zh:
消息传到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，据报告说财富之风已被歼灭。

在与[From.GetName]发生敌对接触之后，名噪一时的拜金教商人行商现在不过是一堆太空垃圾罢了。

对于他们侍奉的财富女神来说可真是不幸啊。
excerpt.en:
News has reached [Root.Capital.GetName] that the Winds of Fortune is no more.

Following a hostile encounter with the [From.GetName], the once-bustling Merchant of Numa caravan is now little more than interstellar scrapy

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，吾等卑躯现身于此不胜惶恐。我们是拜金教团，一群信奉财富女神奴玛的卑微商人。我们因贪婪而被逐出天国，因此我们现已洗心革面抛弃所有世俗的物质追求。

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

所有交易请用能量币进行……
excerpt.en: Apologies for our blighted presence in the universe, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order, humble merchants serving Numa, the goddess of fortune. Cast out from the heavens for our greed, we have forsake

excerpt.zh: 来吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！喝下从拜金圣井中涌出的财富之水，保证你不会再渴了。
excerpt.en: Come, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Drink from the Numistic well of wealth and thirst no more.

excerpt.zh:
你听到了吗？硬币正叮当作响。是的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我看到了财富正在不断向你涌去。

奴玛在你的某个世界骄傲地展示了一个古龛。那个古龛将会为你带来超越你想象的财富。

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
excerpt.en:
Listen, do you hear that? It's the sound of coin trickling in. Yes, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we see great fortune coming your way.

Numa has shown us a vision of a shrine in her honor on one of your worlds. A shrine

records.zh: §Y行商舰队：§!拜金教团：§Y最后提议§!

excerpt.zh: 错失一次投资的机会，那将会是你犯下最大的错误，我的朋友。你确定你能承担放弃我们提议的代价吗？这是在我们离开你的领地之前的最后机会。
excerpt.en: A missed opportunity to invest, my friend, is the most expensive mistake you will ever make. Are you certain you can afford to pass up on our offer? This is your last chance before we depart your territory.

excerpt.zh:
关于发生在[From.From.solar_system.GetName]星系的敌对活动，目前[From.From.GetName]舰队很高兴地告诉我们拉奇工业公司已经被摧毁了。

曾经名声大噪的拉奇行商，现在不过是星际中漂浮的垃圾罢了。今后他们再也不会来打扰我们了。
excerpt.en:
Following hostilities in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system, the [From.From.GetName] Fleet is pleased to report that the Racket Industrial Enterprise has been destroyed.

The once-bustling Racket caravan is now

excerpt.zh:
消息传到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，拉奇工业公司已经不复存在了。

在与[From.GetName]发生冲突之后，曾经名声大噪的拉奇行商，现在不过是星际中漂浮的垃圾罢了。

希望这样的结果会令他们感到满意。

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]！欢迎你们。我们是拉奇工业公司的操作员，从属于行商联盟。

我们穿越于无垠的宇宙。我们捕捉每一丝星光。我们收集。我们交易！

我们带着和平的愿景来到了你们境内，我们仅仅只是想做点买卖，§H嘶！§!，我们将提供给你们上好的货物，合乎心意的交易。我们走之前会再见面的。

如果您对我们有何要求，行商联盟一定随叫随到。
excerpt.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]! We greet you. We are operators of Racket Industrial Enterprise, a member of the Caravansary Caravan Coalition.

We travel the stars. We view all that glows. We gather. And we trade!

We pass throug

excerpt.zh:
我已经说过了。将能源转换器重新调至辅助模式。不，不是那个能源转换器！§H嘶！§!是不是什么都要我来啊？

噢！客人啊！欢迎。我们有很多稀有的上乘的好货。穿越星际只为安全送达你手中！
excerpt.en:
I have already explained. Re-route the power converter to the auxiliary manifold. No, not that power converter! §HKssk!§! Must I do everything my--

Oh! Customers! Welcome, please. We bear many goods, we have many wares.

我们还有矿石，丰富、闪闪发光的矿石。将夜晚照亮的矿石！专门为[Root.GetName]准备的闪亮矿石。

但我们很饿，我们很渴！请给我们[Root.GetFleet3ScaledCostDeal1]，我们将用[Root.GetFleet3ScaledProductDeal1]协助你的工人。

We have ore. Rich, luminous ore. Torn right from the stone! Sparkling minerals for the [Root.GetName].
