excerpt.zh:
入侵者：你仍明显违反§YWAPP-715命令§!，命令要求位于[root.Planet.GetName]的温科沃特花园应以非破坏性方式使用。

这是你的最后一次机会，要么同意我方的指导方针，要么立即面临惩罚。
excerpt.en:
Intrusive entity: you remain in apparent violation of §YDirective WAPP-715§!, concerning the non-destructive use of the Wenkwort gardens at designate [root.Planet.GetName].

This is your last opportunity to accede to our

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上最新建设计划被深层地陷打断了。伤亡不大，并且我们的基础设施没有受到太大影响。然而该地质活动揭露了一座地下交通网络的一角。尴尬的测量师们已经开始勘察这些突然出现的隧道。似乎这属于[From.Planet.GetName]过去的历史……
excerpt.en: Deep-level cave-ins have shaken our newest building project on [From.Planet.GetName]. Casualties were minimal, and none of our primary infrastructure was affected. This geological activity has, however, revealed part of

excerpt.zh:
发掘进行没多久，设计更为错综、建造更加牢靠的隧道和设备就显露了出来。宽轨铁轨与卧铺列车保存状况良好，周围还有各式各样的遗物以及扔了几个世纪的垃圾。

在这些残骸中留有各种经过精心阳极氧化处理的引擎和信号设施部件，和§Y维修站§!里会有的东西一样。所有部件上都刻有精致而复杂的几何图样，或许这其中有高级的艺术技巧，甚至曾令人引以为豪。
excerpt.en: It wasn't long before our excavations revealed tunnels and equipment of sturdier construction and more intricate design. Heavy-gauge rails and sleepers lie preserved and intact, surrounded by myriad relics and centuries-

excerpt.zh:
我们在对一条狭窄辅道试探性发掘时，找到了一个死去多时的爬行动物，死因是大约§Y800年§!前发生的顶板塌陷。遗体出现在这条隧道里的原因一开始是个谜题，但我们在对其身上携带的许多武器进行研究后找到了答案。

发现的带刃工具中有许多挂在一顶装饰性盾牌的内侧，制造这些工具的技术和我们比起来只能算原始，但却与在隧道轨路上使用的技术明显不同。这位带着盾牌的来访者如同我们一样，并不属于这颗星球，而且看起来还在进行与我们类似的考古研究，直至在隧道中丧
excerpt.en: Our chance excavation of a narrow side-tunnel has revealed a long-dead reptilian occupant, whose demise by ceiling collapse dates back some §Y800 years§!. Their presence in this tunnel was something of a puzzle, solved o

excerpt.zh:
负盾者的记录把我们带到了一座§Y变电站§!，这座变电站曾经用于维持这个维修场。看起来他们的探险打破了该设施的气密封印；这里很少有腐烂的迹象。布满灰尘的电缆管道在几十个监视器周围形成柱廊。正是在这样一个通道上，我们发现了残留的来自§Y另一感性物种的§!遗迹。

负盾者的探险队称这是一群软体动物技术人员——他们仍然保存完好的尸体挤在一起，以相互保护或取暖。记录中还记录了两次试图重新启动这个有千年历史的变电站的尝试，但使用的工具都不如我们的。
excerpt.en: The Targe-bearer's notes have led us to an §Yelectrical substation§! which once served this maintenance yard. It looks like their expedition broke an atmospheric seal on the facility; there are comparatively few signs of

excerpt.zh:
就在我们利用一台便携式相位发生器，从[From.Planet.GetName]上启动变电站的几分钟后，该设施突然响起刺耳的警报。几秒钟后，就在我们的挖掘小组工作的地方，部分天花板和铁路旁边的一段墙壁坍塌了。

故障已经被追踪到一个我们以为它是不相连的§R腐蚀的电阻器线圈§!。这一疏忽造成了几人受伤，并决定了我们挖掘队十多名队员的命运；他们现在正步上了负盾者的悲惨的后尘。
excerpt.en: Mere minutes after we jump-started the substation on [From.Planet.GetName] using a portable phase generator, the facility erupted with piercing alarms. Seconds later, part of the ceiling and a section of wall adjoining t

excerpt.zh:
这个变电站遗迹的复杂性让我们吃惊。我们用一台便携式相位发生器启动了它，但随之而来的爆炸活动导致我们周围有千年历史的建筑部分坍塌。

幸运的是，我们的队伍得到了足够的预警，找到了避险处。他们发现一些地区现在已经被完全封锁，但一些新的地区已经取而代之地开放。
excerpt.en: This relic of a substation has surprised us with its complexity. We jump-started it using a portable phase generator, but the ensuing burst of activity caused parts of the millennia-old structure around us to collapse.

excerpt.zh:
我们对这个挖掘地点的意外“改造”暴露了一条长距离的铁路隧道，根据我们破译的控制面板，一列火车躺在那里，隐藏在侧边。同时，这个系统也对列车应用了不同的优先级标记，包括一个我们称之为“§Y仓库§!”的词。

因为很少有一个关键的人工制品以这样大的形式出现在我们面前，我们派去一个团队让火车再次启动。古董火车头本身就是一件足够优雅的工程，但它背后每一辆精心装饰的汽车都被证明是一座博物馆。

火车最好被理解为一个漫游的时间胶囊，随时准备被移动到安
excerpt.en: Our accidental remodelling of this dig site exposed a long-distance rail tunnel down which - according to the control panels we deciphered - a train lay, tucked away in sidings. Those same systems had applied various pri

excerpt.zh:
我们对这个挖掘地点的意外改造暴露了一个货场，它是从一个巨大的拱形洞穴屋顶下凿出来的。在它众多巨大而空无一人的仓库中，只有留下了一个安全封条没有启封；在重新打开的时候，我们发现了更多的负盾者的尸体。他们来这里寻找补给，却与一个有千年历史的警报系统发生冲突。

根据他们留下的日志，这个巡回的§Y芬鲁尼尔远征队§!正在调查[From.Planet.GetName]是否为宜居世界。他们没有料到会在这里发现废墟。由于没有受过训练，对考古学也不感兴
excerpt.en: Our accidental remodelling of this dig site has exposed a goods yard, hewn from under a vast and vaulted cave roof. Of its many vast and vacant warehouses, only one had its security seals tripped; upon re-opening it we f

excerpt.zh:
来自[From.From.Planet.GetName]的铁路建造者留下的记录告诉我们这群狂热的软体动物是如何逃离他们对恐惧科技的家园，通过机械化的努力来寻求更好的自我。他们撤退到一个神秘而遥远的§Y地下洞穴网络§!，后来通过铁路隧道连接和扩大了它们的栖息地。

由于担心他们的文化有一天会被猎杀和消灭，皮耶普人为了安全在地下修建。在接下来的200年里，他们的社会发展缓慢，在此期间，他们的家乡的政府变得更加孤立和偏执。一次激进的转变就促使
excerpt.en: The records left by the railroad-builders of [From.From.Planet.GetName] tell how this fervent band of molluscoids fled their technophobic homeland, seeking to better themselves through mechanical endeavor. They retreated

excerpt.zh:
我国各处的多个研究站探测到了以[root.Capital.GetName]的恒星基地为中心，超空间中存在的轻微变形。这一效应在“真空”中表现为局部的类极光现象，居住在恒星基地上的人员将其描述为一种色彩鲜艳的气态卷须，包裹着整个空间站。

此外，我们在[root.GetAllianceName]中的盟友报告称他们的首都星系出现了类似现象。总统[discloud_coordinator.ruler.GetRegnalName]已呼吁立即对此
excerpt.en: Various research stations across our empire have detected subtle distortions in hyperspace, centered upon the starbase at [root.Capital.GetName]. The effect presents in 'real space' as a localized aurora, which starbase

excerpt.zh:
我们对[root.Capital.GetName]中极光状云团的调查解决了一些问题，但提出了更多疑问。这些形态各异的卷须状云团会在我们向盟友的研究队伍发出通讯光束后出现，但也只有这样才会出现。每朵云都略带红色，边缘凹凸不平，移动方式躁动。

单靠我们自己无法从这些行为中分辨出进一步的含义——但在§Y全体成员国结果汇总后§!，[root.GetAllianceName]应该会有更多答案。

初期理论猜测这些跨维度实体以某种方式与我们的超空
excerpt.en: Our investigation of the aurora-like cloud at [root.Capital.GetName] raised more questions than answers. Distinct tendrils of cloud form whenever we beam communications to our allies' research teams - but only then. Each

excerpt.zh:
在对我们的研究结果进行比对后发现，这些在我们联邦成员国首都盘绕的、看似没有知觉的极光状云团事实上组成了一个单一的有生命实体。

研究者们能得出的结果如下：这个居住在超空间的实体因为事故漂移到了我们联邦的宇域，它被“钩在”我们最为繁忙（也就是为我们首都的恒星基地提供服务）的太空通讯中继器上。研究者一致同意这个气态实体之前正§H尝试重组自身§!，如果不是现在的状况，它处于碎片状态下是做不到这件事的。

在重组完成后，这朵云消失了，它回到了超
excerpt.en:
The results of our findings have been collated: it would seem that every instance of barely-sentient aurora cloud at our federation's capitals was, in fact, part of a single, living entity.

As best the researchers can t

excerpt.zh:
在对我们的研究结果进行比对后发现，这些在我们联邦成员国首都盘绕的、看似没有知觉的极光状云团事实上组成了一个单一的有生命实体。

我们收集到的数据并不完整，但足以推断出我们遭遇了一个格式塔存在：这个气态存在适于居住在超空间中。项目合作者提出理论，认为这朵云的各个部分在漂移过我们星系时被“钩在”了首都的恒星基地上。它似乎想要§H重组自身§!——但由于我方没有一致为其提供帮助，这朵云的某些部分渐渐散去，不再能参与到重组中了。

那些成功重组的
excerpt.en:
The results of our findings have been collated: it would seem that every instance of barely-sentient aurora cloud at our federation's capitals was, in fact, part of a single, living entity.

The data we have is incomplet

excerpt.zh:
由于我们没有对这一项目进行合作研究，关于这个造访我们首都的跨维度云团，我们很难确切得到些什么。理论众说纷纭，但我们都观察到这些云团变得相当躁动。

它们的物理结构开始解体，我们注意到这些云团对于刺激的反应也减少了。它们开始更为迅速地穿入穿出超空间。这在我们的通讯频段上产生了显著的静态干扰，但也为[root.Capital.GetName]的理论研究者提供了宝贵的数据。
excerpt.en: With no collaborative effort having been applied this project, little can be said with any certainty about the pan-dimensional cloud visiting our capitals. Theories abound, but all of us are now witness to these clouds'

excerpt.zh:
驶入[event_target:leylines_world.GetName]大气层的短程飞船报告，称其舰体上有奇怪的声音。声音的来源似乎在行星的地表之下，其所在地区富含稀有矿物。

我们在[from.Federation.GetName]的同事监督的星球也报告过类似事件。为应对此事，他们组成了一个由[event_target:leylines_coordinator.GetName]领导的委员会，负责协调我们都想要参与的挖掘工作。
excerpt.en: Short-range vessels whose routes take them into the atmosphere of [event_target:leylines_world.GetName] report a strange sound assaulting their hulls. The source seems to lie just below the planet's surface, in an area r

excerpt.zh:
我们在[root.Federation.GetName]的同事报告称听到了震耳欲聋的嗡嗡声，他认为声音的来源应该在地表之下，至少存在于一个星球中。他们成立了一个研究委员会，旨在支持他们的挖掘工作。

他们要求我们提供自己的额外资源，以便我们能够更好地理解这件奇怪的麻烦事。
excerpt.en: Our colleagues in the [root.Federation.GetName] report a deafening hum from sources thought to lie buried on at least one of their worlds. A research committee has been established to support any excavation efforts they

excerpt.zh:
我们未能向同事提供他们要求的额外隔音罩。好在设备匮乏只会阻碍他们的工作，并不会彻底阻止他们挖掘。但是，这还是让一线研究人员更加不安。纵使报告显示噪音现在正自己减弱，他们的情绪也没有任何好转。

[root.Federation.GetName]项目委员会现在邀请我们研究声音本身，看看能否得到些许启发，以此来弥补我们之前的过失。
excerpt.en: We have failed to provide our colleagues with the additional acoustic shielding they had requested. This lack of equipment will only hamper their efforts, and won't stall them outright. Nevertheless, it has left their fr

excerpt.zh: 我们已成功提高了折叠隔音罩的覆盖范围和适应力，并与[root.Federation.GetName]的同事共享了这些升级成果。他们的一线研究员报告称意识不清和身体剧痛的情况已经有了极大改善。协调委员会现在要求我们协助进行数据分析。
excerpt.en: We have succeeded in improving the reach and resilience of our deployable acoustic shields. These upgrades have been shared with our colleagues in the [root.Federation.GetName]; their researchers on the ground already re

excerpt.zh: 我们未能得出令人满意的成果，[root.Federation.GetName]项目委员会对此表示失望。困扰联邦内多个星球的噪音终于消失，但研究机会的窗口也随之关闭。研究人员尽自己所能收集了一些信息，但现在只能寄希望于现场的考古学家能够给出详细的答案。
excerpt.en: The [root.Federation.GetName] project committee expresses its disappointment in our lack of results. As the din which has afflicted a number of our federated worlds finally dimmed, so too did the window of research oppor

excerpt.zh: 联邦境内处考古遗址中的嗡鸣已经开始减弱。通过研究每种声音的录音，并将我们与同事的数据进行交叉对比，我们发现，当震耳欲聋的嗡鸣相互重叠时，会产生惊艳绝伦的和声，旋律可绕梁三日，令人心旷神怡。对于建造这些遗址的人来说，这种设计可能具有文化意义，但我们可能永远无法了解其中的含义。研究仍在继续……
excerpt.en: The humming at archaeological sites across our federation's space has begun to subside. By studying recordings of each sound - and cross-referencing our data with that of our colleagues - we discovered a surprising harmo

records.zh: 声震屋瓦的贝壳形建筑

excerpt.zh:
尽管我们必须断断续续地轮班工作，但从技术上讲，揭开这个遗址的奥秘非常简单。我们挖开了两层平平无奇的岩石，然后才看到一个大贝壳，也可以说是穹顶。此外，附近有一些相同的穹顶也已部分出土，目前看来，这些穹顶似乎排列成弧形或圆形。

每个穹顶都是用模子建成，并且进行过一定程度的加固，能够经受地质年代的考验。每个建筑都有会议室大小，因此应该能够进入其中。
excerpt.en: The work of uncovering this site was technically straightforward - despite our having to work in staccato shifts. We removed two featureless strata before encountering a large shell or dome. Other, identical domes have b

excerpt.zh:
尽管我们尚未确定无处不在的嗡鸣的来源，但其主导地位已经开始有所减弱。自此以后，我们的研究人员就能够专注突破这座类似半球的建筑。

里面的空间完全没有实际内容，我们初步结论为，此建筑是按感官隔离室设计的。此外，穹顶的内表面似乎画有星座图，辅以神话人物和某种形式的经文。我们正在努力解读这些设计。
excerpt.en:
While we have yet to identify the source of the pervasive humming, its dominating presence has begun to wane. Our researchers were since able to focus on breaching the near-hemispherical structure.

The space within is e

records.zh: 贝壳形建筑的内部结构

excerpt.zh:
我们在穹顶内部发现了大量精巧的设备，但没有一台能够产生我们在外面还能听到的巨大噪音。一支小规模的工作小队已经独立出去，继续我们的调查工作。

大部分研究人员还留在这个贝壳形结构中，研究其内部机制，设备结构复杂，装饰美观，乍一看像是某种大型计算器。
excerpt.en: We discovered a plethora of elaborate equipment inside the dome, none of which seems capable of producing the immense noise we can still hear outside. A small task force has split off to continue that aspect of our inves

excerpt.zh:
来自[from.owner.Federation.GetName]各地的报告都确认：嗡鸣现已消失。尽管各星际遗址之间距离遥远，但嗡鸣声几乎在同一时间停止。

从那以后，我们的研究团队依据穹顶内部描绘的众多星座推断出了一些模型，这些星座通常用于占星预测。研究人员收集的数据表明，此设施，若是按年代排序，比周围地层要古老得多——但有一处明显的例外：研究人员偶然在穹顶外面发现了一个大型祭坛，这表明在相对较近的年代，至少有一个文明曾使用过这一空间
excerpt.en:
Reports from across the [From.Owner.Federation.GetName] confirm: the droning sirens have now dissipated. They ceased almost simultaneously, despite the vast distances between interstellar sites.

Since that time, our res

excerpt.zh:
来自[from.owner.Federation.GetName]各地的报告都表明：困扰我们共有空间各处研究遗址的嗡鸣声已经消失。这让我们的研究人员如释重负，因为他们可以开始研究穹顶内安置的复杂设备了。

尽管其设计古怪之极，但我们仍然辨认出，该设备由相互连接的太阳系仪组成。这些模型描绘了整个[from.system.GetName]星系和另外两个恒星系，但我们以及联邦内的同事至今仍不知道这两个星系的名称和位置。每台太阳系仪都由一组轴和
excerpt.en: Reports from across the [From.Owner.Federation.GetName] confirm: the ringing hum which was plaguing research sites across our shared space has now dissipated. This came as relief to our researchers as they investigated t

excerpt.zh:
我们对[from.Planet.GetName]和其他地方穹顶的研究已结束。每个遗址都是巨大的占星设备，跨越星际的距离与其他设备同步。

我们的研究表明，这类设施被视为宇宙能量的汇聚点，影响着建造设施的古老文明的总体“位置感”。蚀刻记录中提到，议会将“引导”这些能量，从而指引其帝国的命运。

他们的社会最终依然走向衰落，这种仪式并没有为其逆天改命。但在之后的一千年中，出现了一个继业的文明，这一继承者文明翻译并恢复了这一仪式。那之后，他们
excerpt.en:
Our study of the domes on [From.Planet.GetName] and elsewhere has reached an end. Each site is a vast astrological device, synchronized with others like it across interstellar distances.

Our studies suggest that facilit

excerpt.zh:
有人可能会说，我们直到最后一刻才收集完数据。联邦最新成果刚刚发布没几天，[from.Federation.GetName]境内几个圆顶遗址就突然活跃起来，一束束光从地下深处飞流直上，正好映照在我们首都上方，这让人难以置信。

我们的研究人员也很困惑，遗址的建造者怎么会知道这些？但是[root.Capital.GetName]的人民更关心一连串梦幻般的景象，所有人都亲眼见证了这短暂的景象。广播只传达了一个目的，即宣告这件事成为“§H求索的
excerpt.en: One might say that the last of our data was gathered in the nick of time. Mere days after the last of our federation's findings was published, each domed site within [from.Federation.GetName] space burst into life. Casca

excerpt.zh:
一刹那，[from.Federation.GetName]境内几座圆顶遗址突然活跃起来。据报告，一束束光从地下深处的源头倾泻而出，正好映照在我们首都上方，这简直不可思议。

我们的研究人员也很困惑，遗址的建造者怎么会知道这些？但是[root.Capital.GetName]的人民更关心一连串梦幻般的景象，所有人都亲眼见证了这短暂的景象。尽管还不清楚广播的目的，但人们共同见证这一景象凸显出一种§H平衡繁荣§!的情感氛围。

没有关于后续现
excerpt.en: Each of the once-noisy, domed sites within [from.Federation.GetName] space has, for a brief moment, burst into life. Cascades of light were reported spilling out from sources deep underground, their beams cast squarely -

excerpt.zh:
整个[from.Federation.GetName]的智能生物都为眼前突然出现的宏伟景象所震惊。与此同时，几年前发现的古老圆顶遗址突然活跃起来。据报告，一束束光从地下深处的源头倾泻而出，正好映照在我们首都上方，这简直不可思议。

我们在[root.Capital.GetName]的研究人员对这种梦幻般的景象感到非常困惑。目前我们还不清楚这一现象的目的，也没有观测到后续现象，因此无法获得更多线索。我们似乎错过了对其加以研究的时机。
excerpt.en: Sapients throughout the [from.Federation.GetName] have been startled by a sudden, apparent hijacking of visual feeds which coincided with a burst of activity from ancient, domed sites discovered some years ago. Cascades

excerpt.zh:
[Root.Federation.GetName]的成员们以圣灵之名汇聚一堂。我们在各自的信仰之间找到了共同点，但联邦内仍然还有着多种信条、宗教和教会，和谐共处并不容易。

最近，僧团的成员敦促[Root.Federation.GetName]主持一场主教会议，以便共商起草一份联合教条，定义我们信仰的根基。这个提案被通过了，每一个[Root.Federation.GetName]的成员都要派出他们的代表。
excerpt.en: The members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] are united around their spirituality. We found common ground in the fact that we are believers, but the federation is home to various creeds, faiths and churches and cohabitat

excerpt.zh: 今天的议题是“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”，我们的使团用最华丽的辞藻和无可辩驳的逻辑作出了一场令人印象深刻的陈辞，从气势上彻底碾压了那些反对者我们观点的声音。得益于我们的精彩表现，对手陷入了沉默并且会议很快得出结论。各国使团希望能因我们的智慧而给予嘉奖。

本应被调包的领袖将这一切都归罪到某个敌国身上。因此，[prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的局势渐渐变得紧张，战争似乎一触即发。我方渗透人员准备进行全球性的舆论造势以缓和局势，但需要我们派遣科研船进入轨道进行协助。

随着局势的平息，我们蛰伏特工的影响力提升了。现在整个局势最后对我们非常有利。

短时间内，这颗星球上的大多数人都被卷入了一场全面宗教战争，这是他们称为“天人”的科研团队短暂降临的直接后果。当其中一个交战方为自己的另一位新神修建了另一座金字塔后，争执化为了暴力。在这场宗教冲突中，许多[great_pyramid_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都因此而亡。

The chaos on §Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§! has at last reached a lull, revealing the full extent of our team's catastrophic intervention.

In a short span of time, large parts of the population broke out into all-ou

[great_pyramid_country.GetSpeciesName]达到此等文化和历史理解之迅速让我们的科学家们叹为观止。这也支持了[root.GetPreFTLLower]社会即

于是乎我们沮丧地了解到这个生物正因为衣不蔽体而感到尴尬，正在反复地请求合适的衣物以遮蔽其赤裸的躯体。

在得体地遮蔽躯体后，我们的研究者建造了一台多肢机器以便与这个生物交流。

Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] has determined the wriggling tentacle motions of our guest are a form of sophisticated sign language.

To our dismay, we thus learned that the creature is embarrassed about its lack of clot

我们继续尝试同其进行沟通。

万爪之母不确定她是否有能力复制这一壮举，更何况她的能量储备目前已经耗尽，无法再做尝试。

当前，她愿意继续接受我们的照顾，并将通过帮助我们的研究人员来回报我们的热情款待。

在我们能够进一步了解它的新陈代谢机制之前，通讯行为暂时停止。

Our attempts to provide our mysterious visitor with suitable nourishment have failed: the creature quickly sickened, expelled the meal, and is currently unresponsive.

Communication efforts are on hold until we can gain

该生物对我们的尝试性联络反应激烈，猛烈地袭击了一位我们的科学家，并拒绝进一步的合作。也许我们无意见冒犯了它。

尽管没有人严重受伤，但是这次事故依然对迄今为止我们同这个生物建立的脆弱的信任造成了损伤。

The creature has reacted violently to our communication attempts, lashing out at one of our scientists and refusing further collaboration. We believe we have unintentionally offended it.

这位笼罩着神秘主义色彩的太空生命愿意分享她的知识，尽管她也不确定我们是否能够复制这项技术。我们首都的一座合适的建筑已经准备好被改造成一座研究用的神殿。
excerpt.en:
Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] have expressed an interest in learning the §HJaunt§!, the teleportation technique used by the §HMany-Tentacled One§! to reach our homeworld.

The space-faring mystic is willing to share her

我们的万爪之母最近表达了回归家乡的渴望，但我们难以定位她的母星系：她所描述的天体特征不符合我们所知星系的任何一个区域。

我们的访客凝视着夜空，久久不曾挪开视线。

“§H我很害怕，但我必须要闪现离开了。我心中的思乡之情无处排解，苦痛难耐。感谢你们所做的一切。我祈祷薄幕会善待我。§!”

The Many-Tentacled One is nowhere to be found. The creature disappeared as abruptly as she appeared, leaving a hastily scratched goodbye message on the floor of the research facility:

'§HI'm scared, but I have to Jaunt.

这位研究人员传送了一米，但因为传送至地板内导致失去了下部附肢。随之而来的是许多掌声和一些尖叫声。

After spending many years trying to master the secrets of psionic teleportation, one of our [owner.GetScientistPlural] finally managed to §HJaunt§! successfully.

The researcher teleported a short distance but lost their

excerpt.zh:
又一次成功§H闪现§!了！根据我们的传感器数据，我们的一位[owner.GetScientistPlural]成功地传送到了离我们最近的恒星系，在几分之一秒内跨越了不可估量的距离。只是这个倒霉蛋在一颗恒星内实体化，并瞬间化为灰烬。

使用这种技术来推进舰船讨论遭到了深刻的质疑。虽然建造灵能的推进的引擎存在可能性，但这种技术应用起来可能会难以置信地危险，甚至会给宇宙带来混乱。
excerpt.en: Another successful §HJaunt§!. According to our sensor data, one of our [owner.GetScientistPlural] managed to teleport to our closest neighboring solar system, crossing incalculable distances in a fraction of a second...

excerpt.zh:
我们在完善§H闪现§!之后得到的结论是：一无是处。我们的[GetResearchers]们可能要花费数十年来掌握这项技术，结果也只会是因传送入石头、恒星甚至是一颗黑洞的首次闪现而死。它实在太不精确，根本带不来任何可行的好处。我们越是尝试，就越清楚地意识到，§H万爪之母§!的到来完全是随缘。

也许总有一天，我们梦寐以求的灵能推进器会成为现实。但至少不是今天。

excerpt.zh: 我们在完善§H闪现§!之后得到的结论是：一无是处。我们的[GetResearchers]们可能要花费数十年来掌握这项技术，结果也只会是因传送入石头、恒星甚至是一颗黑洞的首次闪现而死。它实在太不精确，根本带不来任何可行的好处。我们越是尝试，就越清楚地意识到，§H万爪之母§!的到来完全是随缘。

excerpt.zh:
§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的居民通过试用富营养肥料提高了他们的农业水平。他们能够收获到更高质量的农作物产品，社会的整体健康也得到改善。

考虑到他们简陋的技术，这种粮食生产的进步是非常显著的。获得化肥样品后，我们就可以在更大范围内复刻这一成就。
excerpt.en: The inhabitants of §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have enhanced their agricultural skills through experimentation with nutrient-rich fertilizers. Their harvests are yielding higher quality produce and the health of the

records.zh: 温顺好生养：已研究样品

excerpt.zh: 我们对从§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上收集到的肥料样本的分析获得了对前超光速文明农业行为的重要见解，其中的一部分甚至新到可以增进我们自己的技术。大家纷纷表示，这次努力物有所值，任务大获成功。
excerpt.en: Our analysis of collected fertilizer samples from §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! has provided valuable insights into pre-FTL agricultural practices, some so novel that they could actually bolster our own techniques

excerpt.zh:
§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的定居点一直在经历着农业困境。最近的农作物歉收可能会导致争夺食物的冲突。对于一个年轻的、发展中的社会，这是一个关键时刻。

无论他们是选择在需要的时候团结在一起，还是反目成仇，他们现在的决定对于未来朝着哪个方向发展都会产生很大的影响。

不幸的是，无论采取哪种方式，他们都将进入一个极端困难的时期。
excerpt.en: The settlements on §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have been experiencing agricultural difficulties. Recent crop failures could lead to conflicts over food. This is a critical moment in the development of a young societ

excerpt.zh:
我们最近对§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的干预产生了正面的结果。利用我们自己的农业技术，我们暗中确保了他们不会遭受饥荒。

现在，他们有了盈余的食物，所以我们必须约束自己的行径，限制干预的程度。
excerpt.en:
Our recent intervention on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! yielded positive results. Utilizing our own agricultural technologies, we covertly ensured they would not starve.

Now, they have a surplus of food, so it i

excerpt.zh:
§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的居民持续地在他们的公共生活空间中创造出原始的、艺术化的代表作品，我们注意到其中有些图像开始显露出我们的轮廓。

现在看来，我们在这颗星球上的所作所为很可能已经引起了注意。
excerpt.en:
As the inhabitants of §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! continue to create crude, artistic representations in their communal living spaces, we have noticed some images have begun to look like us.

It now seems likely that

excerpt.zh:
在§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上，居民们正在使用原始的雕刻图画来表达和分享想法。我们的研究人员记录的样本表明，居民对他们自己星球以外的天体有认识，甚至已经开始记录星座。

对于这样一个年轻的文明来说，他们早期绘制的星图是相当准确的，但也不至于到了无法改进的地步，只要我们想留下一些暗示……
excerpt.en: On §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, the inhabitants are using crudely carved imagery to express and share ideas. Samples documented by our researchers indicate that the inhabitants have an awareness of celestial bodies

records.en: Written in the Stars: Charts Delivered

excerpt.zh:
由§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的居民绘制的早期星图被我们暗中修订了。

描绘附近恒星系图样的雕刻是在附近的一个山洞里制作的。一旦它们被发现，它们应该能够让当地居民对已知宇宙的规模有一个更好的认识。
excerpt.en:
The early star charts of the inhabitants on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have been covertly corrected.

Carvings depicting nearby system diagrams were made in a nearby cave. Once they are discovered, they should

records.en: Written in the Stars: Charts Received

excerpt.zh:
不幸的是，由于§Y[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的居民不知道是谁负责制作了他们的新星图，他们把我们的所作所为视作单纯的破坏行为。山洞周围的安保措施得到了加强，统治精英们对新形式的自我表达越来越敌视……

从积极的方面看，我们的干预并不是完全浪费时间。他们对这一事件的反应在文化研究方面很有价值。
excerpt.en: Unfortunately, since the inhabitants of §Y[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! did not know who was responsible for their new star charts, they passed off our efforts as simple vandalism. Security around the caves has

excerpt.zh: 我们没能顺利地在暗中纠正§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的星图。对于一个如此年幼的社会而言他们的安保措施令人意外地复杂。对目前的任务来说，暴露的风险太高了。至少目前当地居民需要依靠自己的力量来探索星空了。
excerpt.en: Our efforts to covertly correct the star charts on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have been unsuccessful. Their security protocols are surprisingly sophisticated for such a young society. Given our current mission,

excerpt.zh:
在§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上独立出现了多种非语言的沟通体系。由于在图像和象形文字集之间存在冲突，居民们距离形成一种主导语言还有几个世纪。

有趣的是，其中一个书写体系的语法结构与我们的很相似。如果§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的社会采用这个系统，他们在未来可能会在文化上相当具有可塑性……
excerpt.en: Multiple non-verbal communication systems have emerged independently on §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. With conflicting sets of imagery and hieroglyphs, the inhabitants are still centuries away from forming a dominant

excerpt.zh:
我们在§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的存在引起了旁人的注意。占主要地位的文化团体现在将我们视为睿智而强大的存在，认为我们控制着元素，并最终掌握着他们的宿命。

许多人在精心设计的仪式中以自己的性命向我们宣誓效忠，担心招致我们的不悦会带来十分严重的后果。
excerpt.en:
Our presence on §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! has not gone unnoticed. The dominant cultural group now regards us as wise and mighty beings who control the elements and ultimately their fate.

Many have pledged their l

excerpt.zh: 在对§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的社会进行了大量的历史观察之后，他们占主流地位的社会群体已经把我们当作神灵来敬仰。他们希望继续用恩惠的行为得到我们的青睐……因此，为了纪念我们，血祭仍在继续。
excerpt.en: After actively observing their society for a substantial chunk of their history, the dominant society on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have come to revere us as deities. They wish to keep us in their good graces..

excerpt.zh:
根据§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!当地居民的说法，根本没有神。

尽管我们试图将自己打造成他们神圣的主人，却被他们一眼看穿了本质。人们完全拒绝神灵的概念，接受了一种明显倾向于唯物主义的宇宙观。在没有确凿证据的情况下，他们相信在宇宙中只有自己。
excerpt.en:
According to the inhabitants of §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, there are no gods.

Although, we attempted to assert ourselves as their divine overlords, they saw through us easily. Rejecting the concept of deities

excerpt.zh: §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的社会正不断孕育出丰富的文化和对艺术进行深刻鉴赏的风潮。居民们放下了武器，转而使用书写工具。随着这种全新的学习和探索氛围已超脱于冲突之上，我们可能正在见证这个行星上一个黄金时代的到来。
excerpt.en: Society on §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! is blossoming with rich culture and a deep appreciation for art. The inhabitants are putting down their weapons in favor of writing instruments. With this newfound willingness

excerpt.zh: 我们正在见证§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的居民迈出他们走向启蒙的第一步。他们向上抬头，对宇宙的奥秘始终抱持开放的态度。随着艺术表达在他们文化中的发展，艺术力量捕捉社会的精神奋斗的一面也在发展。他们渴望有某种高于自我的信仰。
excerpt.en: We are witnessing the inhabitants of §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! taking their first steps towards enlightenment. They look upwards, opening themselves to the mysteries of the universe. As artistic expression develop

excerpt.zh: 通过向存在的神圣真理开放自己，§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的居民正在接近开悟。作为精神领袖，我们有责任引导他们。
excerpt.en: By opening themselves to the divine truth of existence, the inhabitants of §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! are approaching enlightenment. As spiritual leaders, it is our duty to guide them.

excerpt.zh: 当§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的居民仰望天空时，他们希望得到圣灵的赐福。然而，他们实际得到的是沉默。他们的祈祷没有得到回应。现在他们必须接受精神飘忽不定的本质。只有科学拥有他们寻求的答案。
excerpt.en: When the inhabitants of §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! looked up to the skies they hoped to receive blessings from the divine. What they actually received was silence. Their prayers have gone unanswered. Now they m

excerpt.zh: §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的居民已经开始提出一个理论，认为他们的所在的星球是由一个不可言喻的存在赠送给他们的，而生命是对神圣造物主不屈不挠的奉献所进行的回报。或许当他们遇到更广泛的星海共同体时，他们会有一个惊喜。
excerpt.en: The inhabitants of §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have begun to theorize that their world was gifted to them by an ineffable being, and that life is a reward for unyielding devotion to a divine creator. They may be in

excerpt.zh:
通过向§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的唯心领袖们现身，我们告诉他们所谓的“神圣造物主”并不存在。他们想要的答案只有通过科学才能找到。

不幸的是，我们的这堂课没有起到效果。这些人们将我们视为神明，整日向我们三叩九拜。我们的任务起到了反效果。
excerpt.en: Revealing ourselves to the would-be spiritual leaders on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, we assured them that their so-called 'divine creator' does not exist. The answers they seek can be found only through science

excerpt.zh:
他们生气了！我们的行动彻底地惹恼了§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的居民。数个世纪以来，他们社会中的成员经常在神秘的情况下失踪，然后又在数日或数月后出现，口述着难以置信的外星科技的故事，这一切在他们眼里无异于魔法。

可以理解，发现魔法不存在，这一切仅仅是外星人们为了研究你们的所作所为这件事极大地撼动了他们的世界观。人们在一夜之间倒向孤立主义，礼貌地要求我们不要再把他们当成实验对象。也许我们是该考
excerpt.en: They are furious! Our actions have completely embarrassed the inhabitants of §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. For centuries, members of their society have disappeared under mysterious circumstances, only to reappear

excerpt.zh:
§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上快速的科技进展催生了工业化的时代。交通方式的跃进式发展将此前星球上相对孤立的区域连成一片，创造了环球贸易和思想交流的机遇。

然而，资源的危机正在悄悄酝酿。如果其他星球上的历史也会重演的话，这里的人们很快就会陷入战争。
excerpt.en: Rapid technological advances on §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! are ushering in an age of industrialization. Breakthroughs in transportation have linked previously disconnected areas of the world, creating opportunity f

excerpt.zh: 我们冒着计算过的风险，向§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的星球领袖透露了自己的身份。我们毫不含糊地建议当地政府结束他们的冲突，警告说战争的后果很可能是灾难性的。许多人试探性地听着。其他人则认为任何关于“外星使者”的谈话都是一个骗局。
excerpt.en: Taking a calculated risk, we revealed ourselves to world leaders of §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. In no uncertain terms, we advised the local governments to end their conflict, warning that the consequences of wa

excerpt.zh:
我们决定任由§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的星球领袖自行发展，现在他们是自己命运的第一责任人了。不幸的是，好像他们正在走向战争。

据信是不可调和的差异导致了星球上不同的文化群体之间兵戎相见。紧随而来的冲突开启了他们的发展史上一段黑暗的篇章。
excerpt.en:
In choosing to leave the world leaders of §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! to their own devices, they are now wholly responsible for their destiny. Unfortunately, it appears they are headed for war.

Supposedly irrec

excerpt.zh: §Y[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的各领袖接受了我们的建议，放下了他们的武器。很难说这样的和平会持续多久，但至少现在，他们不太可能将自己从他们的行星表面抹除了。
excerpt.en: The leaders of §Y[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have taken our advice and put down their weapons. It is impossible to say if the peace will last, but for now at least, they are unlikely to wipe themselves from th

excerpt.zh:
我们的接入对§Y[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!宛如火上浇油。他们的整个星球陷入了战争。然而，如果他们没能互相消灭的话，这种局势也许也有积极的一面：这颗行星上的科技进步成果卓绝。

也许，当战争的硝烟散去，他们就能妥善地把这些科技用到正道上。
excerpt.en: Our intervention may have added fuel to the proverbial fire on §Y[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. Their world is now at war. However, if they fail to eradicate one another, there may be an upside to the situation:

excerpt.zh:
§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!科学技术得到了进一步的发展，因为工业化使他们的社会达到了新的高度。他们在工程方面的最新突破彻底改变了他们对交通的运用，这使他们离行星统一更近了一步。

与我们模型预期的不同，§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!现在成为了一个统一的星球。他们将资源统一调配，人们则将为整个星球的社区的福祉作为首要任务，生活水平大幅提升。
excerpt.en: Technology continues to progress on §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, as industrialization takes their society to new heights. Their most recent breakthrough in engineering has revolutionized their use of transportation

excerpt.zh: §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的生活正在蓬勃发展，繁荣的经济为我们提供了一些……千载难逢的机会。一个新近建造的陆路货运网络就是一个理想的目标。从理论上讲，我们的特工人员可以很容易地登上这些货车，夺取货物。然而，根据我们目前的观测姿态，我们必须要采取额外的预防措施，以保持不被更多人发现。
excerpt.en: Life on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! is thriving, and the booming economy offers us certain... unique opportunities. A newly constructed network of land freighters is an ideal target. In theory, our operatives co

excerpt.zh: §Y[FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的货物打劫行动是一场成功。我们的特工夺得了一小部分合金，同时在下面的时候还学到了很多有关[GetPreFTLLower]转运的知识。
excerpt.en: The cargo heist on §Y[FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! was a success. Our agents secured a small cache of alloys, and learned a lot about [GetPreFTLLower] transit while they were down there.

excerpt.zh: §Y[FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的货物打劫行动宣告失败。我们的特工在某艘陆地货船上的行动中惨遭抓获。在接下来的冲突中，双方都遭受了伤亡，我们的特工身份暴露。
excerpt.en: The cargo heist on §Y[FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! was a failure. Our operatives were apprehended mid-operation aboard a land freighter. During the ensuing altercation, casualties were recorded on both sides

records.en: Conflict! What is it Good For?

excerpt.zh: 一场战争在§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上爆发了。最近这些年，这颗星球上的某些派系设法积累了足够的财富，对生产资料实施了垄断。与之对应，其他人对于日益严重的不平等进行了反抗。现在，一场席卷一切的阶级战争爆发了。对于§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!来说，这是一个黑暗的时代，后果将持续很长时间。
excerpt.en: A war has broken out on §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. In recent years, certain factions on the planet managed to accrue enough wealth to monopolize the means of production. In turn, others revolted against the growin

excerpt.zh:
§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的战争结束了。革命者们一个接一个失败了。主导派系继续从因自身贪婪引起的战争中获利，四处尸山血海。

一切恢复了原状，革命的呼声也一时噤若寒蝉。
excerpt.en:
The war on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! is over. One by one, the revolutionaries fell. As the bodies piled high, the dominant faction continued to profit from a war triggered by their own greed.

The status quo h

excerpt.zh:
我们选择不干涉[GetPreFTLLower]文明的政治，§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的战争也按自己的步调结束了。压迫者势力轻松地碾压了革命者。

一切恢复了原状，革命失败了。
excerpt.en:
After we chose not to involve ourselves with [GetPreFTLLower] politics, the war on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! ended of its own accord. The oppressive powers steamrolled the revolutionaries with ease.

The statu

excerpt.zh:
§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上怠忽的职员们把自己忙得够呛，他们傲慢的反抗以失败告终。执行官们通过巧妙的公司改组和绩效管理手段再度控制住了局面。

一切恢复了原状。所有人再次回到了自己的工作岗位上。
excerpt.en: The delinquent employees on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have tired themselves out, and their arrogant revolt has ended in failure. The executives regained control of the situation through tactful corporate restr

excerpt.zh:
超出模型预期，§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上这些行为不端的雇员们粗暴地驱逐了管理层并取而代之。

这是一场灾难，我们的工人从中获取了灵感，并意识到了自己的处境。我们的投资陷入了前所未有的危险。我们本应更彻底地进行尽职调查的。
excerpt.en:
Defying prediction models, the delinquent employees on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! ousted their executive tier in a hostile takeover.

This is a disaster, as our own workers have taken inspiration and are now ge

excerpt.zh: 在§Y[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上，不满的声音被权势滔天的精英阶层给压制住了。然而，如果我们现在进行干预，肯定可以扭转局势。我们在这个星球上的存在可以为残余的抵抗组织提供支援。
excerpt.en: On §Y[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, dissenting voices have been silenced by the powerful elite. However, if we intervene now we could certainly turn the tide. Our presence on the planet could bolster what is lef

excerpt.zh: 我们的军队刚在§Y[FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上登陆，立即取得了对当地土著军队在物质上和战略上的全面优势。日薄西山的精英阶层已经撤退，革命者们准备好接过权力的衣钵。
excerpt.en: Landing on §Y[FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, our forces demonstrated an immediate material and strategic advantage over the native troops. The former elite has withdrawn, and the revolutionaries stand poised

excerpt.zh: §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的居民已经开始积极地寻找他们星球之外的智慧生命迹象。随着他们准备大胆地前往许多文明已经拜访过的地方时，可能我们是时候要重新评估我们的第一次接触协议了，做好准备，让更广泛的星海共同体迎接新的成员。
excerpt.en: The inhabitants of §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! have begun actively searching for signs of intelligent life beyond their world. As they prepare to boldly go where many have already gone, it may be time for us to reassess

excerpt.zh:
§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上的[GetPreFTLLower]文明不知通过何种手段截取并破解了一段发自我们轨道观测站的通讯信号。

他们正在研究一份在观测站上的工作者发往我们首都的一位未知收信人的极具个性化的信息。

这一意外的泄露暴露了一处我们安保协议的漏洞。
excerpt.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] civilization on §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! has somehow intercepted and deciphered a series of communications emanating from our orbital observation post.

They are currently studying a message of a

records.zh: 他们现在认为只剩自己了

excerpt.zh:
§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的居民搜寻智慧生命的努力一无所获。

他们投入了大量时间和资源在繁星中搜寻生命，但很沮丧地发现除了虚空以外一无所有。

目前这项研究还在进行，但可以肯定他们很快就对项目失去了希望。不必多说，我们将继续在每一个任务参数中对他们隐藏自身的存在。
excerpt.en:
The inhabitants of §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! have had no success in their search for intelligent life.

Having dedicated time and resources in the search for life amongst the stars, they were despondent to discover no

excerpt.zh:
§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上荒谬的居民们居然用他们羸弱的科技截获了一些我们过去的无线电信号。

解码和理解我们的广播足够让他们忙上几个世代。以他们目前的发展水平，我们尚且没有暴露的风险。
excerpt.en:
The ridiculous inhabitants of §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! have used their weak tech to intercept some of our historic radio signals.

Deciphering and interpreting our old broadcasts should keep them busy for a few gener

excerpt.zh:
在他们搜寻外行星智慧的过程中，§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的居民向整个星系发去了广播。他们收到的信息是，“嘘，别让他们听到了。”

这当然是我们一位特工的所作所为。结果是，这个年轻的太空民族现在正为外太空究竟蛰伏着什么恐怖动的东西而瑟瑟发抖。
excerpt.en:
In their search for extra-planetary intelligence, the inhabitants of §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! called out to the galaxy. What they received was a message which said, 'Be quiet or they will hear you.'

This was the act

excerpt.zh: 我们收到了报告，是关于在§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上进行超光速航天器推进装置的事项。当地居民似乎打算成为一个彻底的太空文明。然而，他们在星空中发现的东西，可能会证明当下阶段他们还无法理解。
excerpt.en: We have received reports of superluminal spacecraft propulsion on §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!. The inhabitants seem intent on becoming a full-fledged spacefaring civilization. What they discover in the stars may prove t

records.zh: 获得很多，但是失去的更多
records.en: Much To Gain, Yet Much to Lose

excerpt.zh:
现已证实，§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!确有一艘理论上存在超光速能力的飞船。他们已经开始进行测试，以期尽快突破光障。

一旦成功，他们在技术上便已具备涉及星系外交的能力。这样的境遇必然对他们的社会造成或好或坏的深远影响。
excerpt.en:
The existence of a theoretically FTL-capable craft on §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! is now confirmed. They have moved on to testing, hoping to soon break the light speed barrier.

If they are successful, they

excerpt.zh:
§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上雄心勃勃的宇航员们试图突破光障。整个星球的目光都聚焦在这艘飞船向着星间启航。

发射成功了。一切都按预期的参数运行中。随后他们启动了曲速引擎，事情发生了转折。

他们成功地扭曲了时空连续统（这是一种迷人但存在缺陷的超光速航行方式），然而他们只在舰船尾部成功了。随之而来的在案超乎了§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的一切想象。乘员们被剧烈地扭曲撕扯，身体的一部
excerpt.en:
The aspiring spacefarers on §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! attempted to break the light speed barrier. The whole world looked on as the spacecraft launched towards the stars.

Liftoff was a success. Everything was operatin

excerpt.zh:
§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的人们在实验性跃迁引擎方面取得了巨大的成功，然而他们在关于时空扭曲产生器的投射距离计算方面犯了严重的错误。通过与他们的直接沟通，我们得以引导他们通过超空间航道这种广为接受的方式来进行超光速航行。

依照我们的建议，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]很快就能加入我们的星系社会了。
excerpt.en: The people of §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! have made remarkable progress on their experimental jump drive, however there were some glaring mistakes in their calculations relating to the projected range of their space-tim

excerpt.zh:
§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上的居民们作为一个宇航文明加入了星海共同体。

我们的观测任务结束了，他们已经拥有了超光速运行能力。
excerpt.en:
The inhabitants of §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! have joined the wider galactic community as a spacefaring society!

Our observation mission now concludes, as they are now FTL capable.

excerpt.zh: 使用隐身[GetIndividualNamePlural]和牵引光束，我们能够成功地收集、分析和研究毫无防备的[pre_ftl_species.GetName]个体，之后再将其送还到自己的居所。不幸的是，牵引光束对于[pre_ftl_species.GetAdj]的生理机能产生了预料之外的效果。在返回家中以后，这些样品开始遭受疖子、疹子以及不受控制地打喷嚏，在回到家中的三个小时之后其外表皮还会发生溶解。这种神秘的溶肤病已经酿成了全国范围
excerpt.en: Using stealthy [GetIndividualNamePlural] and tractor beams, we were able to successfully collect, analyze and study unsuspecting [pre_ftl_species.GetName] individuals and return them to their dwellings. Unfortunately, th

excerpt.zh:
从[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上收集活体样本的时候发生了事故。由于计算错误，我们的[GetIndividualNamePlural]上配备的牵引光束强度不足。不仅没有得到样本，我们只能短暂地让它们悬浮在空中，然后立马掉到地面上。

我们试图收集的鸟类样本发现这样的事故特别好玩。这些胆子很大的样本甚至开始追逐我们的[GetIndividualNamePlural]，希望也能被带走，而且完全是出于寻求乐子。
excerpt.en: An accident occurred while collecting live samples from planet [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Due to a miscalculation, our [GetIndividualNamePlural] were equipped with tractor beams of insufficient strength. Instead of acquir

excerpt.zh:
虽然[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的感性个体都从属于一个有机的格式塔意识，但[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]有数个不同的“蜂巢”。这些蜂巢是互相独立的子个体集合体，相互竞争着资源。偶尔，两个群体之间会爆发冲突，有时还会升级为全面战争。我们目前正在目睹一场对蜂巢首都的全力攻击，这场面真是令人毛骨悚然。由于不受移情作用的阻碍，子个体的效率会让任何将军感到自豪。

守军节节败退，但根据我们的
excerpt.en: While all of the sentient population of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] belongs to an organic gestalt consciousness, the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] is home to several different 'Hives'. These hives are isolated collectio

excerpt.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_country.GetName]最近开始在这颗星球的新地区定居下来。当地的动植物群落起初与定居地区的动植物群落大不相同，但现在已经完全被集体所控制，它们采取了一种激进却有条不紊的方法来调节当地的生态系统。某些动物物种被无情地消灭，用其他物种取而代之，而入侵性植物扼杀了本地树木的生命。当地土著对生态的掌控令人惊叹，但它们在气候异常地区不可避免地遭遇了一些挫折，在这些地区
excerpt.en: The [pre_ftl_country.GetName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has recently started settling new regions of the planet. The local flora and fauna, initially vastly different from what can be found in the settled territory, ar

excerpt.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_country.GetName]最近开发了新技术，它们的工业开始疯狂地增长。当地蜂巢的头脑中有了部分自动化的概念，工厂、冶炼厂、装配线和燃料提取器已在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的各地建成。黑烟在天空中飘荡，许多子个体由于接触到有毒的化学物质而开始出现退化的迹象。很快，蜂巢将不得不解决这些问题，然而，不受影响的子个体仍在照常工作。
excerpt.en: The [pre_ftl_country.GetName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has recently developed new technologies, and their industry has started to grow at a frantic pace. Factories, smelters, assembly lines, and fuel extractors have b

excerpt.zh: 发生了一系列意外事件，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]似乎被悲伤所笼罩。在一个子个体的死亡之后，我们目睹了整个蜂巢出现了前所未有的工作停顿。我们不清楚这个子个体有什么与众不同之处，但蜂巢似乎正在举行某种仪式，死去的子个体几乎被虔诚地切成碎片，然后这些碎片被送到各个新生子个体的培育所。几分钟后，整个蜂巢又开始运转起来。这非常令人困惑，很像一个具有社会意义或精神意义的事件。
excerpt.en: In an unexpected turn of events, grief seems to have taken over [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. We are witnessing an unprecedented halt in the work of an entire hive, in the aftermath of the death of a singular drone. We are u

excerpt.zh:
我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上观察到的原生蜂巢已经在进化中迈出了重要一步。在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的大部分地区，小规模的个体群体已经开始组织成小规模的蜂巢，但是没有完全自主，目前这些子个体还缺乏完全成熟的集体应有的团结度和协调性。

这种情况在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的北部地区发生了变化，那里有个正在征服附近子个体的奇点，而一
excerpt.en: The proto hive that we have been observing on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has taken a significant step in its evolution. Over most of the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat], small groups of individuals had started to organiz

excerpt.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的“优异子个体”已经成功捕获并使其进入睡眠状态。尽管我们已经非常小心，但肯定还是被[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]上的其他子个体发现了，每次我们的空间站运行到靠近它们居住地的位置，它们都好像能够感应到优异子个体接近一般。

我们研究优异子个体的大脑在跨维度沟通方面得到了有趣的结果，但我们尚未摸清它控制其他子个体和吞噬萌芽意识的具体能力。
excerpt.en: The 'Drone-Prime' from [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been abducted successfully and put to sleep. Despite our care, the other drones on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] have definitely taken notice, and every time ou

excerpt.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的“优异子个体”已经成功捕获并使其进入睡眠状态。不幸的是，在我们研究这个对象的脑电波模式时，它醒了过来。随后，我们收到了一系列令人费解的报告，似乎都指向该对象逐一打破了观测站人员的思想，并征服了大多数人。幸运的是，唯一能够超光速航行的舰船在混乱中被摧毁了，但站内系统显示，优异子个体正在通过新的子个体们迅速吸收知识，并表现出完全可以使用我们技术和设备的能力。

隔离协议规定，应立即远程摧毁该
excerpt.en: The 'Drone-Prime' from [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been abducted successfully and put to sleep. Unfortunately, the subject woke up as we were studying the patterns in its brain waves. We have then received a confusing c

excerpt.zh:
我们对[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的观察在继续，最近我们发现了最初被误认为是失控了的子个体。它们生活在当地蜂巢定居点的外围，似乎已经拥有部分、甚至完全的自主性。它们似乎彻底脱离了集体，有些甚至很享受悠闲的时光，舒适地无所事事。

然而，它们似乎仍然依赖蜂巢获取资源，本质上是与集体进行交易。我们尚不明了为什么蜂巢不认为应该消灭这些失控子个体。
excerpt.en: Our observation of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] proceeds, and we have recently discovered what we first mistook as rogue drones. These individuals live in the periphery of the local hive settlements, and seem to have acquire

excerpt.zh:
天气条件：§G完美无瑕§!
核热火箭：§G燃料齐全§!
飞行计划：§G已优化§!

今天，当[pre_ftl_country.GetName]启动首次行星际任务时，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的所有广播都在播放这些指示。这些为了这项任务经过多年训练的航天员，于当地时间的今天早上登上了火箭。现在他们已经翱翔于那片我们和他们共享的天空。让我们追随他们的征程吧。
excerpt.en:
Weather Conditions: §GFlawless§!
Nuclear Thermal Rocket: §GFully Fueled§!
Flight Plan: §GOptimized§!

These were the indicators broadcast all over [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] today as the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] launched

excerpt.zh:
通过尝试和试错，[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的第一次行星际旅行以成功告终。尽管这次旅途并非一切顺利，但是他们证明了自己作为太空探索者的潜力。

[from.owner.GetName]受此项任务的激励，正迫不及待地准备迎接前往繁星的旅途上可能遇到的下一项挑战。我们或许很快就有机会与他们进行平等的对话了。
excerpt.en:
Through trials and tribulations, the first [from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj] interplanetary journey ended in success. While not the smoothest of trips, they proved their potential as space explorers.

The [from.owner.GetName] h

excerpt.zh: 第一艘[from.owner.GetSpeciesName]的行星际飞船上的机械故障导致它困死在了太空中。这艘船没有任何办法调整自己的轨迹，很快就会超出救援范围。[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]正在努力寻找解决方案，但机会渺茫。不过，我们也许有机会进行干预。
excerpt.en: Mechanical failure aboard the first interplanetary [from.owner.GetSpeciesName] vessel has left it dead in space. No longer capable of adjusting its trajectory, the ship will soon be beyond saving. [from.owner.capital_sco

excerpt.zh:
这艘注定要毁灭的探索船的船组人员们现在安全地登上了我们的观测站。不难理解，他们现在极度地恐惧和困惑。尤其是因为我们切断了它们和母星的联系，然后把它们留在了一个异星货舱里。

我们或许不得不安排它们生活在我们这里。它们可以从远处观察自己的家园，但却永远无法回去。
excerpt.en: The crew of the doomed exploratory vessel is now safely aboard our observation outpost. They are, understandably, incredibly scared and confused. Especially after we cut them off from their homeworld and left them in an

excerpt.zh:
[fromfromfrom.owner.GetSpeciesName]的行星际飞船已失败，没有幸存者。

这次失败后，[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]似乎不那么有动力探索星空。
excerpt.en:
The [fromfromfrom.owner.GetSpeciesName] interplanetary craft has failed, there were no survivors.

After this failure, the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] seem to be less driven to explore the stars.

excerpt.zh: 使用一块布、一个营养剂容器和一些铜线路，这艘注定要毁灭的飞船的船员成功重新获取了主推进系统的控制权。现在，有母星在身后进行支持和敬佩，它们正在继续完成任务的旅途上。
excerpt.en: Using a piece of clothing, a nutrient container, and some copper wiring, the crew of the doomed vessel managed to regain control over their main thrusters. They are now on their way to complete their journey with the sup

excerpt.zh:
我们被困在虫洞里面太久了。但等等！终于，上天的恩赐帮助我们我们突破了施加于身上的桎梏。我们终于通过了考验。星系的其他地区都在等待着我们去征服。

不要反抗。从长远来看，这样会更好。
excerpt.en: For too long have we been trapped behind the wormhole. But behold! Finally, we have breached the restrictions placed upon us by our celestial heritage. Now, at last, we know we are worthy. The rest of the galaxy is ours

excerpt.zh:
什……？你……突破了虫洞？怎么做到的？我们的科学家已经研究了很多年都没有成功。这肯定哪里出问题了。

……
……
……

这肯定是场考验。我不信任你们！我们必须从星系中清除你们这些东西！
excerpt.en:
Wha-? You... breached the wormhole? But how? Our best scientists have been working on it for years, without success. There must be some kind of mistake.

...
...
...

This must be a test. You are not to be trusted! We mu

excerpt.zh:
§Y[From.GetName]§!少了几颗星球。

所有的计算都表明应该还有几个天体存在，但在这个星系中却找不到它们的踪迹。传感器已经重新校准，数字也重新核对过，但得出的结论被现实所推翻。我们已经在自己的星图上标记出了失踪小行星的位置。

或许再靠近些扫描这个星系会得到更多信息。
excerpt.en:
§Y[From.GetName]§! is missing planets.

All calculations point to the existence of several more celestial bodies, yet they are nowhere to be found in the system. Sensors have been recalibrated and numbers rechecked, but

excerpt.zh:
§Y[From.GetName]§!少了几颗星球。

所有的计算都表明应该还有几个天体存在，但在这个星系中却找不到它们的踪迹。传感器已经重新校准，数字也重新核对过，但得出的结论被现实所推翻。我们已经在自己的星图上标记出了失踪小行星的位置。

我们认为达恰星系中相邻的[owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]与这一状况有关。
excerpt.en:
§Y[From.GetName]§! is missing planets.

All calculations point to the existence of several more celestial bodies, yet they are nowhere to be found in the system. Sensors have been recalibrated and numbers rechecked, but

excerpt.zh:
那些星球是被移动了！

我们在§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系探测到的异常超空间航道都连接着我们认为应该存在星球的位置。在研究了这些怪异的航道后，我们发现它们都通向同一个地方。一个叫做§Y达恰§!的恒星系，本以为是无法到达的，但如果把这些狭窄的超空间航道合并起来，我们就能送一艘科研船过去。
excerpt.en:
The planets were moved!

The abnormal hyperlanes we detected in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system were each tethered to where we previously had expected to discover worlds. After studying these strange lanes, we

excerpt.zh:
围绕着§Y[From.GetName]§!星系三颗恒星的每颗行星都是生态天堂，即盖亚星球，每一颗都能维持有机生命。由于这些星球上没有污染，起初我们认为它们可能无人居住。然而在进行了更深入的扫描后，我们在每颗星球上都发现了横亘整颗星球的大型城市。

更奇怪的是，似乎只有环绕中心恒星的行星是属于这个星系的。其他的恒星则由来自贺利托和其他更遥远的星系的行星环绕。
excerpt.en: Orbiting each of the three stars in the §Y[From.GetName]§! system are ecological paradises, Gaia worlds, each capable of sustaining organic life. Initially, we thought these might be uninhabited, given the lack of pollut

records.zh: 遭遇哈宾特统一星球国

excerpt.zh:
调查一颗新的盖亚星球通常是一个重大事件，但它将成为[Root.GetName]的船员在未来几个月里的例行公事。这些星球包含着一些非常奇怪的[Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]，它们显然还没有实现宇宙飞行，但它们的可再生能源生产可以媲美我们最高效的反应堆。

更奇怪的是资源的平均分配。每颗星球都有生存所需的一切，这应该是不可能的。我们看到只在一颗星球出产的货物抵达另一颗星球，却没有一艘运输船起飞。
excerpt.en: Surveying a new Gaia world is usually a momentous event but for the crew of the [Root.GetName] it is going to become routine for the next few months. The multiple worlds house some very strange [Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlura

excerpt.zh:
§Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§!的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]在某种程度上比我们更善于运用超空间航道理论。它们的每一颗星球都通过一座人造超空间航道网络相互连接。这些航道用来向其他星球运送必要的资源，如食物或建筑材料，而我们不知道它们是如何做到这一点的。

要求更多的[Root.GetScientistPlural]来研究这些星球的请求已经得到批准。虽然从它们的行星监听站的活动来看，它们应该也
excerpt.en: The [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] of §Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§! are somehow more adept with hyperlane theory than we are. Every one of their worlds are linked to each other through an artificial hyperlane network. These la

excerpt.zh:
我们以为那些能够穿越星空的人不会如此原始地诉诸暴力。

§R请离开。§!
excerpt.en:
We thought those who could traverse the stars wouldn't be so primitive as to resort to violence.

§RLeave.§!

excerpt.zh: 我们已经见识过了泛星系的真面目，并选择隐居避世。然而我们还是遭到了骚扰，你们真的想看看我们的宝藏吗？那就让你们见识一下。
excerpt.en: We have seen what kind of galaxy it is and chose to avoid it, yet again we are disturbed, do you really want to see our treasures? Then let us show you.

excerpt.zh:
试图通过与[event_target:solarpunk_country.GetSpeciesAdj]合作来获取超空间航道技术知识的进度一直缓慢得令人沮丧。要想像他们一样掌握局域超空间航道群，我们似乎需要花费数千年的时间来编制超空间波动的目录。我们收到了他们首席代表的新信息。

“老实说，你们在这里让我们越来越不舒服了，既然我们已经帮你们完成了来这里的目的，我们得请你们离开。我们判断你我双方的生活方式不可相容，担心你们在未来可能会觊觎我
excerpt.en: The insights we have gained into hyperlane technology through our cooperation with the [event_target:solarpunk_country.GetSpeciesAdj] has been frustratingly slow. It seems that to achieve the mastery of a local hyperlane

excerpt.zh:
即使在会面之后，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]依然拒绝接受外星人存在的事实。他们宣称我们并非星际访客，而是穴居人，想要从地上的某个洞穴里面钻出来占领行星的地面。他们的行星，[non_believers_planet.GetName]，被认为是中空的，并且他们坚信我们使用自己的宇宙飞船在中央的空穴中飞来飞去。

这些令人困惑的信仰阻碍了我们的外交工作。任何我们说的或者做的都遭到了彻
excerpt.en: Even after meeting us, the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] refuse to accept the existence of extraterrestrial life. They claim we're not interstellar visitors, but subterranean dwellers who climbed to the pl

excerpt.zh:
结果[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不相信太空，或者说：他们认为天空是一块镶嵌着镜子的穹顶，群星是太阳光束折射到镜子上形成的，其他天体同理。

哪怕我们将他们带到了我们的首都，他们可能也会宣称自己从未离开过母星，或者其他同样离谱的事情。
excerpt.en: Turns out the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] don't believe in space, either: they think the sky is a glass dome filled with mirrors: stars are rays of sunlight reflected from the mirrors, as are the other c

excerpt.zh: [non_believers_planet.GetName]传来纷乱的新闻：尽管[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不再认为我们是来自他们[non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon]地底中心的访客，他们现在坚信自己的星球是平的，像我们这样的人是住在吊篮一样的城市里，位于[non_believers_planet.GetName]的地壳下面。
excerpt.en: Mixed news from [non_believers_planet.GetName]: while the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] don't think we are visitors from the center of their [non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon] anymore, they are now convi

excerpt.zh: [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]出于我们的诚实向我们表达感谢。当然他们尚未完全相信我们，因为他们认为我们是来自中空的[non_believers_planet.GetName]的入侵者，但是至少他们理解我们没有敌意，希望他们能同我们开展合作。
excerpt.en: The [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] thank us for our honesty. Of course they can't fully trust us yet, since they still believe we are invaders from the Hollow [non_believers_planet.GetName], but at least th

excerpt.zh: 在下定决心认为我们是中空的[non_believers_planet.GetName]的秘密住民之后，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始担忧[non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的地表之下到底还藏着什么东西。军队开始在洞穴、喷泉和火山口的附近驻扎，随时准备用武力对抗任何从地下涌现出来的入侵者。
excerpt.en: After having determined we are the secret inhabitants of Hollow [non_believers_planet.GetName], the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have started worrying about what else may be lurking under the surface of [

excerpt.zh: [non_believers_planet.GetName]传来难以置信的消息：真的有人藏在地表之下。属于某个先前未知物种的地下军队从洞穴里面涌现了出来，他们正在进攻[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。这是一场全面的入侵！
excerpt.en: Incredible news from [non_believers_planet.GetName]: someone really was hiding under the surface! Subterranean armies of a previously unknown species are pouring out of caves, and they're attacking the [non_believers_cou

excerpt.zh: 某个表面看上去已经死寂的火山突然喷发，正在摧毁一切，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]绝望地寻求帮助。
excerpt.en: The sudden eruption of a seemingly extinct volcano was devastating, and the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are desperate for help.

excerpt.zh: 地底入侵防御部队的士兵驻扎在最大的洞穴和火山口旁边，他们报告称完全没有任何东西从地表下面冒出来。或许这是最好的情况，但是其中一些士兵明显十分失望。
excerpt.en: The Subterranean Invasion Defense Force troops stationed near the biggest caves and volcanoes report that absolutely nothing has emerged from beneath the surface. It's probably for the best, although some of the soldiers

excerpt.zh: [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]希望向我们表达感谢，以及正式的道歉。他们现在明白我们，事实上，并不是地底穴居人，而是来自另一个地方，那里是：
excerpt.en: The [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] would like to offer us their thanks, as well as an official apology. They now understand we are not, in fact, subterranean dwellers, but we come from another place entirel

excerpt.zh: 在经历了一场残酷的世界大战之后，[non_believers_country.GetName]被住在[non_believers_planet.GetName]地表下面的穴居物种彻底消灭。新近成为主导的物种注意到了我们的存在，出于某种混乱的好运，他们显然没有认为我们是来自他们行星的中心。
excerpt.en: After a vicious world war, the [non_believers_country.GetName] has been annihilated by the subterranean race living under [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s surface. The newly dominant species is aware of our presence, and

excerpt.zh: 经过一场漫长的、难解难分的战斗，[non_believers_country.GetName]迫使地底入侵者撤退回到了[non_believers_planet.GetName]的地表之下！
excerpt.en: After a long, hard-fought battle, the [non_believers_country.GetName] forced the subterranean invaders to retreat under [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s surface!

excerpt.zh:
今天，§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上传来了令人意想不到的消息，一张熟悉的面容向我们问好：那是一张我们自己的脸。

最近，[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesAdj]似乎迷上了我们的外表。我们的[Species.GetEarNamePlural]似乎让他们联想到了他们的幼体。事实上，他们形容我们非常“可爱”。一种长着夸张[Species.GetEarNamePlural]的填充玩具在他们的城市
excerpt.en:
Unexpected news from §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! today as a familiar face greets us: our own.

Recently, the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesAdj] have become captivated by our form. Something about our [Species.GetEarNamePlu

excerpt.zh:
§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上正在发生有趣的社会变革。

由于他们只有我们作为参考，那里的人们开始相信宇宙中的所有生命都像我们一样：互相连接、合而为一。在别无其他参照的情况下，[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]急切地希望我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]能进入他们的机构。他们的误解给予我们提升他们文明的良机。然而，如果得知了外面世界的真
excerpt.en:
Intriguing sociological changes are taking place on §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!.

Given they have only ourselves as a reference, the people there have come to believe that all life in the universe must be as we are: con

records.en: Teach a Hive How to Craft

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家十分动摇地离开了§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!。我们希望能够促进对蜂巢的教育计划，这一举措取得了成功，我们计划继续教他们一些基本的化学知识。差不多是立刻，他们就推导出了基于这些原理的最具破坏的应用，我们前脚还没离开他们的大气层，后脚他们就开始对邻近的蜂巢发动战争。现在，数以百万计的子个体正在死亡。
excerpt.en: Our scientists left §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! today in a shaken state. After the success of our educational initiative with the hive we wish to promote, we proceeded to teach them some basic chemistry. Almost immediat

excerpt.zh:
在一个有趣的跨文化交流例子中，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上相当数量的年轻人对[owner.GetAdj]的所有事物产生了消费性的兴趣。这些充满激情的年轻人急切地争抢与我们文化相关的任何东西，现在他们构成了这颗星球上一个充满活力和不断发展的亚文化群体。

我们甚至得知即将到来的粉丝大会将举办一场服装大赛。
excerpt.en: In an amusing example of cross-cultural exchange, a significant number of young people on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have developed a consuming interest in all things [owner.GetAdj]. Eagerly snatching up anything even remo

excerpt.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[owner.GetAdj]大会取得了令人振奋的成功！人们不分老幼都聚集在这颗星球上最大的城市，欢庆[owner.GetName]的一切事物。除了大会带来的好意以外，它还为当地经济提供了急需的推动力。

最精彩的也许是扮装比赛，大奖颁发给了我们[owner.GetRulerTitle][owner.GetRulerName]的死忠粉丝。
excerpt.en: The [owner.GetAdj] convention on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been a rousing success! Young and old alike gathered in the planet's largest city to celebrate all things [owner.GetName]. Apart from the good will the conven

excerpt.zh: 在我们利用影响力遏制了[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上蓬勃发展的[owner.GetAdj]粉丝群之后，那里的人们都团结起来以传统方式表达自己的文化。因此，艺术和文化部门的产出有了明显的改善。
excerpt.en: After we used our influence to curtail the burgeoning [owner.GetAdj] fandom on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], the people there have rallied around traditional expressions of their own culture. Accordingly, output in the arts

excerpt.zh:
我们对[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[owner.GetAdj]粉丝采取的强硬态度引起了巨大的反弹。这颗星球上的许多人开始推崇自己的文化和传统，激烈反对[owner.GetAdj]。

这将如何影响两颗星球的外交关系，还有待观察
excerpt.en: Our hardline approach to the [owner.GetAdj] fandom on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has precipitated a significant backlash. Rallying around their own culture and traditions, many on the planet have grown virulently anti-[own

excerpt.zh:
根据我们同[freeport_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的贸易协议，我们在他们的主要定居点附近建造了一个小型太空港。我们的商人不受规定约束，能够赚取巨额利润，但是禁止离开那片特区。

结果是，走私贩和有组织的帮派建立了一个繁荣的黑市经济。到目前为止，[freeport_species.GetAdj]选择睁一只眼闭一只眼，但是如果任由其发展，这个自由港将不可避免地被犯罪给拖垮。
excerpt.en: Per our trade agreement with the [freeport_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural], we have established a small spaceport near one of their major settlements. Free from regulation, our merchants are reaping massive profi

excerpt.zh: 我们在与[sweet_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的经贸往来中向他们出口一种可口的普通美食，至少对于我们来说是这样的。不过，已经被证实的是，这种普通的甜品对于[sweet_species.GetName]来说居然能产生精神方面的影响。它具有高度成瘾性，而且非常危险。无良的商人们以高价大量出口这种商品，以至于许多当地居民陷入昏迷乃至死亡。
excerpt.en: One of the commodities we have been trading with the [sweet_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] is tasty, but very ordinary food. At least to our species. However, this basic sweetener has proven to be a very powerfu

excerpt.zh: [landgrab_planet.GetName]传来了令人担忧的经济报告，我们的贸易商正在此地同[landgrab_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]进行贸易。当条约签署的时候，我们采取了一些措施来保障当地人的国家主权，但是我们中的一些人绕过法律，从当地的草场人手中购买了大片的土地。以目前的速率，要不了一代人[landgrab_planet.GetName]就会完全被私人贸易商给买空了。
excerpt.en: Concerning economic reports from [landgrab_planet.GetName], where our merchants have been trading with the [landgrab_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]. When the deal was signed, measures were put in place to ensure

excerpt.zh: 我们同[fruitful_coop_country.GetName]签署的贸易协定带来了累累硕果。双方都遵守协定条款，贸易正在流通。一些商人呼吁在规章制度方面进一步放宽，但总体来说协定给双方都带来了益处。
excerpt.en: The trade deal we signed with the [fruitful_coop_country.GetName] has proven extremely lucrative. The terms of the deal are being respected and trade is flowing. Some merchants continue to call for more relaxed regulatio

excerpt.zh: 我们自[space_slavers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]收到了令人动摇的报告：肆无忌惮的奴隶贩子伪装成商人，正在滥用我们的贸易协定，降落到该星球上大肆绑架当地人。当一大批[space_slavers_species.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]出现在某个地下奴隶贸易市场上的时候，我们才了解到这一行径。
excerpt.en: Disturbing reports from the [space_slavers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]: posing as merchants, unscrupulous slavers have been abusing our Trade Deal to land on the planet and abduct the local population. We onl

excerpt.zh:
我们自[preftl_slavers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]收到了令人动摇的报告：在这颗星球的偏远地区，有几个太空旅商，主要是走私贩，连同飞船一起消失了。通过谨慎的调查，我们发现他们被迫在矿井里工作，远离窥探的视线。

令人重视的是，[preftl_slavers_country.GetName]当局并不对此负责，这些事情是由当地的几个军阀和犯罪头子干的，此外所有被绑架的个体都违反了
excerpt.en: We have received disturbing reports from the [preftl_slavers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]: in remote regions of the planet, several spacefaring merchants, mainly smugglers, have disappeared along with their sh

excerpt.zh:
[preftl_hagglers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]用行动证明了自己是天生的贸易商。我们自己的商人通过艰难的教训认识到当地人是如此有悟性、能说会道，当然他们对此不是很高兴。

另一方面，我们的数名经济学家相信[GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的这些行为是可以效仿的。
excerpt.en: The [preftl_hagglers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] have proven to be incredibly adept traders. Our own merchants are learning the hard way that the locals are both savvy and persuasive, and they are not happy a

excerpt.zh: 自己在宇宙中并不孤单，这一发现让[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]上的许多人感到震惊。毫不奇怪，这一事件产生了严重的经济影响。随着整颗星球上的金融机构暴跌不止，生活水平明显下降。
excerpt.en: The revelation that they were not alone in the universe came as a shock to many on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]. Not surprisingly, the event has had severe economic effects. With financial institutions across the pl

excerpt.zh:
我们为[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]提供的金融刺激措施已经得到了丰厚的回报。他们的传统货币和经济机构在我们的支持下，终于稳定了下来。

也许更重要的是，公众对我们继续留在该星系中的支持度空前高涨。
excerpt.en: The financial stimulus we provided to [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName] has paid off handsomely. With their traditional currencies and economic institutions bolstered by our support, conditions have finally stabilized.

excerpt.zh:
我们对市场仁慈的信任得到了丰厚的回报。

摆脱了令人窒息的监管，[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]的金融机构已经稳定下来。那里的人们知道自己的经济前景一片大好，可以放心了。
excerpt.en:
Our trust in the benevolence of the market has paid off handsomely.

Freed from the imposition of stifling regulations, financial institutions on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName] have stabilized. The people there can re

excerpt.zh: 我们对[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]市场自我纠正的信任变成了一场灾难，实在令人费解。事实上，星球上的状况前所未有的糟糕，人们吵着要政府加强对金融部门的监督。
excerpt.en: Inexplicably, our trust in the market to right itself on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName] has been a disaster. In fact, conditions on the planet have never been worse, and the people there are clamoring for increased go

excerpt.zh:
为了促进善意，我们同意与[preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]的居民分享我们的物质复制技术。当然，我们希望它们用它来缓解资源匮乏的问题，但现在我们收到的报告显示，这项技术被武器化了。

居民们有了一个大胆的想法，那就是反转复制单元的功能，这样它就不是组装预编程的物质，而是在原子水平上拆解生命体。
excerpt.en: To foster good will, we agreed to share our matter replication technology with the inhabitants of [preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]. Of course, we expected them to use it to reduce resource scarcity, but now we are receiv

excerpt.zh:
我们的特工到达时，[preftl_misusers_species.GetName]正好在完成它们的手持式原子分解器。我们的人明确告知，赠送物质复制装置不是为了让它们这样使用的。

不出所料，它们不愿意放弃这项技术。当地政府火冒三丈，将我们的没收称作侵略行为。
excerpt.en: Our agents arrived just as the [preftl_misusers_species.GetName] were finalizing their hand-held atomic disintegrator. They were told in no uncertain terms that this was not the intended use for the matter replication un
