在长长的游行队伍中，§Y[From.GetName]§!静静地沉眠，§Y[Root.GetName]§!的每一位公民都受邀前来表示敬意。

葬礼之后是为期一周的盛大祭典，祭典花费巨大。§Y[From.GetName]§!的透明水晶棺材在§Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§!纪念堂展出。人群排在街头，想要一睹他们伟大领袖的最终安息之处。
excerpt.en:
§Y[From.GetName]§! has been laid to rest following a public procession. Every citizen of §Y[Root.GetName]§! was invited to pay their respects.

The funeral is followed by a week-long festival, with no expenses spared. §Y

excerpt.zh: §Y[From.GetName]§!在最亲近的亲属和同事的环绕中静静地沉眠。其对§Y[Root.GetName]§!的贡献不菲，但现在并不是能铺张浪费的时候。
excerpt.en: §Y[From.GetName]§! is laid to rest in a private ceremony with their closest family members and colleagues. Their contribution to the §Y[Root.GetName]§! was an important one, but now is not the time for exorbitant expendi

excerpt.zh: 我们对§Y[From.GetTitle]§!§Y[From.GetName]§!的谨慎处置被媒体迅速捕捉到了。尽管一些人表达了担忧，但许多消息来源还是坚定地指出了这位领袖的缺点。当前的普遍看法是，我们终于可以找一位更合适的继任者来替代现在这位领袖了。
excerpt.en: The discreet disposal of our §Y[From.GetTitle]§!, §Y[From.GetName]§!, has been promptly noted by the press. While others express concern, many sources adamantly point out the leader's shortcomings. The general sentiment

excerpt.zh:
在一场简短的追悼会后，[From.GetTitle]的遗体被捐赠给了科学界，以对基础医药研究和教育继续做贡献。

这些过程中剩下的东西最终将被水火化，变成富含矿物质的肥料，确保身体的任何部分都不会被浪费。
excerpt.en:
After a brief commemoration, the [From.GetTitle]'s body has been donated to science to contribute towards essential medical research and education.

What is left from these procedures will in the end be water cremated an

excerpt.zh:
人们聚集在一起，追悼§Y[From.GetName]§!的一生及其丰功伟绩。人们挤满了街道，向东望不见头，向西望不见尾。颂歌一直唱到了夜幕降临。[From.GetHeSheCap]现在已经跨入彼岸。

[From.GetHisHer]的布道节选现在在整个帝国回荡，提醒着我们共同的目标。
excerpt.en: The people gathered in their masses to celebrate the life and career of §Y[From.GetName]§!. Huge processions filled the streets, and hymns were sung long into the night. [From.GetHeSheCap] is now waiting for us on the ot

excerpt.zh:
大型阅兵方阵和舰队护卫着§Y[From.GetName]§!的灵柩前往最终安息之地。[From.GetHisHerCap]的遗体被发射去了最近的恒星，并全程向全社会广播。

逝世领袖的个人战略部署和日志成为了下一批军校学员课程中的内容。
excerpt.en: A huge parade of troops and a flyover by naval forces marked the arrival of §Y[From.GetName]§!'s casket to its final resting place. [From.GetHisHerCap] body was fired into the nearest star during a society-wide broadcast

excerpt.zh: 为了纪念刚刚去世的伟大§Y[From.GetTitle]§!，§Y[From.GetName]§!，我们设立了一个非盈利的基金会。这个基金会标志着星际的和平与和谐发展迈出了一步，包容了不同社群和物种之间的分歧。
excerpt.en: A non-profit foundation has been established to honor the passing of the great §Y[From.GetTitle]§!, §Y[From.GetName]§!. The foundation marks a step towards peace and interstellar harmony, bridging differences between com

excerpt.zh:
当§Y[From.GetName]§!去世的消息传遍更远的地区时，一种深深的悲痛笼罩了整个帝国。无数的哀悼者遵循传统的葬礼仪式加入了§Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§!的葬礼队伍中。

其遗体被一丝不苟地清洁并进行了适当的装饰。在§Y[From.GetTitle]§!的遗体进行了安葬之前，我们全国上下都要默哀，表示尊重。
excerpt.en: A deep sorrow has gripped the public as news regarding the passing of §Y[From.GetName]§! spreads to the wider community. Countless mourners join the funeral procession on §Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§! to follow the traditio

excerpt.zh:
为纪念§Y[From.GetName]§!一生的丰功伟绩，我们为[From.GetHimHer]准备了一场穿越星海的最后航行。

一个容纳着[From.GetTitle]遗体的胶囊被庄严地发射向未探索的宇域，伴随他的还有诗歌、图表、录音和其他贵宾带来的随葬品。将来有一天，[From.GetTitle]的船只可能会在那里找到一个新家，完成[From.GetHisHer]的最后任务。
excerpt.en:
The remarkable deeds of §Y[From.GetName]§! have warranted [From.GetHimHer] one last voyage through space.

A capsule containing the [From.GetTitle]'s remains is ceremonially launched into the void alongside poems, charts

excerpt.zh: 工匠们获得最好的材料来制作§Y[From.GetName]§!的肖像，将其加入到§Y[Root.GetName]§!传奇英雄的行列中。其庄严的面孔被蚀刻在石头和金属上，让人们牢记这位强大领袖的丰功伟绩。
excerpt.en: Artisans have been provided with the finest materials to fashion the likeness of §Y[From.GetName]§!, adding them to the long line of storied heroes of the §Y[Root.GetName]§!. Their majestic visage is etched in stone and

excerpt.zh: §Y[From.GetName]§!的名字与头衔被镌刻在了一座高大耸立的纪念碑上，与无数其他为§Y[Root.GetName]§!的人民鞠躬尽瘁的人们并列。这位备受尊敬的§Y[From.GetTitle]§!将被人民永远铭记，他的贡献为未来数代领袖们开拓道路。
excerpt.en: §Y[From.GetName]§!'s name and title are carved on a towering monument alongside others who have served the §Y[Root.GetName]§! for the good of its population. The respected §Y[From.GetTitle]§! will be fondly remembered by

excerpt.zh:
这位领袖的去世引起了星际证交所短暂但剧烈的震荡。

除了举办奢华的葬礼，§Y[Root.GetName]§!还将一座较高的摩天楼重命名为[From.GetName]大厦以确保以后这位[From.GetTitle]的名字会被写入公司的编年史中。每间会议室的墙上都挂着一幅经过艺术诠释的肖像，以纪念其对帝国的杰出贡献。
excerpt.en:
News of the leader's passing is met with a sharp, but brief downturn in share value at the galactic stock markets.

In addition to sponsoring the lavish funeral, §Y[Root.GetName]§! rebrands one of its taller skyscrapers

excerpt.zh:
§Y[From.Species.GetName]§!的去世并不像表面上看起来那么彻底。尽管躯干已经开始劣化，但核心还可以恢复活力。

在浸泡过一种特殊的激素溶液后，§Y[From.GetName]§!的遗体被小心翼翼地埋入§Y[burial_planet.GetName]§!的土壤中。埋葬地由孵化者精心照料，他们耐心地等待幼体破土发芽，开始新的循环。
excerpt.en:
The death of a §Y[From.Species.GetName]§! is not as final as it appears. Even if the main stem has begun to deteriorate, the roots can be reinvigorated.

After soaking in a special hormone solution, §Y[From.GetName]§!'s

excerpt.zh:
§Y[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]§!在可靠地服务了[From.GetYearsOfService]后发生了故障，彻底报废。我们的科学家已经备份了文件以保留重要数据。

基于§Y[From.GetName]§!的智能全息图谱已经被安装在我们的舰船系统中，作为虚拟顾问为我们服务。他们将继续支援我们的任务。
excerpt.en:
§Y[From.GetTitle] [From.GetName]§! has broken down after [From.GetYearsOfService] of reliable service. Our scientists have backed up their files to preserve important data.

An intelligent hologram based on §Y[From.GetNa

excerpt.zh: §Y[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]§!的意识在[From.GetAge]岁时从集体意识中移除。我们是§Y[Root.GetName]§!，我们将永存。
excerpt.en: The mind of §Y[From.GetTitle] [From.GetName]§! was removed from the collective at the age of [From.GetAge]. We are the §Y[Root.GetName]§!. We will endure.

excerpt.zh:
一开始只是些许小小的争吵，现在已经演变成在每一项议题前都争论不休的僵局，这严重阻碍了我们内阁的运转效率。

§Y[root.GetName]§!是内阁中最热衷于争吵和扰乱秩序的问题成员。许多人要求免去[root.GetHisHer]的席位，以恢复秩序和效率。
excerpt.en:
What began as minor bickering has now devolved into quarrelsome gridlock on practically every issue brought before the Council, damaging its ability to function.

§Y[root.GetName]§! has proven to be the most contentious

excerpt.zh: 一种罕见的宇宙现象的壮观促使§Y[root.GetName]§!达到了新的高度。兴奋和新想法席卷而来，唯一的问题是应该专注于哪个科学分支。
excerpt.en: The majesty of a rarely seen cosmic phenomenon has spurred §Y[root.GetName]§! to new heights. Brimming with excitement and new ideas, the only question is what branch of science they should focus on.

excerpt.zh: 在§Y[root.GetName]§!富有冒险精神的亲自部署、亲自指挥下，我们查获了大批违禁品。这次行动酝酿了很长时间，其成功地削弱了在我国境内扎根的有组织的犯罪集团。
excerpt.en: Under the audacious regime of §Y[root.GetName]§!, we have accumulated a huge cache of seized contraband. The operation was a long time in the making, and its successful conclusion has crippled the organized crime syndica

excerpt.zh: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!展现出了非凡的领导能力，将内阁团结了起来，确保了对我们社会的高效管理。充分运用统计学、传统和外交手段，[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]成功地安抚了内阁的其他成员，以及我们社会中的各个派系。
excerpt.en: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§! has demonstrated  incredible leadership by uniting the council and ensuring the efficient administration of our society. Making use of statistics, tradition, and diplomacy,

excerpt.zh: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!以自我发现和发展为目的开始了一段旅程。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer]的专心学习、刻苦钻研和善于自省，让[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的心智能力达到了一个全新的高度。现在，[event_target:leader_event_t
excerpt.en: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§! has embarked on a journey of self-discovery and personal development. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] mental capabilities have reached new heights as a resul

excerpt.zh: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!令人震惊的科学发现直接导致研究的效率大幅提高。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的发现在科学圈中成了热门课题，他们现在将[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]视为思想领袖。
excerpt.en: As a direct result of §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!'s astounding scientific discoveries, the rate at which we conduct research has accelerated. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] findings ar

excerpt.zh:
我们发生了一次严重的信息泄露事故，许多敏感信息和关键的安保细节被公之于众。这些文件包含军事设施的编成表、神经交互界面实验、以及对几位重要的反对派人物的监视。

§Y[root.GetName]§!在这次灾难事件中难辞其咎。
excerpt.en: A significant data leak has occurred, exposing sensitive information and crucial security details to the public. The files include schematics of military installations, details of neural interface experiments, and proof

excerpt.zh: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!成为了一位对普罗大众而言的潮流开创者。从[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer]的穿着风格到[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer]的说话方式，一切都吸引了大批追随者。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHe
excerpt.en: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§! has become a trendsetter among the general population. Everything from [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer] style to [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer] met

excerpt.zh: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!发表的热情洋溢的演讲在掀起了一股爱国狂潮。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的赤子之心唤醒了我们全境内的责任感与民族热忱。
excerpt.en: The public have been swept up into a patriotic frenzy following a passionate speech delivered by §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] unbridled passion has heigh

excerpt.zh:
统计分析表明§Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!已经发展出认知和行为上的很大程度的异质性，使其趋近于一个独立个体。

我们无法准确预测自由意志的危害和潜在益处。现在必须作出决定：[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]应该保持现在的状态，还是应该强迫其回归正轨？
excerpt.en:
Statistical analysis has confirmed that §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§! has developed cognitive and behavioral idiosyncrasies of a magnitude that verge on the individual.

The risks and potential benefits

excerpt.zh:
§Y[root.GetName]§!深陷一场轰动全国的巨大丑闻。关于不当行为，挪用公款和掩盖真相的报道层出不穷，许多人甚至因此质疑起了当权者的能力。

毫无疑问，这些事件对公众情绪的影响还会持续好多年。许多人相信，恢复公信力的唯一手段就是让[root.GetName]下台并接受公审。
excerpt.en: §Y[root.GetName]§! is at the center of a major scandal reverberating throughout the empire. There are numerous reports of aberrant behavior, embezzlement, and cover-ups. This has led many to question the competence of th

excerpt.zh:
我们已经毫无疑问地证明了星系处处充满生命。除了占主导地位的物种和国家，还有许多其他的星球。杰出个体可能会不时涌现，动摇着星系霸权的基础。

如果我们能驾驭他们的雄心壮志，这些著名领袖可能会愿意加入我们的事业。
excerpt.en: We have proven beyond any doubt that the galaxy is filled with life. Apart from the dominant species and nations, there are many others who traverse the stars. From time to time, exceptional individuals may arise to shak

excerpt.zh:
我们成功地恢复了[gateway_system.GetName]星系中远古星门的供能！尽管年代久远，这座装置还是形成了一条完全可以供通行的稳定亚空间通路。

我们还检测到了异常的、类似于进出星门时的能量读数，但没有任何船只过境的迹象。
excerpt.en:
We have successfully restored power to the ancient Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system! Despite its age, the device has formed a stable subspace conduit that is fully traversable.

We're also detecting unusual

excerpt.zh:
一艘巨大的舰船从星门中出现，它的体积之巨大我们前所未见。军队已处于高度戒备状态。

那艘未知舰船对我们的呼叫没有应答，但鉴于它似乎完全处于瘫痪状态，我们暂时不会与它交战。我们仍在进行调查并试图开启通讯。
excerpt.en:
A hulking ship has emerged from the gate, its sheer scale unlike anything we have seen before. Military forces have been put on high alert.

The unknown vessel is not responding to our hails, but given the fact that it a

excerpt.zh:
我们对这艘巨大舰船的调查并没有得到很多信息。然而，我们已经能够破译星门第一次打开时收到的一些数据。看来，这艘舰船已经被困在星门里一段时间了（可能久得难以想象）。

为了了解更多，我们需要登上它。由于这是一艘军舰，建议派遣特种部队。
excerpt.en: Our investigation into the hulking ship hasn't yielded many answers. However, we have been able to decipher some of the data we received when the gate first opened. It appears that the ship has been stuck inside the gate

excerpt.zh:
在登上舰船后不久，我们就遭遇了一队异形的外星人。由于我们的突然出现，许多外星人受到了惊吓，纷纷拔出武器。谢天谢地，交火得以避免！

在要求双方冷静下来之后，外星人指挥官解释道这艘船需要进行紧急维修。一旦所有系统正常运转，他和他的船员打算返回自己的母星，斯卡拉维德。

这位指挥官全身着军队盛装礼服，其形象十分令人深刻。这艘舰船的船员在提及他时都满怀敬意，其个人魅力甚至影响到了我方人员。他已经营造了双边建立正式外交关系的可能性。
excerpt.en:
Soon after boarding the vessel, we encountered a group of uniformed aliens. Startled by our sudden appearance, many were quick to draw weapons. Thankfully, a firefight was avoided.

Calling for calm, the alien commander

excerpt.zh:
我们的工程团队已经对外星人船员提供了援助。这艘船的番号大致可以翻译作“利爪一号”，外星指挥官自称斯克兰德·夏普比克，是一位享有盛名的海军上将。

通过对比利爪一号和我们自己的数据，我们确认斯克兰德和他的船员被困在星门里长达几千年。对他们来说，这是一次短暂的旅行，但对星系的其他地方来说，几千年已经过去了。

得益于我们对斯卡拉维德的发掘，至少我们已经能向夏普比克司令指出他故乡星球的所在了，但他曾经爱过的所有人和事都早已离去。
excerpt.en:
Our engineering team has ably assisted the alien crew. The vessel's designation translates roughly to 'First Talon', and their commander has identified himself as Skrand Sharpbeak, an admiral of renown.

By comparing dat

excerpt.zh:
§H利爪一号的舰队司令斯克兰德·夏普比克向我们打了个招呼。他显得精疲力竭。§!

斯卡拉维德陷落了。我的家园不复存在了。数十亿的生命……逝去了。

利爪一号就这么变成了最后一艘利爪号，而我也变成了一个无依无靠的士兵。感谢你们的帮助，我代表我的船员宣誓效忠。
excerpt.en:
§HAdmiral Skrand Sharpbeak of the First Talon hails us. He appears exhausted.§!

Skravird has fallen. My home is no more. Billions of lives... gone.

The First Talon has become The Last Talon, and I am a soldier without

excerpt.zh: 我们的士兵轻易地战胜了外星舰船的船员。我们摧毁了他们的防御，清理掉了舰桥上的敌军士兵。这艘船是我们的了！
excerpt.en: Our troops easily overpowered the vessel's crew. We destroyed their defenses and cleared the bridge of enemy soldiers. The ship is ours!

excerpt.zh: 我方登录外星舰船的部队遭到了残虐！敌人令人难以置信地凶悍。结束战斗后，我们重启了舰船的战术系统。系统显示，超光速引擎仍然无法启动，但舰船本身正在主动争夺我们的控制权。
excerpt.en: Our troops aboard the alien vessel were decimated! The ferocity of the defenders was incredible. After the battle, power was returned to the ship's tactical systems. According to our scans, the hyperdrive is still inoper

excerpt.zh:
随着一种新型瘟疫在舰船上散播开来，利爪一号上的船员们开始陷入恐慌。根据初步的分析判断，对于我们的族群而言，这是一种相对无害的病毒。然而，对于船上的鸟类船员来说情况就不一样了，病毒首先附着在羽毛上，导致羽毛根部感染腐烂，不出几天，感染就会蔓延到血液中。

如果任由这样发展下去，最终会达到不可挽回的地步。
excerpt.en: Panic grips the crew of the First Talon as a novel disease is sweeping across the ship. According to initial analysis, it's a strain of a relatively harmless virus, common to our people. However, to the avian crew of the

excerpt.zh: 尽管我们用尽全力，但斯克兰德还是倒在了坏羽病的侵袭之下。他的同伴们正准备为此举行一场传统的葬礼仪式。
excerpt.en: Despite our best efforts, Skrand has succumbed to Feather Rot. His crew are preparing a traditional funeral service.

excerpt.zh: 尽管我们在利爪一号上采取了严格的隔离措施，但根据斯克兰德刚刚的报告，估计船上约有60%的船员已被感染。
excerpt.en: Despite our best efforts to quarantine the First Talon, Admiral Skrand has contracted a severe case of Feather Rot. We estimate that 60% of his crew is already sick.

excerpt.zh: 到目前为止，坏羽病的新症状几乎在一夜之间就涌现出来了，这超出了利爪一号自身医务室的处理极限，船上的走廊里挤满了病患还有奄奄一息的船员。
excerpt.en: Hitherto unseen symptoms of the Feather Rot epidemic have appeared almost overnight. The First Talon's sickbay is overflowing, and the ship's corridors are full of the sick and dying.

excerpt.zh: 舰船已经汇报了坏羽病导致的第一例死亡病例。那些鸟类船员目前仍然无法抵御病毒的感染，除非我们能找到治疗方法，不然的话据推算最终死亡率可达95%。
excerpt.en: The first fatalities of the Feather Rot epidemic have been reported. The avians remain unable to fight off the infection on their own, and unless we find a way a cure, we estimate a mortality rate of 95%.

excerpt.zh: 在数月的努力后，我们成功治愈了利爪一号上染病的船员们，舰船运转逐步重回正轨。毫无疑问斯克兰德将非常感谢我们在这件事上的帮助。
excerpt.en: After months of work, we were able to administer a successful treatment to the crew of the First Talon. Efforts are underway to up production. Admiral Skrand will no doubt be very grateful for our help in this matter.

excerpt.zh: 我们的人员一直在努力促进与斯克兰德和他的船员的关系。这种跨文化交流的努力已经取得初步成效：刚刚斯克兰德同意提供他们高效舰载机的设计。这可能会大大提升我们对太空作战的理解。
excerpt.en: Our personnel have worked hard to foster relations with Skrand and his crewmates. This effort in cross-cultural exchange is already bearing fruit: Skrand has just agreed to hand over the designs for their highly efficien

excerpt.zh: 历时数月的研究、编写和实验终于提供了一些启发。外星飞船的计算机库包含了舰载机编队的适应性战术。现在这项技术由我们来运用。
excerpt.en: Months of studying, cataloging, and experimenting finally provided some insight. The alien vessel's computer banks contain adaptive tactics in strike craft formation. Now, this technology is ours to implement.

excerpt.zh: 显然，斯克兰德陷入了与我们自己的一位指挥官[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的肢体冲突。问题与舰队司令的个人荣誉感有关。简而言之，斯克兰德觉得自己受到了侮辱，他表示，除非我们解除[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的职务，否则他将立即离开我们。
excerpt.en: Apparently Skrand got into a physical altercation with [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName], one of our own commanders. The issue has to do with the Admiral's deep sense of personal honor. In short, Skrand feels insulted, and

excerpt.zh:
虽然我们的基层军官和指挥官正在与斯克兰德密切合作，但他们也不是完全言听计从。双方所习惯的指挥结构不同，带来了一些不必要的紧张局面。因此我们亟需一场联合军事演练。

该演练可能会降低我们指挥舰队的能力，但不能准备好军队的话可能会导致极其严重的后果。
excerpt.en: Our officers and commanders are working closely with Skrand, but they are not always in accord with him. Their preferred command structures differ, causing unnecessary tension. This has precipitated a need for joint mili

excerpt.zh: 双方都取得了显著进展，我们认为联合演训项目取得了巨大成功。我们从斯克兰德那里学到了很多关于近距离太空作战的知识，同时他和他的军官们也熟悉了我们的后勤系统。一种新的乐观主义和同志情谊已经在军队中扎根下来。
excerpt.en: With exceptional progress on both sides, we consider the joint training program a great success. We learned much from Skrand about close-quarters space combat, while bringing him and his officers up to speed on our logis

excerpt.zh:
主要问题在于我们使用舰载机的战术截然不同。斯克兰德部署了多个大型攻击机小组来打破敌人的指挥链。他们在母舰的明确目标下联合行动。

我们的方法则更灵活，让他们承担一些态势感知型的任务，并去执行高危险高回报的行动，但我们缺乏斯克兰德和他的军官所拥有的大局观。目前，我们还在努力寻找可以一起建立的共同基础。
excerpt.en: The main problem lies in how differently we employ strike-craft tactics. Skrand deploys multiple large strike-craft teams to break the enemy's chain of command. They operate united by clear objectives from their mother s

excerpt.zh:
模拟战斗表明，斯克兰德的集中火力战术在最初阶段非常奏效，但很快会被反制战术所克制。即便如此，他战果也还是比起我们的的表现好得多。

同时实施这两种战术会导致混乱。幸运的是，从这些失败中产生了可能想法，这将缓解潜在的问题。
excerpt.en:
Simulation battles have shown Skrand's concentrated tactics are very effective at first, but quickly fail against counter strategies. Even so, the results were superior to those we could expect ourselves.

Implementing p

excerpt.zh: 显然，斯克兰德陷入了与我们自己的一位指挥官[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的肢体冲突。问题与舰队司令的个人荣誉感有关。简而言之，斯克兰德觉得自己受到了侮辱，他表示，除非我们解除[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的职务，否则他将立即离开我们。
excerpt.en: Apparently Skrand got into a physical altercation with [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName], one of our own commanders. The issue has to do with the Admiral's deep sense of personal honor. In short, Skrand feels insulted, and

excerpt.zh: 显然，斯克兰德陷入了与我们自己的一位指挥官[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的肢体冲突。问题与舰队司令的个人荣誉感有关。简而言之，斯克兰德觉得自己受到了侮辱，他表示，除非我们解除[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的职务，否则他将立即离开我们。
excerpt.en: Apparently Skrand got into a physical altercation with [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName], one of our own commanders. The issue has to do with the Admiral's deep sense of personal honor. In short, Skrand feels insulted, and

excerpt.zh:
我们对利爪终号的联合研究得到了对这艘钢铁巨兽内部运作方式的独到见解。我们相信我们的研究团队跟利爪号的船员们通力合作将有可能进一步改进舰船的外部结构，让它面对攻击和船体破坏具有更强的抵抗力。

我们已经获得了斯克兰德的允许，但项目还需要更多资金。
excerpt.en: Our joint research on the Last Talon has given us unique insights into the inner workings of this behemoth. We believe that our engineering team, in cooperation with those aboard the Talon, have an opportunity to further

excerpt.zh: 虽然我们没能完成预定目标，但还是成功地改进了利爪号的装甲系统。我们的工程师还发现了可以用于改进我们自己舰船的灵感。
excerpt.en: Although we didn't achieve the desired results, we managed to improve the Talon's armor systems. Our engineers also found valuable insights that can be applied to improve our own ships.

excerpt.zh: 我们对改进利爪号的结构强度而不牺牲速度或机动性进行了诸多努力，但进展相当缓慢。斯克兰德的工程师虽然帮了我们很多忙，但是他们不愿意我们在没有密切监督的情况下实施我们的想法。尽管如此，工作仍在继续推进。
excerpt.en: We have made several different attempts to increase the Talon's structural integrity without compromising speed or maneuverability, but progress has been slow. The assistance of Skrands' engineers has been a great boon t

excerpt.zh:
利爪号的部分材料和我们的同类产品不同。这些合金的韧性更差，导致船体在安装额外的装甲板时意外断裂。驻船工程师对我们的监督是正确的，幸好意外发生时他们就在附近。

我们需要使用一些原来用于升级的材料来维修船体，这将会导致整个升级工作的延迟。
excerpt.en: Some of the Talon's materials differ from our equivalents. Its alloy is much less flexible, which caused the hull to break unexpectedly during the installation of additional armor plates. The ship's engineers were right

excerpt.zh:
§H闪烁的屏幕上浮现出斯克兰德的指挥界面。这位舰队司令的羽翼蓬立，双眼发出锐利的目光。§!

这些……混账！他们只知道杀戮、破坏！

§H他愤怒地咬紧了喙，继续说。§!

我请求……不，我下令发起战争！我们不能让他们毁掉一切，让我们再次一无所有！我、我相信我们一起可以防止我人民所遭遇的悲剧再度重演。我已经准备好与你们分享我们所知道的一切。
excerpt.en:
§HThe screen flickers as Skrand's command deck appears. The admiral's feathers are ruffled, his sharp eyes flashing.§!

These... outsiders! They came here only to kill, to destroy!

§HClacking his beak furiously, he cont

excerpt.zh: 得益于斯克兰德对“威胁”作战的专长，及其提供的海量数据，我们现在面对这些涌现出来的天灾更加有备无患了。下一步就是将这些知识落到实处。
excerpt.en: Thanks to Skrand's expertise in warfare against the Menace, and the vast database he has provided, we are now much better equipped to deal with the emerging crisis. All that remains is to put this knowledge to good use.

excerpt.zh:
我们获得的数据库中可查询到一些斯克兰德的帝国时代这些威胁的作战方式实例。看来，他们使用的策略确实类似于我们今天所面对的那些。他们的舰队不使用正常的物流方案，通常是自给自足的。

更重要的是，干扰技术对他们不怎么起作用。破坏操作同样没有用。
excerpt.en: The databanks we've accessed provide us with some examples of how the Menace fought during the time of Skrand's empire. It appears that they used tactics similar to those we face today. They rarely use standard logistica

excerpt.zh: 将我们与斯克兰德的数据进行对比得出了一些有趣的结论。似乎这些敌人相当地古板：它的大型舰队一次只聚焦在一个目标，而忽视其他所有的东西。我们应该可以识别他们的目标，并进行相应的防御。
excerpt.en: Comparing our own data to Skrand's, we have come to some interesting conclusions. It turns out that the enemy is quite inflexible: its largest fleets focus on one target at a time, to the exclusion of all else. It should

excerpt.zh: 利爪号上的一群工程师帮传达了一条来自斯克兰德的指令。他们请求我们帮助维护利爪号的框架，并让我们的船坞做好修船的准备。如上所述，这些计划代价高昂。而且还有一个问题：考虑到这项工作的微妙性质，斯克兰德将不得不亲自监督该项目。
excerpt.en: A group of engineers from the Talon has delivered an order from Skrand himself. They requested help to maintain the Talon's frame and prepare our shipyards for potential repairs. As outlined, these plans would be a costl

excerpt.zh: 在我们的帮助下，利爪号的工程师成功地对我们的船坞进行了复古改装，以对利爪号的内部结构进行研究。他们利用我们的实验性的设计改进了他们的超光速引擎，使得即使在发生船体严重损坏的情况下，舰船仍然能够跃迁。虽然使用这种引擎会导致几乎瞬间到达目的地，但是它也会杀死船上的所有人，并且可能使舰船在数年内无法使用。另一方面，如果舰船在战斗中损毁，我们依然能可以尝试激活这个系统并修复残骸。
excerpt.en: With our help, the Talon's engineers have retrofitted our shipyards to study the Talon's inner workings. Making use of our experimental designs they enhanced their FTL drives, which allow the ship to jump even after a cr

excerpt.zh: 在利爪号工程师团队的密切支持和监督下，我们成功地重建了船体。利爪号再度启航！
excerpt.en: With the close support and supervision of the Talon's engineering team, we were able to rebuild the hull. The Talon takes flight again!

excerpt.zh: 多亏了额外的安全系统以及紧急协议，斯克兰德的旗舰在受到严重损坏后仍成功进行了紧急超光速跃迁。尽管出现在我们首都星球上方的残骸几乎无法被识别为一艘舰船，但船体依然可以作为重建的基础。这些残骸现在正在船坞等待修理。或者，我们可以对船体进行材料回收。考虑到它的状态，即便是我们认定这艘舰船的残骸无法修复的，斯克兰德也会理解这个决定。
excerpt.en: Thanks to additional failsafe systems and emergency protocols, Skrands' flagship managed to enter emergency FTL even after taking critical damage. Although what appeared in the skies above our capital world is barely rec

excerpt.zh: 近期在基因工程方面的进展有助于重新恢复舰队司令斯克兰德的种族。也许暂时还不具有相应的基因多样性来确保他们继续繁衍，但用兼容的基因填补空白应该可以完成这项工作。我们现在只需要足够的资金就可以开始行动。
excerpt.en: Recent developments in genetic engineering could enable us to repopulate Admiral Skrand's species. We may lack the genetic diversity to make them fully capable of reproduction, but filling in the gaps with compatible gen

excerpt.zh: 我们复制斯克兰德DNA的工作某种意义上还是成功了。尽管他们的外观完全一致，但是克隆体的基因组成与斯克兰德的完全不同，它们构成了一个新物种。他们开始称自己为塔隆人。
excerpt.en: Our efforts to replicate Skrand's DNA have been more or less successful. Although their appearance is identical, the genetic makeup of the clones is different enough from Skrand's that they constitute a new species. We a

excerpt.zh: 斯克兰德的鸟类DNA远比预想的要顽固，以至于有必要将其他鸟类的基因拼接起来。这个方法并不理想，但应该能让我们完成这项工作。
excerpt.en: Skrand's avian DNA is far more rigid than expected, so much so that it has been necessary to splice genes from other avian species. The approach is not ideal, but it should allow us to finish the job.

excerpt.zh:
§H斯克兰德的制服一尘不染，他的羽翼油光发亮。§!

我已经看到了你们小小基因实验的成果。虽然这些克隆体还差强人意，但我相当感谢你们的努力。
excerpt.en:
§HSkrand's uniform is in perfect condition, his feathers well groomed.§!

I saw the result of your little genetic experiment. These clones are far from perfect, but I am grateful for your attempt.

excerpt.zh: 我们收到了一份来自许多利爪号船员的请求。他们要求我们调配资源研究他们民族的过往。在利爪号徘徊于亚空间的时候发生了许多许多事情。他们希望能为子孙后代记录下一些东西。
excerpt.en: We received a request from several members of the Talon's crew. They have asked us to use our resources to research their people's past. Much occurred while the Talon lay in limbo. They have asked that it be recorded for

excerpt.zh:
我们收到了关于斯克兰德和他的人民历史的第一份报告:

在他们的时代，星系广阔而未知，星系外边缘被视为太过危险，无法探索。

在星系中心周围，庞大的帝国在争夺权力。其中一个是鸟类文明。在其他人不敢涉足的黑暗之地，这些勇敢的探险家看到了机遇。大迁徙就这样开始了。
excerpt.en:
We have the first report on the history of Skrand and his people:

In their time the galaxy was vast and unknown, the outer rims considered too dangerous to explore.

Around the galactic center, vast empires vied for pow

excerpt.zh:
这里附上另一份关于斯克兰德及其人民的历史的报告：

大迁徙在很久以前就结束了。偏安于星系的一隅，斯克兰德的人民们享受着和平而繁荣的日子。但成平日久的他们，没有做好应对威胁的准备。

攻击者不宣而战。没有一双翅膀来得及张开，尖牙立喙也失去了光芒。这些无面入侵者从太空而来，轰炸了鸟类的行星，留下了尸山血海。
excerpt.en:
Here follows another report on the history of Skrand and his people:

The Migration was long over. Secure along the galaxy's outer rim, Skrand's kin enjoyed both peace and prosperity. But having traded vigilance for comf

excerpt.zh:
我们收到了下一份关于斯克兰德及其人民的历史的报告：

斯卡拉维德的政府崩溃了，经济也在废墟中陷入停止。但人民的英勇丝毫未减。在远离前线的地方，一个项目正在酝酿之中。

一艘史无前例的舰船将被建造出来。其规模之大足以使敌人胆战心惊。当利爪一号准备就绪时，它被划入了斯卡拉维德最后一位指挥官的指挥之下。年轻又未经考验的斯克兰德·夏普比克上了战场。很快，他的人民就会把他称为威胁克星，斯卡拉维德的第一利爪。
excerpt.en:
We've received another report on the history of Skrand and his people:

Skravird's government collapsed. Its economy lay in ruins. But the valor of its people was undiminished. Far from the front lines, a project was hat

excerpt.zh:
以下是斯克兰德和他的人民历史的最后一份汇报：

利爪一号，同时也是最后一号，穿过敌人的阵线。船员和指挥官的精明和勇敢带来了一场又一场的胜利。然而，它的航程是短暂的：即使是像利爪号这样的船，也不可能凭一己之力扭转战局。无奈之下，斯克兰德和他的军官们计划在斯克兰德的最后一次防御战中玉石俱焚。在一次包抄敌人的大胆行动中，斯克兰德命令利爪号进入一个未经测试的星门。他和利爪号便从此失去了音信。
excerpt.en:
Thus reads the final report on the history of Skrand and his people:

The First Talon, first and last of its line, cut through the enemy ranks. Battle after battle was won by the cunning and valor of its crew and their c

excerpt.zh:
刚一进入[From.GetName]恒星系，我们的传感器就发现了来自[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]行星的一个微弱信号。

它具有短促而重复的模式，看起来好像是在求救。然而，由于信号太过微弱，我们估计定位出其来源会相当困难。也许到时候就来不及伸出援手了。
excerpt.en:
On entering the [From.GetName] system our sensors detected a faint signal originating on planet [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName].

A short and repeating pattern, it appears to be a call for aid. However, given the

excerpt.zh:
我们在[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]上找到了求救信号的来源。

地壳深处埋藏着一个古老的逃生舱。它的冷冻胶囊仓里似乎有一个外星人幼体。

尽管这个逃生舱已经非常老了，但低温保存设备仍然在运行中，幼体的生命迹象也很稳定。在胶囊的外部粗略地刻着一系列符号。我们将其翻译成：“我们的希望。我们的未来。我们的子孙。”
excerpt.en:
We have found the source of the distress signal on [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName].

Buried deep within the planet's crust was an ancient escape pod. Its cryostasis capsule contained what appears to be an alien c

excerpt.zh:
在[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]上发现的孩子成功复苏了。所有的生命迹象都符合该类生命形式的合理范畴。目前他还没有恢复意识，也许还要一段时间才能苏醒。

在逃生舱内还发现了一些物品。第一件是一块略微损坏的数据水晶，记录了孩子的姓名、年龄和物种。他叫做§Y艾克萨凯德斯§!”，完整的日志表明他还是§Y瓦格罗的子嗣§!。第二件是一个由未知重金属构成的古怪文物。从该文物的设计上看，好像应该属于一个更
excerpt.en: The child discovered on [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName] has been successfully resuscitated. All vital signs are within a reasonable range for a lifeform of its type. Still unconscious, it may be some time before

excerpt.zh: 目前进行中的对艾克萨凯德斯身边的破损遗物的研究表明，它曾与障碍物发生过碰撞。由于丢失的部件过多，我们只能对其真实功能进行猜测。然而，根据近距离观测时记录的异常读数，我们有理由得出结论，该物体对时空有影响。
excerpt.en: Our ongoing research into the broken relic discovered with Exakeides has hit a roadblock. Given how many pieces are missing, we can only speculate on its true purpose. However, based on the anomalous readings we've recor

excerpt.zh:
§Y艾克萨凯德斯§!一直是一个非常早熟的孩子，随着十岁生日到来，他已经开始了更高级的学习。到目前为止，我们的重点一直是鼓励他无限的好奇心，并为他提供一切必要的工具来追求他的兴趣。在未来的几年里，他将由我们所能提供的最优秀的人才来指导。

他有潜力成为科学领域的领军人物，这足以证明我们的付出是会有回报的。问题是，要将他的教育将建立在什么基础上呢？
excerpt.en: Always a remarkably precocious child, §YExakeides's§! tenth year marks the beginning of more advanced studies. Until now, our focus has been on encouraging his boundless curiosity and providing him with all the tools nec

excerpt.zh:
在二十岁时，§Y艾克萨凯德斯§!已经准备好承担其一位成年人的责任了。

从被复苏那一刻起，他就像一块海绵一样狂热而执着地吸收着我们的教导。尽管他已经具有海量的技艺和无边的智慧，但仍旧谦虚如初。

科学一直是他最热衷的领域，促动着它去发现自己的过往，以及那台与他一同被发现的破碎遗物。在他的同僚中，他的名字被简化为了“§Y凯德斯§!”。
excerpt.en:
On turning twenty years old, §YExakeides§! is ready to assume the responsibilities of adulthood.

In the time since his resuscitation, he has absorbed our teachings with fervor and determination. Despite his prodigious s

excerpt.zh:
你好。

§H凯德斯昂首站着，观察着形势，也在思考着自己对形势该作何反应。他的目光落在自己的双手上：那双手丝毫没有紧张的迹象，如磐石般沉稳。很明显他为这一天做了充分准备。§!

我准备好了。
excerpt.en:
Hello.

§HStanding tall, Keides observes the situation and his own response to it. His gaze falls to his hands: they are remarkably steady. He has prepared for this day.§!

I am ready.

excerpt.zh:
对遗物进行初步调查时，§Y凯德斯§!汇报了一段不同寻常的经历。

在进行物理接触后，他的脑海中出现了“幻视”；出现了人和地方的画面，是被埋在遥远过往的回忆。尽管他尚未完全理解其中的含义，但其中的一些画面描绘的是现实的地点。

凯德斯请求发起一个特殊项目对其进行探索。
excerpt.en:
Upon initial investigation of the relic, §YKeides§! has reported an unusual experience.

After physical contact, 'visions' have appeared in his mind; images of people and places, memories of a long forgotten past. Althou

excerpt.zh: 进入[From.GetName]星系之后不久，我们很快就定位了一颗符合§Y凯德斯§!幻视的行星。在这颗行星的表面流淌着熔矿的海洋。
excerpt.en: Shortly after entry into the [From.GetName] system, a planet matching §YKeides§!'s vision has been located. Oceans of molten minerals stream across the planet's surface.

excerpt.zh:
在惊涛拍岸的熔岩海洋中，§Y凯德斯§!发现了一处矿物处理设施的遗迹。他报告有新的幻视：一条黑暗的走廊，通向一个密封的房间。根据这些影像，凯德斯找到了一个古老的、腐朽的盒子。盒子里面有一块残片，完全没有受到时间的摧残。

凯德斯汇报称，在接触到它的一瞬间，新的令人困惑的幻视立刻向他扑面而来。
excerpt.en: Between the bays and swells of the planet's molten oceans, §YKeides§! discovered the remains of a mineral processing facility. He reported new visions of a dark corridor that led to a sealed room. Following these images

excerpt.zh:
在§Y凯德斯§!的身边浮现出了一座巨大熔炉的轧制流程。矿物、工厂、载具覆盖着大地，航母编队在空中遮天蔽日。在噪音之外，还有数量惊人的传送门，忽明忽灭，可以折叠起来。突然，天地间传来一声巨大的轰鸣，连大地都开始震颤。远处传来一阵绞痛的尖叫声。

从视野中恢复过来后，凯德斯将新的碎片与现有的碎片放在一起。一声尖锐的啸叫充满了空气。几乎就在同时，这两块碎片就自动融合在一起了。于是这件遗珍的影响变得更加强烈了。
excerpt.en: The milling activity of a great furnace rose around §YKeides§!. Mines, factories, and vehicles blanketed the ground. Huge carrier vessels dotted the skies. Beyond the noise, there was a staggering number of portals, blin

excerpt.zh: 追踪着§Y凯德斯§!的幻视，我们来到了一颗位于[From.GetName]恒星系的行星。茂密的丛林覆盖了地面的90%。
excerpt.en: Following §YKeides§!'s vision has led us to a planet in the [From.GetName] system. Dense jungle covers more than 90% of its land area.

excerpt.zh:
野生丛林存在重重危险，要想安全地导航是十分困难的。§Y凯德斯§!不止一次从鬼门关逃了出来。

尽管如此，在一种神秘力量的吸引下，他仍继续前进，终于发现了一座巨大建筑的杂草丛生的遗迹。一个摇摇欲坠的楼梯井通向一座远高于林冠的基座。在那里的黑色金属底座上，有另一块遗物碎片。

几乎就在一瞬间，§Y凯德斯§!被拉入了幻视场景中。
excerpt.en:
The perils of the wild jungle have proven difficult to safely navigate. More than once, §YKeides§! has narrowly escaped the jaws of death.

Even so, drawn by a mysterious force, he pressed on, only to discover the overgr

excerpt.zh:
树木都散开了，取而代之的是一片苍翠的景色。这是一颗美丽而温顺的星球，有大型森林一般大小的动物围栏，包含了来自星系各处的物种。

突然，幻视把§Y凯德斯§!扯入进了一座大型建筑内的一个房间。其中一面墙描绘着数个恒星系的星图。其中四个星系与其他的明显不同，没有超空间航道连接。

从幻视中回到船上，§Y凯德斯§!把最新的一块遗物放在现有的部分旁边。它们发出嗡嗡声，肉眼可见地相互吸引，然后融合在一起。遗物的效果似乎加强了。
excerpt.en:
The vegetation peeled back, giving way to a green vista. A beautiful, tamed world, with animal enclosures the size of large forests, containing species from all over the galaxy.

Suddenly, the vision jolted §YKeides§! in

excerpt.zh: 如§Y凯德斯§!的幻视一般，我们在伊弗施恒星系的一颗行星上观测到了一座舰船之冢。
excerpt.en: Just as in §YKeides§!'s vision, we have observed a graveyard of ships on a planet in the Ivusheh system.

excerpt.zh:
行星的碎裂表面四散着破旧的舰船。在最大的一处残骸堆中心，§Y凯德斯§!发现了一座巨大恒星基地的主框架。

把他带到这颗行星一样的不可抗拒的力量又出现了，牵引着§Y凯德斯§!走向基地内的一个房间。在被尘封的货仓中是遗物的另一个碎片。

在触碰到新发现的碎片的一瞬间，§Y凯德斯§!被拉入了一个幻视当中。
excerpt.en:
The planet's broken surface is littered with battered spacecraft. At the center of the largest debris field, §YKeides§! discovered the framework of a colossal starbase.

With irresistible power, the pull of whatever led

excerpt.zh:
一座围绕着这颗行星的恒星基地。其船坞中源源不断地涌出战列舰的编队。

在旗舰的甲板上，站立着一位年轻的舰队司令，一手握着一件与遗物相仿的物体。随着他手腕的一挥，飞船外的空间模糊、变暗，然后逐渐折叠显现出一个黑洞。当这位舰队司令命令舰队进入黑暗时，幻象突然结束了。

§Y凯德斯§!带着碎片回到船上，把它放在现有的碎片旁边。它们都开始发出刺耳的嗡嗡声振动起来。然后，在某种未知力量的作用下，两块融合成一体。事后，遗物的效果似乎加强了。
excerpt.en:
A vast starbase orbited the planet. From its docks flowed an unending procession of battleships.

On the deck of the flagship a young admiral stood, grasping in one hand an object resembling the relic. With a flick of hi

excerpt.zh:
在取回最后一块碎片后，遗物恢复如初，仿佛从未发生破碎一样。

随着遗物复原，对其目的进行研究迫在眉睫，且随时可以准备就绪。一项由§Y凯德斯§!抓总的特殊项目已经准备就绪。
excerpt.en:
After the retrieval of the final fragment, the relic appears as if it was never broken.

Upon the relic's restoration, research on its purpose is promising and ready to continue. A Special Project led by §YKeides§! has b

excerpt.zh:
对最近复原的遗物进行的研究带来了一些引人注目的发现。

它确实与§Y凯德斯§!有所联系：当与其瓦格罗基因接触时，遗物中的粒子会开始高频共振。尽管这背后的机制尚不清楚，但这种效应是时空操纵所体现的特征。

在数次尝试测量并控制该过程后，§Y凯德斯§!经历了又一次幻视。
excerpt.en:
Research into the recently restored relic has led to some intriguing discoveries.

Its connection to §YKeides§! has been affirmed. When in contact with his Vagrosian DNA, the relic's particles begin to resonate at high f

excerpt.zh:
§Y凯德斯§!描述了一种仿佛从里面看到遗物的感觉。恒星大小的粒子在他周围旋转。在两者间的虚空中，他经感受到一股力量涌了上来。仅凭双手，他就能指挥球体的运动。

§Y凯德斯§!从幻象中回来，把手放在了遗物上。现在他已经了解了它的用途，以及它惊人的能力：如果控制得当，它能使空间中的两点坍缩，创造一对稳定的虫洞。瓦格罗人称这种装置为§Y楔§!。

在他的发现的激励下，§Y凯德斯§!主动在我们的母星系中打开了一个虫洞。连他自己都不知道这条路通向
excerpt.en: §YKeides§! describes seeing the relic as if from within. Particles the size of suns swirled around him. In the void between, he experienced a surge of power. With his hands alone, he commanded the movements of the sphere

excerpt.zh:
遗物所生成的虫洞的另一端是瑟塞特星系。进入后不久，我们的传感器发现了一队有敌意的无人机。它们似乎在守护着这个星系唯一的一颗行星。初步的扫描结果显示，那些无人机上没有生命形式的信号，行星上同样也没有。

§Y凯德斯§!非常确信那颗行星就是他们民族的起源地。毫无疑问答案就在那里。

随后，无人机群向我们发出了通讯要求。
excerpt.en: At the other end of the relic-spawned wormhole lies the Sursect system. Shortly after entry, our sensors picked up a fleet of hostile drones. They appear to be keeping vigil over the system's single planet. Initial scans

excerpt.zh:
§H随着频道开启，尖锐的静电噪音与机器人模拟语音混合在一起。在一个周期内，每个声音都与下一个声音重叠，信息的音量在不规则的波中振荡。§!

动机：回收楔，违反章程。
瓦格罗之楔，状态：未收集。
瓦格罗帝国章程第412条，状态：违反。

目标行为：归还楔。
应对方式：摧毁目标。
excerpt.en:
§HAs the channel opens, screeching static blends with a wash of robotic vocalization. In cycles each voice overlaps the next, the message's volume oscillating in irregular waves.§!

IMPETUS: key confiscation, charter bre

excerpt.zh:
§H合成语音的吱嘎声逐渐放慢，暂时停顿，然后继续说出最后几句话。§!

瓦格罗之楔，状态：紧急收集。
瓦格罗帝国章程第412条，状态：暂时忽略。

行为：待机。
excerpt.en:
§HThe crackle of artificial voices is slowed, halting momentarily, then continues.§!

VAGROSIAN KEY, STATUS: collection imminent.
VAGROS-IMPERIAL CHARTER NO. 412, STATUS: tentatively omitted.

ACTION: hold.

excerpt.zh:
将楔交给那支舰队后，那些无人机立刻顺着一个它们自己的虫洞离开了。

在那之后，虫洞在它们身后关上了。我们现在可以自由地探索这个恒星系和里面的行星了。
excerpt.en:
Upon handing over the Key to the fleet, the drones promptly departed through a wormhole of their own.

Afterwards, the wormhole closed behind them. We are now free to explore the system and its planet.

excerpt.zh:
我们发射了一股电磁脉冲，烧毁了这些无人机的电路。

我们现在可以自由探索瑟塞特恒星系和里面的行星了。
excerpt.en:
We delivered an electromagnetic pulse which fried the circuits of the drones.

We are now free to explore the Sursect system and its planet.

excerpt.zh:
尽管无人机群被击败了，但是它们的制造者也留了一手，让摧毁它们的人也捞不到什么好处。无人机在回应我们的攻击时，启动了自毁程序。残余的东西难以被打捞。

不过，我们现在可以自由地探索瑟塞特恒星系和里面的行星了。
excerpt.en: Despite the drones' defeat, whoever created them made sure that no one could benefit from their destruction. The drones initiated self-destruct protocols in response to our attack. What little remains is hardly salvageab

excerpt.zh: 这颗行星在瓦格罗社会中一定扮演了至关重要的角色。在挖掘初期，很明显，大部分基础设施都以行政工作为中心，这座城市可能是一个通信枢纽。这里还有许多领导层碰面的地方，而且已经发现了几个极大规模的公共广场。
excerpt.en: The planet must have played a vital role in the Vagrosian society. Early into the excavations, it has become clear that much of the infrastructure was centered around administrative work, the city potentially serving as

excerpt.zh:
因为很幸运地发现了一座地下保险库，§Y凯德斯§!兴奋得几天没睡着。他确信这个地方就隐藏着自己身世的秘密。

在保险库的深处，他发现了一排又一排的冷冻仓，但里面都是空的。集成在地板上的电路连向了一座更大的结构：在拱顶的中心有一个像王座一样的基座。
excerpt.en:
Thanks to the fortunate discovery of an underground vault, §YKeides§! has not slept for days. He is convinced that this place holds the key to his existence.

Deep within the vault, he discovered row upon row of cryostas

excerpt.zh:
不顾科学小组的抗议，§Y凯德斯§!毅然决定坐上那台王座般的机器。

他刚一坐下来就失去了知觉。

尽管他的表情变得放松，但他的身体却承受着剧烈的痉挛。科学小组再怎么努力也没能把他从王座上解救出来。几个小时过去了。最后，就在他年轻的身体似乎再也无法承受的时候，凯德斯醒了。他的报告即将发表。
excerpt.en:
Against the protestations of the science team, §YKeides§! made the decision to sit upon the throne-like machine.

No sooner had he sat down, he lost consciousness.

Even as his expression slackened, his body was wracked

excerpt.zh:
§Y凯德斯§!看到了一座广场。广场上有成百上千个人。

大家面朝天空，看着一艘巨大的飞船从大气层外徐徐降落。就在此时一个声音响起：

“听着”它说，“审判之日就要到了。楔将会被夺走。你们应留在此地，直到一切的终结。”

人们的哭喊震耳欲聋。在他的幻视中，凯德斯意识到他的星球已经被抛弃了。他们的主人，一个拥有难以想象的力量的外星物种，发现他的人民缺乏潜力。楔（及其产生的虫洞）是连接他的星球和更广阔的星系的唯一途径。一旦与星系贸易切断往来，
excerpt.en:
§YKeides§! saw a public square. Packed inside it were thousands, if not hundreds of thousands of people.

Faces turned to the sky, they watched as a massive ship descended from the upper atmosphere. At once a single voic

excerpt.zh:
作为怜悯，瓦格罗人被宽限一个月内交出所有楔和相关材料。事实上，这与其说是怜悯，不如说是侮辱，因为这点时间根本不够他们自救。作为一颗行政管理行星是没有办法维持其庞大人口的。他们所能期望的最好结果就是定量配给他们所拥有的食物，让自己能晚一点挨饿。他们在外面的主人当然了然于胸。

然而，即使在绝望中，这颗星球的领袖也想出了一个计划。最近对高级冷冻保存和基因组学的试验结果基于了给了他们一个不一定能成功的机会。
excerpt.en: As a mercy, the Vagrosians were given a month to yield all Keys and related materials. In truth, it was more insult than mercy and not nearly sufficient to save themselves. As an administrative world, the planet did not

excerpt.zh:
当瓦格罗人的求生计划开始实施时，包含他们未来的“子嗣”§Y凯德斯§!被发射到太空中，同时被发射的还有他们最后一个楔的碎片，它被分解成四块，四散到星系各处以避免被发现。凯德斯出生时就没有父母，而是基因工程的产物。他的DNA中包含着对他的族人的记忆。当他成年时，只要接触到楔就可以通过幻视来获取这些记忆。

除了这个计划，这个行星的领袖还下令建造数千个冷冻舱和巨大的地下空间来容纳它们。在那里，最聪明的瓦格罗人可以一直休眠，等待“子嗣”的归来。
excerpt.en: As the Vagrosian survival plan was set into motion, the pod containing their would-be 'Scion' §YKeides§! was launched into space - and with it, a fragment of their last Key, broken into four pieces and sent across the ga

excerpt.zh:
为了不让他们白白牺牲，§Y凯德斯§!再次坐回到子嗣王座上。结果这一次事情很快并且一点也不剧烈地就完成了。他的人民的记忆就像溪水一样平静地涌进他的脑海。

有了他祖先的知识和记忆，挖掘工作很快就结束了。凯德斯的下一步行动是处理所有获得的数据，然后撰写报告。
excerpt.en: So as not to squander their sacrifice, §YKeides§! once more sat upon the Scion's throne. This time it proved a shorter and less dramatic affair. The memories of his people entered him with the tranquility of a flowing st

excerpt.zh:
§H凯德斯的耷拉着肩，失去了一贯的活力。最近的事件似乎让他倍感疲惫。不过，他依然面带释然的微笑。§!

我得到了答案。其中有好有坏，但我很高兴找到了它们。
excerpt.en:
§HKeides's shoulders are slumped, his usual vigor diminished. It would seem recent events have taken their toll. Still, he wears an easy smile.§!

I have my answers. They may be bittersweet, but I am glad to know them.

excerpt.zh: 在常规调查中，我们发现这艘舰船一直在激活的星门旁警戒，但是对于我们的呼叫没有任何应答，而且其似乎在处于高功率运转状态。
excerpt.en: During our standard survey, we found a hulking ship standing guard near an activated gate. The vessel is not responding to our summons and appears to be at functioning at critical power levels.

excerpt.zh:
§H面部识别扫描确认该个体为李萨拓·辛格，是一位通缉海盗。他狡黠地笑着，礼貌地点了点头。§!

你好，我是李萨拓船长。我是想来谈合作的。

我指挥着三艘船和一群被遗弃的乌合之众。到目前为止，我们是为……为自己效劳。换句话说，时代变了，我们已经准备好加入一个更大的事业。如果你们赦免我们所谓的罪行并在你们境内帮我们一个安全的避难所，我们将为你们效劳。

你怎么看？要签个合同吗？
excerpt.en:
§HFacial recognition scans identify the individual as Lysator Syng, a wanted pirate. Smiling slyly, he offers a polite nod.§!

Greetings, I am Captain Lysator. I come to you with an offer.

I command three ships and a ra

excerpt.zh:
§H女人带来了惊人的礼物：一块妥善保管的彗星碎片，一块缇扬奇骨雕，和一只装在罐子里的微小软体动物。§!

你好，我叫诺娜，是科基尔家族的永恒受祝者。我以这些礼物来表达我的尊敬之情。我探索了许多星球，反复学习了许多课程。我愿在你的祝福下学习你们的文化，作为回报，我会向你分享数百个文明的智慧。
excerpt.en:
§HThe woman bears fascinating gifts: a preserved shard from a comet, a Tiyanki bone carving, and a tiny molluscoid in a jar.§!

Greetings, I am Nona, the Eternally Blessed of the House Colzyrion. I offer you these gifts

excerpt.zh:
§H男爵身材魁梧。他身上的一切都散发着严格的军旅气息：靴子一尘不染，制服熨得整整齐齐，他的眼神机警而富于计谋。但在严格的外表之外，还有别的东西：他的脸上写满了哀伤。§!

我可以作为一个舰队司令和战术家为您服务。

接受我的效忠，我就会粉碎那些可能伤害到你的人。
excerpt.en: §HThe Baron is of imposing stature. Everything about him radiates rigid military discipline. His boots are spotless, his uniform neatly pressed, and his eyes are watchful and calculating. But beyond the strict facade, th

excerpt.zh:
§H一队奴隶抬着一乘巨大的轿子，上面坐着一只可畏惧的爬行类。所有关于军阀的刻板印象都可以在她这里找到：大片骇人的伤疤，张扬跋扈的武器，作为杀戮战利品的骨架等等。§!

我叫基雅·祖蒙，这就是我开出的条件！

§H她从坐席上起身，随从徐徐跪服在她的身侧。§!

我将率领你的军队，击溃你的敌人。他们的星球将化为焦土，他们的财宝将为你所得。
excerpt.en: §HA litter of enormous proportions is carried by a procession of slaves. Atop it sits a formidable reptilian. All the hallmarks of a warlord are there: extensive scarring, brazen weaponry, the skeletal remnants of past k

excerpt.zh:
§H这位外星人被包裹在一个咯咯作响的生命维持装置中。浓稠的液体从管子和通风口流过，他的话语变成了一种潮湿的汩汩声。§!

你们的工厂太差劲了吧。
excerpt.en:
§HThe alien is encased in a gurgling life-support unit. Thick fluid sloshes through the tubes and vents, causing his speech to emerge in a wet gurgle.§!

Your industrial plants are a disgrace.

excerpt.zh:
§H我们的传感器显示该机器人的外壳已经有数百年历史。它的语音缺乏音调，但话语却意外地洪亮。§!

数据显示你的政府和附属国之间不协调。缺乏纪律。不合格的教化。建议操作：向系统中添加亚图里昂。删除不必要的功能。强调秩序。
excerpt.en:
§HOur scans reveal that the outer shell of the robot is hundreds of years old. Its voice is monotone, but its words are oddly resonant.§!

Data indicates misalignment between your government and its subjects. Lack of dis

excerpt.zh:
§H这位武士装备着先进的武器和装甲。扫描显示其体内有高度的生化改造和义体升级。§!

基恩将军听您吩咐。我是超然均衡教团的一位特使。我被派遣来帮助所有需要消除暴政的人。接纳我的誓言，我的武力将为你所用。
excerpt.en:
§HThe warrior is armed with advanced weaponry and armor. Scans reveal extensive biological modifications and cybernetic enhancements.§!

General Jynn, at your service. I am an envoy of the Numinous Equilibrium. I have be

excerpt.zh:
§H这位科学家全神贯注地看着手中的输入板，手指对着按键上下纷飞。她哼着欢快的旋律，似乎对工作心无旁骛。一个小型机器人同伴漂浮在她旁边的空中，它发出叽叽喳喳的声音，磕了一下她的肩膀。她倏然抬起头。§!

啊，对不起。你好！我是佐西拉。很抱歉打扰你们，那个，我之前的实验室相当于是，爆炸了。

§H小机器人又叽叽喳喳了起来。§!

啊所以，那个，我是说，我想要找一个地方能让我继续作曲。
excerpt.en: §HThe scientist is focused on a tablet in her hand. As her fingers dance over the keys, she hums a cheerful melody. She seems lost in her work and oblivious to the world. A small robot companion floats in the air next to

excerpt.zh:
§H在一架巨大的移动吊臂上悬着一副类人生物的头和躯干。这一定曾经是一个有机生物，但现在大部分已经由金属、电缆和塑料构成。毫无预兆下，那副躯干振动了一下活动了起来，两只合成眼发出光芒，发出嘎吱作响的嗓音。§!

我是松达尔。我在寻找能效力的人。
excerpt.en: §HSuspended on a massive mobility crane is the head and torso of a humanoid. Once this must have been an organic being, but most of what remains is metal, wires and plastic. Without warning, the body jolts and comes to l

excerpt.zh:
§H粗短结实的机械装置被挤压在一具外骨骼中。工具、零零散散的零件和油腻腻的手都能看出他是个修补匠，他的眼睛里闪烁着好奇和热情。§!

早啊老板！我叫博林，诺嘉之子。很高兴认识你！
excerpt.en:
§HThe short and sturdy mechanic is squeezed into an exoskeleton. Tools, scattered parts and greasy hands bear the telltale marks of a tinkerer, and his eyes glint with curiosity and enthusiasm.§!

Mornin' boss! I'm Borin

excerpt.zh:
§H这位外星人身着华丽和繁复的长袍。尽管年事已高，但他的双眼仍旧警觉，透出敏锐的智慧。§!

向您致敬。我想作为一个和平卫士为您服务。
excerpt.en:
§HThe alien is adorned in rich, intricate robes. Despite his obvious age, his eyes are alert and betray a keen intellect.§!

Salutations. I come to offer my services as a keeper of peace.

excerpt.zh:
§H这位女士的服饰和珠宝让人对其生活的奢华窥见一斑。她轻轻一鞠躬后开口说道，§!

我愿意作为一位总督和一位外交官而效劳。让我成为你的盟友，我能让你在星系的任何一个角落都找到强大的友邦。
excerpt.en:
§HThe Sister's clothing and jewelry offer a glimpse into her opulent lifestyle. She bows before speaking.§!

I offer my services as a governor, and as a diplomat. Make me your ally and I will ensure you have powerful fri

excerpt.zh:
§H扫描显示，这个女人的斗篷里隐藏着许多令人震惊的武器。我们找不到任何关于她存在的官方记录，但面部识别算法显示她至少参与了三起备受关注的暗杀。§!

请允许我省去那些繁文缛节。你是个聪明人，知道宇宙中危机四伏，其中的许多甚至目不可及。只要出个好价钱，我就能让你一窥究竟。
excerpt.en: §HScans show that the woman's cloak conceals a truly shocking array of weaponry. We cannot find any official record of her existence, yet facial-recognition algorithms place her in the vicinity of at least three high-pro

excerpt.zh:
§H这位外星人的皮肤闪烁着粘稠的分泌物。他煞费苦心地深鞠了一躬。但当他一开口，声调却像孩子一样出奇地尖细。§!

这位大人，欧！至高无上的统治者。我，看守人喀·拉，只是您卑微的仆人。您的每句话都是命令。让我管理一颗你的星球，我会给您带来荣耀和财富。啊，那么多的财富！
excerpt.en:
§HThe alien's skin glistens with viscous secretions. He bows elaborately from the waist. When he speaks, his voice is surprisingly high pitched, almost childlike.§!

My lord, Your Honor, Oh! Supreme ruler - I, Q'la-Minde

excerpt.zh:
§H这位外星人一动不动。§!

命运指引着我的每一步。我穿越了无边的黑暗来到你的面前。我是神谕者尤拉斯塔尔。
excerpt.en:
§HThe alien is motionless.§!

Fate guides my steps. I have crossed the blind reaches to stand before you. I am Ulastar, the Oracle.

excerpt.zh:
§H这位男子形如枯骨，饱经风霜：他精美的服饰几乎褪色殆尽，他的皮肤如羊皮纸般干燥粗糙，他的嗓音近乎低语。§!

吾名为纳苏兹·德墨忒尔。吾身为纤尘与迷思所化。感谢您接纳我。
excerpt.en:
§HThe man is thin to the point of starvation. There is a sense of decrepitude about him: his fine clothes are faded, his skin as dry as parchment, and his voice rises barely above a whisper.§!

My name is Nasuz Demetor.

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!知道很多关于可怕的海盗之王兹泰格·迈尔的故事。几个世纪前，他一路劫掠星系，攫取财富，稀有资源和价值连城的古代文物。现在，多亏了一套古老的星图，[Root.GetFirstName]相信[Root.GetHeShe]已经发现了哲泰格-迈尔藏匿他大量战利品的地方。[Root.GetFirstName]拒绝详细说明究竟是如何获得这些海图的，但可以相信它们的真实性，并希望我们派一艘工程船去挖掘宝藏。如果那儿还
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! knows many stories about the dreaded Pirate Lord Zteg-Mayr. Centuries ago, he pillaged his way across the galaxy, seizing riches, rare resources and ancient artifacts of untold value. Now, thanks to a

excerpt.zh: 我们找到了大海盗兹泰格·迈尔藏匿他的宝藏的地下掩体。这些从许多星球偷来的宝物，现在将造福于我们的民族。
excerpt.en: The underground vault containing the treasure of Pirate Lord Zteg-Mayr has been breached. This treasure trove of artifacts, stolen from a number of different worlds, will now benefit our nation.

excerpt.zh: 我们欢迎§Y[Root.GetName]§!的传言已经传遍了星系。现在各种被放逐者、恶棍，还有海盗都把我们的帝国看作一个向所有人开放的地方，在这里所以人都可以有新的开始。[Root.GetFirstName]正在利用这一点，重新树立名望，并邀请他以前的熟人加入我们。许多人响应号召，来寻找更好的新生活。
excerpt.en: Word of the welcome we extended to §Y[Root.GetName]§! has spread across the galaxy. Outcasts, scoundrels, and pirates of all stripes now view our nation as open to all, a place where anyone can start over. [Root.GetFirst

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!听说了一支失踪的船队携带了大量财宝的传言。据说有一位外星使者和他的随从被派去给某个军阀带去贡品。在最近的一次任务中，[Root.GetHeShe]准确地定位了船队最后的位置。我们只需要派一艘船去取回它。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has heard rumors about the vast riches carried by a lost convoy. It seems that an alien emissary and his retinue were sent to bring tribute to a certain warlord. During [Root.GetHisHer] latest assignme

excerpt.zh: 对失踪船队的打捞工作已经完成。所有位于失事地点的资源都已经得到回收。
excerpt.en: The salvage operation of the lost convoy has concluded. All of the resources located at the crash site have been recovered.

excerpt.zh: 一位§Y[Root.GetName]§!曾经的伙伴，布洛葛行政官§Y基拉姆§!希望加入我们的帝国。这位行政官遇上了麻烦，正在寻找重新开始的机会。[Root.GetFirstName]声称这位基拉姆对管理矿产星球的经验相当丰富，而那位和善的行政官也带来了一箱珍贵的矿物作为见面礼。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]'s§! ex-partner, the Blorg official §YKeram§!, wishes to join our empire. The official has fallen on hard times and is looking for a fresh start. [Root.GetFirstName] claims Keram has vast experience in th

excerpt.zh: 终于，§Y[Root.GetName]§!终于从[Root.GetHeShe]家族衰败的情绪低落中恢复出来。在摆脱了负罪和悲痛的枷锁之后，在服务我们的人民中终于找到了[Root.GetHisHer]新的人生意义。
excerpt.en: At long last, §Y[Root.GetName]§! has recovered from the emotional shock of the fall of [Root.GetHisHer] once-proud noble House. Unburdened by the guilt and melancholy, [Root.GetHeShe] has found a new purpose in the servi

excerpt.zh: 在一场激情似火的演讲中，§Y[Root.GetName]§!宣称帝国必须将重心放在扩张上。[Root.GetHeSheCap]提交了两个关于给舰队调配更多资源以完成目标的计划。这两者确实对我们的舰队都很有价值，从长远看来也能让我们都收益。然而同时事实两个计划是不可能的。
excerpt.en: In a fiery speech, §Y[Root.GetName]§! declared that the nation's focus must be on expansion. [Root.GetHeSheCap] submitted two plans on how the fleet could use additional resources to further such a goal. Both options are

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!赢得过许多战争。[Root.GetHeSheCap]曾经同另一位伟大的勇士，哈斯克·古特拉，一起并肩作战。此人正在寻求新的可以侍奉的主人。他是一位果敢的舰队司令，[Root.GetFirstName]对其大加褒奖。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has won many battles. [Root.GetHeSheCap] once fought alongside another great warrior, Hask'Guttra, who is looking for a new master to serve. He is a ruthless admiral, and [Root.GetFirstName] speaks hig

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!坐立不安，渴望战斗。[Root.GetHeSheCap]受够了那些荼毒[coliseum_planet.GetName]的懦夫。[Root.GetHeSheCap]提议建造一座大型竞技场，让荣誉猎手和罪犯身处同一地方。这样一个计划能够为我们的战士提供宝贵的实训机会。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! is restless and craves a fight. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has had enough of the weaklings that plague [coliseum_planet.GetName]. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has proposed an arena where glory-hunters may be pitted agai

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!希望能自动化[planet_governed.GetName]上的物流方案。提出的计划称会将工厂、精炼厂和处理设施通过一个复杂的管道和传送带网络连接起来。该计划在理论上看起来不错，但对生活在附近的人口而言存在风险。工业泄漏、辐射和高频振动之类危险是真实存在的。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! wishes to automate the shipping methods on [planet_governed.GetName]. The proposed plan would link the factories, refineries, and processing facilities together through a complex network of pipelines a

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!提交了一项研究计划，旨在评估未来的工业发展。该研究将会惠及经济，并促进[Root.GetHisHer]的个人发展。[Root.GetHeSheCap]准备了一系列非常具有意义、但可能会导致受试目标死亡的实验。[Root.GetHeSheCap]向我们保证这些实验只是需要一些小小的牺牲来成就上善之道。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has presented research plans to evaluate future industrial developments. This could benefit the economy as well as [Root.GetHisHer] personal projects. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has prepared a number of experi

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!提出了一项人口优化计划，以一些特定的个人自由为代价，将生产力提升至少6.98%。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has devised a population optimization plan that, at the expense of certain personal freedoms, would increase production by at least 6.98%.

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!开发了一项复杂的改过计划，把社会上那些问题分子改造成勤勉的公民。风险评估估计，17.3%的罪犯将不可能改过自新，这应该被认为是‘可接受的损失’。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has developed a complex rehabilitation program to reform the more troublesome elements in our society into diligent citizens. Risk assessment estimates that 17.3% of the criminal population will be imp

excerpt.zh: 超然均衡的特使§Y[Root.GetName]§!雇了一位学徒。这位有前途的年轻战士想要宣誓效忠于我们。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§!, the Numinous Equilibrium's envoy, has taken on an apprentice. The promising young warrior wishes to swear an oath of allegiance to us.

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!向[Root.GetHisHer]的教团“超然均衡”请求支援，来帮助我们帝国继续对抗暴政和压迫者。为我们运送宝贵合金的货船已经从他们的秘密总部抵达。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has requested support from [Root.GetHisHer] order, the Numinous Equilibrium, to aid our empire in the ongoing struggle against tyranny and oppressors. Freighter ships carrying valuable alloys to sustai

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!和[Root.GetHisHer]的机器人伙伴戈尔基花费大部分业余时间进行私人实验。其中一些现在得到了有趣的结果，[Root.GetHeShe]与我们帝国的科学家们分享了[Root.GetHisHer]的发现。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! and [Root.GetHisHer] robot companion Gorky have spent much of their spare time conducting private experiments. Some of them have now yielded interesting results, and [Root.GetHeShe] has shared [Root.Ge

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!收养了一只外星生物来陪伴[Root.GetHisHer]的机器人助手戈尔基。它是一只五彩斑斓的未开智软体动物，表现出了不俗的智力，能对口哨指令作出反应。收养这只生物似乎改变了[Root.GetHisHer]的性格，[Root.GetHimHer]变得更加有责任心，更加安定了。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has adopted an alien creature to accompany [Root.GetHisHer] robot assistant Gorky. It's a colorful mollusk who, though pre-sapient, exhibits an impressive intellect and responds to whistled commands. T

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!声称已经在多方面“改进”了[Root.GetHisHer]的身体。在没有获得允许的情况下，[Root.GetHeShe]为了庆祝[Root.GetHisHer]自己达到了完美的阶段而向整支舰队发送信息，并就此发表了一份宣言称，文明的出路唯有合成飞升：所有有机生命都脆弱不堪，无法逃离死亡。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! claims to have 'improved' [Root.GetHisHer] physical form in a number of ways. Without permission, [Root.GetHeShe] has sent messages across the fleet celebrating [Root.GetHisHer] perfected state and has

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!从国境内所有的舰船传感器上收集数据。使用算法计算重力扭曲后，[Root.GetFirstName]发现了我们的宇域中有一个天体的表面下隐藏着什么东西。如果数据准确无误，那么那颗荒芜的岩石下应该满是稀有合金。[Root.GetFirstName]将此视为一个拓展并升级舰队的好机会，提议派遣一艘工程船去挖取那些合金。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has collected sensor data from all ships within the our borders. Using algorithms that calculate gravimetric distortions [Root.GetFirstName] has discovered something hidden beneath the surface of one o

excerpt.zh: 在炸开几公里深的岩石后，发现了一批珍贵的合金。我们已经开始了检索操作。
excerpt.en: A trove of precious alloys has been uncovered after several kilometers of rock were blasted away. We have started retrieval operations.

records.en: I Was Born in the Year of ...

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!在[Root.GetHisHer]的房间里闭门数月撰写自传，其中不仅有[Root.GetHisHer]自己的毕生经历，还有[Root.GetHeShe]所了解的工程学研究、建设和稀有材料的知识。只要拜读[Root.GetHisHer]的大作，我们的科学家就一定能有所发现。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has spent months in [Root.GetHisHer] cabin writing a self-biography that includes not only [Root.GetHisHer] life story and travels, but also everything [Root.GetHeShe] knows about engineering research,

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!建造了一个机器伙伴，叫做皮瑞里亚。这台机器人具有高级学习能力，并且拥有人格矩阵。它帮助[Root.GetName]进行[Root.GetHisHer]的研究和维修工作。然而，与它的创造者一样，皮瑞里亚也是好奇心满满，渴望着离开家去冒险。[Root.GetName]问我们，皮瑞里亚能不能在我们社会中拥有自主的一席之地？
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! built a robot companion named Beryllia. The robot is capable of advanced learning, and has a personality matrix. It is assisting [Root.GetName] with [Root.GetHisHer] research and repair jobs. However,

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!长期在调查一处境内隐秘发展的犯罪网络。[Root.GetHeSheCap]将许多犯罪头目和海盗与腐败政客和军官勾结的证据整理到了一起。[Root.GetName]采用了新系统来加快此类案件的司法程序，目的是在罪犯有机会离开我们的司法管辖区之前抓住他们。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has been investigating a criminal network that has been growing quietly within our borders. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has put together evidence that connects various crime lords and pirates with corrupt polit

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!花费了[Root.GetHisHer]的大半生学习犯罪的本源和暴力侵犯的动机。[Root.GetHeSheCap]向专家寻求建议，研究其他现存和已故帝国的文化，并使用先进算法来设想一个乌托邦社会可能的样子。[Root.GetHisHerCap]的毕生心血凝聚成了一篇宏大的社会学论文，将会对未来的几代人起到指导作用。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has spent [Root.GetHisHer] life studying the nature of crime and the motivation of violent offenders. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has sought advice from experts, studied the cultures of other empires, both livi

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!因举办奢华宴会而享有盛誉。这些宴会以庭荠磁舵星成员的精彩表演、奇异的食物和饮料以及哲学和伦理讨论而闻名。在这里，人们建立有意，促成交易，解开心结。[Root.GetHisHerCap]将这么多千差万别的人凝聚起来的能力是我们繁荣发展的坚实基础。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has garnered a wide reputation for hosting lavish feasts. The gatherings are known for spectacular performances by members of the Alyssum Magnetar, exotic food and drink, as well as philosophical and e

excerpt.zh: §Y§![Root.GetName]简直是一位劝诱方面的艺术家。[Root.GetHeSheCap]利用[Root.GetHisHer]的人脉和政治影响力从整个星系收集重要信息。[Root.GetFirstName]把[Root.GetHisHer]所有的知识都保存在一件传家宝里：一块浅绿色的水晶，[Root.GetHeShe]偶尔会在[Root.GetHisHer]的奢华宴会上佩戴。当在特定的光谱下观察时，它的秘密就会以一个壮丽光晕的
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! is a true artiste when it comes to charm and persuasion. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has used [Root.GetHisHer] contacts and political clout to gather vital information from all over the galaxy. [Root.GetFirstNa

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!呈递了一个数据库，其中包含了多年来从[Root.GetHisHer]的延伸线人处收集来的敏感信息。这一巨大的数据库包括军事部署计划、秘密研究、意识读取数据在内的等等信息。这些东西当然极具价值，但使用这些信息可能会加剧内部和外部冲突。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! presents a database containing sensitive information gathered over the years from [Root.GetHisHer] extensive contacts. The massive cache includes everything from schematics over military installations,

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!在整个星系中继续铺展开[Root.GetHisHer]的线人网络。有些人是自愿告密的，而另一些人则是被勒索或洗脑的。但不管怎么样，[Root.GetHeShe]收集到的信息都会非常有用。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has grown [Root.GetHisHer] network of contacts throughout the galaxy. Some are willing informants, while others are blackmailed or brainwashed. In any case, the information [Root.GetHeShe] gathers will

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]，§!那位奢靡无度的行政官，在[planet_governed.GetName]为[Root.GetHimselfHerself]建造了一座豪华的宫殿。这座宫殿既彰显着[Root.GetHisHer]的权利和财富，也让[Root.GetHisHer]的浮夸和腐朽显露无疑。为了庆祝宫殿落成，[Root.GetHeShe]将举办一场盛大的宴会，所有的显赫人物都受邀出席。[Root.GetHeShe]还会罕见地
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§!, the decadent official, has built an extravagant palace for [Root.GetHimselfHerself] on [planet_governed.GetName]. This palace is as much a symbol of [Root.GetHisHer] power and wealth as of [Root.GetHi

excerpt.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!，那位奢靡无度的行政官，其贪污腐败行为暴露了。这一现象已经持续了挺长的时间，[Root.GetHeShe]不仅将[Root.GetHisHer]的财产存入银行，还藏匿于地下金库和星系各处的深空贮藏中。在面对质问时，[Root.GetHeShe]涕泗横流，拿[Root.GetHimselfHerself]的头抢地，信誓旦旦地保证这些财产的根本目的是为统治者准备的献礼。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§!, the decadent official, has been caught embezzling. This has been going on for quite some time, and [Root.GetHeShe] has stashed [Root.GetHisHer] wealth not just in bank accounts but also in underground

excerpt.zh: 多年来，神秘人§Y[Root.GetName]§!解读了许多揭示更大命运的征兆和预示。现在，[Root.GetSheHe]宣称预见到了整个星系将会统一在一面旗帜下的画面——而那正是我们的旗帜。真正的辉煌还在后头。
excerpt.en: For many years, §Y[Root.GetName]§! the Mystic has interpreted signs and portents that reveal a greater destiny. Now, [Root.GetSheHe] claims a vision of the galaxy united under a single banner - our own. The real splendor

excerpt.zh: 多年来，§Y[Root.GetName]§!一直通过强大的灵能梦向虚空呼喊。现在，几艘载有许多物种成员的民用飞船出现在[planet_governed.GetName]轨道上。他们愿意为我们服务，以期和他们的先知一起生活。
excerpt.en: For years, §Y[Root.GetName]§! has been calling out into the void via powerful psionic dreams. Now, several civilian ships carrying members of many species have appeared in orbit around [planet_governed.GetName]. In excha

excerpt.zh: 档案员§Y[Root.GetName]§!发现了一处远古遗物的储藏地。[Root.GetHeSheCap]从古老的传说和漫游海盗交易的传感器日志中拼凑出他们的行踪信息。这些神秘物体的起源尚不清楚，但通过吸收低频声音，它们会偶然产生轻微的时间扭曲。这项技术应该是有益的。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! the Archivist has discovered a cache of ancient relics. [Root.GetHeSheCap] pieced together information of their whereabouts from old myths and sensor logs traded from roaming pirates. The origin of the

excerpt.zh: 档案员§Y[Root.GetName]§!截获了一条奇怪的信息。这些信息在星际间回荡了数千年，受到严重的静电噪音影响。它包含了来自外星文明的问候，以及他们家园的精确位置。这个物种已经灭绝了很长一段时间，但在它们的母星上可能仍然有重要的遗迹和远古的知识有待发现。
excerpt.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! the Archivist has intercepted a strange message. Distorted by static, the message has reverberated between the stars for millennia. It contains a greeting from an alien civilization, as well as the pre

excerpt.zh:
太空海盗！即使他们这种想法也令人兴奋，这个自称为§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!的团体把目光转向了我们。

虽然我们可以尊重他们选择的生活方式，但这对我们贸易网络产生的影响可不太理想。
excerpt.en:
Space pirates! Even the thought is a thrill, and a group calling themselves §S[pirate_band.GetName]§! have turned their sights on us.

While we can respect their choice of lifestyle, the effect it's having on our trade n

excerpt.zh:
一小群拥有一种罕见基因突变的子个体，可使它们切断与蜂巢思维的部分连接而不会陷入休眠。不过如果离开蜂巢思维太远，这些离群的子个体就会死亡，所以它们盘踞在了位于我们境内§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!星系。

它们打算当海盗来维持自身，利用少数简陋的飞船打劫穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线。
excerpt.en: A rare genetic mutation present in a small number of drones has allowed them to partly sever their connection to the Mind without being rendered comatose. As these rogue drones would perish if they ventured too far from

excerpt.zh: 一小群故障的单元已经脱离了[Root.GetName]的中枢，并躲进了我们境内的§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!星系。这些单位已经无可挽回地腐化，并开始利用简陋的舰船劫掠穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线，掠夺零件和资源。
excerpt.en: A small group of malfunctioning units have separated themselves from the main intelligence of the [Root.GetName], and sought refuge in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system, inside our space. These units have become irr

excerpt.zh:
一群逃兵与叛徒在§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!星系安了家。这些亡命之徒驾驶着偷来并经过改装的舰船从我们的编队中溜走，如今正掠夺着维持我们航程的贸易航线。他们自称为“§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!”，并发誓不效忠于任何旗帜。

他们出身于舰队，对我们的舰船、航线和行动模式了如指掌。绝不能任由他们继续壮大。
excerpt.en: A band of deserters and renegades has made its home in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system. Slipping away from our formation in stolen and modified vessels, these outcasts now prey upon the trade lanes that sustain ou

excerpt.zh:
一小群拥有一种罕见基因突变的子个体，可使它们切断与蜂巢思维的部分连接而不会陷入休眠。不过如果离开蜂巢思维太远，这些离群的子个体就会死亡，所以它们盘踞在了位于我们境内§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!星系。

它们打算当海盗来维持自身，利用少数简陋的飞船打劫穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线。
excerpt.en: A rare genetic mutation present in a small number of drones has allowed them to partly sever their connection to the Mind without being rendered comatose. As these rogue drones would perish if they ventured too far from

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]报告说，舰队在[From.GetName]星系发现了很多海盗。

扫描发现海盗船和空间站的数目非常庞大，所以这应该是个历史悠久的海盗港口。这些海盗从很久以前就开始在这里进行抢劫活动，且没有遭遇过任何打击行动。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] reports that the fleet has encountered a significant pirate presence in the [From.GetName] system.

Judging by preliminary scans of the immense ships and the stations harboring them, this is a historic

excerpt.zh:
[killer_fleet.GetName]报告称，[killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName]星系的海盗私掠船已经被摧毁了。虽然附近恒星系中还有一些零零散散的海盗船，但从目前来看，星际海盗已经成为了过去……至少今天如此。

我们从他们丰厚的储存室里设法缴获了一批来历不明的赃物，这批宝藏我们可以纳入国库，另有他用。

excerpt.en: The [pirate_slayers.GetName] has destroyed a pirate station in the [pirate_slayers.GetStarName] system, and recovered its strong room module.

excerpt.zh:
[pirate_slayers.GetName]已经消灭了位于[pirate_slayers.GetStarName]星系内的一处海盗空间站并回收了空间站的保险模块。

保险模块中除了各种被偷来的资源之外，还有某个不完整的亚空间传送门设计图的存储数据，我们不清楚海盗们是如何取得这个设计图的，但此设计图可以让我们更好的了解跨星系传送门网络的工作原理。
excerpt.en:
The [pirate_slayers.GetName] has destroyed a pirate station in the [pirate_slayers.GetStarName] system, and recovered its strong room module.

Aside from various stolen resources, the module also contained an ancient dat

excerpt.en: Our trade route in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system is poorly protected and passes through what has largely become lawless space. An increasing number of pirates, smugglers and various other criminal elements have

excerpt.zh:
一小群子个体上出现了罕见的基因突变，可使它们切断与蜂巢思维的部分连接而不会陷入休眠。不过如果离开蜂巢思维太远，这些离群的子个体就会死亡，所以它们盘踞在了位于我们境内的§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!星系。

它们并不是碰巧选中的这个恒星系，而是因为我们一支最不设防的贸易路线正好途经该恒星系。那些离群的子个体无疑打算当海盗来维持生计，利用它们的少数简陋飞船打劫穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线。

excerpt.zh: 一群外星海盗已经潜入并盘踞在了位于我们境内的§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!星系。我们有一条不设防的贸易路线途经该恒星系，它们似乎打算掠夺这条贸易路线来维持自己的犯罪活动。

excerpt.zh: 一小群有机生物体的犯罪分子已经设法潜入并盘踞于我们境内的§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!星系。他们似乎打算打劫途经该恒星系不设防的贸易路线，或许是心存有机生物常见的侥幸心理，误以为他们的存在无关紧要，不会令我们动用武力。
excerpt.en: A small group of organic sub-units, apparently criminal outcasts, have somehow infiltrated and established themselves in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system inside our borders. They seem intent on raiding the system's

excerpt.zh:
[root.GetName]代表：暂时封锁现已在[thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]生效。在此星系加工和运输的食物及矿物现在会被[thalassocracy_country.GetName]外部关卡和所得军官查封。所有非商用飞船将遭到驱逐，若执意前行则会受到炮火攻击。这些条件将一直生效，直至我们完成ECA配额。

我们理解，关卡检查有时会让人精神崩的紧紧的。只要我们相互合作，就不会有人受到伤害。请放

也许历史会将这次屏蔽，这次将[From.GetName]从大宇宙完全隔离的行为，视作极端且不合理。也许也不会。不管如何，从现在起[From.GetStarName]星系有了一颗行星规模的水晶球。
excerpt.en:
The glittering beam from the [From.From.GetName] fades, and [From.GetName] is silent.

Perhaps history will call the shielding, this complete severing of [From.GetName] from the greater cosmos, extreme and unjustified. O

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]地表上的灭杀完成后，[From.From.GetName]上的中子羽流逐渐散去了。扫描显示未发现智慧生命迹象；植被虽被摧毁，但会逐渐恢复的。有些人会称这种彻底消灭智慧生命，只保留无机质的做法为邪恶的战争罪行。

我们将其称为高效。
excerpt.en: The [From.From.GetName]'s neutron plume peters out, having finished its sweep of [From.GetName]'s surface. Scans report no signs of sapient life; plant life, while damaged, may recover in time. Some would call the total

excerpt.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上的灵能的嗡声逐渐淡去，一瞬间万物寂静。[From.GetName]上的人群目瞪口呆（如果他们有眼和鼻的话），灵能射线从他们心智絮网中发散着，每个人都着迷于其强大和强烈的个人信仰。

如果他们之前不明白的话，现在他们知道了：我们都只是某个更伟大事物的一部分。
excerpt.en: The empyreal hum of the [From.From.GetName]'s psionic coils fades, and for a moment all is quiet. Down on [From.GetName] the people stand slack-jawed (or local physiognomic equivalent), enraptured by the powerful and per

excerpt.zh:
[From.From.GetName]已完成纳米同化机器人的部署，其数量经计算足以义体化支配[From.GetName]上所有智慧有机生命。

我们没有在[From.From.GetName]上布置任何传感器或器械以证明我们的成功，但我们知道已经成功了。当我们将目光投于[From.GetName]上时。我们见到了自己，也经由自己所见。

在[From.GetName]表面上，只有我们自己。
excerpt.en:
The [From.From.GetName] has completed deployment of the assimilation nanobot payload, calculated to be sufficient to cybernetically dominate all sapient organics on [From.GetName].

We did not build the [From.From.GetNam

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]曾是圣地。


你们不明白你们犯下了多大的罪恶。


不过马上就会了。
excerpt.en:
[From.GetName] was a holy world.


You do not know the true extent of your sin.


Not yet.

excerpt.zh: 随着从[FromFrom.GetName]上下降的水柱消散，[From.GetName]的表面完全改变了。曾经有广阔缺水的大陆，现在只有崭新闪耀着欢迎的微光的蓝色海洋，随时可以居住。

excerpt.zh: 来自[FromFrom.GetName]的滔天毒流渐渐平息，[From.GetName]上生意盎然的生态系统不复存在，充满毒气的星球中唯有少数几种生命形式能繁衍生息。
excerpt.en: As the awesome stream of venomous substances from the [FromFrom.GetName] subsides, [From.GetName] is transformed from a vibrant ecosystem to a noxious world on which few forms of life can thrive.

excerpt.zh: 随着[FromFrom.GetName]发出的意识清除光束的能量逐渐消散，[From.GetName]的人口几乎都已经退化到了未开智状态。幸免遇难者面对那些曾经认识的人们做出动物般的举动只能束手无策。
excerpt.en: As the energies of the mind wiping beam from the [FromFrom.GetName] dissipate, [From.GetName]'s population has almost entirely regressed to the pre-sapient stage. Those who were spared can now only watch in horror as tho

excerpt.zh: 尽管对[GetPreFTLLower]文明使用超级武器非常有趣，但这也意味着那里已经没什么剩下的可供观测了……
excerpt.en: Although using our superweapons against a [GetPreFTLLower] civilization is certainly amusing, it also means that there is now nothing left to observe there...

从今天起，§Y[Root.GetName]§!定会被视为星球中值得钦佩或羡慕的真正瑰宝。
excerpt.en:
Through our superior bio-engineering, considerable investments, and years of hard labor, our Gaia Seeding project on §Y[Root.GetName]§! has come to fruition.

From this day on, §Y[Root.GetName]§! must be considered a tru

excerpt.zh: 我们的宗主在§Y[from.from.planet.GetName]§!上完成了他们奇异的计划，将其转变成了一颗盖亚星球。承蒙照顾，我们现在可以让这座具有诗一般气候和画一般土地的天国派上用场。
excerpt.en: Our Overlord have completed their strange project on §Y[from.from.planet.GetName]§!, transforming it into a Gaia world. Thanks to them we can now put the idyllic climate and vast open spaces of this paradise to good use.

excerpt.zh: 我们一直明目张胆地在§Y[contact_empire_system.GetName]§!星系进行行动，对于隐藏自己的行动丝毫没有任何注意。尽管他们的技术水平不高，但是即使是§Y[contact_empire.GetName]§!也注意到了我们的行动。现在第一次接触不可避免了。
excerpt.en: We have been careless, conducting operations in the §Y[contact_empire_system.GetName]§! system without bothering to hide our activities. Despite their modest technology level, even the §Y[contact_empire.GetName]§! have t

excerpt.zh:
我们围绕§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!建造了一座观测站来研究上面的居民，但却意识到§Y[contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!反而是在研究我们：他们完全清楚其他外星物种的存在，并很快注意到了我们[root.GetScientistPlural]的到来。

我们先前在这个恒星系的活动一定已经让[fromfrom.owner.GetName]对我们的存在有所警觉。当前情况下，保持我们的存在
excerpt.en: We built an observation post around §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! to study its inhabitants, only to realize the §Y[contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! are the ones studying us: they are fully aware of the existence of other

excerpt.zh:
我们在§Y[From.GetName]§!发现了一些属于远古外星文明的文物！从这些遗物的年代来看，他们应该是在大约1200万年前活跃在这一区域的文明。
 
从我们所能拼凑起的情报中，科学家总结出这是一种自称为“沃陶姆恒星议会”的外星物种，他们长得像蠕虫的环节动物，大约3-4米长，彼此主要借助体节传递的振动进行交流。
excerpt.en:
We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on §Y[From.GetName]§!! They must have been active in this region of space approximately 12 million years ago, judging by the age of the artifacts.

From what

excerpt.zh: 奇迹般地，我们从[From.From.GetName]坑洞中炸飞的沃陶姆数据核心上回收了一部分数据。大部分的数据都已损坏，但我们的科学家成功翻译出了“科尔加”这个代表沃陶姆基本时间单位的单词。
excerpt.en: Miraculously, we managed to salvage parts of a Vultaum data core that had been blown clear of the crater on [From.From.GetName]. Most of the data was corrupt, but our scientists did manage to properly translate the "korg

excerpt.zh: 我们在§Y[From.GetName]§!表面发现了一个古老的沃陶姆观测站，[From.GetStarName]系统距离沃陶姆的发源地相当遥远，这个设施似乎也是主要被用来观测他们自己的恒星的。我们已经浏览了一边观测站还残存的数据，但是完全不知道沃陶姆到底在他们的观测站里寻找什么。

excerpt.zh: 在§Y[From.From.GetName]§!进行的考古发掘在一座天文台一间布满灰尘的小屋中发现了一张小型壁画。上面似乎描绘了数个星座，如从沃陶姆主星观察应该可以看见。我们的天文学家目前还不能确定其中的任何一颗星球。

excerpt.zh: 我们在§Y[From.From.GetName]§!的考古学家在破碎的电梯电缆旁边找到了星图的残片。显然沃陶姆商舰队的队长用过这个星图，星图上标注着几条他们最常用的、获利最大的星际贸易路线。
excerpt.en: Our archaeologists on §Y[From.From.GetName]§! have managed to recover the partial remains of a star chart next to a broken segment of elevator cable. It was apparently used by captains in the Vultaum merchant marine, and

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]表面有几个巨大的圆形湖泊是由数百万年的一系列反物质爆炸形成的，那时，[From.GetPlanetMoon]还是有沃陶姆人居住的，而弹坑所在处在当时都是他们最大的几个居住站之一。[Root.GetName]的科学家已经排除了轨道轰炸的可能性，因此我们相信这些爆炸可能是当时地面上的人造成的。

excerpt.zh: §Y[From.From.GetName]§!上的考古学家在一座倒塌的医疗中心里的一个终端机上回收了完整的存储核心，其中保存着一些有趣的记录，比如沃陶姆的自然平均寿命（大概270年）以及一些他们常患的疾病。

excerpt.zh: 在对§Y[From.GetName]§!进行了一次彻底的扫描之后，我们发现了在[From.GetPlanetMoon]的地表下有一个大规模、人造的地下网络系统，许多隧道都已经崩塌了，[Root.GetName]的一支小队认为这只是沃陶姆地下殖民地的很小一部分。进入地下洞穴的主入口被故意摧毁了，沃陶姆的城市和居民们都被数百万吨巨石压在了地下。
excerpt.en: A thorough scan of §Y[From.GetName]§! has revealed a vast, artificially-constructed network of tunnels beneath the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. Most of the tunnels have collapsed, and the crew of the [Root.GetName] be

excerpt.zh: 在§Y[From.From.GetName]§!进行的考古挖掘中，在离地面很近的其中一间倒塌密室里发现了一些令人惊讶的沃陶姆种群化石遗骸。这让科学家们得以进一步了解沃陶姆种群的真实样貌。
excerpt.en: The archaeological dig on §Y[From.From.GetName]§! has unearthed some remarkable fossilized Vultaum remains from one of the collapsed chambers closest to the surface. This has given our scientists a much clearer picture o

records.zh: 沃陶姆气态巨行星设施

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]附近的轨道上发现了沃陶姆人的采气站的部分残骸，数百万年前，沃陶姆本意是将这个采气站直接送入气态巨行星的内部，但是一次不明物体的撞击使这个计划失败了。
