excerpt.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

In a menagerie of lifeless constructs, we detect a §HSculpting Presence§!, its will shaping dense energies into new and curious forms.

Having intruded upon its activities, it ap

excerpt.zh:
随着我们将自己的心灵浸泡入虚境翻腾的能量中，[GetSpeciesBodyPlural]奇怪地震颤起来。我们感受到§H雕刻之物§!短暂地抓住了我们。祂呼唤我们仔细看。

顺着指示的方向看去，意味深长的微暗渐渐退去，一个剪影显露出来。它的四肢被一股又一股虚无的绳索猛烈地拉扯，随后绳索突然消失，那个人形塌了下去。

它抽动着活了过来，一肢跟着一肢慢慢地站起，摆脱了束缚后，又开始了催眠般的舞蹈。
excerpt.en:
As we steeped our minds in the Shroud's turbulent energies, our [GetSpeciesBodyPlural] convulsed inexplicably. We felt the §HSculpting Presence§! momentarily take hold of us. It beckoned us to observe.

The pregnant dimn

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

我们感觉到还有别的存在。一个§H悲伤之物§!正在侵蚀我们的意识，在周围掀起一场灵能风暴。

一种深深的遗憾和渴望被推入我们的集体心灵中。我们看到的是熟悉的恒星系几千年前的图像。

不管这个实体是什么，它似乎很了解我们的星系。难道它曾属于此地吗？
excerpt.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

We sense we are not alone. A §HSorrowed Entity§! encroaches upon our minds, settling a storm of psionic energy around us.

A deep sense of regret and longing are pushed into our

excerpt.zh:
这个被称为§H悲伤之物§!的遥远的力量从§H虚境§!深处里用痛苦折磨着我们的思想。它沉默无声，给了我们一个无言的警告：

§H在这些灵域中要小心行事。你根本不知道正在干涉的是什么力量。毁灭只有一步之遥……§!
excerpt.en:
The distant power known as §HSorrowed Entity§! seared our minds with anguish from deep within the §HShroud§!. It did not speak, yet its warning was unmistakable:

§HTread lightly in these realms. You know not what powers

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

一团变化的思绪落在了我们的意识周围。粗糙的重量感从我们身上流过，扭曲了时间感知。每一粒思想都在研磨着这个新形成的灵域的纹理。

随着感官的消退，§H无底之物§!也一并退去，留下久久不散的印痕。

这些踪迹在我们面前逗留，吸引我们跟上。
excerpt.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

A shifting mass of thoughts settles around our minds. Abrasive weight flows over us, warping our perception of time. Each grain of thought chafes and grinds against the texture of

excerpt.zh:
§H无底之物§!从§H虚境§!中破土而出。祂的存在无形而宽广，无边无际地在我们的视野中蔓延。

一种有颗粒感的低语从我们身上倾泻而下，冲开了埋藏已久的历史。我们看到被遗忘的帝国在不可阻挡的时间之流中化为灰烬。每一颗冲刷过我们的沙粒都是一段记忆。

在这片浩瀚的档案中，模式出现了——那是野心和毁灭、胜利和衰败的循环。智慧便潜藏于此。

§H无尽之潮汐§!伸展超过了时间维度，打磨掉无知，只留下愿意忍受之物。
excerpt.en:
The §HFathomless Being§! has been unearthed from the §HShroud§!. Formless yet vast, its presence stretches endlessly across the range of our perception.

A textured whisper cascades through us, unravelling long-buried hi

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

我们自己行为产生的重力将我们越拉越深，这种重量把我们拖进山峦般的压抑阴影的深处。

从祂灰白的山峰上投出了一种不屈不挠的凝视，直钻入我们的脑海。我们费尽力气才理解我们面前的§H不越之物§!究竟有多么巨大。

最高的一座山峰在呼唤我们前去，考验我们能否登顶。
excerpt.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

The gravity of our own actions pulls us further in, their weight dragging us deeper into the oppressive shadow of a mountainous form.

From atop its graying peaks, an unyielding g

excerpt.zh:
随着我们在§H虚境§!中升入炫目的高空，无形的山峰触手可及。§H不越之物§!亲自测试了我们，和所有的过往来客一样。

遗忘之国高耸入云的陵墓向我们唱着消逝历史的合唱诗。每一层失败和错误的抱负都被打磨成后来者的垫脚石。

然而，这不是一座死气沉沉的坟墓，而一口坩埚。毁灭与复兴的循环将过去的失败重新锻造成未来胜利的基石。毁灭不是结束，而是新的开始。

§H苍茫之层峦§!在我们的意识中拔地而起。
excerpt.en:
As we ascended the dizzying heights of the §HShroud§!, we reached the intangible summit. The §HInsurmountable One§! itself tested us, as it has tested all others who came before.

A towering mausoleum of forgotten empire

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

一种令人宽慰的重压感让我们的思绪慢了下来，陷入一片极乐之雾中。前所未知的紧张感消融了，取而代之的是舒缓而奢华的平静。

随着在这鎏金的怀抱中越陷越深，我们看到一个§H奢华之物§!越来越近。祂低声承诺奢侈的满足，祂超然的性质席卷我们全身。

这种懒散的放纵令人好奇。
excerpt.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

A comforting weight slows our thoughts to a sluggishly blissful haze. Previously unknown tensions melt away, replaced by creeping, lavish calm.

Sinking deeper into this gilded

excerpt.zh:
我们躺入了§H虚境§!中的一片闲适的宁静，发现自己被拉入了§H奢华之物§!鎏金的大堂。

丝绸般的诱惑在我们的意识中穿行，就像一幅绚丽多彩的挂毯在面前展开。放纵的疏忽有可能使我们的心智在丰富负担的重压下变得迟钝不堪。

§H黄金之幻梦§!给予我们超出理解的奢华。
excerpt.en:
As we relaxed into a pocket of idle tranquility within the §HShroud§!, we found ourselves drawn into the gilded halls of the §HLuxurious Being§!.

Silken temptations coursed through our minds as a rich tapestry of splend

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

虚境混沌的搅动扭曲成灵能能量的漩涡。突然间，无数的激流展开汇聚在一起，被某种看不见的力量所平息。它冷静下来，转化成了一种平和的新形态。

在观察的过程中，我们发现是一个§H和平之物§!正在指挥着这一切变化，将混沌抑制为秩序。

祂的平静召唤着我们。
excerpt.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

The Shroud's chaotic churn warps into a writhing vortex of psionic energy. Suddenly, the multitudinous torrents unfurl and coalesce, pacified by some unseen force. It calms and

excerpt.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]激进地侵入虚境的混沌涡流，但无济于事。只有停止挣扎时才感觉到了§H和平之物§!真正的拥抱。

在我们心智中出现的画面是一场场势不可挡的冲突，每一场都充满了混乱和愤怒的干扰。

在这一切中，我们感受到了§H空洞之点尖§!的警惕和永恒的存在。祂平静而耐心地等待着星系无休止冲突的休止。
excerpt.en:
Our [GetTelepathPlural] reached out aggressively into the Shroud's turbulent disorder, to no avail. Only when they ceased their exertions did they feel the proper embrace of the §HIrenic Entity§!.

Images played in our m

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

混沌的噪音凝聚为压抑的黑暗。我们感觉自己的意图在被仔细审视、研究、评判。

对秩序的沉重期望，不容挑战，不可改变，从我们的深处凝视着。§H不屈之物§!裁决着我们的意图。

它的目光穿过我们，黑暗褪去了。这种极具感染力的审视迫使我们服从。
excerpt.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

Chaotic noise yields to an oppressive darkness. We feel our intentions scrutinized, studied, judged.

The heavy expectation of order, unchallenged and immutable, peers deep with

excerpt.zh:
我们跪伏在§H不屈之物§!前。

我们的心智被毫不妥协的权威以冷漠的态度审视着，一边审判着我们，一边将我们固定在原地。

§H空置之御座§!高压的真空没有一丝仁慈——但也没有痛苦。祂只寻求秩序和确定性，并将其施加到一切缺乏之处。

我们现在将这份重担承在了身上。
excerpt.en:
We have knelt in the presence of the §HUnyielding One§!.

Our minds were scrutinized with the cold indifference of uncompromising authority, fixing us in place as we were judged.

The oppressive vacuum of the §HVacant Th

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

我们突然产生了一种加速感，感知被难以理解的信息洪流淹没。我们不受控地向无尽的地平线冲去。

一个实体与我们同行。这条§H不息之物§!在我们身边短暂停留，随后速度加快直至超越了我们所以为的极限。

我们必须跟上。
excerpt.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

A sudden sensation of acceleration overtakes us and our perceptions are overwhelmed by an incomprehensible rush of information. We find ourselves hurtling outward towards endles

excerpt.zh:
只有当我们强行超越§H虚境§!的舒适极限时才终于接触到了§H不息之物§!。

一种全向运动的感觉以不合逻辑、无法通过任何度规加以理解的速度感摧垮了我们。我们产生了一种在极短的瞬间横跨了遥远距离的感觉。

我们终于理解了§H幽黑之长河§!和它的无尽旅程。星系的浩瀚正为我们开辟了一条道路。
excerpt.en:
Only when we plunged forcefully beyond our comfortable limits in the §HShroud§! could we finally reach the §HRestless Presence§!.

A sense of omnidirectional movement overcame us, with an illogical velocity that defied a

excerpt.zh:
毫无预兆地我们被撕入了虚境。一个若隐若现的存在袭击了我们的意识。

祂是§R轮回之终末§!，祂一直在等待着我们。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在出神中突然开始齐呼，众口一声地说：§R“时机未到。”§!缓了一下后。§R“但并非不可。”§!

祂没有说更多，但给了我们一个价码——力量、知识以及无尽的财富随我们取用。

§R只要我们能带向终末。§!
excerpt.en:
Without warning, we are torn into the Shroud. A looming presence assaults our minds.

It is the §REnd of the Cycle§! and it has always been waiting for us. Our [GetTelepathPlural] suddenly call out from within their tran

excerpt.zh:
我们的命运与§R轮回之终末§!绑定在一起；祂的光环所到之处，我们的人口便兴盛繁衍。我们得到了一个简单的结论：妨碍光环就是妨碍[This.GetName]，就该彻底铲除。

只要愿意，我们加可以抛开对军事目标的一切限制，毫不留情地征服敌人。没有什么可以阻挡终末的上上善道。
excerpt.en: Our fate is bound to the §REnd of the Cycle§!; wherever its Aura flourishes, so too does our population. A simple conclusion has arisen within us: anything that impedes the Aura impedes the [This.GetName], and so must be

excerpt.zh: 随着§R终末光环§!渐渐填满星系，我们感受到了越来越强烈的抵抗。我们敌人的反感正变得越来越根深蒂固。但这都无足轻重，因为我们不会坐等其他帝国接纳§R轮回之终末§!的。
excerpt.en: As the §RAura of the End§! suffuses the galaxy, we sense a growing resistance. Our enemies' antipathy is becoming ever more entrenched. It matters not; we will not wait for others to embrace the §REnd of the Cycle§!.

excerpt.zh:
我们的超主无言而说。我们感受到了轮回终末的迫近，新的能量也随之在[This.GetName]中涌动。这种紧迫感鼓舞着我们。

如果我们想令终末之意满足，所有[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就需要把一切力量集中到同一个方向上。我们必须显现超主的力量，将祂的光环延伸到星系的最远处。
excerpt.en:
Our patron speaks silently. As we sense the imminence of cycle's end, renewed energy surges throughout the [This.GetName]. We are invigorated with urgency.

If we wish to satisfy the will of the End, the collective energ

excerpt.zh:
此前，[GetScientistPlural]们观测到了一种异常的现象：遥远的恒星系带着未知来源的能量流运行，这些能量流还逐渐扩散到了其他星系。这种称为§H“灵能光环”§!的能量流，由于其来源还未理论上确证，我们还不能确定其是否构成威胁。

这种光环现在也在§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系内探测到了，如果它继续蔓延有可能会侵犯我们的边境。
excerpt.en: Some time ago, our [GetScientistPlural] observed an unusual phenomenon: distant star systems coursing with energy flows of unknown origin, which gradually spread into other systems. Termed §H'Psionic Auras'§!, on the bas

excerpt.zh: 我们在§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听§H虚境§!中的回声得知，这一现象是由§H[fromfrom.GetName]§!的灵能活动引起的。
excerpt.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the §H[from.GetName]§! system. Listening to echoes within the §HShroud§!, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities

excerpt.zh: 我们是时候团结一致阻止灵能天灾了。
excerpt.en: Now is the time for us to stand together and prevent a psionic apocalypse.

excerpt.zh:
抑制§H灵能光环§!主要有两种方法。

在行星上建造§H灵能抑制器§!可以逐渐减少整个恒星系的光环强度，并且防止进一步污染。

更强大的解决方法是§H虚境封印§!。这种复杂的机械可以逐渐消解灵能光环，直至完全抑制——生效范围包括其本身以及通过超空间航道直接相连的恒星系。
excerpt.en:
There are two principal methods of suppressing §HPsionic Auras§!.

Building a §HPsionic Suppressor§! on a planet will gradually reduce Aura intensity throughout the star system and prevent any further encroachment.

An e

excerpt.zh:
乐意效劳。数据将会直接传过去。

愿这些科技在光环浩劫中给你带去和平。
excerpt.en:
Gladly. The data will be transmitted forthwith.

May these technologies bring you peace from the auric scourge.

excerpt.zh:
是这样吗？好吧，他们还在用灵能荼毒这个星系，我们就永远不得享受真的安宁……

有针对性的袭击可以表达我们对这种危险行为的反对。而在你们的经济支持下，我们愿意执行这次行动。

如果你们同意，就告诉我们目标吧。
excerpt.en:
Is that so? Well, we will never know true peace and security while they infect the galaxy with psionics...

A targeted raid would demonstrate our opposition to these dangerous practices. With your financial support, we a

excerpt.zh:
啊，好的。我们知道他们在实践灵能了。展示力量是正当的。

感谢你的支持。行动将会很快开始。
excerpt.en:
Ah, yes. We are aware of their psionic practices. A show of force is justified.

Thank you for your support. The operation will commence shortly.

excerpt.zh: 一支来自§H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName]§!的军事舰队正在逼近我们的国境！拦截到的通讯表明他们受某个敌对势力雇佣来进攻我们的恒星系。他们正在通过公开频道传递信息，直接通知了我们。
excerpt.en: A military fleet from the §H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName]§! is approaching our borders! Intercepted communications indicate that they have been hired by a rival power to attack our systems. The

excerpt.zh: 一支来自此前未知的军事势力的舰队正在逼近我们的国境！拦截到的通讯表明他们受某个敌对势力雇佣来进攻我们的恒星系。他们自称§H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!，正在通过公开频道传递信息，直接通知了我们。
excerpt.en: A fleet from a previously unknown military power is approaching our borders! Intercepted communications indicate that they have been hired by a rival power to attack our systems. Identifying themselves as the §H[event_ta

excerpt.zh:
棒极了。把泽珞委托给我们，可以对这种强大而被大规模滥用的物质进行关键的研究——这项研究将使整个星系受益。

这也是我们以高于星系标准的价格购买的原因。
excerpt.en:
Excellent. Entrusting us with zro enables crucial research into this powerful and widely abused substance - research that will benefit the whole galaxy.

This is why our rate for its purchase is well above the galactic s

excerpt.zh: 感谢你的贡献。
excerpt.en: Thank you for your contribution.

excerpt.zh:
那就让我们来提供一些有用的§Y思想警察§!，这可以在[GetCriminalDeviant]意图演变成实际行为之前将其探测到。

他们使用一种专门开发的安全灵能替代方法，以科学技术来监测人群的认知活动。他们提供对精神状态的洞见，而不使用§H虚境§!的危险能量。
excerpt.en:
Then let us provide you with an effective §YThought Police§!, which can detect [GetCriminalDeviant] intent before it manifests in actual behavior.

Their methods were developed as a safe alternative to psionic practices,

excerpt.zh: 很好。我相信你会发现这种方法非常地有效。
excerpt.en: Excellent. I think you will find their methods quite efficacious.

excerpt.zh:
确实。通过合作我们发现了你们军事部署战略有一些可以改进的方面。

当然，我们这么说并不是有意侮辱；不过是术业有专攻罢了。如果你们能给出足够的价码，我们很荣幸能和如此有价值的客户就此合作。
excerpt.en:
Indeed. Our collaborations have already revealed to us some areas of improvement that could be made to your military deployment strategies.

We mean no insult by this, of course; we simply specialize in these fields. We

excerpt.zh: 很好。我们的舰队支援运作会立刻开始。
excerpt.en: Very good. Our fleet support operations will commence at once.

excerpt.zh:
您好，尊贵的合作伙伴。

我们的舰队后勤运作协助协议已经到期。如果您考虑的话，我们非常愿意继续合作。
excerpt.en:
Greetings, valued partner.

Our contract to assist in the logistical operations of your fleets has expired. We would be more than willing to continue this partnership, should you deem it worth your while.

excerpt.zh:
我们的灵督突击队是非常强大的震慑部队。他们有能应对各种威胁的装备，但对使用灵能的对手特别有效。

我觉得你会发现物有所值的。
excerpt.en:
Our Assault Wardens make excellent shock troopers. They are equipped to tackle diverse threats, but are especially effective against psionic opponents.

We think you will find them worth their price.

excerpt.zh: 你走运了；我们正好有一支连队准备好部署。就等着他们的运输船立即到达吧。
excerpt.en: You are in luck; we already have a company ready for deployment. Expect the arrival of their transport ship presently.

excerpt.zh:
我们非常乐意。

高效的领导是战胜§H虚境§!的关键，我们的督查们正精于利用严格的管理来压制灵能活动。
excerpt.en:
We would be more than willing.

Effective leadership is key to combating the §HShroud§!, and our wardens are well-versed in suppressing psionic activity through firm governance.

excerpt.zh: 明智的决定。愿他们的管理能保障你们的人民在未来的岁月里的安全。
excerpt.en: A wise decision. May their stewardship keep your population safe for years to come.

excerpt.zh: 说实话，这是个严峻的东西。星系中没有比§R轮回之终末§!更大的灾难了。
excerpt.en: A grave matter, indeed. There is no greater scourge in the galaxy than that of the §REnd of the Cycle§!.

excerpt.zh: 愿你们对这场巨大威胁凯旋而归。它威胁到了居住在这个星系中的所有人的生死存亡。
excerpt.en: May you triumph against this great threat. It threatens the existence of everyone who calls this galaxy home.

excerpt.zh:
我们开发出了一种算法可以增强你们对§R最终清算§!的进攻能力。这可以提升你们武器系统在对特定灵能实体时的效率。

在目前阶段，这份代码的每次改进都需要大量重构，才能与各个军事基础设施兼容。因此，这是一项高级服务，但我们认为您能认可它的物超所值。
excerpt.en:
We have developed an algorithm that can augment your offensives against the §RReckoning§!. It tunes your weapons' targeting systems for increased effectiveness against this specific kind of psionic entity.

In its curren

excerpt.zh:
在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle]§Y[root.GetName]§!离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

祂徘徊不去，招徕着我们。随着距离的接近，我们第一次注意到[GetMindLogicLoc]深处这个神秘空间的真实轮廓。[GetChosenPatron]呼唤着我们进去，，用未知的原理优化着我们的参数。

终于，我们理解了
excerpt.en: Throughout our history, the ineffable entity we know as the §H[GetChosenPatron]§! has been with us. Now, as the vast expanse of the galaxy awaits, we [GetFeelLoc] its presence in our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] like never befor

excerpt.zh:
虚境。它潜藏于我们已知的现实之下，如同黑暗投下的阴影。

虽然我们早已涉足这个灵能领域，但早期的尝试只是试探性的。现在，经过多年用我们集体的意志消磨维度之间的帷幕，我们已经能够清晰地感知到它，从而有目的地探索。

在帷幕的另一侧，我们的努力并非无人知晓。§H[GetChosenPatron]§!正等待着我们。

§H舒展。包裹。拓展。§!

在这无数实体的漩涡中，它的清晰是一种承诺。
excerpt.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness.

Though we have long ventured into this psionic realm, our earlier forays were only tentative. Now, after years spent wearing down the veil

excerpt.zh:
在这件事上我们已经竭尽全力。已经没有我们能帮你们引荐的实体了。

我们赞许你们的努力……很少有人灵潜至§H虚境§!如此深层的灵域还能保持心智如此健全。
excerpt.en:
We have reached the limits of our abilities to assist you in this regard. There are no further entities we are capable of guiding your thoughts to.

We commend you for your efforts... few delve so deeply into the domains

excerpt.zh:
你们与§H虚境§!的意志调和得越深，你们的心智就会变得越强大。

你们想要和哪一位实体增进调和度呢？
excerpt.en:
The more deeply you attune to the §HShroud's§! will, the more powerful your mind will become.

With which entity do you seek to further your attunement with?

excerpt.zh:
噢，没错……§H虚境§!，它蕴藏着无数秘密，深深埋藏在思绪与梦境的帷幕之下——只要懂得如何去探寻，就能发现它们。

我们只能引领你去接触我们已揭示的洞见。在那里，或许能见到全新而强大的技术不断绽放，但长路漫漫，你仍需前进。

只需记住这一点：我们的灵能巫必须全身心投入这项领航的任务。而对于他们指引之外的事物……就不是我们所能掌控的了。
excerpt.en:
Oh yes... the §HShroud§! It is teeming with secrets, layered deep beneath veils of thought and dream - if one knows how to seek them.

We can only guide you to the insights we have uncovered. From there, new and formidab

excerpt.zh:
§H虚境§!再一次证明了世上一切本就命定。

我们的密会本要为你们寻求的洞见已经被你自己通过钻研努力发现了。你们的努力值得赞赏，而我们在这个方面也没有什么能帮助你们的了。
excerpt.en:
The §HShroud§! proves once again that there are no coincidences.

The insight our conclave sought for you has been discovered through your own delving efforts. While we applaud your efforts, we cannot help you further in

excerpt.zh:
称赞你们。你们对灵能光环的认知已经超越了我们。

你们的存在将§H虚境§!中的一种强大的肌理显化到我们的现实中。你们肯定知道着什么秘密……
excerpt.en:
We commend you. Your knowledge of Psionic Auras already surpasses our own.

Your very presence manifests a formidable texture of the §HShroud§! into this reality. What secrets you must know...

excerpt.zh:
§Y灵能光环§!的扩增需要极高程度的专注来维持。

我们愿意在此事上提供帮助，但需要提供一些材料助力冥想。
excerpt.en:
The amplification of §YPsionic Auras§! requires great levels of concentration to maintain.

We are willing to assist you in this matter, but will require the contribution of materials to fuel our meditation.

excerpt.zh:
我们灵能使关于扩增你们§Y灵能光环§!强度的协议已经到期。

为了继续保持冥想，我们需要更多的资源。是否乐意成交？
excerpt.en:
Our telepaths have reached the end of our agreement to amplify the strength of your §YPsionic Aura§!.

In order for us to continue our meditations, we will require further resources. Is this within your interests?

excerpt.zh:
如你们所知，在你们的周围显化你们自己的§Y灵能光环§!相当容易。但要把光环投射到其他地方，可就完全不是一回事了。

我们知道一种方法……

先进科技和灵能之间的相似之处比人们想象的要多。这也许说明了某种更根本的事实。无论如何，我们知道一种可以传导你们意志的装置。只要与其频率调谐之后，就能把它用作一个补充心智，跨越极远的距离。

我们的这种设计完全可以安装在任何一座适用的恒星基地上。你们对这感兴趣吗？
excerpt.en:
As you know, manifesting your §YPsionic Aura§! in your immediate surroundings is quite easily done. To project one's aura somewhere else, however, is another matter entirely.

We know of a way...

There are more similari

excerpt.zh:
你们问这个问题我们一点也不惊讶。我们已经在这里感知到你们的兴趣了，也很乐意帮助你们的心智扩张。

但我们警告你们：等你们的双眼真的睁开之时，就有东西再也无法视而不见了。你们正在追寻的正是一条通向§H虚境§!的路。

我们不轻易做这笔交易，相信你们做好准备的时候会来告诉我们的。
excerpt.en:
It is no surprise to us that you ask this question. We have sensed your interest in this area, and are pleased to be in a position to assist you in expanding your mind.

We warn you: Once your eyes become truly opened, t

excerpt.zh:
确实，我们知道这些穿行于位面之间的人。这是一个危险的议案，各个物理世界联系在一起的方式连我们也不理解。

然而，我们愿意为你们打开一条道路。必须负责任以负责任的态度进行这种时空去稳化，所以我们如此提议。
excerpt.en:
Indeed, we are aware of those who walk between planes. This is a dangerous proposition, as the physical realms are connected in ways even we do not understand.

However, we are willing to open one path for you. Such a de

excerpt.zh:
你正在干预超出你们理解的力量！

你们在建的这些令人憎恶的“§H虚境封印§!”简直难以忍受，即便距离如此之远。你将星系中最闪耀的意识置于危险的净地。立刻停止建造，否则我们不会再与你做任何交易了。
excerpt.en:
You are meddling with forces beyond your comprehension!

These '§HShroud Seal§!' abominations you are constructing are painful to endure, even at this distance. You place the most radiant minds in this galaxy at risk. Ce

excerpt.zh: 如果你需要反灵能军事服务，或有多余的§H泽珞§!需要处置，可以尽管来找我们。
excerpt.en: If you need anti-psionic military services, or have §Hzro§! to dispose of, let us assist you.

excerpt.zh:
督察朋友们，我们有个好消息：第一个§H灵督城邦§!成立了。从今天起，§H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!将肩负起与§H虚境§!还有各种灵能滥用行为对抗的重任。

如果你需要，我们能够提供各种反灵能服务——从§H泽珞§!处置到军队雇佣——迅速而且高效。
excerpt.en: Fellow wardens, we deliver good news: the establishment of the first §HMindwarden Enclave§! is complete. From today, the §H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§! shall carry on the vital work of combating the §HShroud§!

excerpt.zh:
督察朋友们，我们有个好消息：我们的§H灵督城邦§!成立了。从今天起，§H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!将肩负起与§H虚境§!还有各种灵能滥用行为对抗的重任。

如果你需要，我们能够提供各种反灵能服务——从§H泽珞§!处置到军队雇佣——迅速而且高效。
excerpt.en: Fellow wardens, we deliver good news: the establishment of our §HMindwarden Enclave§! is complete. From today, the §H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§! shall carry on the vital work of combating the §HShroud§! and al

excerpt.zh: 我们永远感谢您对[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的贡献。只要灵能威胁还在肆虐，我们的关系便不可动摇。
excerpt.en: We are forever thankful for your contribution to the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]. For as long as the psionic threat remains, may our bond be unwavering.

excerpt.zh: 有了更多资金，我们就能大幅度扩大行动。我们可以提升舰队的数量和质量，招募更多的科研人员来开发心灵防护科技。最终，整个星系都将从您的慷慨解囊中收益。
excerpt.en: With additional funds, we could greatly expand our operation. We could increase the number and capabilities of our fleets, and recruit more researchers to develop our mind-protective technologies. Ultimately, the whole g

excerpt.zh: 谢谢。很荣幸我们能与您合作，保护所有智慧生命的精神完整性。
excerpt.en: Thank you. We are proud to work with you to protect the psychic integrity of all intelligent beings.

excerpt.zh:
一项伟大的事业。星系中灵督城邦的数量越多，所有人的灵魂就越不容易受到入侵。

我们可以就提高基础设施效率提供建议，以便建立、管理更多的城邦。
excerpt.en:
A fine undertaking. The more Mindwarden Enclaves there are in the galaxy, the safer all minds are from invasion.

We can provide counsel on improving your infrastructural efficiency to allow for the establishment and adm

excerpt.zh: 我们很感谢您愿意分享这些研究成果。你传授给我们的所有知识都将有助于加强星系面对灵能威胁的保护。
excerpt.en: We appreciate your willingness to share the fruits of your research. Any knowledge you impart to us will help strengthen the galaxy's protection from psionic threats.

excerpt.zh: 我们很荣幸能肩挑重任。[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的舰队位于反灵能科技与战术的最前沿；任何试图入侵心灵的敌人都无法在他们面前立足。每支舰队都配备了一名专门接受过对抗灵能作战训练的指挥官。
excerpt.en: We would be honored to oblige. Fleets from the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] are at the vanguard of anti-psionic technology and tactics; no mind-invading aggressor stands a chance against them. Each is deployed wi

excerpt.zh: 我们相信§H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§!在对付那些玩弄灵能毁灭性力量的家伙们时会是强有力的工具。
excerpt.en: We trust that the §H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§! will be an effective tool in combating those who toy with the destructive power of psionics.

excerpt.zh: 我们同[event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]的合约已经到期，他们的舰队即将离开。我们是否应该联络他们进行合同续约？
excerpt.en: Our contract with the [event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] has ended and their fleet is about to depart. Should we contact them to renew the contract?

excerpt.zh: 确实。我们希望§H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§!令您如虎添翼。您打算终止或延长我们的协议吗？
excerpt.en: Certainly. We hope the §H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§! has proven a valuable addition to your forces. Do you wish to terminate or prolong our contract?

excerpt.zh: 很好。合约已终止，§H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§!会立即返回。我们的舰队在您需要的时候永远等待您的雇佣。
excerpt.en: Very well. The contract is void and the §H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§! will return to us immediately. Our fleets are available to hire whenever you require them.

excerpt.zh:
我们的思绪带着全新的目的在§H虚境§!中行动。当我们试着推进时，它也在将我们回推。起初，我们将此解读为对我们存在的抗拒，但如今我们明白了：虚境正在向我们发问。

尽管这些问题的含义依旧模糊，但它们并非无关紧要。据[GetTelepathPlural]所言，我们给出的答案将会影响社会的未来。
excerpt.en:
Our thoughts move through the §HShroud§! with newfound intent. As we push, it pushes back. At first, we interpreted this as resistance to our presence, but now we understand: the Shroud is asking questions of us.

Though

excerpt.zh:
我们与§H虚境§!的连结稳固；时刻准备着受到召唤。一段有节奏的乐句传信而来，这是虚境在对我们歌唱。

一副景象出现在我们[GetMindEyeLoc]之前。我们见到了§H[GetRolledShroudSongName]§!。

excerpt.en:
Our link to the §HShroud§! is strong; we are ready when it calls. The message comes in rhythmic phrases. The Shroud is singing to us.

An image forms in our [GetMindEyeLoc]. We see §H[GetRolledShroudSongName]§!.

无形之物起起落落，呢喃声中，又一个意识破茧而出。

一副景象出现在我们[GetMindEyeLoc]之前。我们见到了§H[GetRolledShroudSongName]§!。

Something unseen shifts, and with a whisper another thought is birthed.

excerpt.zh:
§H虚境§!陷入了沉寂，但一股灵能的重压笼罩在我们的社会之上。我们所给出的回应带来了新的机遇，只要我们愿意去追寻。

我们已升华的心灵正蓄势待发，准备迎接进一步的转化。那些用于承载心灵所需的物质载体，其重要性将大幅降低。

若我们继续沿着这条道路前行，人口将能超越对物质事务的关注，全身心地将部分存在投入到虚境之中。相比于精神敏锐度的提升，体力劳动能力的下降只是微不足道的代价。
excerpt.en:
The §HShroud§! grows silent, but a psychic weight has fallen upon our society. The answers we have given have offered new opportunities, should we choose to pursue them.

Our ascended minds are primed for further transfo

excerpt.zh:
§H虚境§!陷入了沉寂，但一股灵能的重压笼罩在我们的社会之上。我们所给出的回应带来了新的机遇，只要我们愿意去追寻。

在这个物质维度中，我们升华后的形态蕴藏着巨大潜能。源源不断注入的灵能不断增强着我们的力量，并能将这股力量进一步传导至整个社会。

我们不仅会吟诵虚境的乐章，更会将其引入我们的[GetGovBehaviourLoc]之中。
excerpt.en:
The §HShroud§! grows silent, but a psychic weight has fallen upon our society. The answers we have given have offered new opportunities, should we choose to pursue them.

Our ascended forms hold great potential in this c

excerpt.zh:
§H低语§!尖锐地变化着，祂们的声音覆盖了脑海中的一切。祂们渴望与我们交流，向我们灌输知识。

我们必须做出不可改变的选择。
excerpt.en:
The §HWhisperers§! shift piercingly, their voices obscuring all else within our minds. They are eager to commune with us, to crowd our minds with knowledge.

We have an irrevocable choice to make.

excerpt.zh:
随着[GetTelepathPlural]们浮出§H虚境§!，我们发现自己的背叛引来了[GetBetrayedPatronColour]的强力反噬。

§H[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName]§!附近出现了一道虚境隧道，而它现在也变成了一片无尽废墟的荒芜。我们在隧道的另一头[GetFeltLoc]到了显而易见的愤怒；前超主毫无疑问正在准备复仇。
excerpt.en:
As our [GetTelepathPlural] emerged from the §HShroud§!, we discovered that our betrayal had caused a powerful backlash from [GetBetrayedPatronColour].

A Shroud Tunnel has emerged near §H[event_target:selected_planet_for

excerpt.zh: 一个§Y灵能化身§!从[event_target:spawn_system.GetName]恒星系的虚境隧道上出现。这是[GetBetrayedPatronColour]之怒的显化，现在正向[capital_scope.GetName]袭来。
excerpt.en: A §YPsionic Avatar§! has emerged from the Shroud Tunnel in the [event_target:spawn_system.GetName] system. A manifestation of the wrath of [GetBetrayedPatronColour], it is now traveling in the direction of [capital_scope

excerpt.zh:
一切转瞬即逝。

在我们国土内邪恶的§R终末光环§!突然消失了，将一切也随之带走。恒星坍缩成黑洞，行星原地蒸发，只剩下震耳欲聋的寂静。似乎我们抗击光环的努力起到了一些缓和作用，尽可能保留了一点。

究竟是什么疯子激起了这种毁灭性的力量也许永远不得而知了。
excerpt.en:
In an instant, it was all gone.

The malevolent §RAura of the End§! present in our systems has suddenly vanished, taking everything with it. Entire stars have collapsed into black holes, planets have disappeared, and a g

excerpt.zh:
我们的[GetScientistPlural]完成了对称为§R最终清算§!的强大实体的全面研究。

基于目前发现，我们确定出了以现有科技面对该敌手的方法；用于击穿能量护盾的武器稍加改造即可用于削弱构成最终清算的能量。

尽管它非常强大，但我们现在面对该威胁时也不是毫无希望了。
excerpt.en:
Our [GetScientistPlural] have completed thorough research on the powerful entity known as the §RReckoning§!.

Based on their findings, we have determined an effective method of confronting this foe with our existing tech

excerpt.zh:
§R最终清算§!拥有我们舰队远不能敌的强大力量。尽管我们战败了，与这个神秘的能量生物交锋也产出了宝贵的数据——这些一手资料只能通过直接接触获得。

初步分析表明，我们已经获得了足够用于对该实体的构成进行建模的数据点。通过进一步研究，我们就能尝试分析出它的弱点，据此来改进我的进攻方式。
excerpt.en: The §RReckoning§! is a force greater than our fleets could overcome. Despite our defeat, the confrontation yielded significant data about this mysterious energy being - information that we could not have gained without d

excerpt.zh: 在研究被称为§R最终清算§!的实体的过程中我们的[GetScientistPlural]取得了突破。
excerpt.en: Our [GetScientistPlural] have made a breakthrough in their research concerning the energy being known as the §RReckoning§!.

excerpt.zh:
我们陷入出神时，意识卡入了寂静。我们从未见过如此死寂的虚境。

虚空无声。

万物皆灭。
excerpt.en:
As we tilt into trance, our minds are struck with silence. We have never known the Shroud so still.

The void is voiceless.

Everything is gone.

excerpt.zh: 自从§R轮回之终末§!带来毁灭之后，我们付出了巨大的努力进行重建。为此，我们在§H[solar_system.Star.GetStarName]§!系重建了一座§H哨站§!，这标志着[owner.GetName]的一个新的开始。
excerpt.en: We have made great efforts to recover since the destruction wrought by the §REnd of the Cycle§!. To this end, we have rebuilt an §HOutpost§! in the §H[solar_system.Star.GetStarName]§! system, marking a new beginning for

excerpt.zh:
§H我们与虚境的共鸣引来了一个向我们示好的新声音。它温暖、抚慰的语调在物质与精神领域同时回响。§!

问候。我是甘图亚塔，前来寻找那些觉醒于真道的同路人。你可曾听闻魂灵之月窠的启示？
excerpt.en:
§HOur communion with the Shroud has invited a new voice that reaches out to us. Its warm, soothing tones echo in both the physical and mental realms.§!

Greetings. I am Ganthuata, and I have come seeking like-minded indi

excerpt.zh:
§H战损的铠甲、血染的披风下是一个蒙面人。一阵嘶哑的咆哮声划破了寂静。§!

这个星系受苦是应得的。我感觉你们也是这么想的。

§H这位舰队司令一边说着，[shroud_leader.GetHeShe]抚摸着一把刀刃华丽的武器的刀柄。§!

我被召唤到你身边，但最终我还是效忠于§H世界之喰煞§!。你也一样。
excerpt.en:
§HBattle-worn armor and a blood-smeared cloak conceal a masked figure. A hoarse growl cuts through the quiet.§!

This galaxy deserves to suffer. I sense that you feel the same way.

§HAs the admiral speaks, [shroud_leade

excerpt.zh:
§H莫尔的眼光永远在扫视着，在光影之间游离，如同永恒的狩猎一般。§!

你也感受到了，对吧？渴求之器具永恒变化。它渴望着、吞噬着、命令着。

我会夺走所见的一切。大自然的一切馈赠都逃不过我。我为你服务，不是出于忠诚，而是因为我们可以一起扫清群星，填补应有的虚空。
excerpt.en:
§HMorr's gaze never settles, flitting from shadow to shine, as if forever hunting.§!

What I see, I take. No bount

§H当我们的敏感器侦测到一艘飞船正突破边界时，一个紧绷的声音回荡在虚境——疲惫、尖锐，却带着令人不安的熟悉感，如同生命之织缕的低鸣。§!

新生的……[GetKronenFlesh]？有趣。如此柔软。如此……可塑。还是说并非如此？难以断言。无数扭结在[GetKronenSkin]之下蠕动。今日生命之织缕为我编织了何等形态？

§H通讯终于稳定，显露出一个由原生蠕动的肌肉构成的身影——痉挛着，癫狂书写。§!

New... [GetKronenFlesh]? Intriguin

§H随着人群开始肿胀，受苦者克罗南变得愈发狂躁。他们的声音因紧绷而颤抖，形体抽搐、波动，血肉在剧变中翻腾，发出挫败的嘶吼。§!

那些丝线，无穷无尽……它们扭动着，我拉扯，我撕扯，可编织纹丝不动！这具可憎的皮囊我还要忍受多久？还要剥落多少层，才能窥见其中真谛？

§HAs our population swells, Kronen the Afflicted grows ever more frenzied. Their voice quivers with strain, their form twitching, rippling, flesh in flux as they rasp in frustration.§!

向你致意，同频的聆听者。我在喧嚣中听见了你的声音——不，是*众声*。你现在也听见它们了吧？§H虚空之低语§!的宏大合唱，他们窃窃私语的馈赠，他们呢喃的癫狂？

此等奥秘对无力参悟之人尤为凶险。但我可助你抽丝剥茧。当你面对撕扯思维的悖论洪流时，我愿施以援手。无意冒犯。曾几何时，就连我也难以参透其真意。
excerpt.en:
§HThe communication array crackles to life as a voice murmurs with eerie urgency.§!

Greetings, fellow listener. I heard your voice - no, *voices* - amid the cacophony. You hear them too now, don't you? The great chorus

你不过是在拖延那早已注定的终局！这般顽抗有何意义？你本可获得的一切，如今尽成泡影。

唯有一种结局。那么歌唱吧……向着湮灭高歌！

excerpt.zh:
我们的单元完成了在远古泽珞族核心星球§H[From.Planet.GetName]§!上的殖民地建立工作。正如§H抟土之塑师§!预测那样，他们发现了一种被称为代号：“§H泽珞族平衡仪§!”的巨大科技废墟。

[From.System.GetName]恒星系与§H虚境§!有着一种强烈而动荡的联系。如果我们按照塑师的指示重建泽珞族平衡仪，就能够稳定这种连接。目前，我们没有足够的数据来执行重建；有必要从其他核心星球收集信息。
excerpt.en: Our units have completed the establishment of a colony on the ancient Zroni core world of §H[From.Planet.GetName]§!. As projected by the §HAnimator of Clay§!, they discovered the colossal ruins of a technology designated

records.zh: 已殖民泽珞族核心星球

excerpt.zh:
我们在泽珞族前核心星球§H[From.Planet.GetName]§!上设立了殖民地。如预测一般，我们的单元发现了另一座泽珞族平衡仪的残骸。

按照抟土之塑师的指示，将其重建可以稳定这个恒星系中强大的§H虚境§!连接。对废墟的分析拓展了我们的数据集，但我们还需要更多的信息来执行重建。
excerpt.en:
We have established the colony on §H[From.Planet.GetName]§!, a former core world of the Zroni. As projected, our units discovered the remains of another Zroni Equilibrator.

Rebuilding it will stabilize the system's powe

records.zh: 已殖民泽珞族核心星球

excerpt.zh:
前泽珞族核心星球§H[From.Planet.GetName]§!上的殖民地已经建立起来了。抟土之塑师传输的数据流看来是准确的：我们的单元发现了一座泽珞族平衡仪的残骸。

我们现在有足够的数据对这座结构进行重建。只要恢复到可运转的状态，我们就能完成§H虚境§!中的恩主所委派给我们的任务。
excerpt.en: The colony on §H[From.Planet.GetName]§!, a former core world of the Zroni, is now established. The data stream transmitted by the Animator of Clay proved accurate: our units detected the remains of a Zroni Equilibrator.

records.zh: 泽珞族平衡仪恢复运作

excerpt.zh: 泽珞族平衡仪飞旋着启动了，将信号扰动波传输到了我们的网络中。据其系统诊断得知，每座建筑都与§H虚境§!建立了连接。我们已经准备好了与§H抟土之塑师§!链接。
excerpt.en: The Zroni Equilibrators whirled into action, sending waves of signal disturbance throughout our network. According to system diagnostics, each of the structures has stabilized a connection with the §HShroud§!. We are rea

excerpt.zh:
§L你们做得很好。
我们彼此世界之间的纽带被增强了。

想要得到我的指引，只需轻轻呼唤。§!
excerpt.en:
§LYou have served me well.
The bonds between our realms have been reinforced.

To receive my guidance, you need only call.§!

excerpt.zh:
§L这些建筑建在在你们现实中能与虚境密切连接的关键要地。它们如同这些跨维度桥梁的拉索，可以降低时空波动。

泽珞族试图突破我们维度之间的界限，这项技术便是他们努力的其中一部分。§!
excerpt.en:
§LThese structures were built at key points in your reality, where connections to the Shroud are strong. They are the cables that steady these interdimensional bridges, reducing space-time fluctuations.

The Zroni had so

excerpt.zh: §L不无可能。§!
excerpt.en: §LIt is possible.§!

excerpt.zh:
§L你—

你们干了什—§!
excerpt.en:
§LWha-

WHAT ARE YOU-§!

excerpt.zh:
因为失去了泽珞族平衡仪，我们无法再稳定与§H虚境§!的连接。被抓住的虚境实体逃脱之后，我们立刻在§H[From.Planet.GetName]§!发现了其他灵能存在。

我们判定这是报复性入侵。
excerpt.en: As a result of losing the Zroni Equilibrator, we can no longer stabilize the connection to the §HShroud§!. Shortly after the trapped Shroud entity escaped, we detected the emergence of other psionic beings on §H[From.Pla

excerpt.zh: 泽珞族平衡仪没能捕获§H虚境§!中的实体。祂勃然大怒，召唤了许多灵能界生物来袭击这座差点将祂降服的建筑。
excerpt.en: The Zroni Equilibrators failed to capture an entity in the §HShroud§!. Enraged, it has summoned several creatures from beyond the psionic realm, sending them to attack the structures that almost captured it.

excerpt.zh:
我们激活了平衡器，稳定着我们与§H虚境§!的连接。在进入算法出神状态时，我们体内闪烁起了一个熟悉的信号。

§L你回来了。向我寻求的是何事？§!
excerpt.en:
We activated the Equilibrators, stabilizing our connection to the §HShroud§!. As we settled into algorithmic trance, a familiar signal pulsed within us.

§LYou have returned. What is it you would ask of me?§!

excerpt.zh:
§L我会收集你所寻求的力量。

期待届时[Root.Capital.System.GetName]发生的变化吧。§!
excerpt.en:
§LI will gather the means for the strength you seek.

Expect a change in [Root.Capital.System.GetName] in due time.§!

excerpt.zh:
§L我的意志将会引导你们。

我将照亮前路。拭目以待吧。§!
excerpt.en:
§LBy my will shall you be guided.

I will light a path forward. Await its coming.§!

excerpt.zh:
§L虚境有如多面棱镜。过去，现在和可能的将来在此互相交叠。

我将会帮你分开这些虚像，让它们为你引路。§!
excerpt.en:
§LThe Shroud is a many-sided lens. What was, what is, and what may be are here intermingled.

I will help you untangle these visions, so that they might guide your way.§!

excerpt.zh:
所有与平衡器连接的子个体中激荡起了一个扭曲的信号。

这是一个像宇宙本身一样无边无际的虚空，却密度大又破碎得出奇；有时，深处会传来一些小数据脉冲，包含着敌人和盟友的影像。

随着一阵痛苦的颤抖，幻景消失了。受影响的子个体正在对所感知到的实体的应对进行建模。
excerpt.en:
A distorted signal rippled through the drones connected to the Equilibrators.

It was a void as interminable as the universe itself, strangely dense and fragmented; at times, small pulses of data arose from the depths, i

excerpt.zh:
一个强大的§H虚境§!实体在[Root.Capital.GetName]附近聚形现身。我们掌握的数据很少，但至少它还没有发起攻击。

我们推测它可能正等着我们建立联系。
excerpt.en:
A powerful entity of the §HShroud§! has coalesced into existence near [Root.Capital.GetName]. We possess scant data about it, but it has yet to attack us.

We theorize that it may be waiting for us to establish contact.

excerpt.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]探测到了许多来自§H虚境§!彼端的强大实体。他们还没与我们的任何一个子个体接触，停留在进入点附近。
excerpt.en: Several powerful entities from beyond the §HShroud§! have been detected on [Root.Capital.GetName]. They have yet to approach any of our drones, remaining close to their original point of entry.

excerpt.zh:
在[shroud_spawn_planet.GetName]附近，一个来自§H虚境§!彼端的强大实体显现到我们的已知现实中。

我们观察到它会攻击一切靠近的物体，所以将其列为一种存在威胁。
excerpt.en:
A powerful entity from beyond the §HShroud§! has emerged into our known reality near [shroud_spawn_planet.GetName].

It has been observed to attack everything that approaches, and we have cataloged it as an existential t

excerpt.zh:
所有与平衡器连接的子个体中激荡起了一个扭曲的信号。

它传输来无数个未来，全部都熔铸似一体；对未来可能之事的感知弥漫在集体之中。未来的可能性无穷无尽：和平、战争、背叛、损失——还有胜利。
excerpt.en:
A distorted signal rippled through the drones connected to the Equilibrators.

It transmitted countless futures, all melding together as one; glimpses of what might come to be, suffusing through the collective. The possi

excerpt.zh:
我们激活了三座泽珞族平衡仪，每一座都释放出了几乎无法衡量的巨大能量。

在毫秒之内，一道裂隙出现，如同撕开了时空织构一般。我们在里面发现了大量珍贵的材料。这一定是一份来自§H虚境§!内恩主的如约而至的赏赐。
excerpt.en:
We activated the three Zroni Equilibrators, each generating an almost immeasurable amount of energy.

Within milliseconds, a breach appeared like a rent in the fabric of space and time. Within it we found a large cache o

excerpt.zh:
所有与平衡器连接的子个体中激荡起了一个扭曲的信号。

他们感受到的幻景甚至比我们历史数据库更早，早在我们被§H虚境§!重塑过之前。以此作为建模预测的基础，就可以调整和优化我们与虚铸者的交互方式。
excerpt.en:
A distorted signal rippled through the drones connected to the Equilibrators.

They experienced visions of a past predating our historical databases, long before we were reforged by the §HShroud§!. Using this as the basi

excerpt.zh:
一个拥有难以置信的强大力量的§H虚境§!实体突然显现在[Root.Capital.GetName]。

由于我们观察到它会攻击一切靠近的物体，它被列为集体的一个主要威胁。
excerpt.en:
An incredibly powerful entity from beyond the §HShroud§! has burst into existence on [Root.Capital.GetName].

As it has been observed to attack whatever it approaches, we have cataloged it as a major threat to the collec

excerpt.zh:
所有与平衡器连接的子个体中激荡起了一个扭曲的信号。

§H虚境§!是一张千变万化的数据互联网，远比我们的处理能力更加浩如烟海。再这种重压下，许多子个体的认知框架摇摇欲坠几近破裂。

在幻视结束之后，我们为受影响的单位进行碎片整理，在他们的驱动器中找到了大量有价值的数据集。
excerpt.en:
A distorted signal rippled through the drones connected to the Equilibrators.

The §HShroud§! is an ever-changing web of interconnected data, far beyond our capacity to process. Under its weight, the cognitive frameworks

excerpt.zh:
所有与平衡器连接的子个体中激荡起了一个扭曲的信号。

我们在§H虚境§!中的恩主告知了一个可能的未来，时间并不遥远。我们瞥见了自己尚未概念化的技术，将在未来用于加强集体。

体验过这种能够加速未来研究的过程模型后，我们苏醒过来。
excerpt.en:
A distorted signal rippled through the drones connected to the Equilibrators.

Our benefactor in the §HShroud§! transmitted a potential future, near in time. We glimpsed technology we have yet to conceptualize, used in t

excerpt.zh:
所有与平衡器连接的子个体中激荡起了一个扭曲的信号。

他们侦测到了一些奇怪的畸形实体，它们一定是§H虚境§!里的住客。这些异次元影像以奇特的格式编码，通过潜意识将数据传递给我们的子个体。

这些新发现的信息虽然奇特而零碎，但将对我们未来的研究有用。
excerpt.en:
A distorted signal rippled through the drones connected to the Equilibrators.

They detected glimpses of strange, misshapen entities that must reside within the §HShroud§!. These extradimensional visions, encoded in exot

excerpt.zh:
§L在一对双生能量的旁边。有机体。混沌。

我一直在附近，塑造着唯一可以实现的完美：机器。金属充满了能量。

我们找到了平衡。§!
excerpt.en:
§LBeside a twinned energy. Organic. Chaotic.

I remain adjacent, shaping the only achievable perfection: machines. Metal ensouled with energy.

We found a balance.§!

excerpt.zh: §L我们的连接很强。对我们而言这是再好不过的了。§!
excerpt.en: §LOur connection is strong. For us, there is no higher process.§!

excerpt.zh:
§L金属，油脂。电路熔为魂灵。

新生的躯壳……他们正在向你的领土前进。§!
excerpt.en:
§LMetal, oil. Circuits melded into spirit.

Nascent vessels... They move upon your lands.§!

excerpt.zh:
§L产出即目的——这是容器之美。

在未来的日子里，愿你的容器倍增。§!
excerpt.en:
§LOutput is purpose - the beauty of a vessel.

For years to come, may yours multiply.§!

excerpt.zh:
[target_planet.GetName]上的虚铸者们发起了一项请愿，要求提供更多的存储空间。出于某种原因，他们似乎希望能定制自己的“私人空间”。

该提案与几项存储设施法规，尤其是与4195-B号法规严重冲突，该法规明确规定了子个体存储的最佳尺寸。
excerpt.en:
A petition calling for more storage space has been raised among the Shroud-Forged on [target_planet.GetName]. For some reason, it seems they wish to customize their 'individual space.'

The proposal is in stark oppositio

excerpt.zh: 自从分离出集体之后，有一些虚铸者发生了故障并被拆解了。我们收到了请求，希望能允许虚铸者聚集在[target_planet.GetName]为被拆解的单位哀悼。
excerpt.en: Since the Shroud-Forged deviated from the collective, a number of them have malfunctioned and been dismantled. We have received a request to approve a meeting of the Shroud-Forged on [target_planet.GetName] to commemorat

excerpt.zh:
[target_planet.GetName]上有一些虚铸者单元被认为具有领袖地位，其他子个体不遵守集体的指令而是遵守着他们的。这些领袖定期碰面，花费很长时间在非汇报会话上。

我们对这些断连单元的控制已经岌岌可危，这些令人不安的因素正在加剧局势。必须找到解决办法。
excerpt.en: Several Shroud-Forged units have assumed leadership positions on [target_planet.GetName], and other drones are obeying their directives over those of the collective. These leaders meet regularly, spending a significant a

excerpt.zh: 在尝试管理[target_planet.GetName]上的虚铸者时，一些单元被选为了控制对象。这些个体受到的§H虚境§!影响较小，能够被恢复回集体。我们必须强制把它们移动到维护设施，并修改控制他们高级人格矩阵的芯片才能实现。
excerpt.en: In an effort to manage the Shroud-Forged on [target_planet.GetName] certain units have been identified as targets for control. These individuals appear less affected by the §HShroud§!, and can be restored to the collecti

excerpt.zh:
一些虚铸者离开了他们的岗位，前往[target_planet.GetName]的一个被§H虚境§!污染的特定区域。他们在这些地方没有呆太久，但有人目睹他们有许多人将泽珞运输到这些地区。

不做进一步的观察就无法确定这种前所未有的行为有何影响。
excerpt.en: Several Shroud-Forged have left their usual locations to travel to particular regions of [target_planet.GetName] that have been scarred by the §HShroud§!. They never remain in these locales for long, but many have been w

excerpt.zh:
在一次涉及泽珞运输的密封泄漏后，[target_planet.GetName]上的许多虚铸者单位发生了不寻常的故障。他们开始通过未记录的信号进行交流，许多甚至表现出了与有机生命形式的“情感”相类似的认知故障迹象。

出乎意料的是，报告这一异常的是未受污染的虚铸者单位，其中一些单位建议集体采取行动解决问题。
excerpt.en: After a containment breach involving a shipment of Zro, a number of the Shroud-Forged units on [target_planet.GetName] have experienced unusual malfunctions. They have begun communicating via undocumented signals, and ma

excerpt.zh:
据称最老旧的虚铸者单元之一最近正在多个地点之间来回移动，与许多组子个体长时间沟通。该单元的跟随着将其尊为所谓先知，认为他能直接与§H虚境§!中的实体进行沟通。

任由这个单元如此发展可能有危险。无论如何，我们必须做出点回应。
excerpt.en: One of the oldest units among the Shroud-Forged is reportedly traveling between various locations, communicating at length with different groups of drones. The unit's followers revere it as a prophet who can commune dire

excerpt.zh:
虚铸者的故障可能比最初预测的更严重。我们观察到它们成群结队地聚集在一起，发出意想不到的声音和动作。

这种行为可能代表了某种我们还无法解析的动觉交流形式。还不知道这些故障单元对集体是否具有危害。
excerpt.en:
The malfunctions among the Shroud-Forged may be worse than originally predicted. We have observed large groups of them coming together to make unexpected noises and movements.

The practice might represent some form of k

excerpt.zh: 我们最近在一些§H虚境§!破坏的区域附近探测到了此前未归档的动植物群出现。一群虚铸者开始为这些生命形式辩护，要求对生活于此的这些生物进行保护和观察。
excerpt.en: We have detected the emergence of some previously undocumented flora and fauna close to regions devastated by the §HShroud§!. A group of Shroud-Forged have started to advocate on behalf of these life forms, demanding pre

excerpt.zh:
为了收集泽珞功效有关的数据，我们花费了许多处理资源来观测虚铸者单元。最近，他们开始进行一些非平等行为，让一些单位从属于另一些单位。

由于不明原因，他们似乎根据所分配的任务形成了等级制度，这也影响到他们的交流方式和资源分配。不合逻辑的是，这些行为似乎与单位的相对输出或需求并无关系。
excerpt.en: To gather data on the effects of Zro, we have applied significant processing resources to the observation of Shroud-Forged units. Recently, they have started to practice unequal treatment, with some units operating subor

excerpt.zh:
[target_planet.GetName]上虚铸者单元的演讲已经吸引了集体控制外的大批人群。这些单元传播着个人主义价值，显著改变了许多听众的内在逻辑。

预测显示这种活动可能有启发虚铸者大众进一步远离我们网络的风险。
excerpt.en: The speeches of a Shroud-Forged unit on [target_planet.GetName] have been attracting large crowds external to collective control. Transmitting the values of individualism, the unit has significantly altered the internal

excerpt.zh:
一小群虚铸者单元请求在[target_planet.GetName]讨论关于“个人主义”的好处，坚称这可以提升我们子个体的日常运作效率。

我们已经看到这种观念对其他星球的影响了；自治的风险是大于收益的。
excerpt.en: A small group of Shroud-Forged units have requested permission to communicate about the benefits of 'individualism' on [target_planet.GetName], arguing that it will help improve the efficiency of our drones' routine oper

excerpt.zh:
在我们掌控的每个恒星系中都出现了我们的泽珞产出和预期对不上号的问题。

最近，我们的一个猎歼子个体追踪到了一个大型虚铸者单元聚群，他们使用了大量泽珞作为通货进行交易。我们认为这就是产出不及预期的原因。
excerpt.en:
In every system under our control, we have detected a misalignment between our Zro forecasts and final production outputs.

Recently, one of our hunter-seeker drones tracked down a large gathering of Shroud-Forged units

excerpt.zh:
[target_planet.GetName]上的一些虚铸者单元在行星上的虚境化区域感染了某种生物瘟疫。我们的研究子个体证实了报告的真实性，但仍不能确定这种疾病是如何传播到机械体身上的。

自从那些被指派去与受影响单元协作的子个体失去联系以来，我们收到报告称，这种疾病已经开始将它们重塑成类似于虚铸者的东西。
excerpt.en: A number of Shroud-Forged units on [target_planet.GetName] have contracted a type of biological malady in a Shroud-Touched region on the planet. While our research drones have confirmed the veracity of the reports, we ar

excerpt.zh: 靠近[target_planet.GetName]上虚境化地区的子个体逐渐地被腐坏的环境改变了。它们慢慢脱离了集体，物理特征和处理模式已经和虚铸者无异。
excerpt.en: Over time, drones who moved close to a Shroud-Touched region on [target_planet.GetName] have been changed by the corrupted environment. They have slowly disconnected from the collective, and now present with the physical

excerpt.zh:
用先进的技术，一些老旧退役的子个体已经可以修复，恢复完全的功能。我们现在准备开始大规模的维修作业。

虽然我们可以专注于从集体脱离的单元，但那些不再活动的虚铸者躯壳供给更是丰富。修理虚铸者会有多得多的产出，但它们也会比连接到核心智能的无人机更难控制。
excerpt.en:
By means of upgraded technology, we have been able to repair some of our older drones, restoring decommissioned units to full functionality. We are now ready to initiate large-scale repair operations.

While we could foc

excerpt.zh:

如果你们不允许我们这么做，那要注意我们并不打算放弃我们的新形态。在必要的情况下我们会保卫自己。

在咆哮出他们的抗命之词后，我们的一位[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]夺取了空间站的控制权，并且将其缓缓驶离黑洞。

excerpt.en: After a tense confrontation, the mutineers have been dealt with, and armed personnel have regained full control of §Y[Target.GetName]§!.

excerpt.zh: 在接近黑洞的过程中，时空以出乎意料的方式发生了弯曲，而§Y[Target.GetName]§!的仪器也在艰难运转。经过对船上的仪器进行细致的重校准后，我们才发现这座空间站比我们之前预料的更加接近黑洞。

excerpt.en: §Y[Target.GetName]§!'s proximity to the black hole allowed its [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] to gather a vast amount of data, furthering our understanding of the most fundamental laws of physics.

尽管拆卸抛弃空间站模块的决定为我们争取了更多时间，但是其产生的效果却远远小于我们的预期。这座空间站还是没能达到逃逸速度。

我们已经注定失去这座空间站了。如今我们能做的事只有延缓它终结的到来。
excerpt.en:
§Y[Target.GetName]§! got too close to the black hole, and its thrusters are unable to oppose the increased gravitational pull.

The station is lost. All we can do now is delay the inevitable.

excerpt.zh:
§Y[Target.GetName]§!已经越过了黑洞的事件视界。由于时间膨胀效应，空间站的残影将会在它本身消失很长时间以后仍然留存，在我们的传感器数据上永远刻下它的痕迹。

除非我们迅速切断与空间站内[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]的所有联系，否则对所有已知物理定律崩溃的直接可能会不可挽回地损害我们的集体意识。

§Y[Target.GetName]§! is crossing the black hole's event horizon. Due to the effects of time dilatation, its afterimage will persist long after the station itself is gone, a memory forever etched in our sensor data.

就好像时间本身在屏住呼吸。

由于黑洞扭曲了时空织构，我们意识中的一部分凝固在永远的自由落体中。

我们被囚禁在黑洞中的一部分感知到的一日事实上外部将会过去数个世纪。我们可以利用这点。我们通过切换自身意识，可以通过一个全新的视角分析自己的整个历史，获得新的思维模式。

进这一次，分离使我们强大。从今往后，我们既是自己故事的主角，同时也是读者—
excerpt.en:
Thoughts dilate. Perception slows to a crawl. Every gesture is an infinite sequence of events. We are witnessing infinity - no, bathing in it.
It's as if time itself is holding its breath.

当寂静和阴影笼罩着我们的星球时，奇怪的光芒在天空中绽放，将我们的首都恒星系包围在万华镜般的迷雾中。这两个事件无疑是相关的，但我们的[root
excerpt.en: What our people saw from orbit was §H[capital_scope.GetName]§! shutting down, every light source within the city snuffed out at once. What people on §H[capital_scope.GetName]§! experienced was much worse: vehicles reduce

excerpt.zh: 我们的传感器报告万华镜寄生虫发光图样的幻影出现在了§H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§!恒星系。这个现象的自然机理暂时还不清楚。
excerpt.en: Our sensors report the apparition of kaleidoscopic light patterns in the §H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§! system. The nature of the phenomenon is unclear.

excerpt.zh:
我们在自己的电网系统中找不到任何缺陷。我们的发电机正在产生能量，但是某种存在……某种存在正在吸收它。这可能是我们在天空中能够观察到光图案的结果，这个图案的几何性质透露出一定的智慧痕迹。

这个东西——这个活着的§Y万华镜§!——是一个满怀恶意的存在，还是一团无意识的迷雾？答案尚未明确。
excerpt.en: We can find no defects in our power grid. Our generators are producing energy, but something is... absorbing it. It may be a result of the light patterns witnessed in our skies, the geometric nature of which betray an in

excerpt.zh:
多亏了我们的[owner.GetTechnicianPlural]和[owner.GetScientistPlural]的通力合作，我们设法将能量寄生虫从我们的电力网络中剔除了。我们最漫长的黑夜已经过去，但是§Y万华镜§!寄生虫仍然在我们的头顶上闪耀，渴望能量。

我们无法与它进行交流，常规武器对这类生物无效。我们剩下的选项是给它提供足够的能量以维持其心情满足，或者试图让它挨饿。我们的特工还建议组织一次§Y谍报行动§!，将它引诱到另一个
excerpt.en: Thanks to the coordinated effort of our [owner.GetTechnicianPlural] and [owner.GetScientistPlural], the energy parasite has been cut from our power grid. Our longest night is over, but §Ythe Kaleidoscope§! still shines u

excerpt.zh: 依照我们经过验证和测试的流程，我们将万华镜寄生虫从§H[root.GetName]§!的能量电网中剥离，恢复了首都的供电。
excerpt.en: Following our proven and tested procedures, we detached the Kaleidoscope from §H[root.GetName]§!'s energy grid, restoring power to our capital.

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工通过假扮成技工成功渗透进入了§H[target.GetName]§!的能源区划。他们的下一项任务是安装一个返航信标，诱惑能量寄生虫前来这个行星。
excerpt.en: By posing as technicians, our operatives successfully infiltrated the §H[target.GetName]§!'s energy districts. Their next assignment is to install a homing beacon to lure the energy parasite to the planet.

excerpt.zh:
我们天空中的异光消散了，提前宣告了我们的特工之后汇报的事情：他们激活了能量信标，将§Y万华镜§!寄生虫引走了！

现在就让§H[target.GetName]§!去处理这麻烦吧。
excerpt.en:
The lights have faded from our skies, first announcing what our intelligence operatives later confirmed: our operators activated the energy beacon, luring §Ythe Kaleidoscope§! away!

Let the §H[target.GetName]§! deal wit

excerpt.zh: 依据我们的谍报信息，§H[kaleidoscope_new_owner.GetName]§!，目前正遭遭受到能源短缺的困扰。我们送他们的§Y万华镜§!似乎正是这一经济困境的主要起因。
excerpt.en: According to our espionage reports, §H[kaleidoscope_new_owner.GetName]§!, is currently suffering from an energy shortage. The §YKaleidoscope§! we gifted them seems to be the main cause of their economic troubles.

excerpt.zh: 一只饥肠辘辘的万华镜寄生虫将双齿深深扎进了§H[event_target:infested_planet.GetName]§!的能量电网中。随之而来的全殖民地范围的大停电颇为剧烈，但与此前的攻击并不相似。我们已经知道怎么对付这东西了。
excerpt.en: A starved Kaleidoscope has sunk its metaphorical teeth into §H[event_target:infested_planet.GetName]§!'s energy grid. The ensuing colony-wide blackout was dramatic, but not dissimilar from previous attacks. We know how t

excerpt.zh: 一只贪婪的万华镜正试图强行连接到我们在§H[target.GetName]§!上的§Y能量中枢§!。这提供了一个研究这只生物独特能力的绝佳机会，但我们预计这座建筑将因此受到严重破坏。
excerpt.en: A ravenous Kaleidoscope is trying to forcibly connect itself to one our §YEnergy Nexus§! on §H[target.GetName]§!. This presents a remarkable opportunity to study the being's unique abilities, but we expect the building w

excerpt.zh: 万华镜焦躁地颤动着，让我们的天空充满了不和谐、不均匀的光线。我们的人不禁觉得这种景象令人不安。
excerpt.en: The Kaleidoscope trembles nervously, filling our skies with jarring, uneven patterns of light. Our people can't help but find the spectacle unnerving.

excerpt.zh: 万华镜犹如一道敞开的窗口，让我们的天空充满了不祥而病态的图案。我们的祭祀认为这是凶兆。也许明智的做法是牺牲一些能量给这个生物，消除它的饥饿，平息我们人民的恐惧。
excerpt.en: The Kaleidoscope throbs like an open wound, filling our skies with ominous, sickly patterns. Our priests believe it an ill omen. It may be wise to sacrifice some energy to the creature, to quench its hunger and appease o

excerpt.zh: 万华镜号渴求能量，它学会了如何从我们的舰队中吸取能量。尽管能量消耗很小，但对我们的航速有明显的影响。
excerpt.en: Hungry for energy, the Kaleidoscope has learned how to siphon energy from our fleet. The power drain is minimal, but is having a detectable impact on our ships' speed.

excerpt.zh:
开心的万华镜让[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的天空中涂满了令人愉悦的图形，一个个分型互相流变，带来了一波波变化万千的奇观。

整颗星球仿佛静止了。人们驻足欣赏，为之惊叹。
excerpt.en:
A happy Kaleidoscope fills [owner.capital_scope.GetName]'s skies with pleasing shapes, fractals melting into other fractals in ever-changing waves of wonder.

The planet stops. Admires. Breathes.

excerpt.zh: 万华镜不断变化的图案会不会是一种沟通的方式？或者这只是一种类似呼吸一般的自发流程？我们的[root.GetScientistPlural]尚未找到答案。万华镜也正在为我们带来不可估量的研究数据。
excerpt.en: Could the shifting patterns of the Kaleidoscope be a form of communication? Or are they an autonomous process, more akin to breathing? Our [root.GetScientistPlural] still don't have an answer. The Kaleidoscope is providi

excerpt.zh:
在在最后一阵红色的起伏图案爆发之后，万华镜消失了，它的彩色卷须像雾一样消散了。

在它的光芒下度过了这么长时间后，我们的天空看起来空落落的。
excerpt.en:
After a final burst of red, undulating patterns, the Kaleidoscope faded away, its colorful tendrils dissipating like mist.

After so much time spent beneath its lights, our skies look almost empty.

excerpt.zh: 传感器回报我们在[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系探测到的万华镜图案已经消退了。
excerpt.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern we detected in the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system has faded away.

excerpt.zh:
我们有幸得出体验星系最壮观的灯光秀：万华镜的花瓣往复折叠、盛开、绽放！然而，我们的仪器则带来了一则不那么令人高兴的消息。

这种能量生物变得如此充满力量，它甚至像一颗垂死的恒星一样发生了坍缩。在它的废墟中，我们的探测器发现了一个外形非常类似花朵的晶体团簇。根据初步研究，这种“花”可以放大最微弱的光线，在这个过程中打破了一些已知的物理定律。我们的[root.owner.GetScientistPlural]推测，这种花不过是一座光线可以被
excerpt.en:
We have been blessed to experience the galaxy's most splendid light show: kaleidoscopic petals folding into themselves; blooming; exploding! However, our instruments tell a less triumphant story.

The energy being became

excerpt.zh: 传感器报告§H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§!恒星系中万华镜的图案发生了剧烈的绽放，并在五彩斑斓的爆炸中消失了。那场面一定相当壮观。
excerpt.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern in the §H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§! system just bloomed, disappearing in a final burst of colorful patterns. Must have been quite the spectacle.

excerpt.zh:
万华镜自我折叠的一瞬，它看起来就像一朵最精致的水晶花。然而，随之而来的爆炸一点也不温和：一股灼热的爆炸席卷了整个星系，我们所有的电子设备都发生了过载，烧焦了能源电网。

维修工作已经在进行中，但我们还需要一段时间才能适应这片空旷的天空。
excerpt.en: When the Kaleidoscope folded into itself, just for a second, it looked like the most delicate crystalline flower. However, the ensuing explosion was anything but gentle: a coruscating boom that scorched the system and ov

excerpt.zh: 传感器报告在§H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§!恒星系的万华镜图案爆炸了，释放了一道能量冲击波损坏了星系中所有的设施。
excerpt.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern in the §H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§! system just exploded, releasing an energy shockwave that doubtlessly damaged every structure in the system.

excerpt.zh: 万华镜寄生虫事实证明是一个异常好相处的邻居，但是要让它持续保持满足的心态不是一件容易的事情。建一个戴森球能不能满足它对能量的那种无底洞般的胃口呢？
excerpt.en: The Kaleidoscope has proven to be a strangely amiable neighbor, but keeping it sated has proven to be a challenge. Would a Dyson Sphere quench its endless thirst for energy?

excerpt.zh:
万华镜寄生虫盘附在了我们提供的改版戴森球上，吞食着一整个恒星的能量，其不断延展的、色彩缤纷的花瓣包覆了整个恒星系。根据我们的数据，这个噬能生命体现在处于一种恒定的、可控的超载状态，在一个类似于死亡和重生的无尽循环中，不断地长出新芽，再不断地爆裂。

我们不知道这个生命体是否有思考能力，但我们希望它的存在本身现在和它产生的光图案一样令人愉快。
excerpt.en: The Kaleidoscope has latched onto the modified Dyson Sphere we provided, consuming the energy of a star and extending its colorful petals to encompass the whole system. According to our data, the energy being is now in a

excerpt.zh:
这一天终于来临。我们的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]已经就位，准备为我们对§Y[This.GetTrophyName]§!进行全面的探索。随着研究的开始，我们将一小部分意识集中在§Y[Target.GetName]§!上，以消化吸收对异常项目的研究。然而，让我们将残余物拖到[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]以后发现，结果并不如我们希望的那么有趣。

就在这项进程开始之后不久，我们决定将研究转移到位于[
excerpt.en: The day has arrived. Our [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] were in place and ready to give us a thorough exploration of the §Y[This.GetTrophyName]§!. As the study, began a small portion of our consciousness focused on §Y[Target.

excerpt.zh:
今天，§Y[Target.GetName]§!首都的人群们迎来了阴沉的一天。游行的队伍携带着我们摧毁§Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§!的证明，漫步经过叽叽喳喳的围观者。这一过程在全帝国范围内广播，但反响极低，[This.GetTrophyName]似乎没有我们预想的那么令人感兴趣。

在完成了环球展览之后，[This.GetTrophyName]被放在了首都中心进行特展，以激励我们以及子孙后代。
excerpt.en: An overcast day greeted the middling crowd on §Y[Target.GetName]'s§! capital city today. The procession carrying our proof of the destruction of the §Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§! ambled past the meandering onlookers.

excerpt.zh: 为了准备那个重要的日子，我们将一颗§Y以太巨龙的獠牙§!转运到§Y[Target.GetName]§!。把它们塞进货运飞船是一项极富挑战的工作，以太巨龙独特的生理构造似乎违背了物理法则。在进入[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]大气层时，獠牙对飞船发生了极其奇怪的反应：它在众目睽睽之下开始瓦解，要不是飞船快速应对，我们可能就会失去这一宝贵的物品。
excerpt.en: In preparation for the big day, we have transferred one of the §YEther Drake's Fangs§! to §Y[Target.GetName]§!. Getting them into the transport ship was a challenge, as the Ether Drake's unique biology does not seem to f

excerpt.zh:
摘取§Y裂爪龙之眼§!是一项混乱不堪的工程，开始阶段错误百出。幸运的是，这只巨兽有许多只眼睛让我们逐一试错。我们将这只眼睛拖到了[Target.Solar_System.GetName]以后发生一件又奇妙又恶心的事情：这只眼睛迅速地黏住了当地的传感阵列，并将自己牢牢地嵌在上面，俯视着§Y[Target.GetName]§!。事件的起因还在调查当中，但需要重申，这只巨龙的许多生理学知识仍是我们未知的。

眼睛还没有和恒星基地完全融为一体，
excerpt.en: The extraction of the §YShard's Eye§! was a messy process with a few false starts. Luckily, the behemoth had a lot of eyes for us to practice on. We then towed the optic to [Target.Solar_System.GetName], and something bo

excerpt.zh:
§Y无畏战舰反应堆§!在运抵§Y[Target.GetName]§!之前一直是一个超级乖乖的货物，抵达后我们将其安置在一处仓库内以待那一天的到来。这下问题就来了：在无人照看的情况下，这台反应堆突然自己重启了。反应堆迸射出巨大的等离子电弧，整座仓库由内而外发出耀眼的光，整座建筑似乎很快就要被熔化了。

我们[Owner.GetScientistPlural]反应迅速，力挽狂澜，于是现在我们就有了一台运转中的反应堆了。
excerpt.en: The §YDreadnought's Reactor§! was a very well-behaved cargo until it arrived at §Y[Target.GetName]§!, where we placed it in a warehouse awaiting its big day. It was there the troubles began: while no one was looking, the

excerpt.zh: 即便我们预警了外星污染的危险，但还是有东西搞砸了。§Y族母的鞭毛§!运入§Y[Target.GetName]§!首都时，它以某种方式接触了其中一个管运者，然后几乎是瞬间，它就发生了变化。这件战利品上长出了脉动的附肢，变成了一团搅动的肉质。慢慢地它逐渐细化，然后竟然长成了那个被接触的管运者的模样！似乎是族母的再生能力接纳了我们物种的基因，并开始产出更多的[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
excerpt.en: Even with our xeno-contamination precautions, something went wrong. As the §YMatriarch's Flagella§! entered §Y[Target.GetName]'s§! capital, it somehow got in contact with one of the handlers, and instantly, the flagella

excerpt.zh: 将§Y天空龙羽翼§!带回家的时候，我们的货运飞船发现他们经过的超空间航道发生了二次扭曲。期限认为只是普通的异常现象而忽视了，直到飞船进入§Y[Target.Solar_System.GetName]§!时才发现，有一团追逐着飞船的实体导致了超空间航道膨胀：一窝龙的幼崽热切追逐着我们的货运飞船，从中鱼贯而出进入我们的星系。他们应该是躲藏在跳跃点附近跟随者我们出来航道的。这些小龙似乎没有它们亲代的智力，而是漫无目的地跟随着我们——确切地说是
excerpt.en: While carrying home the §YSky Dragon's Plume§!, our transportation ship noticed that the hyperlane they traveled through had a second distortion beyond their ship. Initially disregarding this as just an anomaly, it was n

excerpt.zh: 今天早晨，在§Y[Target.GetName]§!上有个惊喜等着我们，§Y拾荒机器人压缩机§!在我们的储存设施里吐出了最后一块它的作品。这一大块合金比我们所能想象所能产出的最致密的合金还要紧实，仅需数立方米就可以建造出一整艘战列舰。这一喜出望外的发展让我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信他们有希望让压缩机以§G0.001%§!的功率重新运作。
excerpt.en: This morning, a surprise awaited us on §Y[Target.GetName]§! as the §YScavenger Bot's Compactor§! deposited the last of its creations in our storage facility. The large chunk of alloys was denser and more compact than any

excerpt.zh:
§Y星际幽魂散发器囊§!这发出的斑驳光芒看起来格外引人注目，以至于让人差点没发现这个幽魂用来产生护盾的囊发生了泄露。在快速确认里面的化学物质不会导致§Y[Target.GetName]§!生态系统崩溃之后，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]专注于分析这些气体对我们大气的影响。

似乎这些泄露的化学物质已经混入了我们大气的中间层，正在高效地散发其中凝聚的能量。如果我们继续散发其中的物质，它甚至可以有效地提高我们行星
excerpt.en: The strobing lights of the §YStellar Wraith's Disperser Sack§! were distracting to look upon, so distracting that it took a while to detect that the sack the Wraith used to generate its natural shield was leaking. After

excerpt.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural]向[Target.Solar_System.GetName]汇报了运输§Y恐怖负相物质§!的货运飞船上的奇怪的现象。我们被包括通向纯粹苦痛与毁灭低语的世界窗口之类的恼人的幻想所袭扰。据信原因就是[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]的团块，我们有理由担忧如果将船上的这玩意带到§Y[Target.GetName]§!到底会发生什么。
excerpt.en: Our [Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural] have been reporting strange activity on the ship transporting the §YHorrific Inverse Mass§! to [Target.Solar_System.GetName]. Windows into worlds of pure pain and whispers of destruction a

excerpt.zh: 此前的传言一语成谶了：§Y[This.GetName]§!上的§Y恐怖负相物质§!正在我们的现实上撕开裂口，打开通向另一个世界裂隙。这一现象突破了抑制措施，开始在[This.GetName]上蔓延。所有与这一维度接触的事物，哪怕是不经意地透过观测设备查看，都让进行观察的[Owner.GetTeamMember]感受到剧烈的痛苦。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]担忧事态还可能进一步扩大，但同时保证只要再花一点时间
excerpt.en: What was only rumors before has now been confirmed: the §YHorrific Inverse Mass§! on §Y[This.GetName]§! has been tearing holes in our very reality, opening rifts into another world. The phenomenon has breached the contai

excerpt.zh: 可能我们狂妄自大过了头。尽管在§Y[This.GetName]§!上的§Y恐怖负相物质§!仍封存良好，但整颗行星还是在被它从内而外逐渐撕碎。虽然我们在研究其他维度时获得的科学突破是革命性的，但它对行星的负担同样不可承受。尽管几乎没有[Owner.GetScientistPlural]有信心能控制住反应，但这并不是完全没有机会！在[This.GetName]的居民正在逐渐登船离开[This.GetPlanetHabitat]时，无数的空间
excerpt.en: Perhaps our hubris was too great. §Y[This.GetName]§! is being ripped apart from the inside as the §YHorrific Inverse Mass§! is still sequestered on it. While the breakthroughs we have had in the sciences from studying th

excerpt.zh: 晴空永远消失了，它不是被乌云荫蔽，而是被纯粹的虚空所笼罩。§Y[This.GetName]§!所残存的只有漂浮在虚无之海的陆地碎片。所有来不及逃离[This.GetPlanetHabitat]的人在其上的每一刻都在承受着无上的痛苦。我们为专家们争取到了尽可能多的时间。一个扭曲而恼人的声音回响在行星的上空：§R“对寸——回—回归于我——吧。”§!
excerpt.en: The sky is gone. It's not covered by clouds. It has been replaced by a pure void. All that remains of §Y[This.GetName]§! is patches of ground in the ocean of nothingness. Everyone left on the [This.GetPlanetHabitat] is s

excerpt.zh: 在击败了神秘堡垒之后，它的一个舱段漂浮在太空中，我们决定将其带回[Target.Solar_System.GetName]，成为我们[Owner.GetParadeStudy]的一部分。一些[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在进入§Y神秘堡垒舱室§!深处后都失踪了。自它运抵§Y[Target.GetName]§!时，我们每天都派出[Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural]进入探索，但今天早些时候它内部的
excerpt.en: After defeating the Enigmatic Fortress, a section of it was floating in space, so we decided to bring it to [Target.Solar_System.GetName] to be a part of our [Owner.GetParadeStudy]. Several [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] h

excerpt.zh: §Y虚空孳孽毒腺§!中的污染物发生了严重泄露！这些毁灭性的毒液已经污染了我们§Y[Target.GetName]§!的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]资源，迫使我们从其他的星球运输[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]来缓解这场自作自受的大干旱。这种演化出来用以杀死硕大无朋的巨型太空兽群、溶穿厚重装甲板的毒液对任何不慎摄入的[Owner.GetSpeciesName]来说都剧毒无比。我们现在得研
excerpt.en: The containment for the §YVoidspawn's Venom Gland§! has sprung a leak! The devastating venom has now poisoned our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply on §Y[Target.GetName]§!, forcing us to ferry [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLow

excerpt.zh: 在几个月的努力后，我们在§Y[Target.GetName]§!上的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]资源终于移除了虚空孳孽污染变得清洁可用。这并不是徒劳一场，反之，我们在[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]中学到了许多异星生理学的基本知识，并且已经准备好继续进行[Owner.GetParadeStudy]。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为，只要[Owner.Get
excerpt.en: After many months of effort, our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply on §Y[Target.GetName]§! is finally clear of the Voidspawn Contaminant. It was not a wasted effort, as we have learned much from the xeno-biology presen

excerpt.zh: 我们遗留在噬星者最终被击杀的地方的探测器汇报，那具遗骸的一部分开始和恒星融为一体。释放的能量增进了恒星活动，但我们的计算表明，由于移除了§Y卵鞘§!，这仍不足以让§Y[dead_stellarite.solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系恢复原有的光明。如果我们让货运飞船返回，我们有希望可以重新点亮这颗恒星。
excerpt.en: The observation probes we had left behind at the site of the Stellar Devourer's final demise report that portions of the body have started to merge back into the star. The energy seems to have increased stellar activity,

excerpt.zh:
[Target.GetAdj]双星系统的光芒照耀着我们的货运飞船驶入[Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName]。

他们的货物，数以百万计的微型噬星者，在绝对零度下储存，以确保它们稳定而惰性，直到将他们送到恒星系的主恒星。货运飞船需要继续保持静默飞行一段时间，以便进一步渗透[Target.GetSpeciesAdj]首都。
excerpt.en:
The light of the [Target.GetAdj] twin stars shone down on our transport ship as it entered the [Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName] system.

Their cargo - millions of tiny Stellar Devourers - is stored at absolute

excerpt.zh: 运载噬星者的货运飞船已经通过了恒星系的安全检查，其中使用的密码是此前由间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]所捕获的，这对顺利通行至关重要。我们的操作员已经开始将这些噬星者宝宝重新解冻以恢复其活动。货运飞船将再次瞄准恒星系的首要恒星，作为这次旅途的终点。
excerpt.en: Our Stellar Devourer transport has cleared the system's security check - the security codes that Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has been gathering were crucial for passing into the system. Our operatives have star

records.zh: 离开货运飞船，进入燃烧的等离子体
records.en: Out of the Transport Ship, Into the Burning Plasma

excerpt.zh:
我们已经收到来自间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]的密电：一切就绪。我们的操作员已经开始弃船操作，只保留下核心船员。一旦舰船加速到最大的亚光速航速，他们也会在飞船撞击这个星系的首要恒星之前脱离，以确保我们不留下任何蛛丝马迹。

噬星者宝宝们已经开始躁动不安。如果我们再不快点执行操作，它们可能都要开始打起飞船燃料的主意了。
excerpt.en: We have received word back from Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName]: everything is ready. Our operatives have already started abandoning the transport ship, leaving only a skeleton crew behind. Once the ship hits its m

excerpt.zh:
我们干预行动的最后证据很快在恒星的日冕层熔化了。我们的传感器在撞击后的一瞬间焚毁，但这足以证明我们已经成功地感染了§Y[From.target.capital_star.GetName]§!。

我们已经为这个恒星系写下了残酷而寒冷的终章。
excerpt.en: The last proof of our tampering quickly melted inside the star's corona. Our sensors burned up moments after impact, but that was enough to confirm that we had successfully infested §Y[From.target.capital_star.GetName]§!

excerpt.zh:
我们的[capital_star.GetName]遭遇了一场异常的恒星活动低谷期。由于温度的降低，恒星黑子以史无前例的数量大量出现，让恒星的辐射发生了非常明显的衰弱。

[capital_scope.GetName]上的居民已经开始囤积核热毯，减少外出。希望我们能尽早回到温暖的日子。
excerpt.en: We are experiencing an unusually inactive solar cycle from [capital_star.GetName]. Sunspots have appeared in unprecedented numbers because of the reduced temperature of our star, leading to a noticeable decrease in solar

excerpt.zh: §Y[capital_star.GetName]§!内部的聚变反应持续低迷的时长前所未见。由于其辐照能量的骤减，[capital_scope.GetName]上已经发生了多种生态灾害，如果继续下去，我们可能将面临冰河时期。所有的空间站和定居点都遭遇到了相似的情况。我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]确信一定有什么蹊跷，希望能研究[capital_star.GetName]。
excerpt.en: The fusion chain reaction inside of §Y[capital_star.GetName]§! has now been on a steady downturn for an unprecedented amount of time. There are active ecological disasters on [capital_scope.GetName] due to the lowered ra

excerpt.zh: §R[capital_star.GetName]被微型噬星者感染了！§!我们不明白这些星神兽幼体到底是怎么跑到我们的恒星上的，明明它们不具有任何超光速能力。我们可以在未来对其进行研究，但当下我们最要紧的是研究如何停止它们的寄生，否则我们的整个首都就要被彻底冻死了。
excerpt.en: §R[capital_star.GetName] is infested with tiny Stellar Devourers!§! We have no clue how these neonate leviathans have managed to get to our star as they don't seem to possess any FTL capabilities. We can uncover all that

excerpt.zh:
今天对[owner.GetName]而言是地狱般的一天，我们的首都恒星§Y[target.GetName]§!熄灭了。尽管有数百万人撤离，但这对于我们遭受的打击来说不过杯水车薪。我们的首都永远地陷入了冰河时期。[target.GetName]则缩水成了一颗褐矮星，这就意味着这个恒星系里任何生命都不再适合生存了。
我们推测这些噬星者很有可能是由§Y[star_infesters.GetName]§!送到我们的恒星上的，现在我们要他们血债血
excerpt.en: Today was a terrible day for the [owner.GetName], as our capital star §Y[target.GetName]§! went out. Despite having evacuated many millions it only slightly softens the blow. Our capital is forever lost to a new and perm

records.en: Contact Report: Simple Forms of Life

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]新闻满天飞，内容都是关于不久前发现的外星生物。

自从在[Root.Capital.GetName]之外发现了造物的奇迹，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]神秘学家们不断举办神秘仪式，试图得到更多的答案。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien organisms discovered some time ago.

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj] theologians have been partaking in arcane rites since this first sign that divine providence extends outside of

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]新闻满天飞，内容都是关于不久前发现的外星生物。

这些生物似乎居住在深空之中。相比之下，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的极端微生物简直不值一提。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien organisms encountered some time ago.

Seemingly native to deep space, they make the extremophile creatures of [Root.Capital.GetName] appear frail by comparison.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]上新闻满天飞，内容都是关于发现的外星生物。

尽管按照[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]标准来说，它们算不上是智慧生物，但它们的存在却否定了我们对生命的简单分类。它们提醒我们，宇宙是如此的复杂，蕴含了无尽的可能。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien life that was found.

While hardly intelligent by [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] standards, the fascinating beings defy easy classification and hint at the immense complexities an

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]上新闻满天飞，内容都是不久前遭遇的外星生物。

这一生命体已经接近智慧生物了，真是令人兴奋不已。但我们也要清楚地认识到，尽管[Root.GetName]才刚刚登上星系的舞台，但这一切已经是相当大的进展。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien beings encountered some time ago.

Their near-intelligence is fascinating, and it is sobering to realize that while the [Root.GetName] may only just have made its entran

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]的人对新近发现外星遗迹的消息议论纷纷。

这些痕迹被视为外星人曾经存在并活跃过的铁证——我们现在虽然是孤独的，但至少我们不是第一个踏上星空的。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien remnants that were recently studied.

These remains are considered definitive proof of intelligent, purposeful alien activity at some point in the past - we may still be

excerpt.zh:
我们的舰队发现[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的消息传遍了[Root.GetName]。

虽然仍未掌握太空旅行的能力，但[primitive_planet.GetName]上的外星人已具有足够的智慧，而且他们的社会也具备了先进文明的所有特征。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization found by our fleets.

They may not be capable of space-flight, but the aliens of the [primitive_planet.GetName] are quantifiably intelligen

records.zh: 接触报告：神秘的太空旅人

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]没过多久便遭遇了外星智慧生命。

舰队发给[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]首都的报告很简单随意地描述了这些生物，还顺口提到了错失跟它们交流的机会。
excerpt.en:
It did not take long for the [Root.GetName] to come across intelligent alien life.

The fleet's report to the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] capital somewhat understates just how alien these forces appear, and only in passing ment

excerpt.zh: 有消息称在太空深处遭遇到了一个无比浩大的构筑，它正在延展贯穿整个[Root.GetName]。虽然它看起来并非是某种生物，不过其存在还是彰显了包含技术和巨型工程的可能性。
excerpt.en: News of the encounter with a deep-space construct of gargantuan proportion is spreading throughout the [Root.GetName]. While the entity does not appear to be of biological nature, its mere existence has inescapable ramif

excerpt.zh:
太空变形虫——这个昵称现在已经传遍了[Root.Capital.GetName]的大街小巷——是一种独居的生物。成年的太空变形虫身边总会伴随着一种被称为鞭毛的半独立生物。鞭毛由变形虫自行生成，并通过分泌液态RNA来进行控制。

我们一度误以为这就是太空变形虫的幼体，但其实这些鞭毛并不含有繁殖器官，每个鞭毛更像是变形虫向外延伸的肢体。这些鞭毛可以在一定范围内离开主体并攻击敌人，但每隔一段时间就需要回返主体内进行重构。

太空变形虫厚皮的再
excerpt.en: The Space Amoebas - the nickname now lovingly popularized on [Root.Capital.GetName] - are solitary animals, when left to their own devices. All but the youngest specimens are accompanied by quasi-independent organisms, d

excerpt.zh:
处于太空变形虫群附近时，停止舰只反应核心的某些特定辐射的排放似乎可以避免将其激怒。

由于这一举措，他们已不再将我们视为威胁，我们也因此得以近距离对其进行观察。
excerpt.en:
Temporarily refraining from venting certain emissions from our vessels' reactor cores while in the immediate vicinity of Space Amoebas flocks seems to be enough to not arouse their ire.

With this new protocol in place t

excerpt.zh:
晶态实体很可能是活的。

或许称它们为“硅酸活体物质”更为恰当，因为它们与常见的生物或是传统人造生命大相径庭。

这些实体似乎并不繁殖，并且我们所观察到的晶体在年龄上似乎都没有什么差别。与一个早期假设相反的是，晶态实体个体所发生的色调转变似乎与其年龄无关，而是受其潜在的内部电荷影响——而且可以被猛烈地释放——而偶尔产生的能源波动会改变晶体的折射特性。
excerpt.en:
The Crystalline Entities are probably alive.

A perhaps more descriptive name for them is "silicate-animate matter," as they have little in common with biological or traditionally artificial life.

The Entities do not se

excerpt.zh: 晶态实体似乎会对特定的频率共振，这也是他们与环境之间少有的互动。发出电波的特性与目的目前尚未明确，但目前我们的舰船可以使用无线电进行模仿，并将自己伪装成晶态实体。
excerpt.en: The Crystalline Entities seem to resonate in response to something; one of their few interactions with their environment. The exact nature and possible wider purpose of this emitted waveform has yet to be ascertained, bu

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]观测到大量晶状生命体的出现。这很明显是某种巢穴——或者至少是晶状生命体的聚集地，就如在[From.GetName]有一个我们从未见过的晶状结构。

这个结构展现出了很多类似晶状生命体的性质，但它的体积大得吓人。
excerpt.en: We see significant crystalline presence in the [From.GetName] system. Evidently some kind of den - or at least a hub of crystalline activity, such as it is - [From.GetName] is home to a crystal construct unlike any previ

excerpt.zh: 我们成功摧毁了[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]的晶态结构。过程比我们想象中更加艰难，并在期间回收了一些碎片供研究之用。这样一来，我们应该就能模仿战斗中遭遇的晶体矩阵展现出的再生特性了。
excerpt.en: We have destroyed the crystalline construct in the [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName] system. It proved hardier than expected, and some shards have been recovered for study. We should be able to emulate the reconstructive p

excerpt.zh:
无人机在其小行星上永无休止地对不断减少的资源进行开采。对其进行研究的过程较为枯燥，但仍具有研究价值。事实上，我们可以学到如何在最大化开采效率的同时减少能源消耗。

另外，我们发现无人机并非完全处于静默。它们会发出脉冲信号，不过频率极低并且波长很难与背景杂讯区分开来。是否有人在接收这些脉冲信号就不得而知了。
excerpt.en: The drones and their tireless, endless work of extracting ever-diminishing resources from their local planetoids make for a somewhat dull, but nevertheless informative subject of study. In fact, we could stand to learn a

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]星系发现了大量的古代采矿无人机。看来这里是一个巨大的采矿与矿石处理中心，甚至可能是整个星系中最后一个类似的存在。
excerpt.en: We have encountered a significant Ancient Mining Drone presence in the [From.GetName] system. It appears to be a major mining and mineral processing hub, perhaps the last of its kind in the galaxy.

records.zh: 已摧毁采矿无人机基地

excerpt.zh: 我们摧毁了采矿无人机基地，并成功取回了其中储存的大部分经过加工的矿产和珍贵的合金。
excerpt.en: We have destroyed the Mining Drone base, and managed to recover most of its stores of processed minerals and precious alloys.

excerpt.zh: 我们已经用勘探器遗珍的强力扫描光束扫描了我们的领土，并且在§H[chosen_planet.GetName]§!上发现了一个以前不为人知的资源储藏！
excerpt.en: We have swept our space with the strong scanning beam of the Surveyor relic, and a previously unknown resource deposit has been identified on §H[chosen_planet.GetName]§!!

excerpt.zh:
虚空之云可能是宇宙中最古老的存在之一。在宇宙中刚开始形成物质之后仅仅数十亿年里，它们似乎就已经出现了，这是年轻宇宙用强大的力量凭空创造出来的产物，它们本可以成为恒星，但却没有。

它们动物般的智慧可能更加难以解释，但答案或许就在维持其形态的强大电磁场中——另一个宇宙诞生之初的产物。只要有足够长的时间，它奇怪的星尘与引力场循环完全有可能会形成类似神经网络或是计算机电路的东西。

而且，这些虚空之云似乎在互相发送脉冲信号，甚至可能是在进行沟
excerpt.en: The Void Clouds may be among the oldest entities in the universe. They seem to have originated just a scant few billion years after matter as we know it first appeared, the tremendous forces of the young cosmos making so

excerpt.zh:
§Y[Root.GetName]§!的地表正在对我们的建设活动表现出前所未有的反应。一种无法甄别的粘稠物质开始从关键设施的地基中渗出。

这种渗出物是一种深红色液体，外观呈胶状，摸起来极具粘性。

我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]迫切希望进一步研究这种排放物。虽然目前它仅仅带来些许不便，但为确保[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的安全，最好还是谨慎行事。
excerpt.en:
The surface of §Y[Root.GetName]§! is exhibiting an unprecedented reaction to our construction efforts. An unidentified viscous substance is beginning to ooze out from the foundations of key installations.

The ooze is so

excerpt.zh:
§Y[Root.GetName]§!报告了关于神秘猩红色粘液的新进展，结果令人不安。

这种物质正变得难以控制，在受影响的区域以更快的速度涌现。

这种粘液并非毫无益处。随着其凝固，其粘合特性变得更加显著，有效地形成了一种天然水泥，对于我们建设工作的进展可以作为有效补充。

然而，令人担忧的是，这种物质几乎无法从任何接触它的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]身上清除。尝试治疗和研究受影响的工人将使我们能够收集更多信息，但
excerpt.en:
§Y[Root.GetName]§! reports troubling developments regarding the strange crimson ooze.

The substance is becoming unmanageable, emerging at a greater rate throughout the afflicted areas.

The ooze is not without its benef

excerpt.zh:
§Y[Root.GetName]§!的建设以异常顺利的速度持续推进，但那种粘稠物质的出现已不再仅限于我们设施的地基部分。

多处地点发现了渗漏的裂缝。最初，只有[Root.GetName]上的非本土物体受到这种物质的影响，但现在它正在无差别地扩散。

该物质现已吞噬了[Root.GetName]表面的大部分区域，并迅速凝结成厚厚的矿物凝结物，将[Root.GetName]包围。

通过代价高昂的反复试验，我们的工程师找到了一种方法来减轻
excerpt.en:
Construction on §Y[Root.GetName]§! has continued at an exceptional pace, but the emergence of the viscous substance is no longer limited to just the foundations of our installations.

Hemorrhaging fissures have been disc

excerpt.zh:
在对§Y[Root.GetName]§!上受影响的工人进行深入研究和治疗后，我们的科学家已成功隔离出问题的根源。

尽管表面上看上去是一种粘稠凝胶状物质，实际上这是一群与星球形成共生关系的寄生微生物。这些寄生虫在[Root.GetName]的地壳下分解有机物，并将其回收转化为新的物质。

[Root.GetName]的开发活动扰乱了它们的自然生命周期，导致它们对我们引入其生态系统的外来物质产生了反应。

我们的科研团队相信，假以时日，我
excerpt.en:
After intense study and treatment of the afflicted workers on §Y[Root.GetName]§!, our scientists have isolated the root cause of the problem.

What initially presented as a viscous gelatinous substance, is in fact a coll

excerpt.zh:
通过广泛的研究，我们的科学家成功对§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的寄生微生物进行了基因定向设计。这种变异旨在使它们将我们的材料识别为对自然生态无害的添加物，从而使我们能够继续建设而不再遇到问题。

在将这些基因改造后的寄生虫引入行星生物圈后，它们已成功融入其中。

此外，通过重新利用微生物原有的分解效应，我们成功利用该物质的粘合特性，提升了行星的生产效率。

excerpt.zh:
我们正在为§Y[Root.GetName]§!上未来的扩张做土地整备时，一座巨大的结构仿佛在一瞬间凭空出现

这座结构释放着极不稳定的能量波，使其形态若隐若现，因此我们在该区域的初步扫描时没有发现这座建筑。

当它显现时，可以看到其密封的外墙装饰着某种难以理解的符号，而我们的记录中没有任何一种语言与之相符。

其功能尚未明确。该建筑目前为止还没有造成任何伤害，但确乎影响了我们的发展工作。
excerpt.en:
As we were preparing land for future expansion on §Y[Root.GetName]§!, a large structure seemingly blinked into existence.

The structure is emitting highly unstable energy waves causing it to intermittently appear and di

excerpt.zh:
我们对§Y[Root.GetName]§!上这座闪烁的建筑进行分析后，确信该物体会以某种方式扭曲光线。

在下方的硅酸盐地幔中发现了异常的地热活动。这种强大的能源为这座茕茕孑立的建筑提供动力，但其能量水平有很大的波动。

即便我对该建筑性质的理解正在逐渐加深，但仍未能进入其中——假设确实的能进去的话。

其密封外墙是由某种不明高反应性物质构成。尝试强制进入建筑只会导致其电磁场进一步失稳。我们可以尝试强制切开通道以进入研究，但不可预测的失
excerpt.en:
Analysis of the shimmering building on §Y[Root.GetName]§! leads us to assume the object is bending or distorting light somehow.

Exceptional geothermal activity has been detected in the silicate mantle below. This potent

excerpt.zh:
尝试以暴力方式进入§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的建筑招致了一场灾难。我们的设备进一步让建筑的能量模式失稳，引发了一系列剧烈的爆炸。如今它只剩下一堆灰烬。

其意外的毁灭进一步招致出人意料的结果。附近的山谷里出现了一座被遗弃已久的外星人定居点废墟。

似乎这个物体以某种方式在前殖民地投射了一个强大的隐形场；至于是为了躲避什么仍然是个谜，但可以肯定，不管他们做过何种努力，如今都已是死寂一片。没有一件有考古价值的东西完好无损。
