excerpt.en: Ever since the awakening of the §H[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]§! and their ancient §H[From.GetSpeciesName]§! rivals, the two giants have been at odds, skirmishing and jockeying for influence, probing each others' might.

records.en: The End of the War in Heaven

excerpt.zh:
在经历漫长而残酷的争斗后，§H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]§!帝国最终在这场决定星系霸权的战争中昂首胜出。落败的先祖文明已被宿敌完全吞并，现在§H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName]§!睥睨星河，主宰地位无可撼动。

目前星系中维系着脆弱的和平，但这种新的秩序能持续多久呢？
excerpt.en: After a long and fierce conflict, the §H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]§! have emerged victorious in the struggle for control over the galaxy. The defeated ancient empire has been fully annexed by their old rival, and the §H[

records.en: The End of the War in Heaven

excerpt.zh:
在经历漫长而残酷的争斗后，天堂之战以双方僵持不下的局面而告终。§H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]§!与§H[WarInHeavenFETwo.GetName]§!已经签署了停火协议，将舰队撤回了各自边境。

目前星系中维系着脆弱的和平，但这次休战能持续多久呢？
excerpt.en: After a long and fierce conflict, the War in Heaven has ended with neither side able to achieve dominance over the other. The §H[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]§! and §H[WarInHeavenFETwo.GetName]§! have signed a ceasefire and

excerpt.zh: 自从§H[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]§!以及他们的宿敌§H[From.GetSpeciesName]§!觉醒以来，这两个巨人总会偶尔爆发小规模冲突，或者相互施展诡谋以争夺影响力，希望借此试探对方的实力。这样的行为导致了一系列逐渐升温的对峙，最终演变成在某个遥远的星系一支[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]舰队和他们的[From.GetSpeciesName]对手爆发了公开的交火。这一冲
excerpt.en: Ever since the awakening of the §H[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]§! and their ancient §H[From.GetSpeciesName]§! rivals, the two giants have been at odds, skirmishing and jockeying for influence, probing each others' might.

excerpt.zh: 确认
excerpt.en: OK

excerpt.zh: 先祖帝国间的战争以一方被击败而结束，但这并不是他们的宿敌所为。也许是大战消耗了他们的实力，亦或是单纯因为年轻种族们的实力，古老的帝国最终毁灭于他们眼中的弱小种族，这完全改变了局势。现在的问题是，§H[RemainingAwakened.GetName]§!能否避免踏上他们宿敌的后尘？还是说这标志着星系迎来了新的纪元？
excerpt.en: The war between the ancients has ended with the destruction of one of the combatants - but not at the hands of their old rival. Whether it was due to the war weakening them or simply due to the strength of the younger ra

excerpt.zh: 确认
excerpt.en: OK

excerpt.zh: 在先祖帝国之间的兵燹之中，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有一些物种和我们一样，保持了中立的姿态，但如果战事蔓延到我们的领地，我们就只能独自面对来自先祖帝国的威胁。我们已经收到了其他帝国的通讯，他们决定建立一个§H不结盟组织§!，明确挑起反抗战争双方的大旗。由于我们的军事实力与影响力，他们决定邀请我们成为这支联盟势力的盟主。我们一旦接受，就几乎确定会同时跟两大觉醒的帝国开战，但至少我们还有盟友支援，不用独自面对两大先祖帝国的威胁。
excerpt.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the wa

excerpt.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!正式申请加入§H不结盟组织§!。
excerpt.en: The §H[From.GetName]§! have formally requested to join the §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§!.

excerpt.zh: 很快，先祖帝国就意识到了§H不结盟组织§!的存在。双方都派出了代表前往[Root.Capital.GetName]，要求解散联盟，并要求所有成员在这场战争中选边站队。我们自然是拒绝了，而今早，§H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§!与§H[SecondSleeper.GetName]§!都发布了与我们开战的公告。
excerpt.en: It did not take long for the ancients to take notice of the §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§!. Representatives from both warring powers have come to [Root.Capital.GetName] demanding the dissolution of the league, and for

excerpt.zh: 确认
excerpt.en: OK

excerpt.zh: 在经历漫长而残酷的冲突后，这场因两个先祖帝国间的摩擦而起的战争以它们的双双覆灭告终。曾经拥有强大古代科技且自负高傲的巨人们沦为了历史尘埃，星系迎来了崭新的黎明，新兴物种将书写他们自己的命运。
excerpt.en: After a long and fierce conflict, the war that begun as a battle between two ancient empires has ended in the destruction of both. For all their ancient technological might, the arrogance and inflexibility of these ancie

excerpt.zh: 在先祖帝国之间的大战之中，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有一些物种和我们一样，保持了中立的姿态，但如果战事蔓延到我们的领地，我们就只能独自面对来自先祖帝国的威胁。在§H[From.GetName]§!的领导下，§H不结盟组织§!成立了，其目标是对抗挑起战火的先驱者帝国，加入这个联盟就意味着要和战争双方觉醒的失落帝国同时开战，但至少加入这个联盟的中立者们不用再孤军奋战了。
excerpt.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the wa

excerpt.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!已经批准我们加入§H不结盟组织§!，现在我们将和其他中立者一起抵抗这些先祖帝国的威胁。
excerpt.en: We have been accepted into the §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§! by the §H[From.GetName]§!, and now we will stand together against the menace of the elder empires.

excerpt.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!拒绝了我们加入§H不结盟组织§!的请求，现在我们只能独自抵抗先祖帝国的威胁了。
excerpt.en: Our request to join the §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§! was refused by the §H[From.GetName]§!, and now we will have to stand alone against the menace of the elder empires.

excerpt.zh: 在先祖帝国之间的战争中，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了其中一方。比如我们就保持了中立，但这意味着我们要独自面对觉醒帝国的威胁。以在战争中抵抗各边势力为目标，§H不结盟组织§!在§H[From.GetName]§!的领导下成立了。
excerpt.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the awakened menace alone if the

excerpt.zh: 显然，[From.Planet.GetName]曾是一个高度发达的文明的家园。该星球等距环绕着的六颗卫星就足以证明这一点。但是行星目前已经化作一片废墟，整个恒星系都有着各种各样争斗的痕迹。这里到底发生了什么？
excerpt.en: [From.Planet.GetName] was clearly once home to a highly-advanced civilization; its six moons with orbits at equidistant intervals are evidence enough of that. However, the planet is in ruins and the entire star system sh

excerpt.zh: 我们找到了一艘设计独特的古代太空舰船的残骸。它使用的推进方式与现代舰船并不相同，而是依赖于在真空中展开的巨大的帆来进行。也许这艘船可以捕获恒星能量，并在星光和恒星风的推动下前进。我们的考古学家迫切希望揭开隐藏在这艘古老舰船中的秘密。
excerpt.en: We have found the wreckage of an archaic spaceship of unusual design. Instead of using propulsion similar to that of modern ships, the craft relied on large sails unfurled in the vacuum of space. Presumably, the ship har

excerpt.zh:
我们在星球各地都发现了水的迹象。据我们所知，这些水应该还在这颗星球上。星球温度在液态水存在的正常范围内，并且星球仍然存在大气，尽管很脆弱。然而，这里的一切都是干燥的，存在的植被也枯死了。

此外，扫描还揭示了行星上另一个星际文明的踪迹。考古团队将有两个目标：找出水发生了什么，并了解其他星际旅者在这里做了什么。大多数假设已经将两者联系起来，团队中的一些人认为这可能是“偷水贼”干的。
excerpt.en: We have found signs of water all over this world. For all we know, it should still be here. The temperatures are within the normal range for liquid water to exist, and there is still an atmosphere, albeit tenuous. And ye

excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系中孤零零的这颗行星上住满了无人机。它们对我们毫不关心，各自匆匆忙忙做着自己的事情。如果关于这个奇怪的星系有什么线索的话一定能在那里找到。
excerpt.en: The sole planet in the [From.Planet.System.GetName] system is bustling with drones. Heedless of us, they continue to perform their tasks. If the answers to this curious system are to be found anywhere, it is here.

excerpt.zh:
我们的科学家在[From.Planet.GetName]发现了一些奇怪的东西。作为一颗热带星球，其表面大片区域被茂密的丛林覆盖：巨大的、寿达千年的古树从林冠中突兀而起，它们枝叶茂密的树冠俯瞰着其他陆上景观。

初看起来，这些参天大树的分布似乎杂乱无章。然而，更详细的分析表明这些树的分布具有数学精准性，也许是由某个消失已久的文明所种植的。不仅如此，团队领袖相信，树木的分布方式可能包含着一组坐标，指向丛林深处某个未被探索的区域。
excerpt.en: Our scientists have discovered something unusual on [From.Planet.GetName]. A tropical world, much of the planet's surface is covered with dense jungle: massive, thousand year old trees erupt from the canopy, their leafy

excerpt.zh: 整个[From.Planet.GetName]的地表遍布死亡缇扬奇的遗骸。我们的传感器没有检测到生命的信号，然而这些尸体仍然在不停地蠕动，仿佛有什么看不见的力在驱动这些尸体一样。
excerpt.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is entirely covered in the remains of dead Tiyanki. Our sensors detect no signs of life, and yet the corpses still writhe and squirm, as if animated by some inscrutable force.

excerpt.zh: [from.planet.GetName]上辽阔的冰冻荒原曾一度遍布汪洋，水面之下处处是深海火山峡谷。尽管其环境已经无法继续支持生命，我们还是在一处靠近地表的冰封堑道内发现了一些年代久远的水下定居点。
excerpt.en: The vast, frozen wastelands of [from.planet.GetName] were once seas, spread atop an abundance of deep volcanic canyons. Though the environment is no longer capable of supporting life, we have detected the ruins of ancien

excerpt.zh: [from.planet.GetName]乍一看是一颗普通的宜居行星，但我们的研究团队详细调查后发现了许多大型的化石矿藏，而且保存状况相当良好。有趣的是，一些大型的化石群在同一地层中包含许多物种，这表明要么它们是在同一时间死去，要么就是被人刻意这样安置的。对这些遗骸的检测让我们有机会进一步了解这颗行星上生活的物种的进化轨迹。
excerpt.en: [from.planet.GetName] appears to be a standard habitable planet, but on closer inspection, our research team has spotted large deposits of fossils in seemingly well-preserved conditions. Interestingly, larger clusters co

excerpt.zh: 我们对[From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系的扫描显示，它的小行星带是一种非同寻常的类型。与通常组成这类结构的岩石、冰块加太空垃圾的大杂烩不同，它看起来像是许多大型的人造居住站所形成的残骸。这显然是在过去几千年内的某个时间被难以想象的暴力所摧毁的。这片残骸场中必然潜藏着许多不为人知的秘密，但由于体量巨大，进行测绘就需要花费挺长的时间。
excerpt.en: Our scans of the [From.Planet.System.GetName] system show that its asteroid belt is of an unusual variety. Instead of the standard mix of rocks, ice and space rubble that usually make up such formations, it seems to be t

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上发现了一座古城的废墟。通过它的大小和规模发现它很可能是一个星际文明的首都或主要空间居住地。

为了了解这座废墟的起源，我们需要全面挖掘。
excerpt.en:
We've discovered the ruins of an ancient city on [From.Planet.GetName]. Given its size and scale, this was likely the capital or central administrative hub of a major space-faring civilization.

A full excavation will be

excerpt.zh: 一个未知文明所建立的古老殖民地。尽管没有任何灾难迹象，但很显然这些定居者们突然之间就放弃了这个居住地。这儿到底发生了什么呢？
excerpt.en: An ancient colony from an unknown civilization. Despite no obvious sings of calamity, the settlement was clearly abruptly abandoned by its denizens. What happened here?

excerpt.zh: 在被遗弃的泽珞族殖民地中获得的坐标把我们带到了这里。我们需要再次展开探险，调查这颗初看平淡无奇的星球。
excerpt.en: The coordinates provided in abandoned Zroni colony directed us here. We will need to deploy another expedition to explore this seemingly ordinary world.

excerpt.zh: 我们之前调查的尽是些被遗弃的殖民地，但依据上一个发掘遗址的指引，[From.Planet.GetName]好像有着一座遗弃的神庙。那个地方为什么对这群人而言具有重要的精神意义呢？
excerpt.en: Previously we have only explored abandoned colonies, but according to the last dig site, [From.Planet.GetName] houses an abandoned shrine. Why would that place be of spiritual significance to this people?

excerpt.zh: 从那座泽珞族神庙中我们发现了一个科研复合体的坐标。在轨扫描无法找到任何记忆水晶的共振信号，我们需要下到地表进行进一步研究。
excerpt.en: With the revelations from the Zroni's temple we have obtained the coordinates of a scientific complex. Orbital scans could not detect any resonance from their Memory Crystal, we will need to go down to the surface to lea

excerpt.zh: 之前探索过的所有泽珞族星球，在考古学的重要性上都比不过[From.Planet.GetName]。这颗[From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon]的一些建筑即使从太空上俯瞰都肉眼可见。[From.GetName]一定曾是泽珞帝国的中央星球。
excerpt.en: The archeological significance of all the previously explored Zroni worlds pales in comparison to [From.Planet.GetName]. This [From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon] houses structures visible from space. [From.GetName] must have bee

excerpt.zh: 泽珞星可以说是一个灵能活动的漩涡。在我们尝试派遣一个离队小组到地表之前，我们需要对过去用来探测记忆水晶的工具进行重新校准。
excerpt.en: Zron is a maelstrom of psionic activity. The tools we have used to detect Memory Crystals in the past will need to be recalibrated before we can even attempt sending an away team to the surface.

excerpt.zh:
这些遗迹被认为是古代行政建筑群，它们属于一个自称为§Y古茹努尔§!的太空物种，该物种是在[From.Planet.GetName]上被发现的。

令人震惊的是，这个失落的文明似乎在七百万年前就居住在这颗星球上了，我们的考古学家渴望揭开他们的秘密。
excerpt.en:
The remains of what is believed to be an ancient administrative complex, belonging to a space-faring species who called themselves the §YGrunur§! has been found on [From.Planet.GetName].

This fallen civilization appears

excerpt.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]沉积层的深处，我们发现了一处含有许多植物类物种化石的极有价值的宝库，该物种具有的神经结构足以支撑智能的存在。

如果这些早已死去的生物的确是§Y巴奥§!，研究他们的尸体可能会我们提供更多线索，以便弄清他们那一度草木葱茏的行星是如何变成了一个没有空气和生命的星球。
excerpt.en:
Deep in the geological record of [From.Planet.GetName], a trove of promising fossils belonging to a plantoid species possessing the neurological structures necessary for sapience have been uncovered.

If these long-dead

excerpt.zh: 虽然只是前§Y巴奥§!殖民地留下的可悲残片，这一小行星仍有丰富的化石贮藏亟待发掘。我们的考古学家希望能对神秘的§Y巴奥§!的历史和§Y古茹努尔§!在此行星黑暗命运中扮演的可疑角色上有更多的发现。
excerpt.en: The tragic remains of a former §YBaol§! colony, this asteroid nevertheless contains a rich trove of fossils begging for excavation. Our archaeologists hope to discover more about the history of the mysterious §YBaol§!, a

excerpt.zh: 这一前§Y巴奥§!殖民地上仍然拥有大气层和低等生命，我们已在此建立了一个发掘点，以期能对这一文明最终的历史有更多的了解。
excerpt.en: Still in possession of an atmosphere and lower forms of life, a dig site has been established on this former §YBaol§! colony, in the hopes of shedding more light on the ultimate history of the civilization.

excerpt.zh: 整个行星都被巨大的建筑物所覆盖着，这个遗落的大都会星肯定有秘密等待发掘。
excerpt.en: An entire planet covered in vast structures, this fallen megalopolis surely has secrets to be unearthed.

excerpt.zh:
与一个较小小行星的碰撞在[From.Planet.GetName]表面露出一个略微伸出的类似小型防爆门或者气闸室的东西。它似乎有着数千年的历史，先前一直被岩石和尘土所掩盖。

由于未知原因，我们的扫描无法穿透到小行星的内部，并且常规切割工具也无法对防爆门造成影响。为了了解这扇门的背后有什么，我们的团队或许不得不从另一个方向向小行星的中心挖掘。
excerpt.en: A collision with a smaller asteroid has revealed a small blast door or airlock extending slightly from the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. It appears to be thousands of years old, and had previously been concealed by r

excerpt.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上的一个大而与世隔绝的山谷中一些不同物种的化石被发现了，这些物种似乎不是来自该行星的。它们大体上都来自同一个时期，大约是360万年前，跨度为几个世纪的那段时间内。

这些物种中的每一个个体似乎都是在其所属的独特的生物圈中进化而来的，而且它们似乎都具有智慧。奇怪的是，到目前为止发现的每一个化石都显示出遭到暴力终结的迹象。
excerpt.en: Fossilized remains from several different species that do not appear to have been indigenous to [From.Planet.GetName] have been found in a large and secluded valley on the planet. They all date from roughly the same time

excerpt.zh:
这颗行星的地表上，一座古老的建筑物被隐藏在某种迷彩能量场之下。只是偶然观测到，一颗小行星在撞击时才揭示了它的存在，该小行星化为流星偏转了它的能量场。

在该能量场被关闭后，考古学家们现在可以去探索原本隐藏其下的，令人生畏的巨大建筑群了。
excerpt.en:
A chameleon energy field was concealing an ancient structure on the surface of this planet. Only a chance observation of an asteroid impact revealed its existence as the meteor deflected off the field.

With the field de

excerpt.zh: 在这颗卫星上的一个大陨石坑内，可以找到一座大型基地建筑群的遗迹。它已经被遗弃了几千年之久。围绕着附近行星的能量屏障似乎是源于这个古老的基地正下方的一个能量源。
excerpt.en: Ruins of a large base complex of some kind can be found inside a large crater on this moon. It must have been abandoned thousands of years ago. The energy barrier that encompasses the nearby planet appears to originate f

excerpt.zh: 这个古老的遗落星球已经被囚禁在一道无法穿透的能量屏障里大约有75000年之久。它曾经是一颗充满活力的都市星球，居住着数以亿计的居民，但现在街道和建筑物都被遗弃了，星球上的原初居民也都销声匿迹了。
excerpt.en: This ancient Relic World was imprisoned behind an impenetrable energy barrier for roughly 75,000 years. It must once have been a vibrant ecumenopolis home to hundreds of billions of individuals, but the streets and build

excerpt.zh:
一座大型废弃空间站被困在这颗气态巨行星的大气层内部，向着巨行星内部缓慢下坠。其自重很可能在下一个千年里彻底毁坏这个空间站。

好在该空间站飘入大气层还不太深，我们仍有可能对其开展考古行动。
excerpt.en:
A large derelict space station is trapped in a slow terminal orbit inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. The gravitational stresses will likely destroy it completely within the next thousand years.

It has not yet dri

excerpt.zh: 这颗小行星的表面覆盖满了被其低重力束缚的机器人碎片。看起来它们都是由军事行动造成的。如果这些作战机器人没有被破坏到无法修复的话，本来是足够武装几只军队的。
excerpt.en: The entire surface of this small asteroid is covered in robot debris, trapped in its weak gravity field. All of it appears military in nature, and there are enough combat droids here to outfit several armies had they not

excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon]的表面在受到一艘星际飞船的猛烈撞击后，凹陷出一个小峡谷。这艘飞船的残骸仍然可以在峡谷底部找到。虽然撞击肯定发生在亿万年前，但残骸似乎相当完好。派遣一支考古探险队将能了解更多信息。
excerpt.en: A small canyon of sorts has been carved onto the surface of this [From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon] by the violent impact of a starship. What remains of the vessel can still be found on the canyon floor. Although the crash must

excerpt.zh: 即使用肉眼也很容易看出，[From.Planet.GetName]的地表上部分区域的地形极不规整。光滑的弧面上唐突地出现了一个巨大的球形凸起。也许在过去某一时刻，一颗卫星亦或是一颗巨大的小行星与这颗行星发生了碰撞，但碰撞的方式一定相当微妙，碰撞并未撕裂这颗行星，而仅仅是使不速之客寄宿在了行星地壳内部。
excerpt.en: Even with the naked eye it is easy to see something highly irregular in the shape of [From.Planet.GetName]. The smooth curvature of the surface is suddenly interrupted by a gigantic spherical bump. At some point a moon o

excerpt.zh:
来自[From.Planet.GetName]的探测读数显示，这颗星球曾经郁郁葱葱，被繁茂的植被所覆盖。然而现在一切皆为过往云烟，它只不过是一块荒芜光秃的巨岩。

虽然缺乏任何值得注意的构造运动，但使用感应器对这颗行星进行扫描之后，设备记录了下令人困惑的数据。数据表明，有东西正在在地下移动，绝对是一个“庞然大物”。这个发现值得我们进行深入调查。
excerpt.en:
Readings from [From.Planet.GetName] reveal that it was once mostly covered in lush vegetation. Now the forlorn orb is little more than a barren rock.

Despite lacking any noteworthy tectonic activity, sensory scans of th

excerpt.zh: 从[From.Planet.GetName]的轨道上可以很容易地看到一座直径数千公里的人造建筑。形状表明在它的中间位置似乎有一片重要区域。从轨道上获得的探测数据显示没有任何异常，因此我们有必要进行进一步的探测。
excerpt.en: An artificial construct thousands of kilometers across is readily visible from [From.Planet.GetName]'s orbit. The shape seems to indicate a location of importance in the middle of it. Sensory readings from orbit indicate

excerpt.zh:
轨道遥测显示在[From.Planet.GetName]表面有一个巨大的坑洞。此坑洞并非陨石撞击坑，因为其深度令人咋舌，与直径完全不成比例。事实上，该坑洞的实际深度尚无法确定，因为坑道半路上就被岩屑堵塞，任何进一步的轨道扫描均被阻碍。

传统的开挖式考察看起来是确定坑洞下方究竟有何种物体的唯一途径。
excerpt.en: Orbital telemetry shows a massive impact crater on the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. It was not caused by a meteorite strike, as the crater is surprisingly deep in proportion to its diameter. In fact, the actual dept

excerpt.zh:
在我们迄今的探索中，[From.Planet.GetName]表面的情况完全没有先例。从山脉到整个大陆般广袤的地质区域突然被切割成各种几何形状，其规整程度远非自然形成所能及。原本自然的环境被突然破坏，变成完全平坦的平面、完美的三角形和尖锐的锥形。

目前，对这一令人困惑的现象的任何解释都只是纯粹的猜测。
excerpt.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is utterly without precedent in all our exploration to date. Vast geological areas, from mountain ranges to entire continents, are suddenly cut by shapes far too geometrically regular

excerpt.zh:
对[From.Planet.GetName]扫描揭示了地底深处的一间人工密室——其用途和来源未知。放大后发现了一座从地表通往地下拱顶的挖掘井。

欲进行进一步的分析，需派遣一支探险队前往[From.Planet.GetName]的表面。
excerpt.en:
Scans of [From.Planet.GetName] uncovered an artificial chamber deep beneath the surface - its purpose and origin unknown. Magnification revealed an excavated shaft leading from the surface to the subterranean vault.

Fur

excerpt.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]的整个表面如同伤疤般布满了又长又浅的运河。它们随意地交错穿插，布局上没有明显的逻辑。目前还不确定它们是否是一种不寻常的自然特征，又或是别的什么。

需要进行一次地面考察以查明更多的情况。
excerpt.en: The entire surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is scarred by long, shallow canals. They cross and re-cross each other haphazardly, with no apparent logic to their layout. It is as yet uncertain if they are an unusual natura

excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]行星的表面没有任何生命。然而，有迹象表明这里先前存在繁荣的生物圈，加之此处有趣的地壳活动，我们需要对其进行更深入的调查。
excerpt.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is devoid of all life. However, there are indications of a previously thriving biosphere, and some interesting tectonic activity which may warrant a closer look.

excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]的地表扫描结果表明了一种迹象：曾经可能有一个科技文明在这颗星球上活跃，但它现在已经灭绝了。我们需要组织一次地表考察以获得更多信息。
excerpt.en: Surface scans of [From.Planet.GetName] picked up signs that a technological civilization may have been active on the planet, but has since gone extinct. We will need to mount a surface expedition to learn more.

excerpt.zh: 从轨道中拍摄的[From.Planet.GetName]的影像清晰地展现了这个技术文明的基础设施。神秘的是，尽管庞大的城区被复杂的表面交通网络相连接，但这颗行星看起来似乎已完全废弃，没有任何尚存感性生物的迹象。此行星内核比大多数行星更活跃，但这里没有灾难性事件或其他任何足以直接解释这些人口失踪的原因的事件的迹象。他们都去哪里了呢？
excerpt.en: Orbital imagery of [From.Planet.GetName] clearly shows the infrastructure of a technological civilization. Mysteriously, despite massive urban areas linked by an extensive surface transport network, the planet seems tota

excerpt.zh: 我们的调查船扫描了[From.Planet.GetName]并探测到一些值得进一步观测的人造结构。令人不安的是，那里没有任何人口存在的迹象。
excerpt.en: Our survey ship has scanned [From.Planet.GetName] and detected some artificial structures worth a closer look. Unnervingly, there are no signs of any population down there.

excerpt.zh: 即使不依靠仪器，也可以很容易地看到[From.Planet.GetName]上存在着庞大的城市集群遗迹。显然，曾有一个高度发达的文明居住在那里，但现在已检测不到生命迹象，也不能收到符合技术社会特征的电磁信号。这颗行星似乎陷入了死寂。我们需要着陆去了解更多情况。
excerpt.en: Even without instruments, one can readily see the remains of vast conurbations down on [From.Planet.GetName]. Clearly a highly advanced civilization once dwelt there, but today there are no life signs nor electromagnetic

excerpt.zh: 科学船在[From.Planet.GetName]轨道上进行的扫描显示了其海面下有着奇怪的构造，海水以难以解释的方式在流动。虽然该星球天气相对平静，风暴很少，但海面下的水受一些未知力量的影响，不断翻涌和搅动。建议进行详细调查。
excerpt.en: Scans made by the Science Ship in orbit of [From.Planet.GetName] shows some strange formations beneath the waves, and inexplicable water currents. The weather is relatively placid and storms are rare, yet the planetary s

excerpt.zh: 来自[From.Planet.GetName]的可见光传感器反馈的信号显示这个海洋星球的海床上有着极不寻常的构造。
excerpt.en: The visual sensor feed from [From.Planet.GetName] shows formations in the seabed of this ocean world that are highly unusual.

excerpt.zh: 在[From.Planet.GetName]轨道上的科学船已经探测到遍布这个海洋星球表面的圆形岛屿群。从地质的角度来看，它们非常不寻常：其表面看起来很自然，没有人造结构，但它们都呈圆形，且几乎是完美的圆。我们需要前往那里收集更多数据。
excerpt.en: The Science Ship in orbit around [From.Planet.GetName] has detected clusters of small, round islands dotting the ocean planet. From a geological standpoint they are highly unusual: the surface appears natural, with no ar

excerpt.zh: 传感器在一簇小行星内检测到了能量读数。建议进行更深入的调查。
excerpt.en: Sensors have detected energy readings in a cluster of asteroids. Further investigation is recommended.

excerpt.zh:
一颗本应“正常”的熔岩星球，让科研船的传感器出现了无法控制的故障。

建议进行进一步研究。
excerpt.en:
What should be a "normal" molten planet is making the Science Ship's sensors glitch uncontrollably.

Further study is advised.

excerpt.zh: 科研船检测到了一条从[From.Planet.GetName]发射出的怪异读数。
excerpt.en: The Science Ship has picked up a strange reading emanating from [From.Planet.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 对[From.Planet.GetName]详细的调查揭示了一些属于曾经遍布整个行星的文明的微弱信号。
excerpt.en: A closer look at [From.Planet.GetName] shows small signs of a civilization that once populated the planet.

excerpt.zh: 虽然乍看上去平淡无奇，但对[From.Planet.GetName]进一步的检查表明它实际上是一座伪装成自然星体的人工结构。
excerpt.en: Seemingly unremarkable at first, closer examination of [From.Planet.GetName] has revealed that it is actually an artificial construct designed to mimic a natural asteroid.

excerpt.zh: 一台锈迹斑斑，覆膜一样的机器覆盖着[From.Planet.GetName]表面并深入到行星的内核。为了搞清这台机器的奥秘，我们的考古学家们需要建立一座巨大的发掘站点。
excerpt.en: The rusting, film-covered machinery covering [From.Planet.GetName] runs deep into the planet's core. In order to unravel more of this mechanical mystery, our archaeologists will need to establish an extensive dig site.

excerpt.zh: 废墟遍布[From.Planet.GetName]，但奇怪的是，从它们的爆炸模式来看，似乎是大量的地下核爆引发了这一切，而不是正常的大气层核爆或是轨道轰炸。这需要进一步调查，或许需要一次考古挖掘来揭露这里到底发生了什么。
excerpt.en: Ruins cover [From.Planet.GetName], but oddly the blast patterns seem to indicate that vast nuclear explosions occurred underneath the surface rather than from atmospheric or orbital bombardment. This warrants further inv

excerpt.zh: 对[From.Planet.GetName]的扫描显示，在该地区存在大量的有加工痕迹的物品以及零零散散的放射性物质，但从轨道上看不到什么细节。为了了解更多信息，我们需要着陆进行实地调查。
excerpt.en: Scans of [From.Planet.GetName] have revealed an area with packed with refined material and scattered radiologicals, although little is visible from orbit. To find out more we will need to investigate the site on the grou

excerpt.zh:
我们在这颗星球上发现了有着令人惊异数量的严重异变化石，它们都属于同一种已灭绝的智慧物种。

究竟是什么导致了一个高等社会数百万成员的异变？我们的考古学家想进一步调查。
excerpt.en:
A surprising number of heavily-mutated fossils has been found on this planet, all belonging to the same species of extinct sapients.

What could have led to the mutation of millions of members of a once-advanced society?

excerpt.zh:
一个完全由不明骨头建造的原始城市废墟在经历这颗星球上的一场强力沙尘暴之后被发现。

我们的科学家渴望发掘这座可怕的古城。
excerpt.en:
The ruins of a primeval city built entirely out of bones of an unknown origin have been unearthed following a violent sandstorm on this planet.

Our archaeologists are eager to begin excavation on this grisly ancient cit

excerpt.zh: 在这颗星球的地壳内，数量惊人的地下通道系统交错盘旋。究竟是什么造就了这一切呢？
excerpt.en: An extensive network of subterranean tunnels of truly astounding proportion make swirls in the crust of this planet. What could have created them?

excerpt.zh: 探测器在[From.Planet.GetName]的冰雪之下探测到了一座隐藏的设施。部分坍塌与阻塞的隧道似乎组成了连接各种地下结构的巨大网络
excerpt.en: Scanners detect a hidden complex buried beneath the ice and snow of [From.Planet.GetName]. A large network of partially-collapsed or blocked tunnels seems to connect the various underground structures.

excerpt.zh:
乍一看，[From.Planet.GetName]上只有冰雪。雪白的大地、玻璃般晶莹的湖泊和锯齿状的松绿色冰川广袤无垠，火红的橘色天空映衬着地面，宛如裂开的伤口，将[From.Planet.Solar_System.GetName]中夕阳西下的红色光芒倾注在海面。如果世界有终结，那这里一定就是了。海面风平浪静，积雪一尘不染，唯一能听到的，只有冰层崩裂的咔嚓雷动和平原上呼啸的狂风。

然而，[From.Planet.GetName]曾经是
excerpt.en: At first sight there is only snow and ice on [From.Planet.GetName]. Vast expanses of impenetrable white, glass lakes and jagged turquoise glaciers against fiery orange skies torn open like a wound, pouring red into the s

excerpt.zh:
被[From.Planet.GetName]大气圈笼罩着的是一处鬼影幢幢的巨大居住站——埃克斯-柏楞居住区。这里曾是一处日喧夜嚣的太空城，居民们享受着科技带来的巨大便利，过着如同神仙一般的生活，如今此处已成为一座寂静的墓碑。软体类的外星人横七竖八地倒在走道上，腐败程度各不相同。验尸报告表明，这些外星人由于居住站的维生系统失效最后死于窒息。

他们的家里装备有模样奇怪的机械座椅，其顶端连接到了一个形状是蓝色巨大球状体的中央数据库——眠梦仪
excerpt.en: Shrouded within [From.Planet.GetName]'s gaseous atmosphere is the dark looming form of an enormous habitat - the Ix Belèn Residence. Previously a bustling space city where the residents enjoyed a pampered lifestyle with

excerpt.zh: 一个与中子星非常接近的大型空间站正在发出奇怪的读数。尽管其当前位置稳定，但显示出相当大的损坏。焦痕的扩散表明它在过去曾被几次大爆炸所摧毁。
excerpt.en: A large station orbiting in alarmingly close proximity to the neutron star is giving off strange readings. Although its current position is stable, it shows considerable wear and tear. A proliferation of scorch marks ind

excerpt.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上的矿井的深处，是一处古老外星文明所遗留的痕迹。宏伟的装饰建筑和洞室告诉我们，一个有着丰富文化的文明已经能够巧妙地切割基岩和建设隧道系统，它们被厚实的闸门所保护，通往更加深入的山体之中。

由于山体中富集的，以爆炸性闻名的甲烷气体，继续探索下去会很危险。
excerpt.en: In the depths of [From.Planet.GetName]'s mines are traces of an ancient alien civilization. Magnificent ornamental structures and cavernous chambers telling of a rich culture have been cut expertly from the bedrock and a

excerpt.zh:
这颗星球上存在一个由一群沉迷于捡垃圾及囤垃圾的哺乳动物组成的社会。他们迷宫般的城市到处都是垃圾，高耸的建筑摇摇欲坠，由各种破烂拼成。目之所及尽是堆积成山的小摆件、饰品和手工艺品。

这些小家伙自己并不能生产任何东西，但他们精通太空旅行，他们可能从外人那里偷了不少用得着的东西，但同时也偷了不少没用的东西。
excerpt.en: This planet has played host to a mammalian society of compulsive gatherers and hoarders. Their labyrinthine city is littered with junk, their towering ramshackle buildings pieced together from scraps of re-purposed mater

excerpt.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]出土了一座埋藏了数千年的损坏空间站。这座精湛的建筑曾维持着数百万人的生存，他们的尸体现在就保存在空间站内，探索该建筑庞大的内部实在是一种令人毛骨悚然的工作。

虽然我们的科学家还没有确定这些人死亡的原因，但可以确定的是，他们在空间站损坏之前就已经死亡。有些人死相平静，死的时候手里抓着小型雕像；另一些人手里拿着武器，死前遭受了暴力伤害。
excerpt.en: A crashed alien space station has been unearthed on [From.Planet.GetName] after being buried for many millennia. The masterful construction previously held a self-contained arthropoid civilization of millions. Their dead

excerpt.zh:
这些巨型雕像矗立在[From.Planet.GetName]上，静静注视着什么。九个堪称不朽的雕像沿着漫长的边沿一一排开，位于这片区域的重要战略点，似乎在守护着它们中心的某种物品。

他们涂有精致的表面镀层，警觉的姿势好像时刻准备着战斗，不会移动的眼球也似乎紧随着你的每个动作，然而这里显然已经没有什么东西需要保护了。也许他们要保护的东西没能挨过岁月的流逝，又或是他们的任务早已失败。其上的累累伤痕表明，这些哨兵中的许多已经快要被物理损害彻
excerpt.en:
Silent giants stand watch on [From.Planet.GetName]. Nine monumental statues placed along a wide perimeter at strategical points in the landscape appear to be guarding something at its center.

Their skin is covered in fi

excerpt.zh: 一层厚厚的玻璃和金属覆盖在这颗原本贫瘠的行星上，或许暗示着它过去发生了某种灾难性事件。
excerpt.en: A thick layer of glass and metal covers this otherwise barren planet, perhaps hinting at some sort of cataclysmic event in its past.

excerpt.zh: 最近，[From.Planet.GetName]上的地陷将其地下的交通隧道网揭露了出来。这些精致的道路和复杂的信号设施已经深埋地下数百年；它们的设计与我们之前在这片太空区域所发现的一切均不相同。究竟是谁为了什么建造了它们呢？
excerpt.en: Recent cave-ins on [From.Planet.GetName] have revealed a network of underground transportation tunnels. Its elaborate archways and complex signalling equipment have lain undiscovered for centuries; their design is unlike

excerpt.zh:
漂浮在 [From.Planet.GetName] 行星残骸水晶的般清澈的海洋上，包裹在微小冰盖的，似乎是一个人造结构。

需要一个团队来挖掘这个结构。
excerpt.en:
Encapsulated in what remains of the planet's tiny ice cap, floating on the crystal clear oceans of [From.Planet.GetName], is what appears to be an artificial structure. 

A team is required to excavate this structure.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]破碎地面的下方发现了一个大型加固贮藏室。考虑到在这样一个充满辐射的废土，还有其被埋葬的年份，我们很惊讶它居然完好无损。
excerpt.en: A large reinforced cache has been found underneath the broken ground of [From.Planet.GetName]. It's surprisingly intact considering the years it spent buried in a radioactive wasteland.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一艘古老的外星人星舰，它被半掩埋在一个小行星撞击坑中间。冰晶布满了舰身的大部分，但我们还是很顺利地发现了气阀门……并开始搜索这艘船暗藏的秘密。
excerpt.en: We have discovered an ancient alien starship lying half-buried in an asteroid crater. Glacial ice has inexorably spread across most of the ship, but we can easily access the airlock... and search for any secrets hidden b

excerpt.zh:
我们的科学家已经到达星门物体以不可置信的速度坠毁到[From.Planet.GetName]上的撞击地点。

毫无疑问，从撞击点的外表来看，这绝不是一次普通的坠毁着陆，我们的科学家期待进行进一步调查。
excerpt.en:
Our scientist have reached the impact site of the object from the gateway that crashed into [From.Planet.GetName] at incredible speed.

It's clear from the look of the impact site that this was no ordinary crash landing,

excerpt.zh: 一系列奇特的异常读数从[From.Planet.GetName]的地表源源不断地传来。我们需要启动一次地表探查以了解更多情报。
excerpt.en: A string of strange anomaly readings is emanating from the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. We need to launch a surface excursion to find out more.

excerpt.zh: 此前发现的外星指示器指向了这颗行星，我们应该下到其表面进行进一步的调查。
excerpt.en: The previously discovered alien indicators are pointing at this planet, and we should go down on the surface and investigate further.

excerpt.zh: 我们的扫描仪侦测到有东西在[From.Planet.GetName]的地表深处。
excerpt.en: Our scanners have picked up something deep beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 显然，我们的神秘施恩者觉得地下结构是个很时髦的概念。
excerpt.en: Underground structures are apparently a popular motif amongst our mysterious Benefactors.

excerpt.zh: 扫描仪从轨道上读取的数据表明下方的行星上存在一个人工构造。但与以前的不同，该构造并未埋于地下。
excerpt.en: Scanner readings from orbit indicate that there is a structure down on the planet. Unlike the previous ones, this one is not buried underground.

excerpt.zh: 坐标指向[From.Planet.GetName]上的某处，但进一步的扫描没有发现任何异常。
excerpt.en: The coordinates point to an arbitrary spot down on the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. Closer scans indicate nothing out of the ordinary.

excerpt.zh: 我们找了个合适的位置为未来某天重返星空的特瓦'菲亚埋下了这些储备。一份前往未来的礼物，送给过去的巨人。
excerpt.en: We have found a good location to bury the cache intended for the Thwaa'Phyr as they one day take to the stars anew. A gift in the future, to giants of the past.

excerpt.zh: 考古部门将这里作为一个完美的地址，用于埋藏资料，以供给将来“迈入太空时代”的无情者后裔。
excerpt.en: This spot has been chosen by the archaeology department as a perfect site to bury assets for the Relentless descendants when they 'come of space age'.

excerpt.zh: 我们曾经以为，这不过是位于[From.Planet.GetName]上的鸡肋矿物层。但现在，这片矿物层却开始发出震耳欲聋的奇怪嗡嗡声。这还不是个例，联邦境内的诸星球上均可以听到类似的声音。这一异常现象背后究竟隐藏着什么？
excerpt.en: What was once thought to be merely a seam of half-interesting minerals on [From.Planet.GetName] has begun emitting a bizarre and deafening hum - and it's not alone. Worlds across federation space are being buffeted by a

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的一处破损的拱顶发现了奇怪的信号。
excerpt.en: We have picked up strange signals from a broken dome on [From.Planet.GetName].

excerpt.zh:
当意识到我们的困境以后，对自我认同感和目的的缺失困扰着我们这个物种。我们大意地低估了这种负面影响，它使我们举步维艰，更别什么提团结一致了。我们挣扎着寻求共识，我们渴望答案。

于是我们建立了这个发掘遗址来寻找证据来结束关于我们物种诞生的争论，并且希望能找到一个坚实的基础使我们重新团结起来。
excerpt.en: Since awakening to our predicament, the absence of identity and purpose has plagued our species. We grossly underestimated the impact it would have on our ability to move forward, let alone cooperate. We struggle to reac

excerpt.zh: 我们已经找到了一个损毁的巨型结构残骸。该构造显然亟需修复，同时我们也在其数据库中发现了饱含着有关异星生物的见解的宝贵财富。尽管我们还在决定是否要重建这一远古科技的造物，我们的考古学家有机会去发掘并取回这宇宙设备起源的线索。它的其中一个发明者，“量子建筑师”相关的日志似乎格外有价值。恢复这些文件对我们解密遗留给我们科技的远古种族的文化和历史必然有着莫大的帮助。
excerpt.en: We have found the wreckage of a ruined megastructure. The construct is obviously in desperate need of repairs, and we've found a wealth of xenological insights in its databanks. While we're deciding whether to rebuild th

excerpt.zh: 我们自[From.Planet.GetName]的偏远山谷捕捉到了一束独特的信号。由于信号源离这颗星球上的任何已存在文明都十分遥远，追踪这束信号、搞清楚它的来源，或许会有特殊意义。
excerpt.en: We have picked up a unique signal from a remote valley on [From.Planet.GetName]. As the signal's source is far away from any civilization that has existed on the planet, it might be of interest to track it down and figur

excerpt.zh:
一艘我们的飞船在探索[Root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系的时候偶然在位于[Root.Planet.GetName][Root.Planet.Orbit.GetName]的卫星上发现了一艘坠毁的小型飞船。

这艘飞船上的标志与符号我们从未见过。些许样本已经被提取并用于进一步研究，但飞船本身过大且不够牢固，无法移动，我们只能就地进行分析研究了。
excerpt.en:
One of our ships analyzing the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system has come across a small crashed ship on the moon of [Root.Planet.Orbit.GetName], [Root.Planet.GetName].

It bears no emblems or sigils we have seen before

excerpt.zh: 曾经威胁我们家园的战舰仍然高悬在头顶，严酷地提醒着我们侥幸逃脱的命运。现在该去夺回我们的天空，取回这艘舰船残骸中的高超科技了。
excerpt.en: The warship that once threatened our homeworld still looms over us, a stark reminder of the fate we narrowly escaped. It is time to take back our skies and salvage the technological marvels contained within the wreck.

excerpt.zh: 修复这艘坠毁的运奴船的电脑核心应该可以令我们找到自己母星的位置……同时也是弥那玛特种实业集团的母星。
excerpt.en: Repairing the computer core of the crashed slaver ship should reveal the location of our former home worlds... as well as Minamar Specialized Industries.

excerpt.zh: 一座环绕着§Y[From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]§!的废弃观测站。从中可以一窥在这个行星上的前超光速的§Y夏瑞诺伊§!文明的起源。
excerpt.en: An abandoned observation outpost orbits §Y[From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]§!. It may shed some light on the origins of the pre-FTL §YCharynoi§! civilization on the planet below.

excerpt.zh:
那些无人机所保护的是一颗被潮汐锁定的行星，一面向着夜空的黑暗与严寒，另一面则沐浴着永恒的光明。在温暖的昼半球，我们发现了一座可能曾是瓦格罗人城市的废墟。

§Y凯德斯§!相信，他过往的细节可能就深埋于此，并且希望在这里的发现能够揭示这颗行星的历史。

§R这个遗址必须由§Y凯德斯§!亲自挖掘。§!
excerpt.en: The planet the drones were protecting is tidally locked, one side facing the cold darkness of space, and the other bathed in perpetual light. On the warm, light-filled half of this world we uncovered the ruins of what ma

excerpt.zh: 我们在[Planet.GetName]地表上的撞击坑的极深处探测到了异常的地震活动。地下声呐发现了一座前所未知的洞穴。
excerpt.en: We've detected anomalous seismic activity from deep inside an ancient crater on the surface of [Planet.GetName]. Underground sonar revealed a previously unknown cavity.

excerpt.zh: 我们的扫描仪探测到该星球的一个区域不断发出一些有趣的信号。经分析，那里很有可能存在古代文明的遗迹正等着我们去发现。
excerpt.en: Our scanners picked up a series of intriguing signals coming from this area of the planet. Based on their composition, it's highly likely there is a remnant of an ancient civilization waiting to be uncovered there.

excerpt.zh: 在一颗被风暴毁灭的星球中埋葬于废墟之下的庇护所：外部的残破使其难以调查，但内部似乎还是完好的。
excerpt.en: A shelter buried under the debris of a storm-ravaged world; the devastation is making it hard to investigate, but the interior appears intact.

excerpt.zh: 在远古风暴庇护所中发现的三个坐标之一将我带到了§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!。地表的废墟绵延无尽，显然这颗行星曾经拥有许多庞大的城市中心。这很可能是数百万年前因内特贸易体的公民居住的地方。为什么这些坐标要被安全地存储在一个风暴庇护所里仍需调查。
excerpt.en: One of the three coordinate sets found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!. Given the extent of the ruins, it's clear that this planet once boasted many sprawling urban centers. This is l

excerpt.zh: 在远古风暴庇护所中发现的三个坐标之一将我带到了§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!，这是因内特贸易体的一颗工业星球。从其上现存的建筑来看，这颗行星显然不是用来居住的。然而，我们仍不能确定其上的工厂究竟是用于生产什么的。
excerpt.en: One of the three coordinates found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!, an industrial world from the Inetian Traders' empire. Based on the existing architecture, this was clearly not a re

excerpt.zh: 在远古风暴庇护所中发现的三个坐标之一将我带到了§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!。它的地表除了积雪和灰尘以外几乎什么也没有，初步扫描发现这颗行星曾一度是宜居的。不知这颗已经化为废墟的行星在过去是否对因内特贸易体有重要意义呢？
excerpt.en: One of the three coordinates found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!. The surface is little more than snow and dust, but initial scans show that the planet was once habitable. Was it im

excerpt.zh: 在局部扰动抑制器的控制台中保存着一个数据信号。虽然有些难度，但我们能复制它的模式，并且在全星系中搜寻匹配。航迹引向了一颗不可宜居的星球。是时候弄明白因内特贸易体瞄准着什么，以及为什么瞄准了。
excerpt.en: Saved within the command console of the Sectoral Disturbance Depressors was a data signal. Though difficult, we were able to clone its pattern and search the galaxy for a match. The trail led to an uninhabited planet. It

excerpt.zh: 因内特贸易体试图保护这个恒星系中的一座小小的空间站不受星尘沙暴的影响。而这个风暴则始料未及地发育增强并且摧毁了许多其他的恒星系。为什么他们要如此费尽心机地保护这座设施呢？
excerpt.en: The Inetian Traders tried to protect a space station within this system from a small celestial dust storm. As an unforeseen consequence, the storm grew so large several other of their systems were destroyed. Why were the

excerpt.zh: 这座古老的通讯站仍可工作。登上这座站点并直接与其系统交互后，我们也许就能破译此前收到的广播。
excerpt.en: This ancient communication station is still active. By boarding the site and directly interfacing with its systems we might be able to decipher its previous broadcasts.

excerpt.zh: 尽管宇宙风暴一般是破坏性的，但这场风暴却成为发现外星文明存在证据的契机。尽管这颗行星的大气极不稳定，然而登陆队可能会揭示这个古老文化的可怕命运。
excerpt.en: As destructive as cosmic storms can be, this one uncovered evidence an alien civilization. Though the planet's atmosphere is incredibly unstable, a landing party might reveal whatever horrible fate befell this ancient cu

excerpt.zh: 这个地区奇怪的能量波动掩盖着一座巨大的海军墓地。这座由聚合物和金属组成的墓地可能藏有了解阿达卡利亚公约的重要线索。
excerpt.en: The strange energy fluctuations in this area obscured a massive naval graveyard. This necropolis of polymer and metal may harbor a vital clue to understanding the adAkkaria Convention.

excerpt.zh:
这座由阿达卡利亚公约建造的古老居住站环绕着一颗荒芜的星球。其高质量的建筑材料使空间站保留了近乎原始的状态。

调到传输频率上之后，我们收到一条信息，后面跟着一段浮夸的铃铛声：§L欢迎来到崇高仁善爱国协会§!。
excerpt.en:
Orbiting a desolate planet, this ancient habitat was built by the adAkkaria Convention. The high quality building materials used in its construction have ensured the station is in near pristine condition.

Tuning into th

excerpt.zh:
在与宇宙风暴通信之后，艾德苏尔我们展示出了自己的一小部分。在残云之间矗立着一座巨大的建筑群。这里早已遭到遗弃，但奇怪的是它并没有受到时间的影响，扫描显示它的内部存在有机物质。

在这座巨大的建筑前升起了一系列横幅，上面写着同一句话：庆典时刻到。
excerpt.en: After the communication with the cosmic storm, a small part of adSul was revealed to us. Between the remnant clouds stood a massive complex. Abandoned, yet strangely unaffected by the eons, scans reveal organic material

excerpt.zh: 席卷而过的宇宙风暴留下了一份奇怪的礼物：一座属于老旧居住站系统的轨道复合体。登陆之后有可能加以激活。
excerpt.en: The passing cosmic storm left behind a curious present: an orbital complex from an old habitat system. Boarding may allow us to reactivate it.

excerpt.zh: 紧随着最近过境的§Y电力风暴§!，在§H[From.Planet.GetName]§!的地表之下探测到了一场难以解释的能量骤增。进一步扫描发现了一座古老的地下复合体，其中的发电机被风暴重新激活，让这座设施又开始了运作。
excerpt.en: Following the passing of a recent §YElectric Storm§!, an unexplained power surge was detected beneath the surface of §H[From.Planet.GetName]§!. Further scans revealed an aging subterranean complex whose power generators

excerpt.zh: 一个隐现的建筑群，直到现在还隐藏在我们的领土内。残破的庭院中央，一盏灯塔在呼唤着塞塔娜。
excerpt.en: A looming complex, until now hidden in our own territory. From the heart of the ruined courtyard, a beacon calls for Cetana.

records.zh: 塞塔娜：不可能的幸存者

excerpt.zh: 埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克被困在冷冻仓中静静地沉睡着，等待她的女王归来。得益于脑成像科技，我们可以将她的梦境转化为画面，提取记忆来研究她被埋葬时的环境。
excerpt.en: Trapped inside a cryogenic pod, Elik Narith Kerak rests, waiting for her queen's return. Thanks to brain imagining techniques, we can turn her dreams into pictures, excavating her memories to learn the circumstances of h

excerpt.zh: 在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的冰冷荒原上，我们发现了一个小型预制庇护所，里面配备了休眠的生命维持系统和生活区。它们经过数千年的冰暴，严重风化，部分被掩埋。
excerpt.en: On the frigid wastelands of [fromfrom.planet.GetName], we have detected a small prefabricated shelter equipped with dormant life support devices and living quarters. They are heavily weathered and partially buried after

excerpt.zh:
对§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!的地质扫描显示在一个特定的地下区域中，局部的极端温度接近绝对零度。

对内部更详尽的研究将会带来更多的答案。
excerpt.en:
Topographical scans of §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! show extreme temperatures approaching absolute zero localized in a particular subterranean region.

A more detailed study of the interior should yield more answers.

excerpt.zh: §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!的表面几乎完全被一些整齐排列的圆形小池塘覆盖。这种规整的网格表明它们可能是精心设计的而非自然形成。现场调查可能带来更多的解答。
excerpt.en: §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!'s surface is almost entirely covered by a lattice grid of small, circular, liquid-filled pools. Their neat alignment suggests deliberate engineering rather than natural formation. A field expedi

excerpt.zh: §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!表面居高不下的辐射水平指向了一座破旧的反应堆复合体。这座孤零零的设施似乎废弃已久，有待调查。
excerpt.en: Elevated radiation levels on the surface of §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! were traced to a dilapidated reactor complex. The isolated facility appears inactive and warrants investigation.

excerpt.zh:
§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!的轨道影像显示了一座破败的采矿设施，周围还有许多被遗弃已久的原始太空货船。

除了这些影像外，我们的短波通讯阵列还拾获了一个来自行星地下深处的非常微弱的求救信号。对该遗址进行更详细的研究将揭示信号的起源。
excerpt.en:
Orbital imaging of §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! has flagged a dilapidated mining facility accompanied by long abandoned rudimentary space faring cargo vessels.

Alongside these images, our shortwave communications array has

excerpt.zh:
对§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!的扫描发现了一艘太空船残骸。这艘飞船似乎在多年以前遭受了非受控着陆。

其巨大的规模表明了建造其所需的巨大资源量。考古发掘可以帮助我们确认其为何坠毁于此。
excerpt.en:
Scans of §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! revealed the presence of a spaceborne shipwreck. The vessel appears to have endured an uncontrolled landing here many years ago.

Its massive scale suggests immense resources were once

excerpt.zh:
我们的传感器检测到一个从§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!的撞击坑深处发出的异常通讯信号。

震波拓扑扫描显示存在一个地下洞穴网络，其塌陷的洞口正在撞击坑中心。与此同时，我们的放射仪探测到从该地点发出的微弱的引力辐射痕迹，这带来的问题比答案更多。
excerpt.en:
Our sensors have detected an irregular communications signal emanating from deep within an impact crater on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!.

Seismic topology scans reveal a network of subterranean caverns with a collapsed ent

excerpt.zh: 在对§Y[fromfrom.planet.GetName]§!的扫描中发现在这颗行星最难以靠近的区域有一座孤立的设施。这座结构似乎正在休眠或已被抛弃，其中没有任何能量迹象，看起来也饱经风霜。进行考古发掘可能会带来更深入的洞见。
excerpt.en: Scans of §Y[fromfrom.planet.GetName]§! discovered an isolated facility in the planet's most inaccessible region. The structure appears to be dormant or abandoned, with no energy signature and signs of prolonged weatherin

excerpt.zh: §Y[Planet.GetName]§!上发现了一个硕大无朋的金属立方体。它的外表天衣无缝暗示了先进的技术能力，但我们还无从推测它的起源或功能。考古发掘也许能提供答案。
excerpt.en: A colossal metallic cube has been found on §Y[Planet.GetName]§!. Its seamless form is suggestive of advanced technological capabilities, although we cannot begin to speculate upon its origin or function. An archaeologica

excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]的表面遍布系统性毁灭的伤疤：残垣断壁、满目疮痍、一片死寂。最初的扫描显示这里曾经存在过一个繁荣的前超光速社会，直到一些事件导致了他们灾难性的终结。四处散落的遗骸低语着一种无法言说的恐怖。
excerpt.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] planet bears the scars of systematic devastation: blasted landscapes, collapsed cities, and an eerie silence. Initial scans suggest a once-thriving pre-FTL society existed here - unti

excerpt.zh: 一场灾难性的能量涌最近击穿了这座巨大的生产设施——这也是无数服务于[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]的类似设施中的一座。之后，我们的探险队会努力调查这些设施是如何建设的，并试着抢救可能还存在着的技术资产，希望能了解这座设施在我们自己的近期历史中可能发挥的作用。
excerpt.en: A catastrophic power surge recently tore through this vast manufacturing facility - one of several which served the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]. In its wake, our expedition shall endeavor to discover ho

excerpt.zh: 一场灾难性的能量涌最近击穿了这座巨大的生产设施——这也是无数服务于[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]的类似设施中的一座。之后，我们的探险队会努力调查这些设施是如何建设的，并试着抢救可能还存在着的技术资产，希望能了解这座设施在我们自己的近期历史中可能发挥的作用。
excerpt.en: A catastrophic power surge recently tore through this vast manufacturing facility - one of several which served the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]. In its wake, our expedition shall endeavor to discover ho

excerpt.zh: 在[from.planet.GetName]上的漫天黄沙中，曾有某种[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]监测站感兴趣的东西。其硬件现在已经过于陈旧无法修复，但它甚至比我们发现的几乎所有其他机械制品都要早。可能在我们被同化之前它就开始运作了。虽然现在这里很有可能除了沙漠一无所有，但只有一个办法可以完全确定……
excerpt.en: Somewhere in the sand-swept landscape of [from.planet.GetName] once lay something of interest to a [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] monitoring station. The hardware is beyond repair now, and so old, it predat

excerpt.zh: 在[from.planet.GetName]上的漫天黄沙中，曾有某种[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]监测站感兴趣的东西。其硬件现在已经过于陈旧无法修复，但它甚至比我们发现的几乎所有其他机械制品都要早。可能在我们被同化之前它就开始运作了。虽然现在这里很有可能除了沙漠一无所有，但只有一个办法可以完全确定……
excerpt.en: Somewhere in the sand-swept landscape of [from.planet.GetName] once lay something of interest to a [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] monitoring station. The hardware is beyond repair now, and so old, it predat

excerpt.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]抗拒着一切靠近者。指派到该项目的研究者开始编造借口拖延工作，而仪器则会出现类似拒绝接收数据一样的故障。

这里发生了一些事情——一些可怕的事情，它的回声至今仍在现实中回荡。
excerpt.en:
[From.Planet.GetName] repels all who approach. Researchers assigned to its study invent excuses to delay their work, while instruments glitch and fail as if rejecting the data itself.

Something happened here - something

excerpt.zh: [Planet.GetName]表面炙热，不适宜生物生存。行星上明显的人工遗迹影像引起了[GetScientistPlural]的注意。考古调查或可揭示这里的居民和曾发生在他们身上的故事。
excerpt.en: The surface of [Planet.GetName] is scorching hot, and hostile to biological life. Images of clearly artificial ruins have therefore caught the attention of [GetScientistPlural]. An archaeological investigation could reve

excerpt.zh: 远离[Planet.GetName]人口中心的活跃火山山脉中，一座古庙破败残存。了解其历史或能更深入了解当地文化。
excerpt.en: Far from the population centers of [Planet.GetName], in a range of active volcanic mountains, an ancient temple lies in ruins and disrepair. Understanding its history may grant us further insights into the planet's local

excerpt.zh:
终于，我们能够抵达并接触被称为§H[planet.GetName]§!的“虚境星球”。那里有一种声音在呼唤着我们，这声音如今比以往任何时候都更加响亮。

席卷这个星球的灾难所蕴含的秘密，将揭示我们自身星系历史的诸多真相，并有望缓解我们社会对自身预言中毁灭的执念。轨道扫描显示，南半球某一点正聚集着漩涡状的强烈能量——那是一只令人不寒而栗的眼睛，正凝视着我们。
excerpt.en:
At long last, we are able to reach out and touch the 'Shrouded World' known as §H[planet.GetName]§!. Something there calls to us, a voice stronger now more than ever before.

The secrets of the cataclysm that befell this

excerpt.zh: 联合星殖民地在失去联系前大约运作了二十五年。无论这里发生了什么，记录都保存了下来。殖民地的档案管理员一直坚持记录到了最后。
excerpt.en: The Unity colony operated for roughly twenty-five years before contact was lost. Whatever happened here, the record survived. The colony's archivist kept logging until the end.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上发现了一些神秘现象。
excerpt.en: Some strange occurances have been spotted on [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上发现了一些神秘现象。
excerpt.en: Some strange occurances have been spotted on [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上的迁徙森林会干扰我们殖民地的发展。如果我们想在这颗星球殖民，我们必须想办法解决这个问题。
excerpt.en: The migrating forests on [Root.GetName] are interfering with the development of our colony. A solution to this problem must be found if we are to prosper on this world.

excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上的一个地底异星文明正朝着我们的殖民地地表挖掘甬道。他们的数量和意图都是未知的，这对于我们殖民地来说可能是一个重大的威胁。
excerpt.en: An underground alien civilization on [Root.GetName] is tunneling towards our colony on the surface. Their numbers and intentions are unknown to us, and they could be a significant threat.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的一部分在几千年以前曾经被远古文明改造过，但由于未知原因，改造进程搁置了。其结果是这里变成了一个高度不稳定的气候系统和生物圈。我们已经找到了废弃的环境改造设备，必须决定应该做什么。
excerpt.en: [Root.GetName] was partly terraformed by someone thousands of years ago, but the process was interrupted for unknown reasons. The result is a highly unstable climate system and biosphere. We have located the abandoned te

excerpt.zh:
我们在沃陶姆星群内找到了一些史前古器物。沃陶姆是在大约1200万年前活跃的外星文明。虽然这个种族确切的外观已经遗失在时间的迷雾中，但我们从它们的废墟可以推断出，他们是长度约三至四米的类蠕虫环节动物。他们似乎主要通过身体节段的震动来进行沟通。

如果我们能从他们的文明遗迹中找到足够的信息，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母恒星系的位置。
excerpt.en: We have recovered artifacts from the Vultaum Star Assembly. They were an alien civilization that was active approximately 12 million years ago. Though their exact appearance has been lost in the mists of time, we have de

excerpt.zh: 我们已经发现了沃陶姆文明母恒星系的位置。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明母星系的秘密之前派科研船前去探索！
excerpt.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the Vultaum home system. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

excerpt.zh:
我们已经找到了一些来自尤特帝国的史前古器物。他们是一种大约六百万年以前占据一部分星系的外星文明。在生理上，亚特人是一种非常大而扁平的节肢类动物。一个成年亚特的体型可以长到一百米，这使得两个或者三个以上的亚特乘坐同一艘飞船进行星际旅行是一件非常罕见的事情。

如果我们能找到更多他们文明的遗物，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母恒星系的位置。
excerpt.en: We have recovered artifacts from the Yuht Empire. They were an alien civilization that inhabited a portion of the galaxy roughly six million years ago. Physically the Yuht were very large and flat arthropod analogues. A

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了失落已久的尤特文明母星系的位置。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明母星系的秘密之前派科研船去探索那里！
excerpt.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the Yuht home system. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

excerpt.zh:
我们已经找到了一些来自第一联盟的史前古器物。他们是一个大约两百万年以前和平共生的巨大外星种族邦联。在最终崩溃之前，第一联盟的国境已经囊括了很大的一部分星系。

如果我们能找到更多他们文明的遗物，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母恒星系的位置。
excerpt.en: We have recovered artifacts from the First League. They were a large confederation of alien races that co-existed in relative peace roughly two million years ago. The First League's borders may have expanded to cover a s

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了失落已久的第一联盟首都恒星系的位置，他们的大参议院就在那里。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明的秘密之前派科研船去探索那里！
excerpt.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the First League capital system, where their Great Senate was based. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

excerpt.zh:
我们已经找到了一些来自伊拉斯协约国的史前古器物。他们是一个大约一百万年以前统治一大片星系的星际政权。六肢哺乳动物伊拉斯人的免疫系统异常地脆弱，使其面对异星传染病时十分容易夭折。据称，伊拉斯人似乎是灭绝于一种称为贾沃疹的席卷全境的瘟疫。

如果我们能找到更多他们文明的遗物，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母星系的位置。
excerpt.en: We have recovered artifacts from the Irassian Concordat. They were an interstellar power that held sway over a portion of the galaxy a little over a million years ago. The six-limbed mammalian Irassians had unusually wea

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了失落已久的伊拉斯母星系的位置。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明的秘密之前派科研船去探索那里！
excerpt.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the Irassian home system. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]上找到了赛博勒克斯文明的一些史前古器物。他们是约60万年前控制部分星系的机械集群意识。他们的起源和确切的性质都笼罩在神秘的面纱中，但已知的是这个文明发动了一场针对全体有机智慧生命文明的战争。这场战争持续了好几个世纪，数以万亿计的生命死亡。

如果我们能找到更多他们文明的遗物，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母恒星系的位置。
excerpt.en: We have recovered artifacts from the Cybrex on [From.GetName]. They were a linked machine consciousness that controlled this portion of the galaxy some 600,000 years ago. Their origins and exact nature are shrouded in my

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了失落已久的赛博勒克斯母星系的位置。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明的秘密之前派科研船去探索那里！
excerpt.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the Cybrex home system. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

excerpt.zh: 早在掌握超光速旅行之前，我们从[Root.Capital.GetName]向邻近的恒星系发射了数个亚光速探测器。我们必须在它们落入敌人的手中之前先将他们回收。
excerpt.en: Several sublight exploration probes were dispatched from [Root.Capital.GetName] to neighboring systems before we had mastered FTL travel. They must be recovered before they fall into hostile hands.

excerpt.zh: 我们的外星生物学家敦促我们调查所有发现存在生物圈的星球。他们渴望更深入地了解星系中的各种外星生态系统。
excerpt.en: Our xenobiologists have urged us to survey any worlds with an active biosphere that we come across. They are eager to learn more about the diverse alien ecosystems found throughout the galaxy.

excerpt.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]的外太空生物博物馆发来请求，他们想请求帮助收集在各颗星球上鉴别出的一些稀有外星生命体。
excerpt.en: The Museum of Exobiology on [Root.Capital.GetName] has asked for help in the collection of several rare alien life forms that have been identified on various different worlds.

excerpt.zh: 自称“[radical_cult.GetName]”的极端组织正试图暗中颠覆我们，蛊惑民众信仰他们扭曲的教义。他们已经在[Root.Capital.GetName]上历兵秣马了数世纪，他们的领袖现已逃往了外太空，以继续进行反对我们的运动。
excerpt.en: Members of an extremist cult calling themselves the "[radical_cult.GetName]" are seeking to undermine our government and subvert the populace to their twisted religion. After spending centuries quietly building up their

excerpt.zh: 在动身探索星系之前，我们必须对[home_system.GetName]恒星系进行全面调查。我们必须完全了解自己的“后院”。
excerpt.en: Before venturing into the rest of the galaxy, we should conduct a full survey of the [home_system.GetName] system. Our own backyard must not be left unexplored.

excerpt.zh: 为了确保长期生存，[This.GetSpeciesName]物种需要扩张到[This.Capital.GetName]之外的地方去。建立我们的第一个殖民地，并在外星球的地表上插上[This.GetName]的旗帜。
excerpt.en: The [This.GetSpeciesName] species needs to spread beyond [This.Capital.GetName] to secure its long-term survival. Establish our first colony and plant the banner of the [This.GetName] on the surface of an alien world.

excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]的碰撞轨道上探测到了一颗体积巨大的小行星。必须在它撞击地面之前将它摧毁！
excerpt.en: A large asteroid has been detected on a collision course with [Root.GetName]. It must be destroyed before it impacts the surface!

excerpt.zh: 我们探测到了一个相对我们星系具有接近矢量的神秘亚空间信号群。看来马上有访客要来了……
excerpt.en: A mysterious cluster of subspace contacts has been detected on an approach vector with our galaxy. It would appear that we are about to receive visitors...

excerpt.zh: 一个神秘的快子信号被不明信号源发送向了整个星系。该信号异常微弱，我们无法推测这个信号的作用……也许它是有什么作用的。
excerpt.en: A mysterious tachyon signal is being transmitted throughout the entire galaxy by parties unknown. The signal is extremely faint, and we are unable to deduce its purpose... assuming it has one.

excerpt.zh: 一个休眠于我们所处星系的人工智能文明被唤醒。他们称呼自己为肃正协议，他们致力于肃清所有已知的星系文明——无论是有机文明还是其他的什么。
excerpt.en: A previously dormant AI civilization has been awakened in our galaxy. They refer to themselves as the Contingency, and are dedicated towards the sterilization of all of galactic civilization - organic or otherwise.

excerpt.zh: 我们的星系被一群贪婪的星际生物入侵了，他们意图吞食所有遇到的生命体。必须在这些索林原虫入侵者的数量超过我们之前消灭他们。
excerpt.en: Our galaxy has been invaded by a ravenous swarm of spacefaring creatures that seem intent on consuming all life in their path. The rampage of these Prethoryn invaders must be stopped before their numbers overwhelm us.

excerpt.zh: 我们的星系之中出现了巨大的空间织构裂痕，可作为连接其它次元的单向通道。奇怪的虚体飞船从中涌出，他们会从路上碰到的一切物体身上吸取能源，直到那不幸的物体失去一切能源为止。
excerpt.en: A massive tear in the fabric of space has appeared in our galaxy, acting as some sort of one-way conduit between our reality and another. Strange ethereal spacecraft are pouring in through this dimensional portal, and th

excerpt.zh: 出现了第二阵营的异次元入侵者开始出现在我们星系，攻击意愿不逊于之前一波。幸运的是，两支异次元体部队似乎也打起来了。
excerpt.en: A second faction of extradimensional invaders has appeared in our galaxy, no less hostile than the previous one. Fortunately, the extradimensionals seem to be fighting each other as well.

excerpt.zh: 来自另一个虫洞的三号阵营异次元部队出现了。他们也有意吞噬这个星系中的所有生物，但目前已与前两波入侵者陷入了苦战。
excerpt.en: A third extradimensional faction has emerged from yet another wormhole. Although they are also intent on consuming all life in our galaxy, they seem to be engaged in some kind of three-way war with the other factions fro

excerpt.zh: 方舟船将我们祖先带到这个[Root.Capital.GetName]星系，而风信子号则是我们的姐妹船。一个世纪以前，从地球出发的风信子号本来是应该跟随我们来到这里的。现在我们必须要搞清楚她到底怎么样了。
excerpt.en: The Hyacinth, a sister ship to the arkship that brought our ancestors to [Root.Capital.GetName], was meant to follow us here from Earth a century ago. We must find out what became of her.

excerpt.zh: 在我们境内侦测到奇怪的外星人出现，我们无法与其建立通讯通道。另外因为我们无法翻译他们的语言，目前只能静观其变。
excerpt.en: We have detected that the odd aliens, whose communication we cannot tap into, have appeared within our borders. Since it's impossible for us to translate their language we can only wait and see who they are and what they

excerpt.zh: 强行关闭了远古堡垒的防御系统后，我们派出了一支探索队，进去寻找阻止它重新启动的方法。
excerpt.en: Having forced a shutdown of the ancient fortress, a team of explorers has been sent to find a way of stopping it from powering back up.

excerpt.zh: 我们的研究人员发现了一些七百万年前的数据晶体，晶体内按年代顺序记录了一族被称作§Y古茹努尔§!的太空战士的事迹，以及名为§Y巴奥有机体§!的外星生命，其行星被古茹努尔所入侵。
excerpt.en: Our researchers have uncovered seven million year old datacrystals, chronicling the existence of a space-faring warrior race known as the §YGrunur§!, and the §YBaol Organism§!, an alien lifeform whose planets the Grunur

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]人口上发生的狂暴而野蛮的行为被认为是来之有因的，如果再不约束将会导致整个殖民地化为废墟。
excerpt.en: The wild and ferocious behavior of the population on [Root.GetName] is definitely caused by something, and if unchecked it may destroy the entire colony.

excerpt.zh: 我们的调查表明，一个致力于知识积累的文明残余在§H[curator_poi.GetName]§! 恒星系寻求庇护。
excerpt.en: Our investigations suggest that the remnants of a civilization dedicated to the accumulation of knowledge sought their refuge in the §H[curator_poi.GetName]§! system.

excerpt.zh: 结果证明追踪菌丝体发出的信号是件棘手的活。 我们迷茫的科学家最终定出了“通过蘑菇来一瞥更高纬度”这种假设。关于会带来什么结果的细节完全没有。不过无论如何：这项操作是成功的，并且确实把我们指向了某个目标。
excerpt.en: Tracking the signal emitted by the mycelium proved to be a tricky business. Our puzzled scientist finally managed by 'using mushrooms to peer into additional dimensions.' Details are scarce about what this entails, but i

excerpt.zh: 巨大的尼玛居住在我们的一个星球上，我们已经在他们的背上建立了一个殖民地的基础。我们将决定它们的命运。
excerpt.en: The titanic Nemma inhabit one of our worlds and we have already built the foundation of a colony on their backs. We will need to decide what to do with them.

excerpt.zh: 我们可以在其中一个殖民地上获得潜在的丰富资源，自然形成的通风孔将有价值的资源抛到到太空中。现在，我们需要决定如何处理它们。
excerpt.en: We have access to a potentially lucrative resource on one of our colonies, naturally formed vents expunging valuable resources into space. Now we need to decide on what to do with them.

excerpt.zh: 帕尔乌斯III没有有机生命，但它仍然充满了活动。这些生物是什么，它们能够被合理解释吗？
excerpt.en: Parvus III is devoid of organic life, yet it still swarms with activity. What are these creatures and can they be reasoned with?

excerpt.zh: 我们的任务是找到三颗古泽珞族核心星球。借助§H虚境§!中恩主的指引，我们试着恢复这些地方的技术废墟，用于重新稳定我们的现实与虚境之间的联系。
excerpt.en: We have been tasked with finding three ancient Zroni core worlds. Through the guidance of our benefactor in the §HShroud§!, we will attempt to restore technology lying in ruin at these locations - and restabilize the con

excerpt.zh: 在发现神秘的未叙尊者的小行星古龛之后，首席科学官认为可能还有其他关于我们——或者自以为是我们——供奉的古神宫殿存在于附近的恒星系中。
excerpt.en: After the discovery of the mysterious asteroid-shrine to the Untold, top scientists have proposed that there may be additional shrines dedicated to our - or what we believed was only our - pantheon, in neighboring system

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]理论科学委员会的主席和一架非常规科研船原型机一起消失了。

我们已经将他们的下落锁定到三个可能的地点，可以依次排查。
excerpt.en:
The Chair of the [Root.GetName]'s Abstract Sciences Board has gone missing along with an unorthodox Science Ship prototype.

Their current whereabouts have been narrowed down to three likely locations, to be investigated

excerpt.zh: 首席再次消失，但这一次他们留下了一些踪迹。
excerpt.en: The Chair has vanished again, but this time they left a trail.

excerpt.zh:
无论他们的动机是什么，必须把首席带回[Root.Capital.GetName]。

他们是要写下革命性的论文还是只受到纪律处分呢？我们拭目以待吧。
excerpt.en:
Whatever their motives may be, the Chair must be brought back to [Root.Capital.GetName].

Whether they will write a revolutionary thesis or simply face disciplinary action remains to be seen.

excerpt.zh: 为了避免[Root.Capital.GetName]上可能发生的大灾难造成严重后果，我们必须研究其他星球上的灾难都造成了什么后果。
excerpt.en: To avoid a potential apocalypse on [Root.Capital.GetName], we must study the effects that major calamities have had on other planets.

excerpt.zh: 一件外星人文物提供了一个特定星系的坐标。
excerpt.en: An alien artifact provides the coordinates for a particular system.

excerpt.zh: 消灭一个太空变形虫。
excerpt.en: Neutralize a Space Amoeba.

excerpt.zh: 再消灭4个太空变形虫，以便更好的了解这个种群的生物特性。
excerpt.en: Eliminate 4 more Space Amoebas to get a better understanding of their biology.

excerpt.zh: 摧毁一个晶态实体来获取矿物质样本。
excerpt.en: Destroy a Crystalline Entity formation to retrieve a mineral sample.

excerpt.zh: 摧毁4个晶态实体舰队来进一步获取战斗场景数据。
excerpt.en: Crush 4 Crystalline Entity fleets to gather further combat scenario data.

excerpt.zh: 试图拆解并反向组装一个采矿无人机。
excerpt.en: Disable and attempt to reverse-engineer a Mining Drone.

excerpt.zh: 消灭一个虚空之云来获取它的原始星质。
excerpt.en: Neutralize a Void Cloud to sift through its primordial star-stuff.

excerpt.zh:
一群自称为“星际绑架者”的海盗关押了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]私人运输飞船的船员。

我们想在海盗们提出条件之前就救出他们。
excerpt.en:
A band of pirates calling themselves the "Ransomeers" have kidnapped the crew of a [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] private transport vessel.

We intend to free them before the pirates can make any demands.

excerpt.zh: 使用古代采矿无人机的评估系统中的技术，我们定位了一些矿产资源丰富的天体。
excerpt.en: Using techniques derived from the Ancient Mining Drones' assessment systems, we have pin-pointed a handful of stellar bodies that are likely to be particularly rich in minerals.

excerpt.zh:
所有的虚空之云在量子层面上都是相连的；这些散发能源的个体样本很可能就是一个单独的亚空间实体的多个表示形式。

对一个虚空之云进行了仔细研究之后，我们找到了其他可能富含这些云的星系。
excerpt.en:
All Void Clouds are entangled with one another on the quantum level; it is possible that the energies animating the individual specimens are nothing but multiple instances of a singular sub-space entity.

Through careful

excerpt.zh: 领导太空时代的十字军对抗[parameter:heathens.GetName]。
excerpt.en: Lead a crusade against the [parameter:heathens.GetName].

excerpt.zh:
千年之前，某舰队里的成员背弃了盟约，将枪口对准了彼此。在知己知彼的情况下，盟友的飞船顷刻之间就被消灭了，只留下了失去压力的飞船外壳。

我们收集了足够的信息，可以对这些舰队残骸在宇宙中缓慢漂移的过程进行建模。
excerpt.en: Millennia ago, treachery saw a fleet of allied ships turn on each other. With swift strikes to critical systems and known weak points in the hull designs, the formerly allied crews were wiped out with ruthless efficiency

excerpt.zh: 寻找异常辐射读数。
excerpt.en: In search for odd radiation readings.

records.zh: 泛星系贸易市场的成立

excerpt.zh: 国际贸易论坛即将成立，而其中央贸易空间站的控制者必将从中获益。[GetMarketFoundingChainEnd]
excerpt.en: The establishment of an international commercial forum is nigh, and whoever controls the centralized exchange station stands to benefit.[GetMarketFoundingChainEnd]

excerpt.zh: 国际贸易论坛即将成立，而其中央贸易空间站的控制者必将从中获益。[GetMarketFoundingChainEnd]
excerpt.en: The establishment of an international commercial forum is nigh, and whoever controls the centralized exchange station stands to benefit.[GetMarketFoundingChainEnd]

excerpt.zh: 由其中一位创造者隐藏在远古克隆仓内的基因编码密码向我们揭示了两条道路：重获繁育能力但放弃部分力量，或永远告别自然繁育以到达新的生物学巅峰。
excerpt.en: The hidden bio-code cipher, left by one of the Creators within the Ancient Clone Vats, revealed to us two paths: to reclaim our fertility and forgo part of our strength, or to forever forsake natural reproduction to reac

excerpt.zh: 在§H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§!恒星系发现的一颗完全被缇扬奇尸体覆盖了的行星。想研究这一怪异的埋葬地，我们必须先解决它的守墓人。
excerpt.en: A planet entirely covered in the bodies of dead Tiyanki has been found in the §H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§! system. In order to study this unusual burial ground, we must first deal with its gravekeepers.

excerpt.zh: 防止人工智能例程凌驾于现有保护措施之上。
excerpt.en: Prevent AI routines from overriding existing safeguards.

excerpt.zh: 有些东西正在破土而出感染我们的殖民地！
excerpt.en: Something is burrowing out of the ground and infesting our colony!

excerpt.zh: 我们的一艘舰船迷失于虚境之中。
excerpt.en: One of our vessels has been lost to the Shroud.

excerpt.zh: 由于我们取回了坠毁的运奴飞船上的数据，现在我们已经找到了前家园星球的星系坐标。我们的人民迫不及待地渴望踏上返乡的旅程。
excerpt.en: With the data retrieved from the crashed slaver ship, we have pinpointed the galactic coordinates of our former home worlds. Our people are clamoring for a return.

excerpt.zh: 我们已经找到了弥那玛特种实业集团的星系坐标。
excerpt.en: We have learned the galactic coordinates of Minamar Specialized Industries.

excerpt.zh:
我们与一位名为§H虚空之低语§!的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着莫测的感觉，它索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果将我们的行为与超主保持一致，这条纽带将更容易被加强。

低语享受新的知识、沉默的秘密和阴谋。祂们陶醉于一种简单的快乐，这种快乐充满了头脑，在接缝处开裂。
excerpt.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the §HWhisperers in the Void§!. Unfathomable, it granted us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that t

excerpt.zh:
我们与一个名为§H世界之喰煞§!的虚境实体建立了纽带。祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

喰煞无厌而饥渴。祂渴望战争、冲突和哀嚎的甜美。
excerpt.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the §HEater of Worlds§!. Insatiable, it granted us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond c

excerpt.zh:
我们与一位名为§H生命之织缕§!的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着荫蔽的感觉，祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

织缕渴求基因操控和将血肉从进化的桎梏中解脱。祂教导我们对敬畏生命和自然，以及血肉的神圣性。
excerpt.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the §HComposer of Strands§!. Sheltering, it granted us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bo

excerpt.zh:
我们与一个名为§H渴求之器具§!的虚境实体建立了纽带。祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

器具渴求着渴求本身。沉溺享乐、腐化和奴役便是器具的别名。
excerpt.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the §HInstrument of Desire§!. Pampering, it granted us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bo

excerpt.zh: 微小昆虫的集群突然集体爆发，席卷了整个[myrmeku_planet.GetName]大地。
excerpt.en: Swarms of tiny insects have sprung into action, sweeping across the [myrmeku_planet.GetName] landscape.

excerpt.zh: 太空兽群会将我们的§Y种荚§!带到遥远的土地。只要一抹星光，我们的种子就能绽放为新的殖民地。
excerpt.en: Spaceborne fauna will carry our §YSeed Pods§! to distant lands. With a touch of starlight, our seeds can bloom into a new colony.

excerpt.zh: 战争时期，我们的§Y种荚§!可以绽放成为陆军，随时保卫我们的殖民地或者入侵遥远的目标。
excerpt.en: In times of war, our §YSeed Pods§! can blossom into armies, ready to defend our colonies or to invade distant targets.

excerpt.zh: 我门已经定位了适合建造第二座电弧熔炉的理想恒星系。
excerpt.en: We have located an ideal system in which to build a second Arc Furnace.

excerpt.zh: 我们已经得到了誊录仪——一件外星文物——的最后已知坐标，其位于一个我们从未探测到的恒星系。虽然我们还不清楚这件文物的意义，但是据说它蕴含巨大的能量。
excerpt.en: We have uncovered the last known location of the Rubricator, an ancient alien artifact, in a previously uncharted system. Though we do not yet know its purpose, it is rumored to hold great power.

excerpt.zh: 我们已经得到了誊录仪——一件外星文物——的最后已知坐标，其位于一个我们从未探测到的恒星系。虽然我们还不清楚这件文物的意义，但是据说它蕴含巨大的能量。
excerpt.en: We have uncovered the last known location of the Rubricator, an ancient alien artifact, in a previously uncharted system. Though we do not yet know its purpose, it is rumored to hold great power.

excerpt.zh: 星辰不过是我们饥渴的燃料，灾难只是我们野心绽放的土壤。我们将违逆自然法则，锻造一头巨大而不可阻挡到能重塑宇宙的巨兽。
excerpt.en: The stars are but fuel for our hunger, and calamity is merely the soil where our ambition blooms. We shall defy the natural order, forging a beast so immense, so unstoppable, that it will reshape the cosmos.

excerpt.zh:
有一只巨大的虚空孳孽正在星系中横冲直撞。它想要猎杀巨型生物，如果我们替它解决了这些目标，它可能就会放过我们。

目标：寻找并消灭星系中所有四级噬天巨兽。
excerpt.en:
There's a big voidspawn plowing through the galaxy. It wants to kill big behemoths and presumably, if we kill them for it, it might leave us alone.

OBJECTIVE: Find and Kill all tier 4 Behemoths in the galaxy.

excerpt.zh:
随着心智融合的完成，我们的雄心已经近在咫尺了。我们必须适应新的共同身体，并不断转移人民的心智，但更重要的是，我们需要粉碎任何可能的竞争者，无论他们是谁。

§H目标§!：
—寻找并击杀星系中其他所有的4级噬天巨兽。
—完成生长痛局势
—击杀远古虚空孳孽
excerpt.en: With the Mind Meld complete, only a few more steps lie between us and our ambitions. We must grow accustomed to our new shared body and keep transferring the minds of our people, but more importantly we'll need to crush

excerpt.zh:
[GetInvadersLower]攻击了我们数十年。我们的深空擎天堡 I是第一道防线，但只有解开这些敌人的谜团才能真正带来安全。

每个发现都会带我们向着最终的目标推进，我们终将可以发起反抗，终结我们长久以来的围城。
excerpt.en:
The [GetInvadersLower] have attacked us for decades. Our Deep Space Citadel I stands as the first line of defense, but true safety will only be won by uncovering the truth about our enemies.

With each discovery, we move

excerpt.zh:
我们又离揭开传送门的奥秘近了一步。尽管还是无法穿越，但我们现在已经拥有了发展必要科技所需的洞见

想要反抗这些敌人，我们需要§Y虫洞稳定§!。
excerpt.en:
We are one step closer to unlocking the portal's mysteries. Though passage is not yet possible, we now have the insight needed to develop the necessary technology.

To bring our fight to the enemy, we require §YWormhole

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了敌人的老巢，但是要揭开他们的秘密就要直面他们的防御。

这会是一场恶仗，但在这之后我们最终将能探索§Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!恒星系。
excerpt.en:
We have found the cradle of our enemy, but to unlock their secrets it will be necessary to confront their defenses.

The battle will not be easy, but in its aftermath we will at last be free to explore the §Y[event_targe

excerpt.zh:
§Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!恒星系内的[GetInvadersLower]被清除干净了，但这里的情况却出乎我们的意料。

曾经在我们土地上肆虐的敌人现在只剩下一颗饱受摧残的星球。
excerpt.en:
The [GetInvadersLower] have been purged from the §Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§! system, but the situation here is very different from what we expected.

All that remains of our tormentors is an apparently decimated

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一座远古庇护所的残骸，它属于一个兴盛于数百万年前的不存在于我们任何记录中的文明，仿佛就像被精心地从历史中抹除了一般。如果进行调查，也许就能搞明白个中缘由。
excerpt.en: We have found the remnants of an ancient shelter, belonging to an civilization that thrived millions of years ago - a civilization that appears nowhere else in our records, as if it was meticulously scrubbed from history

excerpt.zh: 我们需要跟随一条线索去揭开关于这个怪异古老文明的终极命运的秘密，无论这条线索通向何方。
excerpt.en: To understand the fate of this strange and ancient civilization, we must follow a string of clues. Wherever they may lead.

excerpt.zh: 为了再创新高，感受欢愉以及挑战我们的极限，我们现在开始一系列试炼。欢乐时间到！
excerpt.en: To reach new heights, to know joy and to test our limits, we now embark on a series of trials. Let the fun begin!

excerpt.zh: 我们一直在挑战极限。在前人事迹的鼓舞下，我们现在有机会塑造自己梦想的风暴。
excerpt.en: We have always pushed the limits. Inspired by the deeds of our predecessors, we now have the chance to sculpt the storm of our dreams.

excerpt.zh: 灾难的阴影时刻威胁着这颗独特行星之上的脆弱平衡。
excerpt.en: Disaster threatens to shatter the fragile balance of this unique planet.

excerpt.zh: 一艘不祥的飞船出现在我们的传感器上——但它正处于宇宙风暴之中。那里发生了什么？
excerpt.en: An ominous vessel has appeared on sensors - but only within the cosmic storms. What could be at play here?

records.zh: 我们发现一颗行星表面覆盖着密密麻麻数以兆计的红色昆虫。这对于我们而言究竟是灾疫还是机遇呢？
records.en: We found a planet carpeted in trillions of red insects. A plague, or an opportunity?

excerpt.zh: 猩红爬虫
excerpt.en: Crimson Crawlers

excerpt.zh: 在调查完[From.Planet.GetName]后，我们发现了一种奇特的生物。我们应该怎么办呢？
excerpt.en: After a survey of [From.Planet.GetName], a strange creature was discovered. What will we do with it?

excerpt.zh:
无知正在束缚着我们，让我们无从一窥大千世界之奥秘。

无论付出什么代价，我们都要挣脱束缚。

§R失落帝国会试图阻止我们！§!
excerpt.en:
Ignorance shackles us, putting the universe's secrets out of reach.

No matter the price, we must break free.

§RFallen Empires will try to stop us!§!

excerpt.zh:
离开的时刻到了。为了谱写我们自己的“出谷记”，需要派出视界刺针接上我们所有的人民。

为了将我们整个文明搭载到§H视界刺针§!，必须：
    —依次访问我们所有的所有殖民地，§H搭载§!其中的人口
    —返回我们的首都§H搭载§!最后一批人民。
    —前往一个黑洞并§H深潜§!进入。

§R警告§!：视界刺针没有任何武器，需要被严密保护。

§g要搭载人口或深潜入黑洞，需先选择视界刺针，然后右键点击殖民地/黑洞并选择对应的舰船
excerpt.en:
The time of our departure has come. In preparation for the great exodus, the Horizon Needle will be sent to welcome our people onboard.

To embark our entire civilization the §HHorizon Needle§! must:
    -Visit every col

excerpt.zh:
我们不安于自然所给予的现状，努力地超越了有机躯体的极限。全面铺开的植入体应用只遭遇了微不足道的问题，并且都已逐一迎刃而解。绝大多数人口为全新的义体所带来的一切感到欣喜若狂。

我们正站在成就伟大的大门前，未来可期。
excerpt.en: We refuse to settle for what nature provided, and instead strive to exceed the limits of the organic body. Our full-scale distribution of implants has encountered only minor issues, all of which can be easily resolved. T

excerpt.zh:
将所有人口进行合成化是一项巨大的工程。这必然会引起反响。在适应新常态的过程中，无数的挑战和独特的机遇无疑将影响我们日常的生活。

面对这些变化的态度将决定我们未来的社会。
excerpt.en: Synthesization of an entire population is an undertaking of monumental proportions. There are bound to be repercussions. As we adapt to the new normal, untold challenges and unique opportunities will undoubtedly affect o

excerpt.zh:
初步报告显示§Y[From.GetName]§!上的海洋从某种程度上来说居然是活的，其中包含着一种我们从来都没见过的外星实体。

我们应当建立一座低轨研究前哨来研究将这片活体海洋。我们预期可以获得进展。
excerpt.en:
Preliminary reports suggest the ocean covering §Y[From.GetName]§! is somehow alive, comprising an alien entity unlike any we've encountered before.

We should establish a low-orbit research outpost to study the living se

excerpt.zh: 研究居住在三个相连星系中的垃圾堆隧道里的奇特智慧生物，或许可以更加了解这个曾经拥有这些星球的星际文明。
excerpt.en: Studying the strange sapients that live in tunnels in the junk heaps of three linked systems might yield insight into the lost interstellar civilization that once ruled these worlds.

excerpt.zh:
我们已经获悉在星系边缘的某个地方有一个神秘的星团。我们只能通过§HL-星门§!到达该星团，这是一种在特定恒星系中发现的人造亚空间入口。

这些星门已经被人蓄意地关闭了，并且现在我们对解除禁制所需要的亚空间原理缺乏足够的理解。
excerpt.en:
We have learned of a mysterious star cluster somewhere just beyond the periphery of our galaxy. It can only be accessed through §HL-Gates§!, artificial subspace portals found in certain systems.

These Gateways have been

excerpt.zh: 一个早已消逝的外星物种的巨型世代舰船，其导航设备中可能藏有一颗完美星球的坐标。
excerpt.en: A massive generation ship belonging to a long dead race of aliens may hold the encrypted location of a utopian planet within its navigational drive.

excerpt.zh: 能量辐射
excerpt.en: Energy Emissions

excerpt.zh: 我们的母星周围最近出现了负相物质。这种奇怪的现象肯定不是动摇我们社会根基的事情的预兆。
excerpt.en: Negative Mass has recently appeared around our homeworld. The strange phenomenon surely won't be a herald of something that will shake our society's very core.

excerpt.zh: §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上找回的残损方舟上收集有一些复杂的数学证明，被称为《历代志》。我们对其展开研究，只旨在进一步地了解邓德里人所寻找的天堂星球§Y新布拉图雅§!。
excerpt.en: By studying the "Chronicles", a collection of complex mathematical proofs recovered from the wrecked arkship on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!, we aim to learn more about the paradise planet sought by the Dendritians, §YNew B

excerpt.zh: §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上的一台毁坏的环境改造装置残骸依旧在向星系中的多个地点发出信号。调查这些地点可以揭开更多关于这项危险科技的秘密。
excerpt.en: The remains of a destructive terraforming device on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! continue to emit a signal to multiple locations across the galaxy. Investigating these sites will reveal more information about this dangerous

excerpt.zh: 我们已经发现了我们过去的施恩者的蛛丝马迹。这条线索的末路会通往什么样的结局呢？
excerpt.en: We've found a trail that could belong to the Benefactors of our past. What will we find at the end of this trail?

excerpt.zh: 我们或许可以追踪到那场远古灾厄的元凶——无情者。不过时间过了这么久，我们真的能推算出具体位置吗？
excerpt.en: We may be able to track the legendary scourge of the past - the Relentless. Will there be a reckoning, long since overdue?

excerpt.zh: 我们在[from.System.GetName]星系发现了一个不寻常的优美星球。这个星球很适合殖民，但是有个问题值得考虑：谁设计了它，为什么这么做？
excerpt.en: We encountered an unusually picturesque world in the [from.System.GetName] system. It's ideal for colonization, but it seems prudent to ask: who designed it, and why?

excerpt.zh: 色彩鲜艳的卷须状云团聚集在我国首都星系周围。我们的盟友报告称在他们首都也出现了类似效应。是什么导致了这些现象？
excerpt.en: Brightly-colored tendrils of cloud have gathered around the starbase in our capital system. Our allies report similar effects at their capitals. What's causing these phenomena?

excerpt.zh: 我们的联邦境内，至少有一颗行星发出震耳欲聋的嗡嗡声。由于我们的同事正在努力挖掘这一遗迹，他们要求我们提供自己的科学资源支持其工作。
excerpt.en: A deafening hum rings out across at least one planet in our federation's space. As our colleagues work to excavate these sites, we have been asked to lend our own scientific resources to the effort.

records.zh: 联邦团结暨伟大领导盛典
records.en: A Celebration of Unity and Great Leadership

excerpt.zh: 一项联合行动已经开始，[Root.Federation.GetName]成员国将以此庆祝其强有力的领导并推动意识形态上的团结。
excerpt.en: A joint operation has been launched between members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] to celebrate its strong leadership and push for greater ideological unity.

excerpt.zh: 作为技术领先的敌人发动无端侵略的受害者，我们学到了疏忽大意会付出的代价。这种事情不会再发生了。
excerpt.en: As the victim of an unprovoked act of aggression by a technologically superior foe, we understand the cost of negligence. Never again.

excerpt.zh: 前 MSI 战舰将得到修复，为我们所用。
excerpt.en: MSI's former warship will be restored to serve our purposes.

excerpt.zh:
我们的前主人声称我们亏欠他们战争赔款。他们已经雇佣了一个星际债务回收机构来处理此事。

[root.GetDebtCollectorsDeal]

§L收债人将在§Y[root.payback_debt_collectors_timer]§!访问我们。§!
excerpt.en:
Our former masters claim we owe them war reparations. An intergalactic debt collection agency has been hired to settle the matter.

[root.GetDebtCollectorsDeal]
