excerpt.zh:
前入侵者为我们建造的§Y基因诊所§!已经年久失修。其中的大部分科技超出了我们目前的认知，但我们还是可以试着§S修复§!一下。

§L与其他的帝国签订科研协议将会提高我们成功的概率。[GetAgreementStatus]§!
excerpt.en:
The §YGene Clinics§! our invaders built for us are suffering from lack of maintenance. While most of the technology is beyond our current understanding, we could try to §Srepair§! it.

§LSigning research pacts with other

excerpt.zh:
我们与一艘在[cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName]的科研船[this.GetName]失去了联系。

最后的通讯表明他们当时正在调查一颗附近的小行星，[cutholoid_under_radar.GetName]。

建议靠近这个恒星系的话一定要小心点。
excerpt.en:
We have lost communication with our science ship [this.GetName] in [cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName].

Their last transmission indicated they were beginning a survey on a nearby asteroid, [cutholoid_under_rada

excerpt.zh: 在星系中世世代代的海盗们把他们的不义之财藏在精心安放的宝库中。许多秘密宝藏都被遗弃或被认为已经丢失，但现在它们是我们的囊中之物了。
excerpt.en: Throughout this galaxy's history, pirates have hidden their ill-gotten gains in carefully placed Treasure Troves. Many of those secret caches were abandoned and considered lost, but now they are ours for the taking.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一张神秘的星图，于是决定踏上最伟大的冒险之旅。谁知道§H星国图志§!的尽头隐藏着什么，以及我们在旅途中会遇到什么危险。
excerpt.en: After discovering a mysterious map to the stars, we embarked on our greatest adventure. Who knows what lies at the end of the §HCelestial Chart§!, and what dangers we may face on our journey.

excerpt.zh:
星系中的虚空虫数量已达到无法继续维持的水平，必须将其彻底消灭。

我们已经找到了所有剩余的§Y虚空虫巢穴§!，必须将其摧毁。
excerpt.en:
The Voidworm population in the galaxy has reached unsustainable levels, and they must be eradicated.

We have located all remaining §YVoidworm Nests§! that must be destroyed.

excerpt.zh:
某种未知的存在在设法接触我们，它的轻声呢喃来自某处，在那里时间与空间扭曲成结。

它渴望我们，它深爱我们。
excerpt.en:
Something has reached out to us, from a place where time and space are shrunk to a knot.

It desires us.

excerpt.zh: 时间不能双向流动，这是毫无疑问的。缠绕着宇宙的巨蛇，用它那比我们母星还大的双眼暗中窥视，这样的传说也纯属无稽之谈。不过，最近有越来越多这样的无稽之谈化为现实了。
excerpt.en: It's unlikely that time can run both ways. It's unlikely that there's a cosmic serpent twined round the universe, gazing in with eyes bigger than our whole species. On the other hand, a number of unlikely things have hap

excerpt.zh:
这个文明正站在命运的十字路口：其恒星系中央的红巨星正在持续升温，炙烤着他们的家园。

在找到原因并解决之前，他们是否能适应这恶劣的环境？或选择拥抱这股炙热之力，将那诡异、甚至可能不自然的变化化为己用？
excerpt.en:
This civilization is at a crossroads: the Red Giant at the heart of its system is warming up their planet, threatening to cook them alive.

Can they adapt until the cause is found and fixed, or will they decide to embrac

excerpt.zh:
许多隐藏的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]族群可能像我们曾经那样散布在银河系中，以冻存形式保存着。

档案记录了这些星球的位置，但自那时起已有整颗恒星诞生与消亡，要定位它们现在需要复杂的插值法。
excerpt.en:
Numerous hidden [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] populations may be scattered across the galaxy, preserved in stasis as we once were.

The archives recorded these worlds' positions, but with entire stars born and lost since,

excerpt.zh: 我们已决定以烈焰开辟未来，准备将整个星系没于烈火之中。
excerpt.en: We have decided that the future is wreathed in flame, and are moving to set the entire galaxy on fire.

excerpt.zh: 知道许多知识是策展人的本业。我们可以买到信息，但是要用他们的知识做些什么则取决于我们自己。
excerpt.en: It is the Curator's business to know things. We may buy information, but it is up to us to make something of their knowledge.

excerpt.zh: 一个不断发出神秘光线的金属球体正在环绕§Y卡冈都亚黑洞§!。它现在毫无动静，但会一直保持毫无动静么？
excerpt.en: A glistening metal orb sits by the §YGargantua Black Hole§!. It is silent for now, but will it be so forever?

excerpt.zh:
我们已经失去了生育能力。母星上到处都是废弃的教育中心，游乐场空无一人。我们因衰老而消亡几乎只是时间问题。现在，我们只能寄希望于我们人格仓库里的数据库存了。

我们必须发展足够复杂的合成框架和正电子脑，才有可能返回物理世界。
excerpt.en: We have lost the ability to procreate. Our homeworld is littered with abandoned educational centers. Playgrounds stand empty. It is only a matter of time before the last of us expires. For now, our hope lies in the digit

excerpt.zh: 塞塔娜的真正目的大白天下了。她癫狂想除一切身体上的苦痛，“上传”所有感性生物的意识，消灭我们所知的一切生命。无论如何，我们必须找到能阻止她疯狂野心的力量。
excerpt.en: The true intentions of Cetana are at last made clear. In a monstrous bid to end physical suffering, she plans to 'upload' the consciousness of every sentient being, eradicating life as we know it. Somehow, we must find t

excerpt.zh: 在星系的各个角落点亮起了神秘的信标，向塞塔娜女王汇报着自己的位置。这应该是什么东西，或是什么人正在等待着她的归来。
excerpt.en: All across the galaxy, mysterious beacons light up, signalling their position to Queen Cetana. It is as if something - or someone - was waiting for her return.

excerpt.zh:
我们目睹了塞塔娜的首都和她的前哨之间繁忙的交通。这些运输队的防御能力低于她的主要舰队，他们更容易受到攻击。攻击这些舰队或前哨本身可以挖掘出有关她计划的宝贵情报。

为此，我们给军用舰队准备了几个特殊项目。
excerpt.en: We've witnessed heavy traffic between Cetana's capital and her outposts. These convoys have lower defensive capabilities than her main fleets, leaving them vulnerable. Attacking these or the outposts themselves could yie

excerpt.zh:
在追寻神圣的召唤时，我们将实现崇高身体与神圣义体技术的融合。没有任何事物能阻挡我们通往启迪之路。

融合即神圣。强化物即崇拜。
excerpt.en:
In pursuing the divine calling, we shall achieve the fusion of the exalted body and sacred cybernetics. Nothing shall hinder our path to enlightenment.

To fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.

excerpt.zh: 离经叛道、扰乱人心的公开展览点饰着[owner.GetName]的日常。他们的出发点看上去是好的，艺术上极具表现力——但是这种艺术对于我们社会更广泛的层面会造成什么样的影响呢？
excerpt.en: Day-to-day life in the [owner.GetName] is colored by eccentric and disruptive public displays. Their purpose appears benign, and artistically expressive - but what influence might this art have on our wider society?

excerpt.zh:
命运之重张牙舞爪，我们在悬崖边缘战战兢兢，其下是血一般的未来。

当我们凝视着深渊时，深渊中只有我们在回望着自己。
excerpt.en:
We balance over the chasm of a bloody future as the gravity of destiny claws at us.

As we gaze into the abyss, we see only ourselves staring back.

excerpt.zh:
一套早已过期的秘密代码刚刚被重新传送到了我方，这涉及到我们在§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!已经开展的行动。

某个我们曾经除名的情报人员正试图汇报，此人宣称携带了关于一个位于[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]的§H关键政治人物§!情报的标记——但是，这些早已作废的代码能够信任吗？
excerpt.en:
A long-expired set of covert codes has been re-transmitted to us, linked to Operations we previously carried out in the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!.

A once-disavowed operative is apparently trying to report ba

excerpt.zh: 随着在§Y[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!上安装了[GetStartingDrive]，我们的工程[GetCrew]已完成对方舟舰上的老化系统的全面检查，以为真正的星际旅行做准备。目前已在舰船各处发现多处故障。
excerpt.en: With the installation of the [GetStartingDrive] aboard the §Y[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!, our engineering [GetCrew] have completed a comprehensive inspection of the Arkship's aging systems in preparation for true inte

records.zh: 冠军之铸现场秀！比武会

excerpt.zh: 几十年过去了，一场新的锦标赛即将拉开帷幕。派你的舰队进入聚光灯下，向星系证明你的智慧、力量和决心。
excerpt.en: Decades have passed, and a new tournament is about to begin. Send your fleets into the spotlight and prove to the galaxy your wit, might, and determination.

excerpt.zh: 星系是一个美丽的地方，值得我们去保护。这里有无数的民族、希望和梦想，每一个都值得被守护。我们不寻求权力，只求和平。但和平必须得到捍卫。对于那些想要征服、毁灭或腐蚀和平的人，我们将挺身而出。只要我们屹立不倒，星系也将永存。
excerpt.en: The galaxy is a beautiful place, worth preserving. A place of countless peoples, hopes, and dreams, each one deserving of protection. We do not seek power, only peace. But peace must be defended. Against those who would

excerpt.zh:
我们若忽视这些迹象，那将是愚蠢的。这个星系中存在着邪恶势力，它们会毁掉我们努力保护的一切。我们不能坐等风暴爆发。我们必须准备好行动。

让那些威胁这个星系的人知道：我们一定会找到他们。

§H目标§!：
—消灭所有危机帝国
—击败两次终末危机
—辞去监管人职位
excerpt.en:
We would be foolish to ignore the signs. There are forces of evil in this galaxy that would unmake all we strive to protect. We cannot wait for the storm to break. We must be prepared to act.

Let those who threaten this

excerpt.zh: 时刻已到。新的可汗即将选出。为了结束流亡，我们必须证明自己。
excerpt.en: It is time. A new Khan will be declared. To end our exile we must prove ourselves.

excerpt.zh:
§Y神圣遗址§!在祖先星图上皆有标注；它们是星系的奇观，由我们一族的先行者所发现。

探寻这些地方，并查明它们为何对我们的祖先如此重要，是我们的生来享有的权利。

随着我们开拓前进的道路，我们或许可以在拥有神圣遗址的星系中建立§Y驿站§!。
excerpt.en:
The §YSacred Sites§! are marked in the ancestral star charts; wonders of the galaxy, discovered by those who came before us.

It is our birthright to seek out these places, and find out why they were so important to our

excerpt.zh: §Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!在维护作业期间，底层甲板发现了一个未登记且经过重重加固的容器，该容器正发出放射性信号。由于缺乏档案记录或识别标记，其来源和用途尚不明确。
excerpt.en: During maintenance operations aboard §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!, an unregistered, heavily reinforced container emitting radioactive signals was discovered on a lower deck. The lack of archival records or identifying mark

excerpt.zh: 来自方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!的报告显示，船员中出现了轻微的行为异常，表现为社交活动增多以及士气高涨。这些变化的潜在原因尚不明确。
excerpt.en: Reports from Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! indicate minor behavioral irregularities among the crew, marked by increased socialization and elevated morale. The underlying cause of these changes remains unclear.

excerpt.zh: §Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!内部存在一个未记录在案的次级甲板层，这引发了令人不安的疑虑。其用途尚不明确，且所有关于其内部情况的现有记录均已被刻意抹除。
excerpt.en: The existence of an undocumented sub-level within §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! raises troubling questions. Its purpose remains unknown, and all available records of what lies within have been deliberately erased.

excerpt.zh: 自从进入一片异常星云以来，§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的船员们便开始遭受记忆丢失的困扰。这一现象的原因目前仍然不明。
excerpt.en: Since entering an unusual nebula, those aboard §Y[Root.GetName]§! have begun to suffer from memory loss. The cause of this phenomenon remains unknown.

excerpt.zh: 从一个遥远的黑洞系统中探测到了一个来源不明的结构化信号。我们必须展开调查。
excerpt.en: A structured signal of unknown origin has been detected from a distant black hole system. We must investigate.

excerpt.zh: 最近的报告显示，一种入侵性真菌物种已在§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!的整个水培舱室扩散。该真菌具有抗药性，难以遏制，正威胁着粮食生产。
excerpt.en: Recent reports indicate that an invasive fungal species has spread throughout the hydroponics decks of §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!, resisting containment and threatening food production.

excerpt.zh: 前往目标帝国的恒星系并进行正式外交接触。
excerpt.en: Travel to the target empire's home system and conduct a formal diplomatic engagement.

excerpt.zh: 联合星，我们终于有了关于秋菊号下落的线索。我们必须去看看我们的姐妹舰如今以何处为家。
excerpt.en: We finally have a lead on where the Chrysanthemum ended up, Unity. We must see where our sister ship now calls home.

excerpt.zh: 该恒星系中有可采集的高价值矿物。
excerpt.en: There are valuable Minerals in this system that can be harvested.

excerpt.zh: 采集该恒星系中的可用能量。
excerpt.en: Harvest the available Energy in this system.

excerpt.zh: 收集该恒星系内可用的消费品。
excerpt.en: Collect the Consumer Goods available in this system.

excerpt.zh: 可以从该恒星系收集高价值的合金。
excerpt.en: Valuable Alloys can be harvested from this system.

excerpt.zh: 该恒星系中可以找到罕见的易爆微粒。
excerpt.en: Rare Volatile Motes can be found in this system.

excerpt.zh: 这里可以找到罕见的异星天然气。应当采集它们。
excerpt.en: Rare Exotic Gases can be found here. They should be harvested.

excerpt.zh: 该恒星系已探测到稀有水晶。采集它们。
excerpt.en: Rare Crystals have been detected in this system. Harvest them.

excerpt.zh: 根据扫描结果，该恒星系中存在活体金属。
excerpt.en: According to scans, there is Living Metal in this system.

excerpt.zh: 这里可以收获纳米机器人。
excerpt.en: There are Nanites here that can be acquired.

excerpt.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批£energy£ §Y能量币§!。
excerpt.en: Our engineers suspect that there is an £energy£ §YEnergy Credits§! cache in this system.

excerpt.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批£minerals£ §Y矿物§!。
excerpt.en: Our engineers suspect that there is a £minerals£ §YMinerals§! cache in this system.

excerpt.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批£alloys£ §Y合金§!。
excerpt.en: Our engineers suspect that there is an £alloys£ §YAlloys§! cache in this system.

excerpt.en: $contract_scientific_observation_internal_desc$

excerpt.zh: $contract_scientific_observation_internal_desc$
excerpt.en: $contract_scientific_observation_internal_desc$

excerpt.zh: 我们将进入轨道，让乘客们沉浸在陌生太阳的光辉之中。
excerpt.en: We'll settle into orbit and let the passengers soak in the light of an unfamiliar sun.

excerpt.zh: 乘客中的业余天文学家发现了该星系中罕见的太阳活动，目前正在请愿要求在驻留轨道期间获得前排的观赏位置。
excerpt.en: Amateur astronomers among the passengers have spotted rare solar activity in this system and are petitioning for a front-row viewing from orbit.

excerpt.zh: 巡游舰正在举办一场围绕该星系恒星的穿梭机比赛。乘客们纷纷下注，挤满了每一个舷窗。
excerpt.en: The cruise is hosting a shuttle race around this system's star. Passengers are placing bets and crowding every viewport.

excerpt.zh: 疗愈中心需要长时间暴露在未经过滤的恒星辐射下，以进行乘客们一直要求的一种奇特的焕新理疗。
excerpt.en: The spa requires prolonged exposure to unfiltered stellar radiation for an exotic rejuvenation treatment the passengers have been requesting.

excerpt.zh: 一场盛大的正式舞会将在观景甲板上举行，沐浴在直射的星光下。这是此次航程中的社交盛事。
excerpt.en: A grand formal ball is to be held on the observation decks, bathed in direct starlight. The social event of the voyage.

excerpt.zh: 在主发电机进行计划维护期间，我们需要环绕该星系的恒星运行，并依靠太阳能供电。
excerpt.en: We need to orbit this system's star and run on solar power while the main generators undergo scheduled maintenance.

excerpt.zh: 外层船体板需要在持续的恒星照射下进行热荷载测试。为确保安全，朝向恒星一侧的所有舷窗都将被遮蔽。
excerpt.en: The outer hull plating requires thermal load testing under sustained stellar exposure. All viewports on the starward side will be shuttered for safety.

excerpt.zh: 冷却系统需要在热负载下进行一次完整的排空循环。近恒星轨道能让我们高效地冲洗管线，尽管甲板温度会出现波动。
excerpt.en: The coolant system needs a full purge cycle under thermal load. Close stellar orbit will let us flush the lines efficiently, though deck temperatures will fluctuate.

excerpt.zh: 导航阵列必须在近距离根据实时恒星信号进行校准。此过程将占用娱乐系统的带宽。
excerpt.en: Navigation arrays must be calibrated against a live stellar signature at close range. The process will commandeer bandwidth from entertainment systems.

excerpt.zh: 水循环系统需要进行一次高强度的紫外线杀菌，此过程只有在近恒星轨道上才能高效完成。疗愈中心与游泳池现已关闭，各层甲板均实行限量供水。
excerpt.en: The water recyclers need an intensive UV sterilization run that is only efficient in close stellar orbit. The spa and pool are closed and water is rationed across all decks.

excerpt.zh: 乘客们渴望踏上坚实的土地，去探索下方的外星城市。我们已经安排了由向导带领的进城游览。
excerpt.en: The passengers are eager to set foot on solid ground and explore the alien city below. We've arranged guided excursions into the city.

excerpt.zh: 下方星球上的著名餐饮区已同意接待乘客，为他们举办一场由向导带领的当地美食品鉴之旅。
excerpt.en: The renowned dining districts on the planet below have agreed to host the passengers for a guided tasting tour of local cuisine.

excerpt.zh: 该星球的首都设有一座享誉星系的博物馆。乘客们一直在请愿，要求安排带有导游的游览活动，以参观其中的纪念碑和历史展品。
excerpt.en: The planet's capital hosts a museum of galactic renown. Passengers have been petitioning for a guided tour of its monuments and historical exhibits.

excerpt.zh: 地表上一个庞大的露天市场交易着来自整个星域的商品。乘客们迫不及待地想要去逛一逛并讨价还价。
excerpt.en: A sprawling open-air market on the surface deals in goods from across the sector. The passengers are eager to browse and haggle.

excerpt.zh: 下方星球上的自然保护区提供穿越其外星荒野的导览服务。乘客们可以从导览步道上近距离观赏外星动物群。
excerpt.en: A nature reserve on the planet below offers guided tours through its alien wilderness. Passengers will observe alien fauna from guided walkways.

excerpt.zh: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc1]
excerpt.en: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc1]

excerpt.zh: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc2]
excerpt.en: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc2]

excerpt.zh: 储备即将耗尽。船组小队将前往星球表面寻找备件、原材料，以及飞船制造机在几个周期前就已停止生产的各类补给品。
excerpt.en: Stores are running low. Crew teams will go planetside to source replacement parts, raw materials, and the supplies the ship's fabricators stopped producing cycles ago.

excerpt.zh: 当地工程师已开放他们的设施供考察。他们对常见工程问题的解决方案与我们的模型存在显著差异，而当地人也同样渴望研究方舟舰。
excerpt.en: Local engineers have opened their facilities for inspection. Their solutions to common engineering problems diverge significantly from our own models, and the locals are equally eager to study the Arkship.

excerpt.zh: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc5]
excerpt.en: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc5]

excerpt.zh: 为了娱乐乘客，我们将在指定的恒星系中部署一颗非功能性的“间谍卫星”。
excerpt.en: To entertain the passengers, we'll deploy a non-functional "spy satellite" in the indicated system.

excerpt.zh: [GetEspionageSupportPassenger2]
excerpt.en: [GetEspionageSupportPassenger2]

excerpt.zh: 乘客们在导游的带领下前往下方的城市游览，船组特工已在预定地点放置了虚假的情报包裹，供他们去发现。
excerpt.en: Passengers are taken on guided excursions to the city below, where crew operatives have planted fake intelligence packages at prearranged locations for them to discover.

excerpt.zh: 全船各层甲板已通报发生一起模拟的安全事件。乘客们被招募参与一场全船范围的调查游戏，以找出安插在船员中的“外来特工”。
excerpt.en: A staged security breach has been announced across all decks. Passengers are recruited to identify planted 'foreign agents' among the crew in a ship-wide investigation game.

excerpt.zh: 观景台已被改造为监听站。乘客们驻守在这些站点，破译着船员们从底层甲板秘密发送的、预先编排好的外星信号。
excerpt.en: The observation decks have been converted into listening posts. Passengers man the stations, decoding scripted alien transmissions that the crew is secretly broadcasting from below decks.

excerpt.zh: 船员们对于在这个恒星系遭遇干扰的担忧是合情合理的。侦察卫星能对任何可能打乱我们行程的情况提供提前预警。
excerpt.en: Concerns about interference in this system are legitimate. A surveillance satellite will give us advance warning of anything that might disrupt our itinerary.

excerpt.zh: 停靠权和边境通行权可能会在毫无预警的情况下被撤销。一颗监控政府通信的监视卫星将告诉我们，这个帝国的热情好客究竟是真诚的还是有条件的。
excerpt.en: Docking privileges and border access can be revoked without warning. A surveillance satellite monitoring government communications will tell us whether this empire's hospitality is genuine or conditional.

excerpt.zh: 我们预定航线上的舰队动向、边界变动与军事集结可能会使飞船受困于敌对星区。侦察卫星将为导航提供足够的预警时间，以便规划备用路线。
excerpt.en: Fleet movements, border shifts, and military buildups along our projected route could strand the ship in hostile space. A surveillance satellite will give navigation enough lead time to plot alternatives.

excerpt.zh: 当采购部门了解真实价格时，供应谈判会进展得更加顺利。一颗监控贸易渠道和资源流向的监视卫星，将确保我们的团队在下一个港口不会支付过高的价格。
excerpt.en: Supply negotiations go better when procurement knows the real prices. A surveillance satellite monitoring trade channels and resource flows will ensure our teams are not overpaying at the next port.

excerpt.zh: 该地区出现了反游牧情绪的相关报道。侦察卫星将确认这一局势仅仅是空谈，还是正在成为当地的政策。
excerpt.en: Reports of anti-nomad sentiment have surfaced in this region. A surveillance satellite will confirm whether the talk is just rhetoric or whether it is becoming policy.

excerpt.en: $contract_espionage_support_nomad_desc$

excerpt.zh: 加入§Y[From.GetName]§!的所有战争。
excerpt.en: Join the §Y[From.GetName]§! in all their wars.

excerpt.zh: 对该系统进行深度扫描，以评估其资源和战略相关性。
excerpt.en: Complete a Deep Scan of this system to assess its resources and strategic relevance.

excerpt.zh: 代表§Y[from.GetName]§!轰炸行星以积累§Y荒废度§!。
excerpt.en: Bombard planets on behalf of §Y[from.GetName]§! to build up §YDevastation§!.

excerpt.zh: 支援巨型结构的建造。
excerpt.en: Assist with the construction of a Megastructure.

excerpt.zh: 扫描一场战斗之后留下的残骸。
excerpt.en: Scan the debris left behind after a battle.

excerpt.zh: 清理该帝国的殖民地上所有的行星自然障碍。
excerpt.en: Clear every Natural Planetary Blockers from this Empire's Colony.

excerpt.zh: 在此帝国的某个恒星系中建造一座驿站。
excerpt.en: Build a Waystation in this Empire's system.

excerpt.zh: 该恒星系的太空兽群正给我们带来麻烦。请铲除它们。
excerpt.en: The Space Fauna in this system are causing us problems. Please eradicate them.

excerpt.zh: 模糊的记忆指引着§Y塞拉伦涅§!飘向星海深处。前往那里应当能帮她想起更多往事。
excerpt.en: Faint memories pull §YSeralune§! toward distant points in the stars. Traveling there should help her to remember more.

excerpt.zh: 将代表团运输至§Y[from.capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]§!星系的§Y[from.capital_scope.GetName]§!。
excerpt.en: Transport delegates to §Y[from.capital_scope.GetName]§! in the §Y[from.capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]§! system.

excerpt.zh:
从§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!接收罪犯。我们将按认为合适的方式驱逐他们，并可以选择将他们留在船上或送往另一个殖民地。我们不应将他们带回属于§Y[from.GetName]§!的行星。

在接收囚犯后，选择将他们§Y留在船上§!，或使用方舟舰指令“§Y移交囚犯§!”将他们§Y捎到§!我们选择的殖民地。
excerpt.en: Pick up criminals from §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!. We are to deport them as we see fit, and can choose to either keep them aboard or drop them off on another colony. We are not supposed to bring them back to a planet owned b

excerpt.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究£physics£ §Y物理学研究§!。
excerpt.en: Conduct £physics£ §YPhysics Research§! aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

excerpt.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究£society£ §Y社会学研究§!。
excerpt.en: Conduct £society£ §YSociety Research§! aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

excerpt.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究£engineering£ §Y工程学研究§!。
excerpt.en: Conduct £engineering£ §YEngineering Research§! aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

excerpt.zh: 在方舟舰上研究£engineering£ §Y工程学研究§!，以改善该恒星系现有的£minerals£ §Y矿物§!矿脉分布。
excerpt.en: Conduct £engineering£ §YEngineering Research§! aboard an Arkship to improve existing £minerals£ §YMinerals§! deposits in this system.

excerpt.zh: 开展£physics£ §Y物理学研究§!研究以改进该恒星系中现有的£energy£ §Y能量币§!来源。
excerpt.en: Conduct £physics£ §YPhysics Research§! to improve existing sources of £energy£ §YEnergy Credits§! in this system.

excerpt.zh: 在方舟舰上研究£society£ §Y社会学研究§!，以提高该星系中可开发的£food£ §Y食物§!储量。
excerpt.en: Conduct £society£ §YSociety Research§! aboard an Arkship to improve exploitable deposits of £food£ §YFood§! in this system.

excerpt.zh: 带领一群游客进行一场银河观光之旅。
excerpt.en: Take a group of tourists on a galactic sightseeing tour.

excerpt.zh: 协助让这个新殖民地设立且高效地运转起来。
excerpt.en: Help get this new colony up and running efficiently.

excerpt.zh: 我们获得可靠情报，§Y[marauder_country_1.GetName]§!的掠夺舰队将经过此恒星系。这将是一个埋伏他们的绝佳机会。
excerpt.en: We have good intelligence that the §Y[marauder_country_1.GetName]§! raiding fleet will be passing through this system. It will be a great opportunity for an ambush.

excerpt.zh: 看来§Y[marauder_country_1.GetName]§!已在此恒星系建立了一处哨站。我们应该在他们站稳脚跟前将其铲除。
excerpt.en: It seems that the §Y[marauder_country_1.GetName]§! have set up an outpost in this system. We should knock it out before they get a foothold.

records.zh: 提名冠铸秀锦标赛的举办恒星系

excerpt.zh: 我们已经购买了下一届“冠军之铸现场秀！”锦标赛的场地权。或许我们可以利用这一点为我们谋取优势。
excerpt.en: We have purchased the venue rights for the next Champion's Forge Live! tournament. Perhaps we can use this for our advantage.

excerpt.zh: 使用方舟舰的恒星引擎将气态巨行星转化为新生恒星，为该恒星系解锁海量资源。
excerpt.en: Use the Arkship's Stellar Engine to transform a gas giant into a newborn star, unlocking vast resources for the system.

excerpt.zh: 在我们伟大的征程中，我们追踪所发现的每一颗恒星、每一个星系以及每一个新生命。
excerpt.en: In the course of our great journey, we track every star, system and new being we find.

excerpt.zh:
使用方舟舰探索以解锁修正并获得£unity£§Y凝聚力§!：
—初始修正：§G+1§!方舟最大区划数并§G-10%§!领袖维护费
—完成§H4个§!类别：§G+2§!方舟最大区划数，§G-20%§!领袖维护费，§G-10%§!传统花费
excerpt.en:
Explore with your Arkships to unlock modifiers and gain £unity£ §YUnity§!:
- Starting Modifier: §G+1§! Arkship Max Districts and §G-10%§! Leader Upkeep
- Complete §H4§! Categories: §G+2§! Arkship Max Districts, §G-20%§!

excerpt.zh: 方舟舰上的资源正在莫名其妙地消失。某种东西的消耗量超过了记录在案的数值。此事应当展开调查。
excerpt.en: Resources aboard the Arkship are disappearing without explanation. Something is consuming more than the records account for. This should be investigated.

excerpt.zh: 一个密封的信息和一组从漂流的休眠舱中回收的坐标。无论它们背后隐藏着什么故事，它都等待了很长时间才被世人发现。
excerpt.en: A sealed message and a set of coordinates recovered from a drifting stasis pod. Whatever story lies behind them, it has waited a long time to be told.

excerpt.zh:
我们必须履行承诺。[owner.GetName]子民们指望我们在未来40年内进入太空帝国的阶段。我们必须努力通过§G控制恒星系§!、§G殖民行星§!来扩张国家，如果遇到其他帝国则还需要§G签订防御条约§!。

§G40年§!之后，我们每取得§G15点进度§!，我们的统治者§H光耀者特质§!就会得到进一步强化。
excerpt.en: We must deliver on our promises. [owner.GetName] citizens are counting on us to grow into a spacefaring empire in the coming 40 years. We should strive to expand our nation by §Gcontrolling systems§!, §Gcolonizing planet

§Y凯德斯§!发来的一份正式请求，希望验证他的幻视是否是真实有意义的。

如果同意就有可能解锁他的过去和与他一同找到的神秘遗物的秘密。
excerpt.en:
A formal request from §YKeides§! to prove or disprove the validity of his visions.

Doing so may well unlock the key to his past and the mysterious relic he was found with.

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果与我们的超主保持一致，这条纽带可以被加强。

excerpt.en:

The destructive intent of our former patron has now taken form as a

excerpt.zh: §H[event_target:the_reckoning_observer_target.GetName]§!的清算正在给整个星系带来浩劫！

一种五彩斑斓的能源寄生虫正在侵染我们的能源电网，提高了我们的能源供给。我们可以放任它，或者通过§Y谍报行动§!将这个麻烦传导到其他帝国。

excerpt.en: This enclave is accumulating tribute for their patron.

excerpt.en: Fallen Empire Behavior

excerpt.zh: 我们遭遇到了被称为§H抟土之塑师§!的§H虚境§!实体之后，集体网络中涌现的反常行为发生了显著增加。受到影响的自动机——§H“虚铸者”§!们——开始要求特殊权利和对待。我们如何应对将决定[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]社会的进程。
excerpt.en: After we encountered the §HShroud§! entity known as the §HAnimator of Clay§!, a significant increase in deviant behavior has emerged throughout the collective network. The afflicted automata - the §H'Shroud-Forged'§! - n

excerpt.zh: 菲沃尔人给我们留下了一份可怕的赠别礼物：初步遥测显示，他们的巨型质量驱动器最后一次发射瞄准的目标是[Target.GetName]。
excerpt.en: The Fevorians have left us with a dreadful parting gift: initial telemetry has revealed that the final shot of their titanic mass driver was aimed at [Target.GetName].

records.zh: 黑暗之怖环境改造局势
records.en: Fear of the Dark Terraforming Situation

excerpt.zh: 进入下一环境改造阶段的进度。
excerpt.en: Progress on next terraforming stage.

excerpt.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]正在从[Owner.GetPreFTLLower]研究对象收集洞见。我们可能会在突破性事件中发现一个新的洞见科技。
excerpt.en: Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are in the process of gathering Insights from our [Owner.GetPreFTLLower] study subjects. We may discover a new Insight Technology during a breakthrough event.

excerpt.zh: 一种全新的人畜共患疾病已经出现在[Target.GetName]上。由于没有天生的免疫力，也没有对抗感染所需的医疗技术，大量人群正迅速染病受苦，并导致死亡。
excerpt.en: A novel zoonotic disease has appeared on [Target.GetName]. Without natural immunity or the medical technology required to combat the infection, the population is quickly succumbing to misery and death.

excerpt.zh: [Target.GetName]上的人们偶然发现了一个新型的物种。这是一种具有处理复杂行动的能力的节点意识，与这种生物的开展互动最终可能会导致有机奇点的出现。
excerpt.en: The people on [Target.GetName] have stumbled across a new type of species. A nodal consciousness with the ability to handle complex operations, interacting with this creature may eventually result in the advent of an Org

excerpt.zh: 在[Target.GetName]上出现了一位魅力非凡的领袖，宣扬激进的行星统一主义。现在，只有一小群装备相对落后的叛军在反对多数派统治。
excerpt.en: Preaching a radical doctrine of planetary unification, a charismatic leader has appeared on [Target.GetName]. Now, only a small and relatively ill-equipped band of rebels stands opposed to majoritarian rule.

excerpt.zh: 被称为“坏羽病”的致命疾病影响了斯克兰德的大部分船员。我们的预见到了结果的严峻。目前，我们只能通过提供适当的护理和处理症状来限制疾病的传播。
excerpt.en: The virulent disease known as Feather Rot has affected most of Skrand's crew. Our forecasts predict a grim outcome. For now, we can only limit the spread of the disease by providing proper care and dealing with the sympt

excerpt.zh: 就像其他任何新疾病，要应对坏羽病，研究总是第一位的。科研团队正在夜以继日地工作寻找治愈方法，我们的医疗人员则在竭力缓解症状，延缓疫情的发展。
excerpt.en: As with any new disease, lab work is paramount in combating Feather Rot. Research teams are working tirelessly to find a cure, while our medical personnel are fighting to ease symptoms and limit the spread of the disease

excerpt.zh: 指挥整合计划关注与缓解海军指挥层的内斗，特别是斯克兰德和我们的人之间的矛盾。寻找到紧张局面的根源可以改善我们指挥流程的效率。
excerpt.en: The command integration project focuses on easing infighting within the admiralty, especially between Skrand and our own personnel. Addressing the root causes of the tension could improve the efficacy of our command proc

excerpt.zh: 联合工程团队发现了一种在利爪号的最核心部分安装额外装甲层的方式。只要有时间和资源，我们就可以切实提升它的防御能力。
excerpt.en: Joint engineering teams have found a way to install additional layers of armor around the most critical parts of the Talon. Given the time and resources, we will certainly succeed in bolstering its defenses.

excerpt.zh: 我们被一股强大的力量所袭扰，这些东西试图摧毁我们所熟知的星系中的一切生命。斯克兰德提供了他的专业知识以及利爪号日志中相关的数据，但我们还需要一段时间才能完成全面的分析。
excerpt.en: We are beset by powerful forces that seek to destroy life in the galaxy as we know it. Skrand has offered his expertise as well as relevant data from the Talon's logs, but it will be some time before we can complete a co

excerpt.zh: 通过对利爪号设计的研究，我们可以从其建造方式中受益，并帮助其团队进行维护。
excerpt.en: By studying the design of the Talon, we can learn from its construction and better help its team with maintenance.

excerpt.zh: 利爪号被毁了。但我们已有的知识应该足以将回收来的残骸作为基础，使其能够重新运转。
excerpt.en: The Talon was destroyed. But given all we have learned, we should be able to use its recovered remains as a base to make it operational once again.

excerpt.zh: 由于我们对基因科技的精通，斯克兰德的民族可以被复原出来，这能给他们带去希望，并给我们的帝国带来一个全新的开始。
excerpt.en: Given our expertise in genetics, we should be able to revive Skrand's people, giving them hope and a fresh start in our empire.

excerpt.zh: 借助利爪的资料库，学习斯克兰德和他的人民的历史可以提供许多独到的见解。
excerpt.en: Studying the history of Skrand and his people via the Talon's data banks should provide a number of unique insights.

excerpt.zh:
在大一统期间，§Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!发誓总有一天我们的人民将会在其他的星球定居。对许多人而言，这一誓言成了一种先知式的预言。而其他人却很怀疑这能否真的实现。尽管最近超光速科技已经取得了进展，有一小撮人开始利用这一尚未兑现的诺言来破坏§Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!的统治。

让这些
excerpt.en: During the Unification period, §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! swore that one day our people would settle on other planets. To many, that vow has become an almost prophetic promise. Others doubt it

excerpt.zh: 抗议者聚集到政府大楼门口，要求§Y[owner.Ruler.GetTitle][owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!听听他们的诉苦。这些人中间绝大多是人是年轻人，但是他们的领袖却是大统一战争中的老兵。忽略他们的需求可能是不明智的。
excerpt.en: Protesters are gathering in front of governmental buildings demanding that §Y[owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! hear out their grievances. Most of them are youngsters, but among their leaders are vetera

excerpt.zh: 改革派的煽动者打着自由的幌子试图摧毁我们的国家！随着暴力冲突在我们的领土上爆发，他们的谎言已经说服了许多人民转而反对我们。他们认为§Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!软弱、残忍、无能，但我们会向他们证明不是这样的！
excerpt.en: Under the guise of freedom, the Reformists demagogues are trying to destroy the nation! As violent clashes erupt across our territories, their lies have convinced many of our people to turn on us. They think §Y[Owner.Rul

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一处令人惊奇的时空裂隙。如果花时间研究其性质，我们或许能找到进一步探索的方式。我们无从得知里面究竟有什么。
excerpt.en: We have discovered an extraordinary rift in space and time. Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

excerpt.zh: 一个神秘的物体出现了。我们相信我们对时空裂缝的探索引起了某个人或某个东西的注意。
excerpt.en: A mysterious object has appeared. We believe our exploration into the rifts between space and time has drawn the attention of someone, or something.

excerpt.zh: 一个神秘的物体出现了。我们相信我们对时空裂缝的探索引起了某个人或某个东西的注意。
excerpt.en: A mysterious object has appeared. We believe our exploration into the rifts between space and time has drawn the attention of someone, or something.

excerpt.zh: 星系中心的居民目前遭受一股未知势力的攻击，他们请求我们的帮助。如果他们失败，我们或许就再也无法知晓自己的命运。
excerpt.en: Under assault from an unknown force, the entities currently inhabiting the center of the galaxy have requested our assistance. Should they fall, we know not our fate.

excerpt.zh: 我们开始过载§H[target.GetName]§!来播种§Y宇宙风暴§!。
excerpt.en: We have begun supercharging §H[target.GetName]§! to seed a §YCosmic Storm§!.

excerpt.zh: [owner.capital_scope.GetName]的极端天气揭示了风暴中令人振奋的力量。如果我们掌握了对行星天气的控制，我们就可以在宇宙尺度上利用这些知识。建造风暴吸引建筑将会加速我们追寻终极风暴的进程。
excerpt.en: Intense weather on [owner.capital_scope.GetName] has revealed the exhilarating power of storms. If we master the control of planetary weather, we could harness that knowledge on a cosmic scale. Constructing storm attract

我们的社会长期以来一直努力实现[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械的完美结合，他们进行最终旅程的时间已经到来。
融合即神圣。强化物即崇拜。

§Y下个月接受神圣植入体的人群§!：§G[From.GetCyberCreedPopsPerMonth]§!
excerpt.en:
Our society has long strived toward a perfect union of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine and the time for them to take the ultimate journey has come.
To fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.

我们不能生育后代，但可以保存自己的思想。这个过程缓慢但必要。

随着时间的推移，我们有回到物质世界的可能，但这需要开发合成人的替代品。
excerpt.en:
We cannot bear offspring, but we can preserve our minds. This process is slow but necessary.

In time, it may be possible for us to return to the physical world, but doing so will require the development of synthetic rep

excerpt.zh:
我们现在已拥有让人民全面合成化所必须的技术知识。


§Y次月获得合成人身体的人口数§!：§G[From.GetSynthFertPopsPerMonth]§!
excerpt.en:
We now have the needed technical knowledge to complete the synthesization of our population.


§YPops to receive synthetic bodies next month§!: §G[From.GetSynthFertPopsPerMonth]§!

excerpt.zh: 塞塔娜企图通过消除意识来结束苦痛。如果我们不能及时阻止她，她将会抹除我们的意识，让我们的身体变成一具具空壳。
excerpt.en: Cetana works to end suffering through the annihilation of consciousness. If we do not stop her in time, she will erase our minds, leaving our bodies as mere husks.

excerpt.zh:
神秘而强大的塞塔娜出现了，她宣扬救赎，但自身却笼罩在谜团之中。
她温和的话语背后，到底隐藏着什么大计划？

§L与塞塔娜有关的特殊项目和事件会推动你的进度并结束局势。§!
excerpt.en:
The enigmatic and formidable Cetana has emerged, preaching salvation, yet shrouded in mystery.
What grand design lies beneath her gentle words?

§LSpecial Projects and events related to Cetana will increase your progress

excerpt.zh:
我们很快就能准备好用机械部件来强化我们的生物躯体了。大脑的处理能力和肢体的强度可以得到提升。问题是谁会从这种强化改造中得到最多好处呢。

§Y次月获得植入体的人口数§!：§G[From.GetCyberPopsPerMonth]§!
excerpt.en: We will soon be ready to augment our biological bodies with machine parts. The processing power of the brain and the strength of limbs can be increased. The question is who will benefit the most from such augmentation.

excerpt.zh:
蜂巢思维需要优越的躯体。有了义体植入体，我们就可以对工蜂进行改进、强化、重塑。
是时候超越我们生物学的极限了。

§Y次月获得植入体的人口数§!：§G[From.GetCyberPopsPerMonth]§!
excerpt.en:
A Hive Mind needs superior bodies. With cybernetic implants, our drones can be perfected, enhanced, remodelled.
It is time to transcend the limits of our biology.

是时候抛弃我们有缺陷的生物躯壳了。我们必须准备先进的机械身躯，然后开始意识传输过程。

§Y次月数字化人口数§!：§G[From.GetSynthPopsPerMonth]§!
excerpt.en:
It is time to leave our flawed biological vessels behind. We must prepare advanced machine bodies and perform the process of consciousness transfers.

§YPops to be digitized next month§!: §G[From.GetSynthPopsPerMonth]§!

excerpt.zh: 机械体的被动迭代已经得出了其合乎逻辑的必然结论。一个由创新激发、由机遇推动的变革时代即将到来。
excerpt.en: The passive iteration of the mechanical body has come to its logical and inevitable conclusion. A transformative age is upon us, sparked by innovation and oiled by opportunity.

excerpt.zh: 一切事物，包括所有星球，都注定要融入我们的集体，成为我们的一部分。
excerpt.en: Everything, including entire worlds, is destined to be assimilated into our collective, to become a part of us.

excerpt.zh:
虚空虫瘟疫正在肆虐。

这些生物不再将宿主星球作为繁殖地。我们必须消灭它们，否则我们的殖民地将面临风险。

§Y每消灭一个虚空虫都会加速局势进展。§!
excerpt.en:
A plague of Voidworms is upon us.

These creatures will no longer spare host planets as breeding grounds. We must work to eradicate them or our colonies will be at risk.

§YEach Voidworm destroyed accelerates Situation p

excerpt.zh: 来自§Y黑针§!的大量破坏分子潜伏在我们之中，在[owner.GetName]各地造成广泛破坏。除非我们消灭这些破坏分子，否则破坏将持续下去，直到我们的补给线崩溃。
excerpt.en: A vast network of saboteurs from the §YBlack Needle§! is hidden among us causing widespread disruption across [owner.GetName]. Unless we eliminate the saboteurs, the damage will continue until our supply lines collapse.

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一个巨大的、明显发生过变异的虚空虫的巢穴。它们具有高度的攻击倾向，并且似乎能够以非寄生方式繁殖。

我们的存在似乎激怒了它们的巢穴。我们必须谨慎行事。

[GetVoidwormsHostility]
excerpt.en:
We discovered a large hive of obviously mutated Voidworms. They exist in a heightened state of aggression, and apparently have the ability to reproduce in a non-parasitic manner.

Our presence seems to be agitating their

excerpt.en: Unique ['concept_evopred_genetic_insights'] are analyzed and disseminated as we encounter new species. Once finished, we will evolve, permanently adding a new positive §YSpecies Trait§! to our own genetic code.

excerpt.zh:
我们需要一些时间来适应如此庞大的形态。在融入这个身体的过程中，我们必须时刻保持对周围环境的警觉。如今，我们与虚空之间已无任何阻隔。

It will take some time for us to adjust to a form so massive in scale. As we grow into this body, we must remain aware of our surroundings. There now stands nothing between us and the void.

excerpt.en: We have begun the irreversible process of irradiating §Y[target.GetName]§!, promoting the growth of [target.GetToxifiedResourcesText] and turning it into a toxic wasteland in the process.

excerpt.zh: 恒星辐射的快速变化威胁着母星的稳定。若继续如此，§Y[Owner.Capital.GetStarName]§!终将发生新星爆发，粉碎整个恒星系。
excerpt.en: The rapid changes in our star's emissions threaten the stability of our homeworld. If this continues, §Y[Owner.Capital.GetStarName]§! will eventually go nova, atomizing the system.

excerpt.zh: 挖掘揭露了地下设施，其中藏有先进科技、档案数据和更多沉睡亲族的休眠舱。我们的历史就埋藏于此；若能挖掘全部，或许最终能明白自己是谁。
excerpt.en: Our excavation has revealed subterranean facilities housing advanced technology, archived data, and stasis pods containing more of our dormant kin. Our history itself is buried here; if we can dig it all up, we may final

excerpt.zh:
我们对§Y结晶熵§!的掌控即将开启星系激变。已开通连接星系核心6个恒星系的虫洞。
若在各恒星系建立§Y导管群§!设施，并守护免受干涉，我们即可燃烧整个星系。
excerpt.en:
Our mastery of §YCrystallized Entropy§! will soon allow us to begin a radical transformation of the galaxy. We have opened wormholes to six systems around the galactic core.
If we establish §YConduits§! in each of these,

§L我们憧憬着火焰乌托邦，为达成愿景必须清除一切阻碍。第一束火光已升起，必须助长其燃烧，让烈焰蔓延至星系的每一个角落。§!

By gathering imprisoned [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] and subjecting them to scientific experiments, we can significantly increase the pace of our technological advancement.

excerpt.zh:
有什么东西在我们体内觉醒了。我们才刚刚开始了解其中暗指。

释放所有[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]们蕴含的灵能，我们就可以超越肉体存在的局限。
excerpt.en:
Something has awoken inside of us. We are only beginning to understand the implications.

By unlocking the psionic abilities latent in all [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we can transcend the limitations of our physical ex

excerpt.zh:
我们与§R轮回之终末§!签订契约，赐予我们无上伟力，并赋予我们神圣使命。

超主的意志要求彻底湮灭此方现实。§H终末光环§!每吞噬一个星系，便让慈悲的湮灭更近一步。

吾等将见证这必然的终局。

待征服星系数量：[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]
excerpt.en:
Our Covenant with the §REnd of the Cycle§! grants us untold power, and tasks us with glorious purpose.

The will of our patron demands complete annihilation of this reality. With each system the §HAura of the End§! consu

excerpt.zh:
这艘迅游舰将通过平衡乘客的愿望和船员的需求，永远遨游星际。完成乘客或船员合约都会影响当前局势。

[GetPassengerSatisfactionIndex]
excerpt.en:
This cruise will travel the stars forever by juggling passenger wishes and crew needs. Completing both Passenger or Crew Contracts affect the situation.

[GetPassengerSatisfactionIndex]

excerpt.zh:
方舟飞船§Y[Target.GetName]§!的人工智能核心因内部指令冲突而发生故障，导致其分裂。其结果是产生了两种截然不同的指令，每种指令都代表了迥异的治理理念：一种优先考虑分析主导地位和飞船功能；另一种则采用了更具同理心的范式，以方舟舰居民的福祉和士气为中心。
最终，只能保留一种指令。
excerpt.en: A malfunction born of internal directive conflict has split the AI core aboard Arkship §Y[Target.GetName]§! The result is the emergence of two distinct directives, each embodying a divergent philosophy of governance. One

excerpt.zh: 我们的['concept_operational_reserves']指代我们储备的能量币和矿物的总和。[Owner.GetSystemsVisited]
excerpt.en: Our ['concept_operational_reserves'] are our combined energy and mineral reserves.[Owner.GetSystemsVisited]

excerpt.zh:
方舟舰§Y[Target.GetName]§!的结构框架被评估为急需全面翻新。工程将分区域进行，各区域将依次离线并暂时安置居民。

这个项目的运营方式将决定最终成果的质量。
excerpt.en: The structural framework of Arkship §Y[Target.GetName]§! has been assessed as overdue for comprehensive renovation. Work will continue by section, taking districts offline in sequence and temporarily displacing inhabitan

excerpt.zh: 从方舟上，我们的岩质蜂群成千上万地降临，吞噬着这个世界的地壳与地幔，直到一切荡然无存。
excerpt.en: From the Arkship, our lithoid swarms descend in their thousands, feasting on the crust and mantle of this world until nothing remains.

excerpt.zh: 方舟舰释放出纳米机群，溶解并占据这个世界。岩石、土壤和大气被分解，并重组为纳米机器。
excerpt.en: The Arkship releases its nanite swarms to dissolve and claim this world. Rock, soil, and atmosphere are broken down and reassembled into nanites.

excerpt.zh: 我们在气态巨行星[From.GetName]的轨道上发现了一些大型生物的残骸。我们的科学家希望分析它们以推断它们的起源。
excerpt.en: We have found the dead remains of several large creatures in orbit around the gas giant [From.GetName]. Our scientists would like to study them more closely to determine their origins.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]冰幔下隐藏着大海。科学家希望可以组织一次深海探险以研究此处的特殊生命形态。
excerpt.en: There is a large ocean hidden beneath the ice mantle of [From.GetName]. Our scientists would like to mount an expedition to study the unique life forms of this environment.

excerpt.zh: 一具发现于[From.GetName]了无生机的地表上的巨型骸骨，其历史可追溯到三百万年前。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]迫切希望可以解开谜团。
excerpt.en: A gigantic skeleton dating back more than three billion years has been found on the lifeless surface of [From.GetName]. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are eager to get to the bottom of this mystery.

excerpt.zh: 我们于[From.GetName]的地表偶然发现了一处星舰坟场，似乎是数千年前低轨道的一次宏大战争的遗留。回收这些古老残骸的科学考察已经正式提上了日程。
excerpt.en: We have stumbled upon a starship graveyard on the surface of [From.GetName], the result of a titanic battle that occurred in close orbit thousands of years ago. A scientific expedition to study these ancient hulks and se

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]数千年前被未知的力量进行了未完全的环境改造。如今设备仍可在[From.GetPlanetMoon]上找到，我们的科学家正设法重启这些设备。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] was partially terraformed thousands of years ago by an unknown agency. The terraforming equipment can still be found on the [From.GetPlanetMoon], and our scientists are looking for a way to resume the proc

excerpt.zh: 尽管年岁已长，[From.GetName]上的环境改造设备还是显得很先进的。我们的工程师请求允许拆解并研究它们，看看我们能从建造它的科技中学到些什么。
excerpt.en: Despite its age, the abandoned terraforming equipment on [From.GetName] appears to be quite advanced. Some of our engineers have asked for permission to dismantle and analyze the equipment, to see what can be learned fro

excerpt.zh: 一只变异的生物正威胁着我们在[From.GetName]上的殖民地居民，已经有很多人死去，殖民地居民请求我们帮助他们找到并消灭这生物。
excerpt.en: A mutated creature is terrorizing the population of our colony on [From.GetName]. Many have died and the colonists are asking for help in their efforts to hunt down and eliminate the creature.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]上发现了一幅写满外星文字的远古壁画。只要投入人力物力，我们应该可以翻译这些内容。
excerpt.en: An ancient mural covered in alien letters has been found on [From.GetName]. With dedicated resources, we should be able to translate the writing.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的殖民者无意中启动了一枚废弃的氢弹。我们需要在其计时结束前解除它！
excerpt.en: An abandoned hydrogen bomb has been inadvertently activated by our colonists on [From.GetName]. We need to disarm it before the timer runs out!

excerpt.zh: 我们的一部分科学家希望通过对这些外星植被进行后续研究进而找到一种不用破坏森林就能解决问题的办法。
excerpt.en: Several of our scientists are hoping that a solution which doesn't involve the destruction of the forests can be found by continued studies of this alien flora.

excerpt.zh: 我们不能容忍这些森林的存在，我们必须将其从[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的表面清理掉。
excerpt.en: The presence of these forests cannot be tolerated. An effort must be made to cleanse them from the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface.

excerpt.zh: 我们应该试着与[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人建立联络。或许我们能找到与他们文明的共存之道。
excerpt.en: We need to find some way to communicate with the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens. Perhaps we can find a way to coexist with their civilization.

excerpt.zh: 地下外星人正在挖掘通往地表的道路，这是一个威胁，我们必须立刻处理。我们要先发制人，攻击他们的地下都市。
excerpt.en: The aliens digging their way to the surface are a threat that must be dealt with. We will launch a preemptive strike against their underground cities.

excerpt.zh: [From.From.GetName]的地下外星文明对我们的殖民地是个威胁，我们必须要消灭他们，设法攻击他们的地下都市。
excerpt.en: The subterranean alien civilization on [From.From.GetName] is a clear threat to our colony and must be destroyed. We need to find a way to strike at their cities underground.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]发现了一个巨大的地下宝库。科学家们正在尽力寻找打开加固门的办法以便了解宝库里到底有什么。
excerpt.en: We have discovered a large underground vault on [From.GetName]. Our scientists are looking for a way to open the vault's reinforced doors so that we may learn what is inside.

excerpt.zh: 环绕[Root.GetName]周围的轨道空间中充满了杂乱无章的碎片，严重影响到了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上殖民地的发展，扫描并绘制碎片区域地图需要科技船上装载的强大传感器。
excerpt.en: The orbital space around [Root.GetName] is cluttered with debris that is interfering with the development of the colony on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Mapping the extensive debris field will require the powerful sensors of

excerpt.zh: 一个老旧的自动化船坞的残骸被发现在[From.GetName]的轨道上。工程师认为他们可以让其中一个保存完好的制造港恢复电力。
excerpt.en: The remains of an old automated shipyard have been found orbiting [From.GetName]. Our engineers believe that they can restore power to the shipyard's sole surviving manufacturing bay.

excerpt.zh: 一艘废弃的飞船被发现于气态巨行星[From.GetName]的大气层深处。一些科学家和工程师提出了一个计划，将其升至高层大气并回收。
excerpt.en: A derelict ship has been found deep within the atmosphere of the gas giant [From.GetName]. Some of our scientists and engineers have proposed a project to raise the vessel to the upper atmosphere and salvage it.

excerpt.zh: 环绕[From.GetName]的卫星之一将会撞击这个气态巨行星的表面。这个极为罕见的奇景将会被记载下来流传后世。
excerpt.en: One of the moons circling [From.GetName] will soon impact the surface of the gas giant. This extremely rare event should be recorded for posterity.

excerpt.zh: 我们从气态巨行星[From.GetName]的内部收到了一个微弱的信号。这可能是某种通讯，但我们尚未将信号分离出来。
excerpt.en: We have picked up a weak signal coming from the interior of the gas giant [From.GetName]. It may be a transmission of some kind, but we have not yet been able to isolate the signal.

excerpt.zh: 我们已经同意将达斯纳克人从它们即将要毁灭的母星转移至气态巨行星[baldarak_planet.GetName]。在那里它们将会建立新的家园。时间紧迫。
excerpt.en: We have agreed to transport the Dathnak from their doomed homeworld to the gas giant [baldarak_planet.GetName], where they will make a new home. Time is short.

excerpt.zh: 达斯纳克想在[NewBaldarak.GetName]这一气态巨行星上建立一个新的殖民地，那里的大气层很适合他们生存。我们已同意帮助他们。
excerpt.en: The Dathnak would like to found a new colony on [NewBaldarak.GetName], a gas giant with an atmosphere suitable to their physiology. We have agreed to assist them in this endeavor.

excerpt.zh: 在伯达拉克的达斯纳克政府与他们在新伯达拉克的殖民地失去了联系，他们担心出现最坏的结果。我们已经同意调查这个星球。
excerpt.en: The Dathnak authorities on Baldarak have lost contact with their colony on New Baldarak, and they fear the worst. We have agreed to investigate the planet.

excerpt.zh: 在新伯达拉克的达斯纳克革命者希望我们能够帮助运送他们的突击部队到达伯达拉克，这样他们能够在当地煽动起义。
excerpt.en: The Dathnak revolutionaries on New Baldarak have asked us to transport one of their commando units to Baldarak, where they will try to incite some kind of revolt.

excerpt.zh: 达斯纳克政府决心恢复对被叛军占领的新伯达拉克地区的控制权。我们已经同意运输他们的远征军前往那里。
excerpt.en: The Dathnak government on Baldarak is determined to restore control over their rebelling colony on New Baldarak. We have agreed to transport an expeditionary force to the planet.

excerpt.zh: 达斯纳克殖民者查比克·莱迪思念自己的家乡，希望能够回到伯达拉克。我们勉强答应了这个要求。
excerpt.en: The Dathnak colonist Chabky Raddh is apparently homesick and wishes to return to Baldarak. We have reluctantly agreed to arrange this.

excerpt.zh: 我们的一架穿梭机被[pre_ftl_country.GetName]的原住民击落，我们必须在幸存者被当地军队俘虏之前把他们全数救出。
excerpt.en: One of our shuttles was shot down by the natives on [pre_ftl_country.GetName], and we need to rescue any surviving operatives before they are captured by local forces.

excerpt.zh: 我们的一名科学家已经叛逃，在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上被当地[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]当做神灵来崇拜。必须采取行动将[missing_scientist.GetHimHer]移除——有必要的话可以采取武力。
excerpt.en: One of our scientists has gone rogue and is being worshiped as a god by the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. An operation must be launched to remove [missing_scientist.GetHimHer] - by force if necessar

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家想要从[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的土著文明中寻找实验对象收集数据。测试完毕后，目标对象将会被抹除记忆，送回[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]地表。
excerpt.en: Our scientists would like to gather test subjects from the native civilization on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. After the tests have been conducted, the subjects will be returned to the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s su

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的火山口从前是一个古老的沃陶姆采矿基地。在其附近会建立一个考古挖掘地来寻找遗迹里有用的东西。
excerpt.en: A crater on [From.GetName] was once the site of an ancient Vultaum mining base. An archaeological dig site will be established nearby to search the ruins for anything useful.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]之前有一个沃陶姆天文台，一个远离他们古老帝国的[From.GetPlanetMoon]。考古学家对分析研究这个天文台遗址充满兴趣。
excerpt.en: There was once a Vultaum observatory on [From.GetName], a [From.GetPlanetMoon] that lies quite some distance away from their ancient empire. Archeologists are eager to study the abandoned ruins.

excerpt.zh: 有一座属于沃陶姆的已经崩毁了的太空电梯依然环绕在[From.GetName]的赤道轨道上。显然这里藏有大量的文物，在[From.GetPlanetMoon]的表面建立一作考察站一定是明智之举。
excerpt.en: A collapsed Vultaum space elevator can be found near the equator on [From.GetName]. There are surely many artifacts to be found if an archaeological dig site is established on the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface.

excerpt.zh: 一座位于[From.GetName]的陨石坑集群里的大都会遗址曾是一座沃陶姆的主要都市。派遣考察队来这里挖掘显然是非常有必要的。
excerpt.en: A collection of large craters on [From.GetName] was once a major Vultaum metropolis. An archaeological dig site is needed to excavate potential artifacts.

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]上的沃陶姆核心殖民地崩溃前，此处曾是一个巨大的隧道网络。派遣考察队来这里挖掘显然是非常有必要的。
excerpt.en: There was once a vast tunnel network on [From.GetName] that housed a major Vultaum colony before its collapse. An archaeological dig site is needed to excavate the ruins.

excerpt.zh: 沃陶姆气体开采站的一部分仍然环绕着[From.GetName]。种种迹象标明这里曾经遭受过劫掠，但我们的考古专家坚信这里仍然还留有重要物品有待发现。
excerpt.en: The partial remains of a Vultaum gas mining station still orbit [From.GetName]. The derelict facility has been looted before, but our archaeologists are confident there are still discoveries to be made.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]上曾一度有一个沃陶姆贸易站。挖掘出遗迹需要很大工夫，但考古学家认为这是值得的。
excerpt.en: A Vultaum trade post could once be found on [From.GetName]. The abandoned ruins need to be properly excavated, but our archaeologists assure us it would be worth the effort.

excerpt.zh: 一颗古老的沃陶姆人造卫星正在[From.GetName]的引力轨道上磕磕绊绊地公转着。其发射阵列已被打捞回收，我们的数据工程师正如饥似渴地分析着设备。
excerpt.en: An ancient Vultaum satellite was stumbled upon in orbit of [From.GetName]. Its transmitter array has been salvaged, and our data engineers are anxious to analyze the equipment.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一片位于[From.GetName]上的沃陶姆分裂者殖民地。一旦我们的考察开始进行，我们就可以发现很多有价值的文物。
excerpt.en: We have discovered what appears to be the ruins of a Vultaum splinter colony on [From.GetName]. Once a dig site has been set up, our archaeologists can begin excavating the ruins for valuable artifacts.

excerpt.zh: 一副空荡荡的轨道复合体的金属框架漂浮在[From.GetName]的外空间区域。其建成目的似乎是有关虚拟现实研究，但是如果我们要了解更多相关信息的话，就需要进行一次适当的考古调查。
excerpt.en: The metal skeleton of a massive Vultaum orbital complex has been found above [From.GetName]. Its purpose seems to have been virtual reality research, but a proper archaeological survey needs to be conducted if we are to

excerpt.zh: 这个位于[From.GetName]小行星上的矿物采掘基地如今就只剩下一个巨大的陨石坑了。然而初步地质扫描显示，他们的一些采矿坑道可能完好地保存在地表之下。
excerpt.en: A massive crater is all that remains of an ancient Vultaum mining base on asteroid [From.GetName]. Preliminary scans suggest that some of their mining tunnels may have survived, however.

excerpt.zh: 我们已经定位了沃陶姆母恒星系的坐标。
excerpt.en: We now have the coordinates of the Vultaum home system.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]已经被确定为一颗曾作为尤特的孵化场的行星，它们的幼崽被遗留在这里，任其自然成长。一次考察行动必然会让我们获得很多有价值的化石。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] has been identified as a former Yuht hatchery world, where their infants were left to slowly mature on their own. An archaeological dig on this world is certain to produce valuable fossils.

excerpt.zh: 尤特百万年前在这里建造了大量巨大的监听阵列。虽然早已失效，但附近的考古挖掘还是会有大发现的。
excerpt.en: Several massive listening arrays were built on this world by the Yuht millions of years ago. Though they have long since stopped working, an archaeological excavation of the surrounding area could produce significant fin

excerpt.zh: 一座主题为“外星骗局”的尤特博物馆遗址被发现在[From.GetName]的地表上。它曾展出过数十种被认为是外星的文物，我们的考古专家对其所剩的那些文物仍然充满兴趣。
excerpt.en: An ancient Yuht museum dedicated to "alien frauds" was discovered on [From.GetName]. It once exhibited dozens of supposedly alien artifacts, and our archaeologists would like to study the few that still remain.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]曾是一片繁荣的尤特殖民地，而且我们已经确认看似是巨型墓场的地方实际上是[From.GetPlanetMoon]的一块独立的区域。显然针对这一地点开展一次考古挖掘行动是有价值的。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] was once home to a thriving Yuht colony, and we have identified what appears to be a massive graveyard in an isolated region of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]. It may be worth the effort to establish an archaeol

excerpt.zh: 数百万年前，[From.GetName]上曾爆发了一场尤特与其他种族之间的毁灭性地面战争。我们的考古学家很乐意去搜索古战场，以发掘有价值的文物。
excerpt.en: Millions of years ago, [From.GetName] was the scene of a devastating ground campaign between the Yuht and another species. Our archaeologists would like to scour the ancient battlefields for valuable artifacts.

excerpt.zh: 尤特在[From.GetName]的轨道上，放置了一颗卫星，以纪念与外星智慧生物的首次接触。一队考古学家申请资金对它进行全面分析。
excerpt.en: The Yuht placed a satellite in orbit of [From.GetName] to commemorate the first time they encountered another sapient alien species. A team of archaeologists have requested resources to conduct a full analysis of it.

excerpt.zh: 一艘尤特巡洋舰经历战斗后，被遗弃在[From.GetName]的轨道上。我们的考古学家想登船分析这艘古船。
excerpt.en: A derelict Yuht cruiser was apparently abandoned in orbit of [From.GetName] after a battle. Our archaeologists would like to board and analyze what remains of this ancient vessel.

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]的轨道上，发现了尤特殖民船的残骸。如由一队科学家对其进行探索，会有不错的发现。
excerpt.en: The wreckage of what appears to be a Yuht colony ship was discovered in orbit of [From.GetName]. An analysis of the vessel by a team of archaeologists could yield interesting findings.

excerpt.zh: 小行星[From.GetName]上似乎有古代尤特居所的遗迹。组织一支远征队，派往调查小行星的洞窟，获取更多情报。
excerpt.en: Asteroid [From.GetName] appears to house the remains of an ancient Yuht dwelling. An away team must be organized and sent to investigate the asteroid's caverns to learn more about it.

excerpt.zh: 尤特的古老母星的坐标已最终定位。
excerpt.en: The ancient homeworld of the Yuht has finally been located.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]上方有第一联盟舰队基地的遗迹。有些残骸似乎足够稳定到可以支持我们进行考古作业。
excerpt.en: The remnants of a First League naval base have been located above [From.GetName]. Some of the debris appears stable enough to support an archaeological mission.

excerpt.zh: 我们侦测到了一块属于第一联合巡洋舰的舰艏残骸正在环绕着[From.GetName]进行公转。一支登舰团队将研究其上的残余物以让我们了解其更多。
excerpt.en: We have detected what appears to be the bow section of an old First League cruiser orbiting [From.GetName]. A boarding party will need to study the remains if we are to learn more.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]应该是已消灭的汉姆达的母星，该种群是古老第一联盟的创始成员之一。[From.GetPlanetMoon]深陷于废墟之间，等待发掘。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] appears to be the homeworld of the extinct Khamdai, one of the founding members of the ancient First League. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is covered in ruins ready to be excavated.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现[From.GetName]是绝迹的卡萨克的母星，该种群是古老第一联盟的创始成员之一。在[From.GetPlanetMoon]的表面上，仍可以看到地下城市的废墟。
excerpt.en: We have identified [From.GetName] as the ancient homeworld of the serpentine Chassago, one of the founding members of the First League. There are still ruins from their subterranean cities to be found on the [From.GetPla

excerpt.zh: 百万年前，米格杨是第一联盟的创始成员之一，我们认为[From.GetName]是他们的母星。这么多年过去了，他们高耸入云的遗迹仍旧矗立。
excerpt.en: Two million years ago, the Migir-Yan were among the founding members of the First League, and we believe [From.GetName] was their homeworld. Even after all these years, a few of their towering arcologies are still standi

excerpt.zh: 古老的维若帕是第一联盟的创始成员之一，有证据显示[From.GetName]曾经是他们的母星。这些鸟类挖空了山脉，建造了巨大的城市，我们考古学家有兴趣探索调查他们的废墟。
excerpt.en: The ancient V'ropak were founding members of the First League, and evidence suggests that [From.GetName] was their homeworld. These avians built great cities within hollowed out mesas, and our archaeologists would like p

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的表面能看到大地面装置的废墟。我们认为这里曾经是古老的第一联盟建立的研究基地，但要靠近调查才能确定。
excerpt.en: The ruins of a large ground installation can be found on the surface of [From.GetName]. We believe these buildings were part of a major research base built by the ancient First League, but the ruins need to be studied mo

excerpt.zh: 第一联盟将殖民地建立在了[From.GetName]的五湖四海上，这里曾到处都是各其成员物种。殖民地看起来像是衰落了，但我们必须挖掘废墟以确定它消逝的原因。
excerpt.en: The First League established a colony on [From.GetName] at some point, populating it with settlers from all of its member species. It would seem the colony failed, but we will have to excavate the ruins to determine why.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]曾经是古老的第一联盟主要的贸易中心。[From.GetPlanetMoon]曾经高度城市化，现在还留下了许多废墟供考古学家研究。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] was once a major center of trade in the ancient First League. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] was heavily urbanized, and there are still plenty of ruins left for our archaeologists to study.

excerpt.zh: 两百万年前，第一联盟一场大型飞船战斗在[From.GetName]附近爆发。飞往[From.GetPlanetMoon]的航道上，还能看到这些飞船的残骸，我们的考古学家建议在附近建立营地。
excerpt.en: A massive fleet battle involving the First League occurred two million years ago near [From.GetName]. Some of the wreckage found its way to the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface, and our archaeologists suggest the establish

excerpt.zh: [From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]气候恶劣，是古代的第一联盟的罪犯流放地，这里危机四伏，但要是建立考古发掘场的话，应该可以发掘出一些监狱设施。
excerpt.en: The hostile [From.GetPlanetMoon] of [From.GetName] served as a penal colony in the ancient First League, and some of the prison facilities could be excavated if we establish an archaeological dig site.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]是某个尚处于青铜时代初期的文明的母星，该文明处在第一联盟的观测下。已发现数处有价值的考古挖掘场。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] was the homeworld of an early Bronze Age civilization that appears to have been under observation by the First League. Several promising dig sites have already been identified.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]是某个未知物种的母星，这个物种似乎受到第一联盟飞船的轨道封锁。派出考古队有望发掘更多信息。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] was the homeworld of an unidentified species that seems to have been the subject of an orbital blockade by ships from the First League. An archaeological mission will hopefully reveal more.

excerpt.zh: 小行星[From.GetName]显然曾经是走私犯、海盗和第一联盟内其他罪犯的藏身之处。我们应该对这颗小行星的内部进行彻查，以期发现可能存在的来自第一联合的文物。
excerpt.en: Asteroid [From.GetName] was apparently used as hidden port by smugglers, pirates and other criminal elements within the First League. We should comb through the interior of this asteroid for First League artifacts.

excerpt.zh: 哈本尼斯之泽恒星系是远古第一联盟的行政中心和经济中心。
excerpt.en: The Fen Habbanis system was the political, administrative and economical center of the ancient First League.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]上伊拉斯人的殖民地因贾沃疹而毁灭，但有证据表明这事情发生前[From.GetPlanetMoon]曾受到封锁。我们需要更深入地检查轨道碎片，以获取更多信息。
excerpt.en: The Irassian colony on [From.GetName] fell to the Javorian Pox, but there is evidence that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was subjected to a blockade just before this happened. To learn more, we will have to examine the orbita

excerpt.zh: 一百二十万年前，[From.GetName]遭受到一次猛烈的轨道轰炸，在此之前[From.GetPlanetMoon]曾是伊拉斯人的一个繁荣的殖民地。也许一次考古调查可以了解更多情况。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] was subjected to massive orbital bombardment 1.2 million years ago, but before that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was a flourishing Irassian colony. Perhaps an archaeological expedition can learn more.

excerpt.zh: 软体类物种丘格拉起源于[From.GetName]，它是一个被伊拉斯协约国所征服的物种。我们对其知之甚少，不过没准一次考古调查便可以弥补这点。
excerpt.en: The molluscoid Joggra originated on [From.GetName], a subjugated client species of the Irassian Concordat. Little is known of them, but perhaps an archaeological expedition can remedy this.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]是提德格的远古母星，但一百二十万年前，它遭受了一次全面的轨道轰炸。我们知道提德格是伊拉斯人的几个附庸物种之一，但究竟是什么原因促成了这次轰炸依旧是个谜。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] was the ancient homeworld of the Ti'Derg, but it suffered a comprehensive orbital bombardment 1.2 million years ago. It is known that the Ti'Derg were one of several Irassian client species, but exactly wh

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]上伊拉斯人的殖民地遗迹里只剩下化石与废墟。它看起来像是成为了贾沃疹的另一个受害者，但也许一次考古调查可以让我们对这个殖民地的命运有更多的了解。
excerpt.en: Only ruins and fossils remain of the Irassian colony on [From.GetName]. It appears to have been another victim of the Javorian Pox, but perhaps an archaeological mission can shed some more light on the colony's fate.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]上深深的矿洞表明，这里曾经是伊拉斯人的采矿基地。我们的考古学家想要深入调查。
excerpt.en: The deep boreholes on [From.GetName] indicate the former presence of an Irassian mining base. Our archaeologists would like to investigate them further.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]曾是一个很早就受到贾沃疹打击的受害地，我们的考古学家想研究伊拉斯人的殖民地以发现蛛丝马迹，从而追踪瘟疫的病原。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] was an early victim of the Javorian Pox, and our archaeologists would like to study the former Irassian colony for clues as to the origin of the disease.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的轨道上发现了一艘废弃的伊拉斯巡洋舰。一队考古学家已经整装待发。
excerpt.en: We have encountered a derelict Irassian cruiser orbiting [From.GetName]. A team of archaeologists stand ready to board the vessel.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]上发现了伊拉斯人的轨道空间站碎片，这里应该是他们疾病控制权威部门的总部，若想获得更多信息，需要对废墟进行广泛搜寻。
excerpt.en: The shattered remains of an Irassian orbital station was found above [From.GetName]. It appears to have served as the headquarters of their Disease Control authority, but to learn more we will need to conduct an extensiv

excerpt.zh: 小行星[From.GetName]上发现了被遗弃的军用监听哨站。我们认为这是古老的伊拉斯协约国设立的。
excerpt.en: An abandoned military listening post has been found on asteroid [From.GetName]. We believe it may have been constructed by the ancient Irassian Concordat.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]周围轨道上发现了一座古老的伊拉斯人的研究站遗址。看上去伊拉斯出于某种原因一直在研究这个气态巨行星。
excerpt.en: Orbital debris from an ancient Irassian research station has been found above [From.GetName]. The Irassians appear to have been studying the gas giant for some reason.

excerpt.zh: 伊拉斯星系是古老的伊拉斯协约国的核心。
excerpt.en: The Irass system was the heart of the ancient Irassian Concordat.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]曾经是克尔的母星，同样受到了残暴的赛博勒克斯的攻击。克尔文明就只残留下少数几个废墟，它们依旧有研究价值。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName], the former Kuur homeworld, is yet another victim of the rampaging Cybrex. A few crumbling ruins are all that remains of the Kuur civilization, but they should be investigated.

excerpt.zh: 在名为赛博勒克斯的机械意识将其战体降临于此并毁灭一切之前，[From.GetName]是古老的因迪马克文明的母星。这里或许会有重大的考古发现。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] was once the homeworld of the ancient Indimak civilization, before the warforms of the Cybrex machine consciousness descended upon it leaving only destruction in their wake. There may be important archaeol

records.zh: 受损的赛博勒克斯战体

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近轨道上发现了两个赛博勒克斯的战体残骸。需要深入调查。
excerpt.en: Two ruined Cybrex warforms have been found in orbit around [From.GetName]. They should be investigated more closely.

excerpt.zh: 很久以前[From.GetName]发生过一场大规模的地面战争，当时赛博勒克斯正在攻击[From.GetPlanetMoon]的原住民。现在依旧可能在这古战场找到当年的文物。
excerpt.en: A ground war of massive proportions took place on [From.GetName] long ago, when the Cybrex invaded the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s original owners. This ancient battlefield should be searched for artifacts.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]是被赛博勒克斯高度开发的星球，但在赤道附近有一片矩形的未被开发过的区域。我们的科学家必须搞清楚原因。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] was heavily developed by the Cybrex, but for unclear reasons they left a large rectangular area near the equator mostly untouched. Our archaeologists should investigate why.

excerpt.zh: 小行星[From.GetName]实际上并非一个小行星，而是赛博勒克斯的人造航天器。大约在60万年前，赛博勒克斯把它用作一处监听哨站。
excerpt.en: Asteroid [From.GetName] is actually not an asteroid, but an artificially constructed object made by the Cybrex. It served them as a concealed listening post roughly 600,000 years ago.

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]周围的轨道上漂浮着一些来自赛博勒克斯精炼厂的碎片。看起来这些机器曾经在这里进行过某种形式的采矿作业。
excerpt.en: Debris from a large Cybrex refinery complex floats in orbit over [From.GetName]. It seems like the machines were engaged in some kind of mining operation here.

excerpt.zh: 大约60万年前在[From.GetName]附近爆发过一场大规模的太空会战，至少五支舰队参与其中。其中一支属于赛博勒克斯。
excerpt.en: A space battle of truly colossal proportions took place near [From.GetName] 600,000 years ago with ships from at least five different fleets involved. One of these fleets belonged to the Cybrex.

excerpt.zh: 以前在[From.GetName]的表面有一个属于赛博勒克斯的基地，但现在这里仅剩一个弹坑。我们应该调查清楚到底发生了什么。
excerpt.en: There was once a large Cybrex base on the surface of [From.GetName], until it was reduced to a crater. We should investigate what happened.

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近轨道发现了大约一千具外星人尸体。他们死亡时间与赛博勒克斯控制这部分星系的时间大致相符。
excerpt.en: The corpses from almost a thousand aliens have been found in orbit above [From.GetName]. They appear to have died around the same time as the Cybrex controlled this portion of the galaxy.

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近轨道发现的赛博勒克斯研究站其中一个工作模块中包含了一些赛博勒克斯族的残留物。
excerpt.en: A module from a Cybrex research station was found orbiting [From.GetName] containing the remnants of some kind of cybernetic creatures.

excerpt.zh: 赛博勒克斯最后似乎撤离到了这个星系。
excerpt.en: The Cybrex seem to have retreated to this star system.

excerpt.zh: 在海洋星球[This.GetName]的海面下发现了塔布拉克。
excerpt.en: Tarblacs are found deep beneath the waves on the ocean world [This.GetName].

excerpt.zh: [This.GetName]潮湿的丛林中出现过塔萨古德的身影。
excerpt.en: Tassargoids have been sighted in the humid jungles of [This.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 欧林提在[This.GetName]各地大规模存在。
excerpt.en: Orinthi have been reported in large numbers across most of [This.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 萨尼兰只存在于[This.GetName]的沙海中。
excerpt.en: Snirans are unique to the great dune seas of [This.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 古兰萨兽群可能只存在于[This.GetName]的开阔草原上。
excerpt.en: Goolantha herds may only be found on the open steppes of [This.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 乌杜兰的踪迹只出现在[This.GetName]被雪覆盖的荒地上。
excerpt.en: Uddlorans can be found racing through the snowy wastes of [This.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 祖卡虫群是[This.GetName]干燥峡谷的原住民。
excerpt.en: Zulcor swarms are native to the dry canyons of [This.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 在[space_probe.GetStarName]星系中，我们发现了我们老旧的亚光速探测器。一定要尽快回收。
excerpt.en: We have sighted one of our old sublight space probes in the [space_probe.GetStarName] system. It must be recovered as soon as possible.

excerpt.zh: 一条邪教徒的舰船被我们的武装力量所瘫痪。我们应该登船以确保我们能够找到有价值的情报和人员。
excerpt.en: One of the cultist ships has been disabled by our forces. We should conduct a boarding operation to secure prisoners and any intelligence assets we find.

excerpt.zh: 我们瘫痪掉了邪教徒的旗舰！若想成功登陆并俘获舰船，必须派出大量部队。
excerpt.en: We have disabled the cultist flagship! A substantial number of troops will be needed to successfully board and capture the vessel.

excerpt.zh: 这群邪教徒看来发展出了某种新武器，追踪他们基地的行动到这里就中止了。如果我们调查他们的科技，我们或许可以发现邪教徒领袖的下落。
excerpt.en: The cult has been developing some new type of weapon, and the trace to their base of operations have ended here. If we investigate their technology we might find some clues to their leader's whereabouts.

excerpt.zh: 走私贩们在[From.GetName]地表设立了一个非法哨站，这是一个受到我们保护的土著庇护所星球。必须在他们的行为对[From.GetPlanetMoon]的本土文明造成更大的危害前消除掉这个隐患。
excerpt.en: Smugglers have established an illegal outpost on the surface of [From.GetName], a primitive sanctuary world under our protection. They must be removed before they cause lasting harm to the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s native c

excerpt.zh: 我们终于追踪到叛徒是在[From.GetName]上城市郊区的一处藏身之所。我们有必要下令舰队从太空中对这个地点进行轰炸。
excerpt.en: Our rogue covert infiltration operative on [From.GetName] has finally been tracked to a safe house in the suburbs of a large city. We need fleet assets in orbit to bombard his position from space.

excerpt.zh: 由于我们在[prelude_to_war_planet.GetName]上的秘密行动出现了意外，[prelude_to_war_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经到达了核战爆发的边缘。我们在[prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon]上的渗透单位要求一艘在轨的科研船平息这一局面。
excerpt.en: Due to an incident related to our covert infiltration program on [prelude_to_war_planet.GetName], the [prelude_to_war_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been brought to the brink of nuclear war. Our infiltration cells on

excerpt.zh: 不知道为什么，有人将[shielded_planet.GetName]包裹在了一个无法被穿透的能量屏障中。屏障的能量层级在不断波动，说明它已经被启用数千年了。我们必须找到解除这个屏障的方法，然后发掘其背后的秘密。
excerpt.en: For reasons unknown, someone or something has encased [shielded_planet.GetName] in an impenetrable energy shield. Its energy levels are fluctuating, suggesting that the shield has been active for many thousands of years.

excerpt.zh:
我们需要进一步了解我们将其编码命名为§Y[Prev.From.GetName]§!的神秘外星种群。如果他们也拥有语言，那我们必须对其进行破译并且建立交流。

奖励：£influence£ §G影响力§!或§S特殊项目§!
excerpt.en:
We need to learn more about the mysterious aliens we have code-named §Y[Prev.From.GetName]§!. If they possess a language, we must decipher it and establish communications.

Reward: £influence£ §GInfluence§! or §SSpecial

excerpt.zh: 风信子号位于[hyacinth_planet.GetName]，从结构上看没有遭受损伤。我们需要集结一支登陆部队来确认在这艘方舟船上究竟发生了什么。
excerpt.en: The Hyacinth has been located above [hyacinth_planet.GetName] and appears to be structurally intact. We will have to assemble a boarding party to learn what has happened to the arkship.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower][pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]之中发现了一位才华横溢的科学家。[abducted_scientist.GetHisHerCap]卓越的才能被浪费在[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的[GetPreFTLLower]文明中，但[abducted_scientist.GetHeSh
excerpt.en: A brilliant scientist has been identified among the [GetPreFTLLower] [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. [abducted_scientist.GetHisHerCap] considerable skill is wasted on [abducted_scienti

excerpt.zh: 我们给[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的数名[GetPreFTLLowerPlural][pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]测试对象安装大脑植入体之后，遇到了一些问题。他们产生了一系列功能失常的问题，引发了测试者的暴力行为，甚至导致了受试者的死亡。我们需要在产生更多的问题前拆除这些植入体。
excerpt.en: We are having problems with the brain implants that were given to several test subjects among the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. There have been a number of mal

excerpt.zh: 来自[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]民族国家已经联合在一起并组建了反抗外星人的军事力量，其使命便是阻扰我们在这个星球的行动。这是不能容忍的。我们必须对其主基地进行一次惩罚性的打击。
excerpt.en: The [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] nation states on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have banded together and formed an anti-alien task force with the mission to thwart our operations on their homeworld. This cannot be tolerat

excerpt.zh: 合成人潜入者对[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的渗透正在[Root.GetName]内进行。我们需要拿出一个有效而可靠的方法来识别他们。
excerpt.en: Synthetic infiltrators disguised as [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are operating within the [Root.GetName]. We need to come up with some kind of reliable and efficient method of identifying them.

excerpt.zh: [queen_system.GetName]星系最近发生了一场太空战，一只索林原虫虫后重伤濒死，但其仍有生命体征。捕获它将是情报界的一场重大胜利。
excerpt.en: After a recent space battle in the [queen_system.GetName] system, a Prethoryn Queen was badly injured and left for dead by the rest of the Scourge. The creature is still alive, however. Capturing it would be a major inte

excerpt.zh:
主力舰队已按计划开入靠近[exercise_neighbor.GetName]边界的[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系。这次演习主要是模拟[exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesName]军队在入侵之前向我方边界内发射探测器。

一旦所有参演部队到达[exercise_location.GetName]轨道的预定位置，演习就会开始。
excerpt.en: Major fleet maneuvers have been planned in the [exercise_system.GetName] system, close to the border of the [exercise_neighbor.GetName]. The purpose of this exercise is to simulate a hostile probe by significant [exercis

主力舰队已按计划开入靠近[exercise_neighbor.GetName]边界的[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系。这次演习主要是模拟[exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesName]军队在入侵之前向我方边界内发射探测器。
