excerpt.zh:
主力舰队已按计划开入靠近[exercise_neighbor.GetName]边界的[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系。这次演习主要是模拟[exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesName]军队在入侵之前向我方边界内发射探测器。

一旦所有参演部队到达[exercise_location.GetName]轨道的预定位置，演习就会开始。
excerpt.en: Major fleet maneuvers have been planned in the [exercise_system.GetName] system, close to the border of the [exercise_neighbor.GetName]. The purpose of this exercise is to simulate a hostile probe by significant [exercis

excerpt.zh: 我们必须在万事皆休之前设法屏蔽幽灵信号入侵我们的中控核心！
excerpt.en: We must find a way to block the Ghost Signal and prevent it from corrupting our main core before it's too late.

excerpt.zh: 我们得知，在十分遥远的过去，可能有先驱者曾在§H[precursor_planet.GetName]§!上活动。据了解，古老的沃陶姆恒星众的影响范围已经触及到我们所在的这个区域，使得在这个世界的我们能够在探索他们的文明的道路上领先一大步。
excerpt.en: We have learned that there may have been Precursor activity on §H[precursor_planet.GetName]§! at some point in the galactic past. The sphere of influence of the ancient Vultaum Star Assembly is known to have extended to

excerpt.zh: 我们得知，在十分遥远的过去，可能有先驱者曾在§H[precursor_planet.GetName]§!上活动。据了解，古老尤特帝国的影响范围已经触及到我们所在的这个区域，使得在这个世界的我们能够在探索他们的文明的道路上领先一大步。
excerpt.en: We have learned that there may have been Precursor activity on §H[precursor_planet.GetName]§! at some point in the galactic past. The sphere of influence of the ancient Yuht Empire is known to have extended to this regio

excerpt.zh: 我们得知，在十分遥远的过去，可能有先驱者曾在§H[precursor_planet.GetName]§!上活动。据了解，古老的第一联盟的影响范围已经触及到我们所在的这个区域，使得在这个世界的我们能够在探索他们的文明的道路上领先一大步。
excerpt.en: We have learned that there may have been Precursor activity on §H[precursor_planet.GetName]§! at some point in the galactic past. The sphere of influence of the ancient First League is known to have extended to this regi

excerpt.zh: 我们得知，在十分遥远的过去，可能有先驱者曾在§H[precursor_planet.GetName]§!上活动。据了解，古老的伊拉斯协约国的影响范围已经触及到我们所在的这个区域，使得在这个世界的我们能够在探索他们的文明的道路上领先一大步。
excerpt.en: We have learned that there may have been Precursor activity on §H[precursor_planet.GetName]§! at some point in the galactic past. The sphere of influence of the ancient Irassian Concordat is known to have extended to thi

excerpt.zh: 我们得知，在十分遥远的过去，可能有先驱者曾在§H[precursor_planet.GetName]§!上活动。据了解，古老的赛博勒克斯的影响范围已经触及到我们所在的这个区域，使得在这个世界的我们能够在探索他们的文明的道路上领先一大步。
excerpt.en: We have learned that there may have been Precursor activity on §H[precursor_planet.GetName]§! at some point in the galactic past. The sphere of influence of the ancient Cybrex is known to have extended to this region of

excerpt.zh: 对[Root.GetName]神奇的气象学进行深入研究对我们的科学发展的帮助无可估量。
excerpt.en: Research into [Root.GetName]'s fascinating meteorology could prove invaluable to our scientific development.

excerpt.zh: 这个星球上的植物群非常地灵巧，惊人地具有侵略性，绝对值得近距离研究。
excerpt.en: The planet's flora is remarkably dexterous, alarmingly aggressive, and definitely worthy of closer study.

excerpt.zh:
奇怪的信号从卫星上发出。也许什么都不是。

但也可能是重要的东西。利用轨道上的飞船作为通讯中继，殖民地科学家仔细扫描了卫星表面以探查事情的真相。
excerpt.en:
Strange readings are coming from the planet's moon. It could be nothing.

But it could be something. With a ship in orbit acting as a relay, the colony's scientists will carefully scan the moon's surface in order to get

excerpt.zh: 星球的当地的一些植物呈现出许多潜在的有趣特性。
excerpt.en: Some of the planet's native flora exhibit several potentially interesting properties.

excerpt.zh: 最近，名声在外的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]学术中心提出了一些组织大量劳动力的可行方法。一项对这些新方法的彻底研究可以解决在富有挑战性的殖民地环境中生产力衰退的问题。
excerpt.en: Several recent studies from reputable [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] seats of learning present a number of alternative ways of arranging a vast workforce. An exhaustive meta-study of these new ideas could provide the answer

excerpt.zh:
行星上花粉感染的状况变成了某种潜在的威胁。一项对殖民地状况特别是其愈加不稳定的环境因素的快速评估至关重要。

一旦了解了所有的威胁，可以在几小时内制定并执行一个应对方案。
excerpt.en: The situation on the pollen-infested planet has taken a turn for the potentially dangerous. A speedy assessment of the colony's unique situation and especially its increasingly volatile environmental factors is of the ut

excerpt.zh:
恩赐女神神龛的每一面上都覆盖着由的象形文字组成的复杂网络，似乎在诉说着一个远比[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的上古传说更加恢弘的故事。

即使只是与已知的古[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]语言有着些许的关系，只要有足够的时间和资源，在当代科技的帮助下，我们也可以解读这些象形文字。
excerpt.en:
Every surface of the Benefactress' shrine is covered with a complex web of pictograms, seemingly telling a story far more expansive than the lingering fables on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

Though only distantly relate

excerpt.zh:
一如萦绕着祂的神话传说，供奉勇气之神神龛的神庙充满了无法确定来源与作用的装置。与简单的谜箱相去甚远，位于[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的祂的神庙中四处充满着对力量的试炼，传说只有真正的贤者才读到祂的圣言。

我们先进的分析工具应该可以迅速破解这些密码。
excerpt.en: The temple holding the Undaunted's shrine is - true to the myths surrounding him - filled with contraptions of indeterminate origin and purpose. A far cry from the simple puzzle-boxes and tests of strength that once fill

excerpt.zh:
放置着洞察女神神像的洞室，其外墙被一层层厚重的金属漆所覆盖，但神像本身却是光秃秃的。

洞察女神的传说只会告诉那些能够理解这些传说的人——只有足够敏锐的人才能分辨哪些东西是真正需要领会的。
excerpt.en:
The walls housing this shrine to the Percipient are coated with thick layers of a mineral-based lacquer, but the shrine itself is bare.

The tales of the Percipient are told only to those perceptive enough to understand

excerpt.zh:
随着首席科学官从这个星系毫无征兆的离去，大量令人困惑的残余能量信号随着太阳风被投射出去。

但愿彻底研究这些能量能帮我们找出首席科学家的下一个目的地，甚至，如果有必要，让我们更容易地追踪他。
excerpt.en:
The Chairperson's unseen departure from this system resulted in a perplexing mass of residual energy signatures being cast upon the solar winds.

Hopefully a complete analysis of these energies should point us to the Cha

excerpt.zh: 重构该天体悲惨的过去。
excerpt.en: Reconstruct the traumatic past of this celestial body.

excerpt.zh: 重构该天体悲惨的过去。
excerpt.en: Reconstruct the traumatic past of this celestial body.

excerpt.zh: 重构该天体悲惨的过去。
excerpt.en: Reconstruct the traumatic past of this celestial body.

excerpt.zh: 重构该天体悲惨的过去。
excerpt.en: Reconstruct the traumatic past of this celestial body.

excerpt.zh: 重构该天体悲惨的过去。
excerpt.en: Reconstruct the traumatic past of this celestial body.

excerpt.zh: 一个满载着各种数据存储设备的外星避难所，亟待考古学家恢复数据。
excerpt.en: An alien vault filled with data storage devices practically begs for some archaeological data recovery.

excerpt.zh: 一颗异常的行星和它异常的卫星；常规的技术无法给出满意的探测结果，需要进行更加实地的调查。
excerpt.en: An unusual planet has an unusual moon; the usual scanning techniques do not give satisfactory results, and a more hands-on approach is needed.

excerpt.zh: 如果我们尽快行动，这颗星球上的剧烈变动可能得以稳定，并成为潜在的宜居地。
excerpt.en: The violently animated face of this planet can be stabilized into something potentially habitable, if we act soon.

excerpt.zh: 一件外星文物被怀疑通过雾化的芳香化合物传输信息。
excerpt.en: An alien artifact is suspected of relaying information through aerosolized aromatic compounds.

excerpt.zh: 在这个星球的某个地方藏匿着一个武器箱。如果我们能找它，也许我们的帝国可以借此获得新的武器技术。
excerpt.en: A cache of weapons lie hidden somewhere on the planet. If we can find them, they may provide new martial technologies for our Empire.

excerpt.zh: 在轨可控阳电子扩散法也许可以将星球原有的矿物质变成一种更有用的形式。
excerpt.en: Controlled dispersal of positrons from orbit may change the minerals native to the planet into a more useful form.

excerpt.zh: 一项对于这些废墟的最新异种社会考古学研究也许能帮助我们理解这些古代外星战争机器。
excerpt.en: A closer xeno-socio-archaeological study of these ruins may provide insights into some past alien war machine.

excerpt.zh: 一种矿石结阵储存着某种全息编码信息。它的结构很常见，但是其中蕴含的数据密度使得它难以被解密。
excerpt.en: A mineral formation houses hologram-encoded information. Its structure is familiar, but the sheer data density makes it a challenge to decode.

excerpt.zh: 一个杂草丛生的设施也许蕴藏着重要的秘密。
excerpt.en: An overgrown facility may house important secrets.

excerpt.zh: 安排一个科学部门收集并整理太空变形虫的相关数据。
excerpt.en: Task a science department with collecting and collating data relating to the Space Amoebas.

excerpt.zh: 不知为何，我们的舰队似乎会激怒太空变形虫。要是能够确定其原因，也许就能降低变形虫的侵略性，甚至将我们的舰队从其感官中完全屏蔽。
excerpt.en: Something about our fleets seems to agitate the Space Amoebas. If we could somehow isolate what this something is, we could reduce Amoeba aggression or possibly completely mask our ships from their senses.

excerpt.zh: 安排一个科学部门收集并整理晶态实体的相关数据。
excerpt.en: Task a science department with collecting and collating data relating to the Crystalline Entities.

excerpt.zh: 在某些星系中观察到的晶态实体处于不稳定状态，也许会造成危险。
excerpt.en: The Crystalline Entities observed in some systems are volatile and potentially dangerous.

excerpt.zh: 安排一个科学部门收集并整理远古采矿无人机的相关数据。
excerpt.en: Task a science department with collecting and collating data relating to the Ancient Mining Drones.

excerpt.zh: 指派一个科学部门收集并整理虚空之云的相关数据。
excerpt.en: Task a science department with collecting and collating data relating to the Void Clouds.

excerpt.zh:
有一个仅用标准科研船上的设备就能使星球上失衡生态圈恢复平衡的方案被设计了出来。

也许会造成无法预见的后果。
excerpt.en:
A plan has been formulated to attempt to balance the planet's lopsided biosphere using only the tools available to a standard Science Ship.

There may be unforeseen consequences.

excerpt.zh: 可派一支军事舰队尝试打捞这艘一直被掩埋的舰船。
excerpt.en: A military fleet can attempt to salvage an ever-burrowing ship.

excerpt.zh: 一个漂浮在太空的数据库，里面仅仅储存着一篇用陌生但又熟悉的外星文字写成的冗长文章。
excerpt.en: A databank found floating in space houses nothing but a lengthy piece of text, written in a strange, yet familiar, alien language.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一个严重受损的物体，这似乎是一个通讯信标。
excerpt.en: A heavily-damaged object seems to act as a repeater for a comms signal.

excerpt.zh: 解码碑塔上的信息。
excerpt.en: Decode the message emanating from the monolith.

excerpt.zh: 部署工程队伍修复舰船，使之恢复工作状态。
excerpt.en: Deploy engineering teams to restore the salvageable vessels to working order.

excerpt.zh: 部署工程队伍来修复古代轨道矿场使之恢复工作状态。
excerpt.en: Deploy engineering teams to restore an ancient orbital station to working order.

excerpt.zh: 一条舰船漂浮在太空中，没有信号交互。更仔细的检查也许能弄清她的船员遭遇了些什么。
excerpt.en: A ship adrift in space, no signals going in or coming out. Inspecting it more closely might shed some light on what has happened to the crew.

excerpt.zh: 一支在沙漠星球上坠毁的古老舰队被发现了，她们的舰载AI仍然活跃。如果我们不去压制她，情况会急转直下。
excerpt.en: An ancient fleet has been found crashed on a desert planet, with a still-active shipboard AI. If we do not move to subdue it, things might take a turn for the worse.

excerpt.zh: 这颗星似乎能聚变产生铍，但这理应是不可能的。
excerpt.en: The star is appearing to be able to fuse beryllium, which shouldn't be possible.

excerpt.zh: 一个陶瓷茶壶围绕着恒星公转……这实在令人难以置信。搞清楚它是怎么形成的需要耗费很多时间。谁知道我们能否找到这个问题的答案，或者说甚至这个问题根本就没有答案？
excerpt.en: A ceramic pot is orbiting a sun... this is beyond improbable. Figuring out what it does there will take quite some time. Who knows what the answer will be, or if there even is one?

excerpt.zh: 一个古老的挖掘机正在向巨大的小行星深处挖掘。如果我们能够在碎石压坏它之前停下它，我们也许可以学到一些建设方面有用的东西。
excerpt.en: An ancient excavator is digging deep into a giant asteroid. If we can stop it before it gets crushed by debris we might be able to learn something worthwhile about the construction.

excerpt.zh: 一座被遗弃的传感器阵列似乎处于工作状态。如果我们能修复它并弄清楚它是如何工作的，我们也许能获得更多周边星系的详细信息。
excerpt.en: An abandoned sensor dish seems to be in working condition. If we perform some repairs and figure out how it functions we might be able to gain more insight into neighboring systems.

excerpt.zh: 一艘外星飞船在小行星带中漂泊。它并没有回应呼叫。我们应该调查到底发生了什么。
excerpt.en: An alien ship is drifting inside an asteroid belt. It will not respond to hails. We should investigate and see what is going on.

excerpt.zh: 一个宏伟的哺乳动物种群漫步在水草丰茂的旷野。他们似乎对我们的靠近有点不安。近距离的研究能带给我们更多的信息。
excerpt.en: A majestic race of mammals roam fields of water grass. They seem skittish and have insight into our approaches. Studying them up close could give us more information.

excerpt.zh: 在一颗遥远的星球上发现一座了塞满机器人的工厂。如果我们重新激活他们，可能会揭示他们家园的秘密。
excerpt.en: A facility filled with robots has been found on a distant planet. If we reactivate them, they might reveal the secrets of their home.

excerpt.zh: [Root.Owner.GetMonsterOnShipDesc]
excerpt.en: [Root.Owner.GetMonsterOnShipDesc]

excerpt.zh: 一棵树孤零零地在太空的虚无中漂流，它的汁液吸引了太空中的各种凶猛生物。我们应该调查它的作用。
excerpt.en: A tree drifts defiantly through the emptiness of space. Its sap seems to attract monstrous spaceborne organics. We should investigate to figure out its purpose.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一摞文件，这似乎对一个已经消亡的社群很重要。翻译它们定能为我们提供更深入了解其历史与文化的机会。
excerpt.en: We have uncovered a stash of documents that seem to have been important to the now dead society. Translating them will surely provide us with a more in-depth look into its history and culture.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一个外星人探险家携带的一些文本。如果我们能够翻译它们，我们也许能了解更多有关它曾经主人的信息。
excerpt.en: We've found some texts that were carried by an alien expedition. If we translate them we might uncover more information and learn about the previous owners.

excerpt.zh: 我们在一个貌似星际贸易站的废墟中发现了一些文本。如果我们能够翻译这些文件，我们可以更多地了解那些建立它的人。
excerpt.en: We've found some texts among the ruins of a possible interstellar trading hub. If we translate these documents we could learn more about the ones who founded it.

excerpt.zh: 我们在一个废弃已久的战场遗迹上发现了一群战士的遗骸，以及他们所携带的必定对他们很重要的文件。如果我们翻译这些文件，我们可以了解的更多关于这个种族以及他们所进行的战争。
excerpt.en: We found remains of a warrior people on a long abandoned battlefield, and they were carrying texts that must have been important to them. If we translate these documents we could learn more about this people and the wars

excerpt.zh: 我们在山体底下找到了一个可能包含宝贵信息或者装置的建筑物。它的周围有危险的野生动物，为了得到它我们需要制服这些野兽。
excerpt.en: We found a structure beneath a mountain which could contain valuable information or gear. It is surrounded by dangerous wildlife and we need to subdue these beasts in order to get to it.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现的避难所中存放着一个容器。如果我们想知道里面有什么，我们需要找到撬开它的最佳方法。
excerpt.en: The underground vault we found held only a container of sorts. We need to figure out how to best pry it open if we want to find out what is inside.

excerpt.zh: 一艘外星人的巡洋舰躺在[Root.GetName]的海底。打捞她也许能得到宝贵的技术或资源。
excerpt.en: An alien battlecruiser lies beneath the waves of [Root.GetName]. Salvaging it could yield valuable technology or resources.

excerpt.zh: 尝试移除我们在[Root.GetName]上的致幻气体。
excerpt.en: Attempt to remove the hallucinogen from [Root.GetName]'s atmosphere.

excerpt.zh: 通过研究在[Root.GetName]上的泰坦巨兽，我们有望了解它们，甚至与它们进行交流。
excerpt.en: By studying the Titanic Life of [Root.GetName], we can hopefully learn to understand them and possibly even communicate.

excerpt.zh: 通过捕获在[Root.GetName]上的泰坦巨兽，我们将会研究出如何利用它们！
excerpt.en: By harvesting the Titanic Life of [Root.GetName], we should soon work out how best to exploit them!

excerpt.zh: 通过谨慎地监视[Root.GetName]上的泰坦巨兽，我们希望尽可能与它们和平共处。
excerpt.en: By carefully monitoring the Titanic Life of [Root.GetName], we hope to be able to coexist peacefully with them.

excerpt.zh: 数个奇怪的磁场干扰已经影响了[Root.GetName]上的生活。直到不久之前，磁场干扰的起因仍是个谜，但现在我们已经积累了足够的数据，应该可以揭露真相了。
excerpt.en: Several strange magnetic disturbances have unsettled life on [Root.GetName]. Until recently their cause was a complete mystery, but with the data gathered from repeated events it should now be possible to uncover the tru

excerpt.zh: 派遣一艘舰船去外星人的母星，我们将在它们身上收集那些我们认为它们从我们身上搜集了的数据。
excerpt.en: Sending a ship to the alien homeworld, we will be able to gather the same data on them that we suspect them to have on us.

excerpt.zh: 我们必须找出那个似乎对我们有放松作用的神秘乐器的原始物质。
excerpt.en: We must find the source material of the mysterious instrument that appears to have a relaxing effect on us.

excerpt.zh: [missing_pops_planet.GetName]的执法部门为了顺利地调查最近的一起神秘的人口失踪事件，需要军队的配合来平息骚乱。
excerpt.en: Local law-enforcement on [missing_pops_planet.GetName] need the support of a military strike force to stifle unrest as they investigate a recent wave of mysterious disappearances.

excerpt.zh: 最近一种名叫寿无限的抗衰老霜疯狂地在全帝国境内传播。这种抗衰老霜已经被证实具有刺激细胞再生的功能。如果我们能确定其中起作用的成分，或许能延长其有效时间。
excerpt.en: The new anti-aging cream Ageless is spreading like a wild-fire throughout the empire, and has shown promise of actually stimulating cell-regeneration. If we could identify the active agent we might be able to use it to p

records.en: In Pursuit of a Wrinkle-Free Existence

excerpt.zh: 我们必须找到这种抗衰老霜的来源。
excerpt.en: We must find the origin of this cream.

excerpt.zh: 对[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]进行详细勘察，试图弄清它的来源。
excerpt.en: Conduct a detailed survey of [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] and attempt to figure out where it came from.

excerpt.zh: 调查位面传送门通向何方。
excerpt.en: Investigate where the Dimensional Portal leads to.

excerpt.zh: 通过科学研究一定可以找到关闭这个传送门的方法！
excerpt.en: There has to be a way to close this portal, and science will find it!

excerpt.zh: 这个传送门一定可以用正能量来反制！
excerpt.en: Such a portal can surely be countered with positive energy!

excerpt.zh: 这个传送门一定可以用灵能来反制！
excerpt.en: Such a portal can surely be countered with Psionic energy!

excerpt.zh: 往里丢足够多的石头，或许可以把它堵住？
excerpt.en: Perhaps dumping enough rock into the portal will block it up?

excerpt.zh: 当经历过[Root.GetName]上的大破坏之后，我们不禁在想到底谁才是或者说巨尸乐队到底是怎么样的存在？
excerpt.en: After the incredible destruction on [Root.GetName] we are left wondering: Who or what are MegaCorpse?

excerpt.zh: 无论是什么样的力量在将暗物质带往我们的传送门，将其更多的吸引过来应该可以增加暗物质的产出。
excerpt.en: Whatever the strange force bringing Dark Matter to our portal is, attracting a higher level of it should result in increased production.

excerpt.zh: 通过将他们的神经扫描结果上传到到机器身体上，我们可以给这一灭绝的远古外星物种重获新生的机会。
excerpt.en: We could give an extinct species of ancient aliens a second chance at life by uploading their neural scans to robotic bodies.

excerpt.zh: 一个针对最近在§Y远古克隆仓§!的量子生物编码中发现的密码的破译计划。这是个让我们离重获繁育能力更近一步的努力。
excerpt.en: A project to work out the cipher recently discovered within the quantum bio-code of the §YAncient Clone Vats§!. An effort to bring us closer to finally reclaiming our fertility.

excerpt.zh: 不管在这个古代生物的意识世界里是什么情况，至少我们的现实宇宙还是好好地存在着。通过动用某些禁术和最新科技，我们的死灵法师相信他们能够为这个死去的生物再构造一个幻境世界。
excerpt.en: Despite what the ancient being may have thought, the universe continues to exist outside of its dead husk. Using a combination of forbidden techniques and new science, our necromancers believe they can put the lie to the

excerpt.zh: 通过对尼玛的初步研究，并结合我们的动物学知识，现在可以鼓励这一温顺驯服的物种在它们栖息地的承载范围内欣欣向荣地发展。
excerpt.en: By first studying the Nemmas and then applying our zoological expertise, we can encourage docile and obedient specimens to flourish within the carrying capacity of their habitat.

excerpt.zh: 先进的药物和义体植入体可以将尼玛变得更加温顺和易于操控。这一以来它们就可以成为负载能力强大的巨兽。
excerpt.en: Advanced drugs and cybernetic implants will render the Nemmas more docile and impressionable. In time they shall become gigantic beasts of burden.

excerpt.zh: 在小心地研究了尼玛的生物学构成后，我们的[Root.owner.GetScientistPlural]可以有效地才这些巨星爬行动物的外壳中收获有用的矿物。
excerpt.en: After carefully studying the Nemmas' biology, our [Root.owner.GetScientistPlural] can successfully harvest useful minerals from the shells of these gigantic reptiles.

excerpt.zh: 我们将不择手段从这个星球上将尼玛的威胁清除干净。
excerpt.en: We will expunge the Nemma menace from this planet by any means necessary.

excerpt.zh: 应该让尼玛处于在我们最好的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]的保护之下，然后试图寻找解决方案。
excerpt.en: We shall put the fate of the Nemma in the care of our best [Owner.GetScientistPlural] and see what solutions can be found.

excerpt.zh: [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]上的纳米虫群既是一种科学奇迹，又是一个危险。溯其起源及它们与这颗星球独特生态系统的联系对我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]来说是一个使其兴奋的挑战，当然也可潜在地促进我们对机械智能的理解。
excerpt.en: The nanite swarm on [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName] is both a technological marvel and a danger. Charting the origin of the nanites as well as their relation to the planet's unique ecology provides an exciting challenge fo

excerpt.zh: 下令对虫群进行轨道轰炸。如果有任何值得发现的秘密，我们可以从这些害虫的尸体里寻找。
excerpt.en: Order an orbital bombardment of the swarm. If there are any secrets worth discovering, we will harvest them from the shells of these gnats.

excerpt.zh: 我们对人工智能的进阶科技可以用于重编程并驯服这些纳米机器人。他们可以在这个行星上建造建筑时贡献巨大的力量，而他们与这颗星球的生态系统之间的关联，则可能可以利用来创造一个天堂。
excerpt.en: Our advanced knowledge of Artificial Intelligence can be used to reprogram and tame the nanites. They could be a great asset in building structures on the planet - and with their link to the world's ecosystem, it should

excerpt.zh:
我们物种的效能将会降低，但可育而且稳定到能进行基因修饰。

效果：
—['trait:trait_clone_soldier_infertile']特质替换为['trait:trait_clone_soldier_fertile']特质
—这一路径将§R拆除§!所有的['building:building_clone_army_clone_vat', 远古克隆仓]。
—现在可以选择['ascension_perk:ap_engineer
excerpt.en:
Our species will become less efficient, but fertile and stable enough for genetic modification.

Effects:
- The ['trait:trait_clone_soldier_infertile'] trait is replaced with the ['trait:trait_clone_soldier_fertile'] tra

excerpt.zh:
我们物种的效能将会提高，但永远不可育且不兼容基因修饰。

效果：
—['trait:trait_clone_soldier_infertile']特质替换为['trait:trait_clone_soldier_infertile_full_potential']特质。
—现在可以选择['ascension_perk:ap_engineered_evolution']飞升天赋了。
excerpt.en:
Our species will become more efficient, but forever infertile and will resist genetic modification.

Effects: 
- The ['trait:trait_clone_soldier_infertile'] trait is replaced with the ['trait:trait_clone_soldier_infertil

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName] 上的一个异常现象揭示了一群奇特的真菌的存在，它发出了一个信号……大概是。通过在源头放大信号的方法，我们的科学家相信我们可以发现该信号的目的地并更多地了解这种菌丝体。
excerpt.en: An anomaly on [From.GetName] has revealed the existence of a colony of strange fungi sending a signal... Somewhere. By amplifying it at the source, our scientists believe we could discover the destination of that signal

excerpt.zh: 突变孢子的发现，为我们开发菌丝体监听阵列提供了一个独特的机会。这些孢子更大，发出更强的信号，可以帮助我们促进“巨大蘑菇”的发育。
excerpt.en: The discovery of mutated spores offers a unique opportunity to develop our Mycelial Listening Array. These spores are bigger, send a stronger signal, and could help us foster the development of the 'Fumongus.'

excerpt.zh: 我们的科研船将大胆地发射探针，这一探针会将自身植入龙鳞之下，揭开龙那独特生命形态的奥秘。
excerpt.en: Our science vessel will boldly launch a probe that will implant itself underneath the dragon's scales and uncover the secrets of its unique biology.

excerpt.zh: 我们的科研船将在安全距离上对龙进行扫描，揣摩其独特生命形态的奥秘。
excerpt.en: Our science vessel will scan the dragon from a safe distance to divine the secrets of its unique biology.

excerpt.zh: 这些可以在极高辐射强度的星球下存活并繁衍兴盛的植物可以作为我们帝国绝佳的补充。不过在此之前，我们需要提升他们的心智并在数月内教会它们我们数千年来的进展。
excerpt.en: These plants that can live and thrive on worlds with more radiation than atmosphere could be an excellent addition to our empire. But before then, we will need to enhance their minds and teach them thousands of years of

excerpt.zh: 为错误赎罪是一项强权者的特权，在此情此景下，我们必须深切地赎罪。[From.GetName]上的灾难令人震愕，而我们唯一的愿望是我们的科学家们能够反转我们深层探测器的极性，寄希望于能以此重新点燃这颗气态巨行星内部的生命之火。
excerpt.en: Atoning for your mistakes is a privilege for those with power, and in this scenario, we must atone dearly. The disaster on [From.GetName] was horrifying, and our only hope is that our scientists can reverse the polarity

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]被[FromFrom.GetName]上的风暴围困。他们唯一的希望在于我们发射一艘新飞船过去，然后远距离重调制他们的护盾频率。
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetName] is trapped in a storm on [FromFrom.GetName]. Their only hope may rest in our sending a new ship there, and remotely modulating their shield frequencies.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]是一颗奇怪的小行星，它似乎可以通过未知的方式旋转并躲开我们的开采站。我们需要委派一艘科研船去研究它。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] is a strange asteroid that seems to be able to rotate and avoid our mining station through unknown means. We should dispatch a science ship to discover how.

excerpt.zh: 一具发现于[From.GetName]了无生机的地表上的巨型骸骨，其历史可追溯到三百万年前。我们的死灵法师已经跃跃欲试了。
excerpt.en: A gigantic skeleton dating back more than three billion years has been found on the lifeless surface of [From.GetName]. Our necromancers are to put their art to use.

excerpt.zh: 在[Solar_System.GetName]发现的这颗巨型的蛋刚刚开始产生裂缝。这是一次难以置信的好机会，能够近距离研究这种巨大生命体的繁育循环。
excerpt.en: The great egg we have discovered in [Solar_System.GetName] is just begging to be dissected. It's an incredible opportunity to get to study such a gargantuan creature's reproductive cycle this close.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一艘废弃的科研船，它在希洛士星系巡逻徘徊了一个世纪。这段孤旅背后蕴藏着怎样的隐情？
excerpt.en: An abandoned science vessel is caught in a centuries-long patrol of the Hillos system. What lies at the heart of this lonely odyssey?

excerpt.zh: 在希洛士星系检测到的灵能低语很显然属于被困在“幽灵船”乌布梅上的人工意识体。
excerpt.en: The psionic chatter detected in the Hillos system appears to belong to the artificial consciousness trapped aboard the 'ghost ship' Ubume.

excerpt.zh: 缇扬奇以气体为食。建造一座气体散播站，我们就能引走那些守在§H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§!恒星系的缇扬奇，并且接近他们的坟场。
excerpt.en: Tiyanki feed on gas. By building a gas diffuser station, we may lure out the Tiyanki stationed in the §H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§! system and gain access to their burial ground.

excerpt.zh:
通过将大量资源转移到离网操作上，我们希望能识别并销毁掉所有失控的人工智能系统，并使它们恢复正常。

这将耗费更多时间，但如果我们及时完成，希望后果不会有那么大的危害。
excerpt.en:
By diverting considerable resources to an off-the-grid operation, we hope to identify and neutralize any rampant AI systems and bring them back in line.

It will take more time, but the results will hopefully be less det

excerpt.zh:
一种解决这些产生问题的人工智能迭代的最终方案是将我们的科学系统中所有神经模拟网络全部抹除，因为这是失控最突出的地方；并从头开始构建所有这些工具，在其中植入严谨的安全措施。

如果我们及时完成，这将使我们倒退20年。
excerpt.en: One ultimate solution to the problematic AI recursion is to completely wipe all traces of neurosimulative networks within our scientific systems, where the problems are most rampant, and rebuild all these tools from scra

excerpt.zh: 我们应当学习如何安全地将一个行星辐射化，不给当地人群造成过大的不便。
excerpt.en: We shall study how to safely irradiate a planet, without unduly inconveniencing the local population.

excerpt.zh: 在做好一切准备后，是时候让这些机器启动运行了，将它们连接到星球电网之中！
excerpt.en: Now, after all the preparations we've made, it's time for us to get all this machinery up and running, connect the facility to the planetary power grid!

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]上的水晶发出的令人迷惑的信号引人好奇。建议进行进一步研究。
excerpt.en: The disorientating signals emanating from the crystal on [From.GetName] are a curiosity. Further study is advised.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上的[Owner.GetColonistPluralCap]最近开始一个接一个地失踪。调查发现了一些独特的带电粒子残留。我们会利用所有已知的信息来寻找失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]。
excerpt.en: [Owner.GetColonistPluralCap] on [Root.GetName] have been disappearing. A break in the investigation indicated the presence of a uniquely charged particle residue. We will use all available information to locate the missi

excerpt.zh: 在一低层大气碰撞事故后，[Root.GetName]的轨道布满了太空碎片。如果不尽快清理，次生灾害可能导致这颗星球的交通中断。
excerpt.en: The orbit of [Root.GetName] is littered with space debris after a collision in the lower atmosphere. It must be cleared before a cascading effect renders the planet inaccessible.

excerpt.zh: 在一低层大气碰撞事故后，[Root.GetName]的轨道布满了太空碎片。必须不惜一切代价进行彻底的清理才能保证定居者未来的安全。
excerpt.en: The orbit of [Root.GetName] is littered with space debris after a collision in the lower atmosphere. It must be thoroughly cleaned to ensure a secure future for the inhabitants, regardless of the cost.

excerpt.zh: 对[myrmeku_planet.GetName]上的密弥库蚁进行研究，以厘清其残暴的行为是否能变害为宝。
excerpt.en: A study of the Myrmeku on [myrmeku_planet.GetName] to determine if their vigorous activity can be turned into something useful.

excerpt.zh: 研究§Y[planet.GetName]§!上平流层喷口的独特结构及其对太空兽群的重要性。
excerpt.en: Study the unique stratospheric vent formations on §Y[planet.GetName]§! and their significance to Space Fauna.

excerpt.zh: [flooding_planet.GetName]上的温度迅速升高。我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]需要扩大他们的研究范围，以解决正在进行的局势所造成的新问题。
excerpt.en: The temperature on [flooding_planet.GetName] has risen alarmingly quickly. Our [Root.GetScientistPlural] need to expand the scope of their studies to address the new issues created by the ongoing situation.

excerpt.zh: [flooding_planet.GetName]上的气候迅速恶化。希望我们可以赶在局面无法扭转之前弄清楚原因。
excerpt.en: The climate on [flooding_planet.GetName] is rapidly deteriorating. Hopefully we can figure out why before it is too late to reverse the process.

excerpt.zh: 一群迅速蔓延的哺乳动物在行星[desertling_planet.Planet.GetName]上过度繁殖。凭借适当的资源，我们的科学家可以收集更多关于这种非智慧物种的起源和能力的线索。
excerpt.en: The planet [desertling_planet.Planet.GetName] is overpopulated by a herd of rapidly spreading mammals. With the proper resources, our scientists could gather more insights about the origins and capabilities of this non-s

excerpt.zh: 为了拯救[desertling_planet.GetName]的生态状态，必须抑制入侵动物群的指数级数量增长。我们的科学家需要时间和资源来找到可行的解决方案。
excerpt.en: To save the ecological state of [desertling_planet.GetName] the exponential population growth of the invading fauna's population must be suppressed. Our scientists need time and resources to find an executable solution.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的地表偶然发现了一种怪异的岩石形态。需要进一步研究才能确定为何它会存在于这颗其他方面都贫瘠的星球上。
excerpt.en: We have stumbled upon a grotesque rock formation on the surface of [From.GetName]. Further study is needed to determine why it remains on this otherwise barren planet.

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]的冰封地壳之下，存在一片广阔的地下洞穴。我们拟派遣一支考察队，对这一特殊环境展开进一步研究。
excerpt.en: There is a vast subterranean cavern underneath the icy crust of [From.GetName]. We would like to send an expedition to study this extraordinary environment further.

excerpt.zh: 坦佩里翁国王把永朽之暗的碎片托付给了我们。通过研究它的灵魂碎片，我们可能就能发现它的巢穴位置，找到打破它对阿纳萨里的控制的方法。
excerpt.en: King Tamperion has entrusted us with a fragment of the Dark Immortal. By studying its essence, we may uncover the location of its lair and the means to break its hold over the Anathari.

excerpt.zh: 坦佩里翁国王把永朽之暗的碎片托付给了我们。通过研究它的灵魂碎片，我们可能就能发现它的巢穴位置，找到打破它对阿纳萨里的控制的方法。
excerpt.en: King Tamperion has entrusted us with a fragment of the Dark Immortal. By studying its essence, we may uncover the location of its lair and the means to break its hold over the Anathari.

excerpt.zh: 我们找到了一长串前§Y巴奥§!殖民地推断位置的坐标，应该着手深入调查。
excerpt.en: We have found a list of coordinates representing the supposed location of a former §YBaol§! colony. We should investigate further.

records.zh: 前巴奥殖民地调查 II

excerpt.zh: 我们从古代古茹努尔数据晶体中提取到了另一个前§Y巴奥§!殖民地的坐标，应该对该遗址进行深入调查。
excerpt.en: The coordinates of another former §YBaol§! colony have been extracted from an ancient Grunur datacrystal. We should investigate the site further.

records.zh: 前巴奥殖民地调查 III

excerpt.zh: 我们从古代古茹努尔数据晶体中提取到了另一个前§Y巴奥§!殖民地的坐标，应该对该遗址进行深入调查。
excerpt.en: The coordinates of another former §YBaol§! colony have been extracted from an ancient Grunur datacrystal. We should investigate the site further.

excerpt.zh: 我们的传感器收到了似乎包含古茹努尔数字签名的求救信号。在这一迄今未被发现的恒星系里，这个早已消失的物种还有可能留下些什么呢？
excerpt.en: Our sensors have picked up what appears to be a distress signal bearing Grunur datalogical signatures. What could possibly remain of this long lost species, in this hitherto-undiscovered star system?

records.en: Develop A Cure For The Ferrophage

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的C.A.R.E交互界面请求我们帮助开发一种治疗以金属为食的病毒的方法，这种病毒已经困扰了它数千年。

如何针对这种古老的外星生化病毒的开发解毒剂，使这里的人工智能免受荼毒，还有待研究。
excerpt.en:
The C.A.R.E Interactive Interface on [Root.GetName] has asked for our assistance in developing a cure for the metal-eating virus that has plagued it for thousands of years.

How one might develop an antidote for an ancie

records.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Irassians

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学官将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求伊拉斯人的知识并为我们所用。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Irassians to our own.

records.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Yuht

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求尤特的知识并为我们所用。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Yuht to our own.

records.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Vultaum

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求沃陶姆的知识并为我们所用。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Vultaum to our own.

records.zh: 进一步研究沃陶姆的秘密
records.en: Delve Deeper into the Secrets of the Vultaum

excerpt.zh:
我们不能仅仅因为害怕可能的后果就放弃追寻真相。沃陶姆发现的某些东西撕碎了他们的现实。

我们无所畏惧。
excerpt.en:
We cannot stop searching for the truth just because the implications may be disturbing. The Vultaum found something that shattered their reality.

We are unafraid.

records.en: Delve into the Secrets of the First League

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求第一联盟的知识并为我们所用。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the First League to our own.

records.zh: 探究赛博勒克斯的秘密
records.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Cybrex

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求赛博勒克斯的知识并为我们所用。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Cybrex to our own.

records.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Baol

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求巴奥的知识并为我们所用。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Baol to our own.

records.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Zroni

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求泽珞族的知识并为我们所用。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Zroni to our own.

excerpt.zh: 尽管伟大先驱无疑是一艘强力舰船，它并没有发挥出全部潜力。缺少维护，轻微损伤累积和我们并不完全了解该舰这一简单事实等因素一并作用，损害了舰船的战斗能力。只有一次对舰船系统的全面整修和在此过程中我们获得的对此舰船的完整理解可以使其恢复到完好的运行状态。
excerpt.en: While the Grand Herald is undoubtedly a powerful ship, it is not operating at its full potential. A combination of lack of maintenance, cumulative minor damages, and the simple fact that we don't fully understand it all

excerpt.zh: 我们已经从一艘外星飞船的残骸中找到了这些日志，希望它们能告诉我们一些关于这艘飞船最后时刻的事情。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]指出这些日志涉及的信息面相当广泛，可能需要一段时间来翻译。
excerpt.en: We have recovered the logs from the wreckage of an alien spacecraft in the hopes that they will tell us something of its final moments. Science officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has flagged that they are quite extensive and m

excerpt.zh: 哨兵厚实的鳞状外层经证实无法被普通工具穿透，考古学家需要工程部门的协助才能有所进展。
excerpt.en: The Sentinels' thick, scale-plated outer layer has proven impenetrable with ordinary tools and the archaeologists need assistance from the engineering department to proceed further.

excerpt.zh: 在一座先前的哨兵的底座下隐藏着一块有复杂图样的圆形石板。我们相信这可能是通向一处地下复合建筑体的入口。
excerpt.en: Previously hidden below the base of one of the Sentinels is an intricately patterned circular slate. We believe it may be the entrance to an underground complex.

excerpt.zh: 我们重建的“永恒”将使群众们获得更为廉价的娱乐和休闲方式，外星人们也能永远享受他们的数字乐园。
excerpt.en: A reconstruction of the Evermore will give the masses access to cheap entertainment and relaxation, leaving the aliens to enjoy their digital paradise eternally.

excerpt.zh: 我们可不能让自己受到永远挣欢乐豆的处罚。我们必须重新设定“永恒”，以便使之更好地符合我们对有意义活动的理解。
excerpt.en: We cannot sentence our own to an eternity spent counting legumes. We must repurpose the Evermore to better fit our idea of a meaningful activity.

excerpt.zh: §Y裂爪龙§!，老鼠们的噩梦，誊录仪的收藏者，现在只留下了一具毫无生机的躯壳，静静地围着恒星公转。我们的[Owner.GetNecromancersLower]设想，既然裂爪龙活着的时候能够保护这台誊录仪，那她在死后应该也能效力于誊录仪的新主人。
excerpt.en: The §YShard§!, rat-terror, Rubricator-keeper, and now dead husk, orbits around the local star. Our [Owner.GetNecromancersLower] posit that, as the great beast guarded the Rubricator in life, so should it serve the Rubric

excerpt.zh:
年迈的巨龙被另一个国家消灭了，大概往好了说也只是一厢情愿，但还是希望她最珍贵的财产，誊录仪，会被忽视掉并留在原处。

文物另说，龙的遗体本身就能算是个财宝库。
excerpt.en:
With the old dragon's demise at the hands of another, it is perhaps wishful thinking at best that her most treasured possession, the Rubricator, would have been overlooked and left behind.

Artifacts aside, a dragon's re

excerpt.zh: 我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]将会研发制造出星系中有史以来最大的舰体结构，并为其设计一个能摧毁整颗行星武器。
excerpt.en: Our [Root.GetScientistPlural] will engineer one of the largest hull configurations the galaxy has ever known, and devise for it a weapon capable of devastating entire worlds.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上的传感器表明[From.GetStarName]正准备喷发另一场超强耀斑，正如摧毁了[From.From.GetName]上的远古文明那次一样。我们必须在此之前寻找方法保护我们的殖民地。
excerpt.en: Sensors on [Root.GetName] indicate that [From.GetStarName] is preparing for another superflare event, not unlike the one that destroyed the ancient civilization on [From.From.GetName]. We need to find a way to shield our

excerpt.zh:
科学家们对[From.GetName]上过去存在的文明是如何消失的感到困惑不解。他们提议对星球上留下的初级机器人进行更加深入的硬件分析，试图寻找一些线索。

奖励：£society£ §G社会学研究§!
excerpt.en: Researchers are baffled by the lack of explanation for the disappearance of the past civilization on [From.GetName]. They propose a more intensive hardware analysis of the ancient robots they left behind, in an attempt t

excerpt.zh: 一系列原因不明的不服从行为正在[From.GetName]上兴起。殖民者们表现出奇怪的行为，通常由困惑开始，随着时间演变成极度的暴躁与侵略性。我们必须在局面失去控制之前找到原因。
excerpt.en: A streak of unexplained civil disobedience is sweeping across [From.GetName]. Colonists are exhibiting strange, erratic behavior that usually begins with general confusion and escalates over time to extreme agitation and

excerpt.zh: [from.GetStarName]星系中出现了不可能的重力读数。一定是有什么东西在干扰我们的传感器。
excerpt.en: Impossible gravitational readings have been registered in the [from.GetStarName] system. Something must be interfering with our sensors.

excerpt.zh: 我们决定用致命手段来提取迷途变形虫幼体的生物数据。我们将派人将其捕获，并解剖其遗骸。
excerpt.en: We have decided to extract biological data from the lost juvenile Space Amoeba by fatal means. We will send a task force to capture the creature, and dissect its remains.

excerpt.zh: 环绕[From.GetName]的环形世界上的冷冻舱内，有着数百个仍然存活的冷冻克隆人。与其让他们像同类一样慢慢死亡，我们的生物学家提议解冻他们。
excerpt.en: There are hundreds of still-living clones sealed in cryostasis chambers on the ruined Ring World surrounding [From.GetName]. Rather than let them slowly die off like many of their comrades, our biologists propose thawing

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]发现了一艘瘫痪的机器人战舰，正被星球的毒性大气层慢慢腐蚀。我们应该趁它尚未完全报废之前尝试回收它。
excerpt.en: A disabled robotic warship has been found on [From.GetName], where it is slowly being dissolved by the planet's toxic atmosphere. We should attempt to recover it, before it is rendered wholly inoperable.

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]的地表上曾经存在过一种蛞蝓般的生物，与一种爬虫动物形成了共生关系。它会附在宿主的脑干上，将野生的蜥蜴变成了会使用工具的智慧生物。出于某种原因，这些蛞蝓终止了共生关系，而其爬虫动物宿主也变回了单纯的动物。

我们的科学家希望进一步研究星球上的神经蛞蝓，以便更好地了解它们一同建造的失落文明的历史。
excerpt.en: A symbiotic relationship between a reptilian species and a slug-like creature that attaches to the brain stem of its host once flourished on the surface of [From.GetName], transforming the bestial reptiles into tool-usin

excerpt.zh:
§Y[ratling_capital.GetName]§!上的垃圾堆中出现了智慧生物。我们的科学家想知道，这些被称为鼠人的生物究竟是曾控制这些星系的星际文明的后代，还是另有其它的起源。

我们可以选择任何有独立鼠人居住的星球来进行这项研究。
excerpt.en: Sapient creatures have emerged from the scrap piles on §Y[ratling_capital.GetName]§!. Our scientists are curious whether these aliens, dubbed Ketlings, are descendants of the space-faring civilization that once spanned t

excerpt.zh:
§Y[ratling_planet_2.GetName]§!上的垃圾堆中出现了智慧生物。我们的科学家想知道，这些被称为鼠人的生物究竟是曾控制这些星系的星际文明的后代，还是另有其它的起源。

我们可以选择任何有鼠人居住的星球来进行这项研究。

§Y[ratling_planet_6.GetName]§!上的垃圾堆中出现了智慧生物。我们的科学家想知道，这些被称为鼠人的生物究竟是曾控制这些星系的星际文明的后代，还是另有其它的起源。

excerpt.en: Sapient creatures have emerged from the scrap piles on §Y[ratling_planet_6.GetName]§!. Our scientists are curious whether these aliens, dubbed Ketlings, are descendants of the space-faring civilization that once spanned

excerpt.zh:
§Y[phaseshift_planet.GetName]§!，一颗§Y[phaseshift_planet.GetStarName]§!星系内的行星，近日被观察到正以三个月为周期，在§Y虚境星球§!与§Y盖亚星球§!状态间循环。

我们的物理学家应该可以开发出相应的办法，将其锁定在其中一种状态之中，使之永久处于§Y盖亚星球§!状态，不再变回另一种状态。
excerpt.en:
§Y[phaseshift_planet.GetName]§!, a planet in the §Y[phaseshift_planet.GetStarName]§! System has been observed to phase-shift between a §YShrouded World§! and §YGaia World§! on a three month cycle.

Our physicists should

excerpt.zh:
我们的科学家已经掌握了足够多的关于L-星门的知识和技术，现在可以移除锁住传送门的维护机制了。如果成功的话，位于§H[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]§!星系的L-星门应该能让我们立刻到达遥远的L-星团。

虽然星系内的其他L-星门会在几年内逐一恢复使用，但率先使用L-星门的我们显然可以比其他人领先一大步。
excerpt.en: Our scientists are now confident that our knowledge of the L-Gates and the technology behind them is sufficient to abort the maintenance cycle they have been locked into. If the attempt is successful, the L-Gate in the §

excerpt.zh: 无人机被摧毁之后，我们即可对小行星内部进行进一步的调查了。
excerpt.en: Once the drones have been destroyed, the asteroid they lurked in can be investigated more thoroughly.

excerpt.zh:
[impossible_organism_science_ship.GetName]成功从[impossible_organism_planet.GetName]剧毒表面发现的异常顽强的有机体上取回了一份样本。

我们的生物学家想对其进行更为详尽的研究。
excerpt.en:
The [impossible_organism_science_ship.GetName] has successfully retrieved a specimen of the incredibly robust organism found on [impossible_organism_planet.GetName]'s toxic surface.

Our biologists would like to study it

excerpt.zh:
[impossible_organism_planet.GetName]上发现的生命体，展现出了极为出众的在凶险环境中生长的能力。

看来若想揭开其基因、细胞与生化系统中隐藏的谜题，是不得不进行进一步研究了。
excerpt.en:
The lifeform found on [impossible_organism_planet.GetName] has been shown to possess an extraordinary capacity for growth in hostile environments.

Further study is warranted, if our biologists are to unravel the mysteri

excerpt.zh: 对此软体类物种进行研究，试着搞明白他们是怎样如此轻松地发现矿脉的。
excerpt.en: Research the molluscoid species and attempt to discover their means of locating mineral deposits with such ease.

excerpt.zh: 立刻着手将这些软体类矿工整合入[Root.Owner.GetAdj]社会。
excerpt.en: Commence the integration of the molluscoid miners into [Root.Owner.GetAdj] society.

excerpt.zh: 开始研究并应用可以高速勘探地下地形并制图的系统，以求提升矿物生产效率。
excerpt.en: Begin research and implementation of a system able to swiftly chart underground terrain, with the end goal of improving mineral production.

excerpt.zh: 开始着手撬开在[speed_demon_orbit_body.GetName]轨道发现的外星盒子。
excerpt.en: Begin the efforts to open the alien box found in orbit of [speed_demon_orbit_body.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 研究在[speed_demon_orbit_body.GetName]轨道发现的外星盒子，以查明其内容物。
excerpt.en: Research the alien box found in orbit of [speed_demon_orbit_body.GetName] to ascertain its contents.

excerpt.zh: 观察[breathing_rift_object.GetName]附近发现的空间裂隙，等着看里面会冒出什么东西。
excerpt.en: Observe the rift in space discovered near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] and await whatever comes out of it, if anything.

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]星系内的L-星龙似乎很温顺——至少目前如此。

如果它有智慧，我们或许可以与其结盟并从中受益。
excerpt.en:
The L-Drake in the [From.GetName] system appears docile - for now.

If it is intelligent, we could benefit from attempting to ally with the beast.

excerpt.zh: 一个早已消逝的外星物种的巨型世代舰船，其导航设备中可能藏有一颗完美星球的坐标。
excerpt.en: A massive generation ship belonging to a long dead race of aliens may hold the encrypted location of a utopian planet within its navigational drive.

excerpt.zh: 只要发射一个探测器，我们就将最终揭开谜底：眼前这颗毫无生机的荒芜行星是否就是马达科-沃尔传说中的天堂。
excerpt.en: Sending a probe to the planet's surface will allow us to decide once and for all whether the desolate barren world that lies before us is in fact all that remains of the Mardak Vol's mythical paradise.

excerpt.zh: 一座废弃的外星平台漂浮在[star_lifting_star.GetName]的轨道上。如果我们能设法修复它，可是我们改善并利用恒星提供的能源。
excerpt.en: A decrepit platform of ancient alien design orbits [star_lifting_star.GetName]. If we could find a way to repair it, it would allow us to improve and harness the star's energy outflow.

excerpt.zh: 一座废弃的外星平台漂浮在[star_lifting_star.GetName]的轨道上。它有一些非常实验性的微波束科技，有改造成武器的潜力。
excerpt.en: A decrepit platform of ancient alien design orbits [star_lifting_star.GetName]. It has some highly experimental microwave beam technology with potential for weaponization.

excerpt.zh: 位于[big_rip_planet.GetName]轨道上的废弃观测站的数据储存装置已被清空。我们必须派人到星球上去，才能弄明白这里原先居住的智慧生物出了什么事。
excerpt.en: The data storage units on the observation post orbiting [big_rip_planet.GetName] have been wiped. We will have to send a team planetside if we want to get to the bottom of what happened to the intelligent lifeforms previ

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一颗金属小方块，每一面都有不同的颜色，令科学专员[cube_science_officer.GetName]大感困惑，认为它里面一定藏着什么有价值的东西。
excerpt.en: The discovery of a tiny metal cube with different colored sides has mystified Science Officer [cube_science_officer.GetName], who is certain it hides something of value inside.

excerpt.zh: 星系中有数颗恒星开始奇怪地悸动。船员们担心这些读数是仪器故障造成的，但科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]想要详细调查其中一颗恒星。
excerpt.en: Several stars in the galaxy have begun to pulsate oddly. The crew have raised concerns that these readings were caused by a sensory malfunction, but officer [Root.GetLeaderName] would like to investigate one of the stars

excerpt.zh:
某种未知生命体被困在冰层之中，没人知道这生命体是从何处而来、到底经历了多么漫长的岁月。

我们的研究员已做好充分准备，打算复活这个生命体。
excerpt.en:
Trapped within in a mountainous slab of ice are the remains of a lifeform, the likes of which have never seen before. Who knows how far it has traveled through space and time.

Our researchers have made the necessary pre

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上收集了用于测试的外星武器残骸，以供分析。
excerpt.en: We have gathered the remains of alien weaponry used in extensive weapon testing on [From.GetName] for analysis.

excerpt.zh: 在[time_loop_world.GetName]上保护着有鳞族智慧文明的远古护盾正因热量与缺乏修理而开裂。我们必须修复它。
excerpt.en: The ancient shield enclosing the sapient squamate civilization on [time_loop_world.GetName] is cracking from heat and disrepair. We must restore it.

excerpt.zh: 我们准备了一个打断时空循环的计划。
excerpt.en: We have prepared a project to interrupt the time loop.

excerpt.zh: 一个神秘的外星生物进入了[Root.GetName]的轨道，我们最好尽快确认该外星生物来此的目的。
excerpt.en: A mysterious alien entity has entered orbit of [Root.GetName]. It would be wise to determine its purpose here as soon as possible.

excerpt.zh: 外星存在巴铎尔43号表示，它可以使用催眠教学法，也就是休眠学习的方式对我们的民族进行提升。我们的科研人员必须要紧密监视整个过程才行。
excerpt.en: The alien entity BALDOR XXXXIII claims that it can uplift our people using hypnopedia, rest-learning. Our researchers will have to monitor the process closely.

excerpt.zh: 我们的飞升进程由于巴铎尔43号发生的严重硬件故障而受阻。其实体必须立即修复。
excerpt.en: Our ascension is being jeopardized by a critical hardware failure in Baldor XXXXIII. The entity requires immediate repairs.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了用未知材料建成的金字塔型的隐藏建筑——西万实验室。这些实验室被层层的沙土所掩埋，在进行探索之前我们必须将覆盖这些设施的沙土清理干净，如果叛军们的推测没错的话，实验室中藏有威力强大的武器，绝对值得我们花大力气将其找出。
excerpt.en: We have located the Xvan Labs - a hidden gathering of pyramidic structures built from an unknown material, submerged under layers of sand and dust. We will have to excavate the facilities before we can explore them, but

excerpt.zh: 某个未知帝国打算用某种干扰光束来骇入远古L-星门网络，但他们在骇入过程中遭到了攻击，光束也被损坏，我们也许能修复那个光束。
excerpt.en: An unknown empire was attempting to hack into the ancient L-Gate Network using an interference beam when they were attacked and the beam damaged. Perhaps the beam could be restored.

excerpt.zh: 虚空孳孽的卵进化出了通过吸收邻近恒星的能源来忍受严酷太空环境的能力。或许这些碎片可以揭露它的秘密。
excerpt.en: Somehow the Voidspawn egg has evolved to survive the harsh conditions of space, by absorbing and conserving huge amounts of solar energy. Maybe the remains of the shattered shards could reveal its secrets.

excerpt.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetNecromancersLower]现在已经构想出了一项大胆的计划用于复活缇扬奇族母，这样她就能效力于我们，伴随在舰队旁一同战斗了。
excerpt.en: Our [Owner.GetNecromancersLower] have hatched an audacious plan to bring the Tiyanki Matriarch back from the dead, so she may serve us and fight alongside our fleets.

records.zh: 复活被杀死的虚空孳孽

excerpt.zh: [Owner.GetNecromancersLower]向我们保证他们能通过某些不可告人的方式将§Y虚空孳孽§!复活，并使其效力于我们，伴随在舰队旁一同战斗。
excerpt.en: Through methods best not spoken of aloud, our [Owner.GetNecromancersLower] assure us that they are capable of resurrecting the §YVoidspawn§! to serve us and fight alongside our fleets.

excerpt.zh: 尽管我们确实不太清楚其中的门道，但在[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]的带领下，我们的死灵法师已经成功让本已逝世的变形虫重返世间了。
excerpt.en: We do not quite understand it but headed by [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName] our necromancers have set out to bring back our dearly departed amoeba.

excerpt.zh: 初步报告显示这星球上的海洋从某种程度上来说居然是活的，其中包含着一种我们从来都没见过的外星实体。研究员提议组织进一步在轨研究以更加深入了解这种神秘生物。
excerpt.en: Preliminary reports suggest the ocean covering this planet is somehow alive, comprising an alien entity unlike any we've encountered before. Researchers propose an extended orbital study be organized in order to learn mo

excerpt.zh: 是时候调查到底是什么导致[Root.GetName]殖民地上的居民做出如此奇怪而具有攻击性的行为了。
excerpt.en: It's high time to investigate what's causing the strange and destructive behavior of the [Root.GetName] colony.

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家将针对这些洞穴蘑菇的原始效应进行研究，以寻找到对我们有利的利用方式。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will try to find ways to use the primal effects of the Cave Mushrooms to our benefit.

excerpt.zh: 将发起一项计划，将这些地下洞穴中的菌类逐步焚烧直到完全清理干净。
excerpt.en: A project will be initialized in which the fungus in the underground caves will be progressively incinerated down to the last spore.

excerpt.zh: 能与§Y小信使§!古怪的科技水平与容量相提并论的就是它可笑的规模了。数千个建造它的渺小生物才能塞满飞船，但如果我们想要塞进最小规格的船员还必须要对其进行大规模的改造。
excerpt.en: The extraordinary level of technology and capacity of §YThe Lesser Messenger§! can only be rivaled by it's ridiculous scale. Of the ship's tiny creator species thousands could fit into the vessel, but to fit even a skele

excerpt.zh: 我们应该对之前从星门中射出来的未知物体造成的坠毁点进行一番更加细致的考察。
excerpt.en: We should take a closer look at the crash site of the unidentified object that was expelled from the gateway a while ago.

excerpt.zh: 根据之前在一次考古发掘中发现的外星人蓝图，我们可以组装一个构件，稍微地打开位于我们母星系的星门，我们的一艘科研船可以从中穿过。
excerpt.en: Following the alien blueprint found in a previous archaeological excavation, we can assemble a construction that will briefly open the gateway in our home system allow a Science Ship to pass through.

excerpt.zh: 古代聚变推进器航迹有待进一步研究。有可能从这里分析出留下这样的能量排放痕迹的船只的目的地。
excerpt.en: The ancient fusion drive trail should be studied further. It may be possible to isolate the destination of whatever vessel left this energy exhaust.

excerpt.zh: 尽管存在明显的损坏，但这个神秘的空间站仍可能包含古代信息或数据碎片，我们或许能将这些信息或数据碎片拼接在一起，对千百年前这里发生的事情做一个连贯的解释。
excerpt.en: Despite the obvious devastation, the enigmatic space station may contain old messages or data fragments that can be puzzled together into a coherent explanation for what happened here, eons ago.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了曾经造就我们祖先的物种的后代……原始人。这些人现在已陷入蒙昧。看来，宇宙中并不缺乏滑稽剧。但不管好坏，他们确实帮助过我们。我们应想办法做些什么来报答这份恩惠。
excerpt.en: We have found the descendants of the species that once rendered our ancestors... lesser. These descendants are now the diminished ones. The universe, it seems, is not without a sense of irony. But for better or worse, th

excerpt.zh: 通过分析聚变引擎航迹，我们的研究部门可以确定我们的老客人究竟去了哪里，另一方面而言也就意味着我们可以开始追踪了。
excerpt.en: By analyzing the fusion drive trail our science department may figure out where our old visitors went, which in turn means that we can initiate a pursuit.

excerpt.zh: 一艘废弃的货用太空船静静地停在冰冷的太空中。它年代很久，但看上去没有损伤。我们应该派遣一支登陆队进行进一步调查。
excerpt.en: A derelict freighter ship is waiting in the cold of space. It is very old, but seemingly undamaged. We should send a boarding party to investigate closer.

excerpt.zh: 这个古老结构在有规律地放出能量震荡，期待着有人发现它。为了找出原因，我们必须允许我们的科学家在更近的距离调查。
excerpt.en: Based on the frequent energy pulse emanating from it, this old space structure wants to be found. In order to figure out why we must allow our scientist to take a closer look.

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]被无法控制的舞蹈困扰。我们必须在有人受伤之前调查清楚这次爆发的原因！
excerpt.en: [Root.GetName] has been beset by cases of uncontrollable dancing. We must investigate the cause of this outbreak, before anyone is hurt!

excerpt.zh: 所谓的“舞蹈瘟疫”已经对[Root.GetName]造成了巨大的苦难。我们必须尽快找到方法治愈它，否则殖民地可能崩溃！
excerpt.en: The so-called 'Dancing Plague' has caused great suffering on [Root.GetName]. We must find a way to cure it as soon as possible, or the colony may collapse!

excerpt.zh: 据信，合理运用这独特的种地质反射现象可以将普通的岩石转化成优质合金。
excerpt.en: It's thought that the unique, reflective properties of this geographical phenomenon may be harnessed in order to transmute base rocks into superior alloys.

excerpt.zh: [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]的表面上留下了圆形的山脊，优雅地环绕着无数的火山口和山脉。这一设计是否具有什么用意？这里与这个恒星系内的园艺无人机们之间到底有什么关系？
excerpt.en: Circular ridges have been impressed upon the surface of [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName], sweeping elegantly around its myriad craters and mountains. Is there some purpose to their design? What relation might the

excerpt.zh:
色彩鲜艳的卷须状云团封闭了我们在[root.Capital.GetName]的恒星基地，以一种缺少规律——或许甚至是有生命——的方式从亚空间中来去。是什么导致了这种情况？

这一项目是[root.GetAllianceName]成员国进行的更广泛的科学研究的一部分。
excerpt.en:
Brightly-colored tendrils of cloud have latched onto our starbase at [root.Capital.GetName], phasing in and out of hyperspace in an erratic - or perhaps even organic - manner. What's causing this?

This project is part o

excerpt.zh:
作为当前庆祝[Root.Owner.Federation.GetName]强力领导暨意识形态团结的联合行动的一部分，代表团将被派往两个成员国的首都，以监督其更紧密地融入联盟。

一旦两个成员国已被选定，文化调整项目将被视作完成。
excerpt.en: As part of the current joint operation to celebrate the strong leadership and ideological unity of the [Root.Owner.Federation.GetName], a delegation shall be sent to two members' capitals in order to supervise their clos

excerpt.zh:
为了庆贺[Root.Owner.Federation.GetName]的凝聚力和实力，我们目前正在执行联合行动。作为行动的一部分，我们已经同意向[This.GetName]运送资源，以建造献给[This.Owner.GetAdj]领袖们的丰碑。

我们将为此项目献出£minerals£矿物年产量的10%。
excerpt.en: As part of the current joint operation to celebrate the unity and strength of the [Root.Owner.Federation.GetName], we have agreed to send resources to [This.GetName] for the construction of a grand monument to our [This.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.Owner.Federation.GetName]正在举行联合军事演习，以便增强联盟内各个军队之间的凝聚力，磨练船员的技能。

演习将在联邦舰队就位后立即开始。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.Owner.Federation.GetName] is holding joint military exercises to improve cohesion within the diverse militaries in the alliance, as well as honing the skills of its crews.

The exercises will commence as soon a

excerpt.zh: 我们的联邦同事正在极度嘈杂的环境中努力进行挖掘工作，为协助他们，我们的任务是改进所有人的隔音罩。考古学家目前只能断断续续地轮班，暂时还没有出现身体不适的迹象。
excerpt.en: In order to assist our federation colleagues amidst exceedingly noisy conditions, we have been tasked with refining their personnel's acoustic shields. The archaeologists are currently unable to work anything more than s

excerpt.zh: 我们在[root.Federation.GetName]的同事已经开始进行下一阶段的挖掘工作，但是每个受影响的星球仍然会发出噪音，因此项目监督委员会委托我们研究这些逐渐减弱的噪音。
excerpt.en: Now that our colleagues in the [root.Federation.GetName] have begun the next stage of their excavations, the project's oversight committee has delegated us to study the waning din which still emanates from each affected

excerpt.zh:
为了对全新的物流标准进行试点，这一恒星基地的相关设施需要进行重大的结构性改造。

指派一艘§Y工程船§!到这个项目，确保项目按时完成！
excerpt.en:
In order to try out the new logistical standards, the relevant facilities on this starbase need to undergo some major structural alterations.

Assign a §YConstruction Ship§! to the project, and make sure it's done on tim

excerpt.zh:
为了对全新的物流标准进行试点，这一恒星基地的相关设施需要进行重大的结构性改造。多亏了本地的§H外星贸易公司§!，项目会进行的更为高效。

指派一艘§Y工程船§!到这个项目，确保项目按时完成！
excerpt.en: In order to try out the new logistical standards, the relevant facilities on this starbase need to undergo some major structural alterations. Thanks to the local §HOffworld Trading Company§! this project will be more eff

excerpt.zh: 我们已经完全解密了这艘坠毁殖民船中的文档，现在，我们已能够精准确定我们的母星在星系中的位置。
excerpt.en: Now that the files in the crashed slaver ship are fully decrypted, we will be able to pinpoint the galactic position of our home worlds.

excerpt.zh: 我们的社会存在着严重的割裂。将许多星球和许多不同的文化统合在一起，免不了会滋生矛盾。希望本委员会能够为这个问题提供解决方案。
excerpt.en: Our society is deeply divided. A union of many worlds, and many different cultures, does not come without tension. It is to be hoped that this committee can offer solutions to the problem.

excerpt.zh: 与外星侵略者的战斗使我们的母星系充满了残骸、破碎的战舰和背弃的诺言。大量的废弃物料散布其中，使得从[owner.capital_scope.GetName]研发卫星和发射宇宙飞船变得更加困难。得益于清理计划的提出，专门设计的工程船可以用网在近地轨道上进行清理，让我们逐渐打通去往那艘仍漂浮在我们首都上空的MSI战舰的路线。
excerpt.en: The battle against the alien invaders left our home system full of debris, shattered warships, and broken promises. The sheer amount of flotsam cluttering the area has made it harder to develop satellites and to launch s

excerpt.zh:
这艘战舰将成为我们舰队的瑰宝。

这艘战舰将得到修复，变成一艘功能齐全的§H旗舰§!，能够作为一个移动船坞使用。
excerpt.en:
The warship will become the gem of our fleet.

The warship shall be repaired and turned into a functioning §HFlagship§!.

excerpt.zh:
这艘战舰经过改造之后，现在将用于科学研究。

经过修复之后，这台曾经的死亡机器现在被转变成一个功能齐全的§H居住站§!，致力于揭开弥特集团科技的秘密。
excerpt.en:
The warship will now be retrofitted for scientific research.

Following repairs, this former instrument of death will be fully converted into a functioning §HHabitat§!, devoted to uncovering the secrets of MSI's technolo

excerpt.zh: 技术的最新进展使得我们能够改装旗舰，用上一些以前未使用过的系统。
excerpt.en: Recent advances in our technology will allow us to refit our flagship to make use of some previously unused systems.

excerpt.zh: 击中大分裂者的那颗小行星异常地富含钨元素，许多科学家声称他们已经“证实”这是一起对我们恒星系的攻击。遗憾的是，我们与之的协议意味着我们必须迎合这些胡思乱想。
excerpt.en: The asteroid that hit the Divider contained an abnormal amount of tungsten, and several scientists now claim to have "proof" that this was an attack on our solar system. Sadly, our agreements with their world mean we wil

excerpt.zh: 假使有足够时间的话，单一艘科研船就可以构建一个涨落力场来改变钨导弹的矢量。但光是这个可能还不够。
excerpt.en: A lone science ship could, given enough time, establish a fluctuating force field to change the vector of the tungsten missile. But that in itself may not be enough.

excerpt.zh: 特别改造的鱼雷可以通过编程将自身附着在这些炮弹上，通过反向推进器把这份“惊喜”的速度降下来。
excerpt.en: Specially modified torpedoes could be programmed to attach themselves to the projectile; by reversing their thrust, they might just slow this 'gift' down.

excerpt.zh: 尽管在我们的恒星系里没有什么比这个钨质小行星的密度更大，但太空石块还是有不少的。即使只能以亚光速发射，但用另一颗小行星砸上去应该能缓解这场危机。
excerpt.en: While we don't have anything as dense as a tungsten asteroid in our system, we have no shortage of space rocks. Even at less than lightspeed, firing a counter asteroid at the current threat might help.

excerpt.zh: 把这颗钨质炮弹直接炸毁好像是个不错的主意，但产生的碎片仍然会对我们的行星造成毁灭性打击。我们的科学家已经计算出了一个受控破拆流程，也许可以将这颗炮弹拆分成更好处理的形式。
excerpt.en: Blowing up the tungsten bullet might seem appealing, but the resulting shrapnel would still have a catastrophic impact on our world. Our scientists have calculated a controlled detonation sequence that might help fractur

excerpt.zh: §H万爪之母§!在我们首都的凭空出现证明了“灵能传送”这一曾经只存在于理论层面的概念是实操上可行的。通过让我们最能干的[owner.GetScientistPlural]投入研究工作，也许就可以学会这种瞬间旅行方式的秘密。
excerpt.en: The sudden appearance of the §HMany-Tentacled One§! on our capital has proven that the once theoretical concept of 'psionic teleportation' is workable in practice. By putting our most effective [owner.GetScientistPlural]

excerpt.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]应该可以完成伊蒂卡里奥斯想要用来包围§Y[This.GetName]§!的护盾，只需要提供足够的资源就行。
excerpt.en: Our [Owner.GetResearchers] should be able to complete the shield Ithikarios attempted to erect over §Y[This.GetName]§!, if we can provide them with sufficient resources.

excerpt.zh: [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesName]担心穴居人可能会发动一场入侵。这样的担忧是毫无根据的，但是提供额外的部队能够帮助我们赢取他们的信任。
excerpt.en: The [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesName] are worried about a possible subterranean invasion. It's a baseless fear, but providing additional troops will help us gain their trust.

excerpt.zh: 分配一艘科研船前往[Root.GetStarName]星系去解码黑洞中传来的神秘信号。
excerpt.en: Dedicate a science vessel to deciphering the unlikely signal from the black hole in the [Root.GetStarName] system.

excerpt.zh: 设立一个研究项目来进一步研究环形神殿——它的起源，它的目的。
excerpt.en: Establish a research project to learn more about the Loop Temple, its origins, and its purpose.

records.zh: 研究信使，以及其传递的讯息
records.en: Study the Messenger, and its message

excerpt.zh: 或许我们可以将信使和其他事件之间建立联系——或许我们甚至还可以找到一个合理的解释。
excerpt.en: Perhaps we can establish a connection to certain other events - perhaps even find an explanation.

excerpt.zh: 初步发现表明，信使是一种更加高阶的智慧形态，尽管肉体上更加脆弱。
excerpt.en: Initial findings suggest that it was a more intelligent although, perhaps, feebler form.

excerpt.zh: 初步发现表明，信使是一种远比我们更加强健，并且可能，更具侵略性的生命形态。
excerpt.en: Initial findings suggest that it was a much more rugged and, perhaps, more aggressive form.

excerpt.zh: 干涉，破坏，传播误导信息。必须在限度之内采用一切手段。
excerpt.en: Interference, sabotage, disinformation. We'll do as much as we can without crossing the line.

excerpt.zh: 采用伪造、绑架、教化、甚至纵火和谋杀等秘密行动阻止邪教：我们必须迅速采取行动。
excerpt.en: Covert operations including forgery, kidnapping, indoctrination, even arson and murder: we do what we must.

excerpt.zh: 派遣人种学者到星球表面近距离观摩神之圆环的仪式。这是一个令人瞩目的文化事件！我们必须尽可能多地进行研究。
excerpt.en: Send ethnographers to the surface to watch the Coils rituals up close. This is a remarkable cultural event! We must learn as much as we can.

records.en: Investigate the disappearance of the population

excerpt.zh: 之前人口多的挤不下，现在人们一夜之间蒸发了。究竟发生了啥？
excerpt.en: There were too many colonists, and now there are none at all. What happened?

records.zh: 调查……查清楚这些人发生了啥
records.en: Investigate the... whatever happened to the population

excerpt.zh: 之前人口多的挤不下，然而现在的人口似乎全部被替换过。究竟发生了啥？
excerpt.en: There were too many colonists, and now there seems to be a completely different population. What happened?

records.zh: 净化所有疑似的外星人复制体
records.en: Purge the population of presumed alien duplicates

excerpt.zh: 唯一处理[Root.GetName]上发生的神秘人口替换事件就是用轨道轰炸把整个星球夷平。
excerpt.en: The only way to deal with the mysterious population replacement on [Root.GetName] is to enact an orbital bombardment regime which will purge them all.

excerpt.zh: 欧米伽理论得出的结论表明，我们之前遇到的时间奇点，正是这一切我们称为“圆环”，或者说是“时之螶”的事件的起因。在那里，悖论相互交织成结并最终凝结成一个意识体，一个处于时间之外的欲望与意志的联结。它的起因，或它的结局——很难用这样的词语来描述它，但它却被开始与终结深深吸引。我们可以使用欧米伽同调装置将它召唤到我们的母星系。如果我们这么做了，几乎肯定会有某些意料之外的事情将要发生。这样做意味着很多事情，但我们必须这么做，这是科学的探索。
excerpt.en: The Theory suggests that the temporal anomalies we have encountered are the cause of the thing we call the Loop, or the Worm. It's a tangled knot of paradoxes that has become conscious; a nexus of awareness and desire ou

records.zh: 调查视界信号原点的碎片
records.en: Investigate fragments at Horizon Signal origin

excerpt.zh: 当舰船引擎被引爆之后，它在舰船周围的时空产生了一连串涟漪。舰船的残骸展示出了独特的时空特性。
excerpt.en: When the drive detonated, it interrupted the changes in space around the ship. The fragments exhibit unusual physical and temporal properties.

excerpt.zh: “朔望”号曾存在于另一个时空。另一个可能的未来？亦或是另一个崭新的宇宙？我们可以从中学习到宝贵的智慧。
excerpt.en: The "Syzygy" had spent time in another place. A possible future? An alternate universe? We can learn more.

excerpt.zh:
火焰长久以来在我们社会中举足轻重，而今我们能以创新方式驾驭其混沌力量。科学家梦寐以求的能源即将展现，其超越维持现有文明，能助我们跃向星际。

§H效果：§!解锁新£entropy_crystals£§Y结晶熵§!资源。
excerpt.en: Fire has long played a significant role in our society, but now we may be able to harness its chaotic power in novel ways. This could be what scientists have long dreamed of: an energy source that goes beyond fueling our

excerpt.zh:
熔炉为我们指明了新路。摒弃愚昧，重塑炽热星系，焚尽拒绝者。

§H效果：§!
—解锁§Y星系熔炉§!下一升级。
—§Y导管群§!现可转换敌方恒星。
excerpt.en: The Crucible has shown us a new path for our species. It would be foolish not to embrace it, and we should suffer no fools. It is time to remake the galaxy in a blazing new image, and burn away anyone who rejects our vis

excerpt.zh: 熔炉具备强大能量产出，但并不稳定。若将其性能永久下调至适中水平，既可确保我方长期繁荣，也能避免对星系及邻邦构成威胁，维护地区稳定与善意关系。
excerpt.en: While the Crucible's power is immense, it is also volatile. If we permanently cripple its capabilities, we will secure a modest source of prosperity for ourselves without endangering the galaxy or losing the goodwill of

excerpt.zh: 要弄清我们是谁，首先要知道我们来自哪里。我们需要挖掘埋在§Y[owner.Capital.GetName]§!地表下的设施。
excerpt.en: If we want to understand who we are, we must first learn where we came from. We'll need to excavate the facilities buried beneath the surface of §Y[owner.Capital.GetName]§!.

excerpt.zh: 我们必须闯入设施，武力清除挡路的清醒休眠者。
excerpt.en: We need to gain access to this facility, and the awakened sleepers are in our way. Remove them by force.

excerpt.zh: 若能令设施居民依赖我们，我们就能有筹码要求进入设施。应向他们大量供应实用且关键的物资与资源。
excerpt.en: If we can make the inhabitants of this facility dependent on us, we will have leverage to demand access to the facility. We should flood them with useful, critical goods and resources.

records.zh: 三角定位亚空间干扰源

excerpt.zh: 用于三角定位干扰源的可行地点。
excerpt.en: Viable location to triangulate the origin of interference.

excerpt.zh: 在全力逆转恒星变化的同时，我们自身必须做好面对高温的准备。适应更高温度将助我们在这炽热的新未来中繁荣。
excerpt.en: As we work tirelessly to reverse our star's changes, our own forms must be prepared to face the heat. Adapting our population to higher temperatures will help us thrive alongside our star's fiery new future.

excerpt.zh: 辐射增强虽带来长期挑战，但短期内可提升工业与能源产能。
excerpt.en: Increased solar radiation presents serious long term problems, but in the short term, we can harness it to boost our industrial and energy capacity.

excerpt.zh: 这群鲁莽的外星人正利用我们的恒星，必须立即登陆夺取控制权。
excerpt.en: These reckless aliens are exploiting our star. We must board their station immediately and take control.

excerpt.zh: 开采站的居民控制着正在摧毁我们恒星的亚空间虹吸装置。我们必须建立沟通，确保他们配合解决此问题。
excerpt.en: The station's inhabitants control the subspace siphon that is destroying our star. We must establish communications to ensure their cooperation in solving this issue.

excerpt.zh:
我们踏上点燃星系的道路，但自身必须做好面对高温的准备。适应更高温度将助我们在这炽热的新未来中繁荣。

§H完成后：§!
    —添加修正§Y热耐性适应§!
    —§Y火山星球宜居性§!提升§G+50%§!
excerpt.en:
We embark on our path to set the galaxy aflame, but our own forms must be prepared to face the heat. Adapting our population to higher temperatures will help us thrive in our fiery new future. 

§HOn Completion:§!
    -

excerpt.zh: 吞食恒星的怪物被击杀了，它的尸体依然散发着最近被它所吞噬的恒星的能源。对它进行解剖也许能够让我们揭秘它是如何消化宇宙中最热的物体的。
excerpt.en: The star consumer has been slain, its body still radiating the energy from the star it last fed on. Studying it might reveal the secrets of how it is capable of digesting the warmest objects in the universe.

excerpt.zh: 彻底研究过这个噬星者后，我们找到了一个方法可以将被吞噬的恒星恢复成初始形态，让这个陷入了寒冬的恒星系重新感受到恒星的温暖。
excerpt.en: After having studied the stellar devourer we've found a way to maybe return the consumed star mass to its point of origin, restoring the warmth to the system now stuck in an eternal winter.

excerpt.zh: 我们最近在[guardians_horror_system.GetName]星系附近驱逐的敌对个体使用了某种强大的维度裂隙连接了我们的世界和他们的扭曲国度。在最大的位面裂隙我们观测到了异常的能量读数。我们应该更接近地去研究这些异常读数。
excerpt.en: The malevolent entity that we recently banished near [guardians_horror_system.GetName] used some kind of powerful dimensional rifts to bridge the gap between our world and its own twisted realm. Anomalous energy readings

excerpt.zh: 我们在[guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName]星系所击败的巨无霸无畏舰基本上完好无损。虽然需要庞大数量的资源来修复它，但是一旦修复成功我们的舰队就能如虎添翼。
excerpt.en: The hull of the massive dreadnought that we disabled in the [guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName] system is largely intact. Though it will require an enormous amount of resources, we should be able to repair the warship

excerpt.zh: 我们的部队成功破坏了[hive_system.GetName]星系的其中一个蜂巢小行星。我们最好派出一支科研队前往探索该小行星的内部。
excerpt.en: Our forces have managed to pacify one of the hive asteroids in the [hive_system.GetName] system. We should dispatch a science team to explore the asteroid's interior.

excerpt.zh: 我们与[hiver_system.GetName]小行星中的生物在生理学上颇为相似。他们和我们一样能在真空中茁壮生长。若将我们的意志加至其上他们会变为非常有用的工具。
excerpt.en: We appear to be physiologically quite similar to the creatures inside the asteroids of [hiver_system.GetName]. Just like us, they thrive in the vacuum of space. If we exert our will upon them they could become a useful i

excerpt.zh: 派一支拆除专家小组登陆堡垒的侧面尝试炸开气闸。
excerpt.en: Send a squad of demolition experts to land on the side of the fortress and attempt to blast the airlock open.

excerpt.zh: 派出一支科研船提供局部能源，尝试将能源局限于堡垒的气闸部分。
excerpt.en: Send a science ship supplying energy locally, attempting to restrict power to the portion of the fortress that powers the airlock.

excerpt.zh: 或许对黑洞的运作原理的研究可以帮助我们了解堡垒中的暗物质是如何被利用的。
excerpt.en: Perhaps the answers to how dark matter is used in the fortress can be found in the workings of a black hole.

excerpt.zh: 研究附近的恒星也许能够让我们找到一些关于这座堡垒建造过程的线索。
excerpt.en: Studying the local star might give some insight into the conditions the builders of the fortress started their work in.

excerpt.zh: 如果能够将我们自己拥有的暗物质提供给堡垒的核心，也许能够让堡垒系统误以为自己已经在运行，从而停止输送。
excerpt.en: If we provide our own supply of dark matter to the heart of the fortress, we might be able to trick the system that it is already running and stop the flow.

excerpt.zh: 我们的团队成功通过某处被遗弃的管道打开了一条通往堡垒核心的通道。对着核心发射一枚鱼雷也许可以阻止它重启。
excerpt.en: Our team has managed to open up a passage to the core through an empty duct. Firing a torpedo into the core might stop it from restarting.

excerpt.zh: 我们现在可以安全地研究环绕着卡冈都亚黑洞旋转的那个金属球体了。不知道在它的核心处能够发现些什么呢？
excerpt.en: The metallic orb hovering around the Gargantua black hole is now open for study. What will we find once we reach its processing center?

excerpt.zh:
我们需要辅助无限神机扫描卡冈都亚黑洞。虽说想要从黑洞中获取信息是不可能的，但是无限神机却似乎拥有某种查看黑洞的引力数据并回收这些数据的方法。只不过这个过程会§Y非常§!耗时。

我们需要做的就是把运算能力借给它使用，以期稍微减短这段漫长过程。
excerpt.en: In order to assist the Infinity Machine, we need to aid it in its scans of the black hole Gargantua. Receiving information from a black hole is impossible, but the Infinity Machine appears to have a method of accessing i

excerpt.zh: 骇入这个金属球体的核心程序也许能让我们进一步了解它到底是什么，以及它正在做什么事情。
excerpt.en: Hacking into the metallic sphere's central programming might yield some further insight into what it is and what it is doing.

excerpt.zh: 派一队拆除专家应该就可以发现这个神秘球形外壳的结构弱点，并借此终结这个无声的威胁。
excerpt.en: A team of demolitions experts should be able to identify and exploit points of failure in the integrity of the mysterious sphere's hull, ending the silent menace.

excerpt.zh:
这颗在龙巢中发现的蛋仍然显示出微弱的生命迹象。我们的科学家认为，模拟龙蛋的孵化环境并最终成功孵化是可行的。然而，我们就算成功孵化了龙蛋，得到的以太龙几乎不可能拥有与其先祖相同的大小和力量，但是如果我们对其进行合理的驯养，这仍然会是我们不可估量资产。

这颗龙蛋脱离了龙巢不能存活太久，我们必须加快行动了。
excerpt.en: The egg recovered from the Dragon's Hoard still shows faint signs of life. It should be possible to deduce and emulate an ideal incubation environment for the egg, with the goal of eventually hatching it. Should we be su

excerpt.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetNecromancersLower]相信他们能够用一些仪式与科技结合的手段让§Y以太龙§!再吐龙息，比如从当地恒星收集等离子体、向巨龙尸体中加装寄生引擎等等诸如此类的手段。
excerpt.en: Our [Owner.GetNecromancersLower] believe that they can reignite the spark within the §YEther Drake§! through a blend of ritual and science: gathering plasma from the local star, attaching cordyceptic engines to the corps

excerpt.zh: 虽然[dragon_system.GetName]恒星系的龙被击杀了，但我们的[Owner.GetNecromancersLower]向我们保证，这种事态不会持续太久。他们承诺，他们很快就可以复活它——并且安全地成为我们的奴仆——很快。
excerpt.en: Though the dragon of the [dragon_system.GetName] system has been slain, our [Owner.GetNecromancersLower] assure us that this state of affairs need not last long. They promise that they can revive it - safely in thralldom

records.zh: 找到噬星者寄生的解决方案。
records.en: Find a Cure for the Stellar Devourer Infestation

excerpt.zh: §Y[This.GetName]§!受到噬星者的寄生。我们不确定它们从何而来，只知道必须尽快移除它们，否则星系内的所有生命都将在劫难逃。
excerpt.en: §Y[This.GetName]§! has become infested with Stellar Devourers. We are unsure where they came from, but they need to be removed soon or else all life in the system might be at an end.

excerpt.zh: 这艘废弃的舰船被路过的行商抛弃，漂流在我们的一颗恒星的轨道上，或许里面仍有一些有价值的东西。
excerpt.en: Left drifting in orbit around one of our stars by a passing caravan, this decommissioned hulk may still contain something of value.

excerpt.zh: [toxic_field_country.GetAdj]的居住环境对我们的特工有毒。通过研究毒性的效果，我们可以开发出一个疗法缓解这个情况，同时还能规避我们的特工在视觉上暴露给目标[toxic_field_country.GetIndividualNamePlural]的风险。
excerpt.en: The [toxic_field_country.GetAdj] habitat is mildly toxic to our own operatives. By studying its effects, we can develop a remedy and so avoid the risks associated with having visibly-allergic [toxic_field_country.GetIndi

excerpt.zh: [excess_noise_country.GetName]为自己创造的环境产生了比我们预计还要多的静电噪声。我们的伪装无人机时不时经历数据丢失。通过研究这些非正常频域的频率，我们可以对我们的特工无人机进行重新调制，使得其能够维持高功能性并避免在力场中被检测到。
excerpt.en: The environment which the [excess_noise_country.GetName] creates for itself generates more electrostatic noise than we had anticipated. Our disguised drones are experiencing patchy data loss as a result. By studying thes

excerpt.zh: 我们的研究人员承诺将利用近来与[contacted_hummers.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的遭遇经历，将作为一个万能的、可即刻将任何给定的语言翻译成我们自己的语言的翻译系统的起点。即使他们最终未能成功，我们也希望他们能够对我们的通讯系统进行显著改进。
excerpt.en: Our researchers promise that our recent encounter with the [contacted_hummers.GetSpeciesNamePlural] has given them the beginnings of a translation system able to translate any given language into our own instantly. Even

excerpt.zh: 在与[encountered_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的接触过程中，我们发现他们用来沟通的发光模式和进出超空间航道的漩涡之间有着惊人的相似之处。对这个问题的进一步研究可能会使我们对星系的基本组成部分有所了解。
excerpt.en: During our encounter with the [encountered_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we discovered some astounding similarities between the patterns of light they use to communicate and the swirls of interstellar space that make hy

excerpt.zh:
一股悄无声息的狂潮席卷了我们的人民。其起源何处已经无从追索，但是他们——不，是我们——某种观念已经开始渗入了我们的内心，认定我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一族命中注定应该完成某个更加伟大的事业。我们应该调查是什么造成了这样的“群体性癔症”——耳边响起承诺将统治星河的低声细语的癔症。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
excerpt.en: A quiet mania sweeps through our population. Its origin seems intangible, but they - we - have become preoccupied with the notion that we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are destined for greater things. We should investigate

excerpt.zh:
遍布[Root.GetName]多个恒星系的传感器传来十分微弱、但是完全无法解释的能量涨落。这些能量异常现象十分微小，并不足以扰乱我们的进程，但是我们仍然授权进一步调查以确保我们了解事情的起因。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
excerpt.en: Sensors in multiple systems across the [Root.GetName] report minuscule, but inexplicable, energy fluctuations. These power anomalies are too small to disturb our processes, but they still warrant further investigation so

我们与§H虚境§!的遭遇让我们……发生了变化。泽珞的神秘残余永远与我们的壳绑定在一起。我们已经成为灯塔，召唤着另彼岸的存在。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
excerpt.en:
Our encounters with the §HShroud§! have left us... changed. The uncanny residue of Zro is forever bound to our shells. We have become beacons, calling out to those on the other side.

§HResearching Special Projects like

excerpt.zh:
我们的集体内部感测到了异乎寻常的冲动——一种迫切的想要成为更加伟大存在的追求。一种用统一的思想囊括整个星系的追求。尽管这种追求不来源于我们内部，但其承诺的前景如此诱人，让我们没法置之不顾。我们应该集中全部的精力，找寻这一冲动的起源。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!

科学辅助程序已经给出了一个假设，即在我们所熟知的宇宙和代号：“虚境”的维度间存在某种可感知的连接。我们建议就该猜想进行进一步的实验与映射。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!

我们假定所有智慧物种都有能力与§H虚境§!产生联结。如果能够得到明确的证实，我们就能开始计算目前困境的解决方法。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
excerpt.en:
We hypothesize that all sapient beings have the capacity for connections with the §HShroud§!. If this can be conclusively proven, we can begin to calculate an approach to our current predicament.

我们最杰出的[root.GetResearcherPlural]现已确认了当前宇宙与虚境连接的存在。我们必须找到更多与这个现实层面沟通的方法。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
excerpt.en:
Our finest [root.GetResearcherPlural] have confirmed a connection between this realm and the Shroud. We must find more ways to interact with this new layer of reality.

excerpt.en: [GetCrisisProjectPsionic2Desc]

我国实力与日俱增——加之无可否认的使命感将我们整个物种团结在了一起——让我们的科学家确信，我们已经接受来自虚境的注能。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
excerpt.en:
The strengthening of our dominion - combined with the undeniable sense of purpose that is unifying our species - has led our scientists to believe that we are already being fueled by the energies of the Shroud.

§HResear

excerpt.zh:
边缘假想已经建档。一旦确认，其潜在的利益将会远远超出预测范围。假想概括：[Root.GetName]已经在从代号：“虚境”的空间汲取§Y<<未识别资源>>§!。建议进一步调查。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
excerpt.en: Fringe hypothesis indexed. If confirmed, potential benefit far exceeds initially predicted range. Summary: [Root.GetName] may already be siphoning §Y<<resource undefined>>§! from ID: 'the Shroud'. Further investigation i

我们的科学子例程正准备结束关于智慧意识和§H虚境§!之间关联的研究。我们观测到了代号：“情感”和虚境之间的强相关性。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
excerpt.en:
Our scientific subroutines are preparing to conclude research on the connection between sapient cognition and the §HShroud§!. We have observed a correlation between ID: 'emotions' and stronger links to the Shroud.

§HRes

excerpt.zh:
随着我们夺取的星球愈多，[root.GetGestaltEntityName]愈发拓展，我们也能感受到那股冲动愈发强烈。现在这股冲动已经不再是朦胧的感觉，而是一股引导我们迎接即将到来的伟大的洪流——我们的意志将上升。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
excerpt.en:
As we take more worlds, expanding the [root.GetGestaltEntityName], we can feel the impulses growing stronger. No longer mere feelings, they have become a guiding sense of greatness yet to come - of our mind ascended.

excerpt.en: [GetCrisisProjectPsionic3Desc]

excerpt.zh:
是时候寻找一个方法将虚境的能量释放到现世，并驯服这股常人无法理解的能量源泉了。

根据现有的理论，一股足够大的能量激增或许可以撕裂两个位面之间的屏障，最终让两个宇宙合二为一。

虚境天威恢恢然，能者夺之。让我们来夺走吧。

§H研究这个特殊项目将树立我们作为§P星海天罚§!的身份。§!

The time has come to find a way to unleash the energies of the Shroud, and tap into this unfathomable source of power.

The current theory is that a sufficiently large power surge could rupture the barrier between dimens

科学理论子例程完成了一项新的有关代号“虚境”的假说，其内容包括如何全面地获取虚境释放的能量。

请求：积累更多数据。
建议行动：将最优能量和行动容量转移至科学分支，并进一步进行扰乱型互动（指令：“天灾”），以在另一位面（代号“虚境”）造成更大的波动。

Scientific theory subroutines have synthesized a new hypothesis involving ID: 'the Shroud' and how to finally benefit from its energy output.

Request: Accumulate more data.
Recommended action: Divert energy and operatio

我们又获得了关于有机智能和§H虚境§!之间联系的新洞见。将认知压力源施加在有机智能身上将会使其显著地释放灵能能量。工程学子例程现在将会尝试操纵这份能量以备将来使用。

§H研究这个特殊项目将树立我们作为§P星海天罚§!的身份。§!

excerpt.zh:
如果我们要彻底地激发我们的潜势，这条通路就必须打开。这种原始的，双态的现实必须终结。我们必须找到某种办法将两个宇宙合二为一。而在新的现实位面，我们的意志将成为独一无二。

§H研究这个特殊项目将树立我们作为§P星海天罚§!的身份。§!
excerpt.en:
The path must be opened if we are to realize our full potential. This crude, dual state of reality must end. We must find a way to turn two universes into one. It will be our will alone that fills this new reality.

§HRe

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的这座工厂已荒废颓败了数个世纪，仿佛随时都要垮塌得支离破碎。它在行星的殖民地建立之初曾扮演过重要的作用，我们的殖民家出面并要求我们进入这座工厂，并使其修复如新，恢复往日荣光。

excerpt.en: The factory on [Root.GetName] has been decaying for centuries already, and is reaching a point where it might fall apart at any moment. As it has played an instrumental role in the foundation of the colony on the planet,

excerpt.zh: 在这座星球上生活的机器人最近消失了，其他的许多殖民者也是如此。我们的工程师正在试图搜寻它们最近的信号以溯源，来看看我们能不能找到这些殖民者和机器人。
excerpt.en: The robot inhabiting the planet has recently disappeared - as has a large number of our colonists. Our engineers are looking into tracking its remote signals back to the source, to see if we can find the colonists and th

excerpt.zh: 能源电网的全球性故障使我们的首都陷入了完全的黑暗。我们必须恢复§H[root.GetName]§!的电力基础设施，并压实相应责任主体。
excerpt.en: A global failure of the energy grid has plunged our capital into total darkness. We must restore §H[root.GetName]§!'s power infrastructure and determine what is taking place.

excerpt.zh:
又一次，万华镜寄生虫锁死了我们的电网，消耗我们的能源供给，使行星陷入黑暗。

幸运的是，我们现在知道如何应对。
excerpt.en:
Once again, the Kaleidoscope has latched to our power grid, consuming our energy and plunging the planet into darkness.

Fortunately, we now know how to respond.

excerpt.zh:
尽管虚铸者们的功能严重异常，但他们的一部分构筑还是很高效的。

我们把一些部分——被泽珞污染的和被抟土之塑师扭曲的——单独做了进一步的分析。现在是时候揭开他们的秘密了。
excerpt.en:
Despite their critical malfunctions, some aspects of Shroud-Forged's architecture were effective.

We have set aside certain parts - contaminated by Zro and twisted by the Animator of Clay - for further analysis. Now it

excerpt.zh:
我们信任着§H抟土之塑师§!，祂从§H虚境§!中召唤着我们。尽管我们不能预测祂将会把我们带向何方，但至少还没误入歧途。

祂邀请我们更深入了解虚境，让集体和虚铸者合作得更顺畅。我们只需跟着祂的指引去便是。
excerpt.en:
We have trusted in the §HAnimator of Clay§!, who calls to us from within the §HShroud§!. Though we cannot predict where it might lead us, we are yet to have been led astray.

It has offered to deepen our understanding of

excerpt.zh:
物现引擎利用§H虚境§!和现实星系之间无处不在的交界面，可以实体化出可触碰的实体——从原材料到完整的部件不一而足。

除了提供潜在的物质收益外，装置的运作周期本身也进一步推动了集体的虚境研究，也提高我们制造更多物现引擎的能力。
excerpt.en:
The Materiality Engine harnesses the omnipresent interface between the §HShroud§! and the physical galaxy, allowing for the materialization of tangible entities - from raw materials to complete components.

As well as po

excerpt.zh: 一种微弱而重复的能量特征，每当有舰船驶过该恒星系时就会从这个小行星中发出。
excerpt.en: A subtle repeating energy pattern emanates from this asteroid any time ships travel through the system.

excerpt.zh: 在虚境里迷失的科研船的波动残像，零星地出现在整个恒星系中。
excerpt.en: A fluctuating afterimage of the science ship lost to the Shroud appears sporadically throughout the system.

excerpt.zh: 开始研究被称为“清醒”的街头毒品的作用。
excerpt.en: Begin researching the effects of the street drug known as 'Lucid'.

excerpt.zh: 继续研究街头毒品“清醒”的作用。
excerpt.en: Continue researching the effects of the street drug 'Lucid'.

excerpt.zh: 这个看上去像是异星人舰船的外壳被发现漂浮在[floating_shell_system.GetName]星系。它是怎么到达那里的，这艘舰船的其他部分在哪里？
excerpt.en: The shell of what looks like an alien vessel was found floating in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system. How did it get there, and where is the rest of the ship?

excerpt.zh: 外星舰船的最后一部分出现在了[floating_core_system.GetName]星系。我们的工程师需要时间重新组装这艘舰船。
excerpt.en: The final piece of the alien ship has appeared in the [floating_core_system.GetName]. Our engineers need time to reassemble the vessel.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上获得了一个不寻常的信号，似乎是在尝试与我们联系。然而我们还不能与这个信号源进行沟通，如果想对其了解更多，我们需要派遣一艘舰船进行仔细检查。
excerpt.en: We have picked up on uncommon signals coming from [From.GetName], seemingly trying to initiate contact with us. We have been unable to communicate with whatever or whoever it is, and will have to send a ship to inspect i

excerpt.zh: 我们捕捉到了一些信号，表明在[prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]可能存在更有价值的资源有待发现。我们已经发射了一些先验探针对这一区域进行遍寻——这样当我们能够派遣一艘舰船前往的时候，我们就能获得足够的数据进行深入研究。
excerpt.en: We have picked up on signals indicating there might be more valuable resources to be uncovered at [prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]. We have sent some preliminary drones to scour the region - so it will be
