excerpt.zh:
一处怪异的引力井突然出现在[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]的上空，扰乱了许多我们的人造卫星轨道。殖民地本身尚未受到威胁，但这一现象出现在我们的一处殖民点附近，还是造成了不便。

此外，如果我们不加干预，许多在[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]上空运转的卫星将面临着提前坠落的风险。一旦发生，显然这将会实实在在地妨碍我们研究新生成的重力井的能力。
excerpt.en: A strange gravity well suddenly appeared above [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName], disrupting many of our satellite orbits. The colony itself doesn't seem to be under threat yet, but this phenomenon is situated uncomfor

excerpt.zh: 某个宣称自己是一名传奇英雄的个体来到了我们的母星。这样的暴论有可能是真的吗？
excerpt.en: An individual claiming to be a legendary hero has appeared on our homeworld. Could their wild assertions possibly be true?

excerpt.zh: 太空兽群已将我们的休眠种荚带到了§H[this.GetName]§!。通过向这颗行星发射一道聚能光束，我们可以刺激其生长，将这颗了无生机的星球转变为郁郁葱葱的新殖民地。
excerpt.en: Space Fauna have brought our dormant Seed Pods to §H[this.GetName]§!. By aiming a concentrated energy beam at the planet, we can stimulate their growth, turning an uninhabited rock into a verdant new colony.

excerpt.zh: 我们的种荚被太空兽群带到了§H[this.GetName]§!，他们在此处得到了§H[this.owner.GetName]§!的栽培和照料。通过向行星发射一道聚能光束，可以将这片森林转变为§H外星植物军§!。这颗行星上§H外星入侵植物§!的等级越高，就会生成越多的陆军。
excerpt.en: Space Fauna have brought our Seed Pods to §H[this.GetName]§! where they were cultivated and cared for by the §H[this.owner.GetName]§!. By aiming a concentrated energy beam towards the planet, we can stimulate growth, tur

excerpt.zh: 把一些空间站人员投入到对缇扬奇的研究中，可以让我们进一步了解这些宁静而神秘的太空生物的习性。
excerpt.en: Dedicating some space station personnel to the study of the Tiyankis could give us further insights into the life of these pacific, mysterious voidborne creatures.

excerpt.zh:
当有更有效率的东西出现时，一味坚持陈旧、衰老的东西是一个愚蠢的决定。

我们现有的科技水平使得神经植入体能够应用于我们[Root.GetName]的全体国民。我们的公民在四肢和器官被改良型的机械版本替换之后，将会变得更强、更快、更聪明。
excerpt.en:
It is a fool who persists in clinging to a worn, decrepit instrument when a more efficient alternative presents itself.

We now possess the technology to make cybernetic implants available to the population of the [Root.

excerpt.zh: 是时候抛弃我们有缺陷的器官和血管并且拥抱不朽了。我们必须为我们的所有人口准备先进的合成替身，然后开始意识传输过程。
excerpt.en: It is time to leave our flawed organic vessels behind and embrace immortality. We must prepare advanced synthetic avatars for our entire population, and then begin the process of consciousness transfers.

excerpt.zh: 如果我们要和被称为“虚境”的灵能领域中的居民交流的话，我们必须释放一股难以想象的巨大灵能能量。一场巨大的降灵会已做好筹备，[Root.Capital.GetName]新建的灵能使密会所里最强大的通灵者们将参与其中。
excerpt.en: If we are to communicate with the denizens of the psychic realm known as the Shroud, we will have to unleash an incredible amount of psionic energy. Preparations have been made for a huge séance involving our most powerf

excerpt.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]上的灵能使集会所正在准备一场盛大的圣餐以探寻一位深居虚境中的实体。
excerpt.en: The Conclave of Telepaths on [Root.Capital.GetName] is preparing a great communion to reach out to an entity that dwells in the Shroud.

excerpt.zh: 我们必须登上这艘外星舰船。微弱的能量读数表明其中可能有一个正常运转的生命维持系统。有可能有人或什么东西潜伏在船上。我们的士兵很想知道答案。
excerpt.en: We must board the alien vessel. Faint energy readings could indicate a functioning life-support system. There is a chance that someone, or something, may be lurking on the ship. Our soldiers are eager to find out.

excerpt.zh: 这艘舰船需要进行全面维护。我们自愿支援维修工作。
excerpt.en: The alien vessel requires extensive maintenance. We have agreed to assist with repairs.

excerpt.zh: 在首都恒星系建造一座通讯中继站以避免长距离通讯受到干扰。我们最好的工程师已经准备好开展工作了。
excerpt.en: Building a relay in our capital system will prevent disruptions in long-range communications. Our best engineers are ready to get to work.

excerpt.zh: 准备一场盛大的游行，设立公休假日，这需要大量的准备工作。如果我们要重燃国家自豪感，一切都必须安排得尽善尽美。
excerpt.en: A grand parade and public holiday will require a great deal of preparation. Everything must be perfect if we are to rekindle the nation's pride.

excerpt.zh: 异见者正悄悄地在我们的军队里落地生根，他们诽谤§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!并试图谋反。我们必须采取快速而强有力的行动。
excerpt.en: Dissidents are taking root inside our military, slandering §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! and scheming against us. Swift and decisive action must be taken.

excerpt.zh: 制止内阁中的裙带关系应该是我们的首要任务，因为它几乎阻碍了我们所做的一切。清理这些腐败可能需要一些时间，但我们的人民对我们抱有期待。
excerpt.en: Putting a stop to nepotism in the council should be our top priority, as it hinders almost everything we do. It may take some time to clean up all this corruption, but our people are counting on us.

excerpt.zh: 需要花费许多时间去定出[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]行星上的求救信号准确的地表位置。
excerpt.en: It will take time to pinpoint the exact planetary position of the distress signal on planet [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 在[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]上发现的孩子在经历了比任何已知历史更久的冷冻期之后成功地活了下来。复苏工作需要小心谨慎的准备。
excerpt.en: The child discovered on [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName] has survived a longer period of cryostasis than any in recorded history. Resuscitation will require careful and meticulous preparation.

excerpt.zh: 在艾克萨凯德斯的冷冻舱里发现的破碎部件，该遗物远超我们目前的科学理解。需要很长的时间和资源来发现其中的秘密。
excerpt.en: A broken fragment discovered in Exakeides's cryostasis capsule, this relic is well beyond our current scientific understanding. It will take a significant investment of time and resources to uncover its secrets.

excerpt.zh:
对瓦珀博恒星系中的这颗行星的初步调查证实了§Y凯德斯§!的幻视中闪现的场景。

尽管地质不稳定，但此地仍有一些相互隔绝的坚实地面。探险还是有可能进行的。

§R该特殊项目必须由§Y凯德斯§!本人施行。§!
excerpt.en:
Initial investigation of the planet in the Vapob system corroborates with the scenes glimpsed in §YKeides§!'s vision.

Though geologically unstable, there are isolated areas of firm ground. An expedition is possible.

§R

excerpt.zh:
如果这颗位于塔普入恒星系的行星和§Y凯德斯§!幻视中所见的一般，那么我们在这里应该小心再小心。

§R该特殊项目必须由凯德斯本人研究。§!
excerpt.en:
If the planet in the Taprib system is anything like the one §YKeides§! saw in his vision, we should exercise extreme caution.

§RThis Special Project must be researched by Keides himself.§!

excerpt.zh:
我们在伊弗施恒星系的一颗行星上观测到一座舰船的坟场，与§Y凯德斯§!的幻视非常相似。

§R该特殊项目必须由§Y凯德斯§!本人研究。§!
excerpt.en:
A graveyard of ships, eerily similar to the one in §YKeides§!'s vision, has been observed on a planet in the Ivusheh system.

§RThis Special Project must be researched by §YKeides§! himself.§!

excerpt.zh: 重重谜题围绕着§Y凯德斯§!所复原的遗物，而这是一次解答这些谜题的尝试。这是他幻视的来源吗？如果是这样，那么这件遗物还具有什么能力呢？
excerpt.en: An endeavor to answer the questions surrounding §YKeides§!'s restored relic. Was it indeed the cause of his visions? And if so, what further powers does it possess?

excerpt.zh:
§Y凯德斯§!发起的一项特殊项目，旨在缓解瑟塞特恒星系中无人机的哨戒。

他打算用电磁场摧毁其电源。如果成功的话我们就能去到这个星系的的行星上了。
excerpt.en:
A Special Project prompted by §YKeides§!, to relieve the Sursect system's drones of their vigil.

He intends to deploy an electromagnetic field to knock out their power sources. A successful outcome should afford us acce

excerpt.zh: 让[beholder_planet.GetName]上的[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]逐渐适应我们的存在让我们有可能靠近低语金字塔。如果他们降低对我们的警惕我们就能在他们当中自由活动，甚至会有机会进一步研究他们的物种。
excerpt.en: Acclimatizing the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] on [beholder_planet.GetName] to our presence will help us gain access to the Murmuring Monolith. If they lower their guard around us we can move freely among them, and may

excerpt.zh: 我们有机会研究[beholder_planet.GetName]上的远古低语金字塔了。
excerpt.en: We have an opportunity to examine the ancient Murmuring Monolith on [beholder_planet.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 通过将能量集中在低语金字塔的内部部件上，我们或许可以重现低语呢喃现象，并实现进一步的接触。
excerpt.en: By concentrating bursts of energy on the internal components of the Murmuring Monolith, we may be able to recreate the Murmuring phenomenon, and achieve further contact.

excerpt.zh: 我们应该能追踪到这个怪异通讯的源头。
excerpt.en: We may be able to trace the source of the anonymous transmissions we have been receiving.

excerpt.zh: 我们从艾莎琳那里收到的所谓礼物实际上是一种植物性细菌，且与我们所见过的任何细菌都不同。中和它将会是一个危险的挑战。然而，如果我们成功了，它将进一步加深我们对科学和医学的理解。
excerpt.en: The supposed gift we received from Azaryn is in fact a plant-based bacteria, unlike anything we've ever seen. Neutralizing it will provide a dangerous challenge. However, if we are successful, it would further our unders

excerpt.zh: 艾莎琳给我们一个任务，让我们尝试让一朵在她船上生态系统原生的巨大的花苞开花。基于初步的观测，这朵花可能对太空生物学有着极为重要的意义。
excerpt.en: Azaryn has tasked us with blooming a giant flower bud, native to her dome ship's ecosystem. Based on initial observations, this flower may be of great astrobiological significance.

excerpt.zh: 研究我们从§Y太空创生家艾莎琳§!的环境改造之核获取的样本可以提升我们对该科技的理解。
excerpt.en: Studying the sample we obtained of §YAstrocreator Azaryn§!'s terraformation nucleus could enhance our understanding of this technology.

excerpt.zh: [event_target:renowned_xenophile1.GetName]发现的兹泰格·迈尔的宝藏。
excerpt.en: The pirate treasure of Zteg-Mayr discovered by [event_target:renowned_xenophile1.GetName].

excerpt.zh: [event_target:renowned_xenophile2.GetName]发现的一支古老的船队。传言称其中有着大量财宝。
excerpt.en: An ancient convoy found by [event_target:renowned_xenophile2.GetName]. It is rumored to contain vast riches.

excerpt.zh: 舰队司令[event_target:renowned_materialist1.GetName]在这颗荒芜星球里发现的高价值合金。
excerpt.en: Valuable alloys have been discovered by Admiral [event_target:renowned_materialist1.GetName] on this barren world.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一处时空的异常裂缝。研究它的独特性质应该能够提供我们有价值的科学启发。
excerpt.en: We have discovered an anomalous rift in space and time. Researching its unique properties should provide valuable scientific insight.

excerpt.zh:
不稳定的引力异常正在从[From.System.GetName]的§Y星界细缝§!中泄漏出来，显现为缓慢移动的奇点在附近空间中传播，然后剧烈地内爆。穿越这个恒星系的舰船可以避开它们，但必须小心谨慎地行驶。

进一步调查这种情况，可能能够发现稳定维度裂口的方法。
excerpt.en: Unstable gravitational anomalies are leaking out of the §YAstral Scar§! in [From.System.GetName], manifesting as slow-moving singularities that travel throughout nearby space before violently imploding. Ships passing thr

excerpt.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!的地表布满了有缺陷的军火，每次爆炸都会在行星上切割出一块块的碎片。

我们对这些武器十分陌生，其本身又是极其易爆的。此外，爆炸产生的图案表明了整个行星上埋藏这一个起爆网络。
excerpt.en:
The surface of §Y[from.GetName]§! is riddled with defective munitions, each carving out chunks of the planet as it detonates.

The weapons themselves are unfamiliar and extremely volatile. Furthermore, the pattern of the

excerpt.zh: 在§Y[wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]§!的庇护所崩塌之前发现了一组受干扰的坐标。我们有理由相信其中的一个坐标是指向一台因内特贸易体用于操纵宇宙风暴的机器。这可是一项值得去找到的科技。
excerpt.en: A set of scrambled coordinates were recovered from §Y[wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]§! before the shelter collapsed. We have reason to believe one of these might lead to a machine the Inetian Traders used to manipulate

excerpt.zh: §Y[wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]§!上的三个坐标拼起了一幅古老的拼图，剩下的事就是激活局部扰动抑制器了。终于到了搞明白它的用途的时候了。
excerpt.en: The three coordinates from §Y[wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]§! completed an ancient puzzle. All that is left is to activate the Sectoral Disturbance Depressors. The time has come to discover their purpose.

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一处古代星尘沙暴的形成地点，但证据表明，它比典型的风暴要小得多。鉴于它的规模之小，因内特贸易体认为有必要使用他们的局部扰动抑制器来控制风暴就显得很奇怪了。

如果继续追踪风暴的路径，我们也许就能发现他们为什么在这个项目上投入这么多时间。
excerpt.en: We found the formation point of an ancient celestial dust storm, but evidence suggests it must have been much smaller than a typical disturbance. Given its size, it is curious that the Inetian Traders felt the need to co

records.zh: 探究因内特贸易体的秘密
records.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Inetian Traders

excerpt.zh: 在发现了因内特贸易体的安息之地后，关于他们辽阔帝国仍有许多未解之谜。我们计划再一次进行调查。
excerpt.en: After having discovered the final resting place of the Inetian Traders there is still more to learn about their vast empire. We would like to investigate them one more time.

excerpt.zh: 坐标指向了一颗位于[planet_assembling_the_past.System.GetName]恒星系内的行星。我们应该派出一艘探索舰船来调查这颗行星与阿达卡利亚公约之间可能存在的关联。
excerpt.en: The coordinates point to a planet in the [planet_assembling_the_past.System.GetName] system. An exploration vessel should be sent to investigate what relevance this planet may have had for the adAkkaria Convention.

excerpt.zh:
我们复原出了阿达卡利亚公约的母行星的坐标。

探索这个星系和行星也许终于能揭示阿达卡利亚文明的命运。
excerpt.en:
We recovered the coordinates to the adAkkaria Convention's home planet.

Exploring the system and planet may finally reveal the fate of the adAkkaria civilization.

records.zh: 阿达卡利亚公约的秘密

excerpt.zh: 庆典学院还有很多值得我们研究的东西。我们有勇气继续深入探察这些阿达卡利亚人的实验吗？
excerpt.en: There is still so much we can learn from Institute of Celebration. Do we dare to engage with these adAkkarian experiments even further?

excerpt.zh: 这场在[Owner.Capital.GetName]的千载难逢的风暴具有一种非常适合调制的独特性质。但首先我们必须加深对其构成的理解。谁知道我们会给生活带来什么奇妙的东西呢？
excerpt.en: This once-in-a-lifetime storm system on [Owner.Capital.GetName] has special properties that make it ripe for modulation. But first, we'll need to better understand its underlying composition. Who knows what brilliant odd

excerpt.zh: 我们有培植风暴的技术，附近却没有初生的风暴。我们需要研究如何播种出一个可以培植的风暴。
excerpt.en: We have the technology, but without a nascent storm in the vicinity, we will need to investigate how to seed a storm we can sculpt.

excerpt.zh: 小心地将暗物质注入太空织构就可以在这个恒星系中激起可塑的风暴。
excerpt.en: By carefully injecting Dark Matter into the spatial fabric, a malleable storm will be provoked within this system.

excerpt.zh: 我们如今知晓宇宙风暴能靠提供正确的饮食来操控。为了饲育这场风暴，我们需要特定的资源。
excerpt.en: We now know that a cosmic storm can be manipulated by feeding it the correct diet. To feed this one, we require a certain sampling.

excerpt.zh: 创造一场完美的风暴需要一组精心调配的资源。
excerpt.en: Creating the perfect storm will require a carefully measured sampling of resources.

excerpt.zh: 如果我们想要避免这颗星球走向崩坏，就必须要将其稳定下来。
excerpt.en: Stabilizing the collided planet is necessary if we want to prevent this world from collapsing.

excerpt.zh: 执行这个大胆的计划，改造被撞行星的生态环境吧。我们要么创造一个适合所有生命的星球，要么将这颗行星推向毁灭。
excerpt.en: Carry out our ambitious plan to harmonize the biomes of the collided planet. We will either create a world for all, or doom it in the process.

excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]地表完全被这些温和的红色昆虫所覆盖。想要行星变得宜居，就要先处理掉这些虫子。与此同时，它们似乎是一种不错的食物来源，或许我们可以从此入手。
excerpt.en: [From.Planet.GetName] is entirely covered by placid, red insects. The planet could be habitable if the bugs are dealt with. At the same time, they appear to be a good source of food. There may be a path forward here.

excerpt.zh: 我们的一艘科研船上出现了一种特别有趣、非常可爱的动物。我们要先进行调查，再行决定要不要留下它。
excerpt.en: A most intriguing, positively adorable animal was found aboard one of our science vessels. An investigation into the creature's biological qualities is required before we decide to keep it or not.

excerpt.zh:
我们探测到那艘不祥的舰船将会在这场风暴中现身。

派遣一艘科研船去将其引出并捕获！
excerpt.en:
We have detected the ominous ship will be manifesting itself inside this storm.

Send a science vessel to draw it out and intercept it at once!

excerpt.zh: 扫描位于[this.GetName]中的[fromfrom.GetName]，结果表明其内部漩涡中携带着大量物质。远程传感器无法对这一不寻常现象提供确凿的答案。为了增进我们的认识，需要对风暴中心进行一次实地考察。
excerpt.en: Scans of [fromfrom.GetName] in [this.GetName] suggest it is carrying a large mass within its inner vortex. Long-range sensors have been unable to provide conclusive answers about this unusual phenomenon. A field expediti

excerpt.zh: 扫描位于[this.GetName]中的[fromfrom.GetName]，结果表明其内部漩涡中携带着大量物质。远程传感器无法对这一不寻常现象提供确凿的答案。为了增进我们的认识，需要对风暴中心进行一次实地考察。

excerpt.zh: 一个明显受损的神秘胶囊正在飘过§H[this.GetName]§!星系。我们不知道它的起源，也对其功能一无所知。它看起来不具备明显的武器，我们相信对其先进的建造工艺进行分析是一个安全和值得投入的项目。
excerpt.en: A mysterious and visibly-damaged capsule is drifting through the §H[this.GetName]§! system. We know neither its origin nor function. It possesses no evident weaponry and we believe further analysis of its advanced constr

excerpt.zh: 一个古老的“风暴陷阱”在太空中自由漂流，内部携带着压缩的宇宙风暴。打开它将为风暴管理和缓解提供宝贵的洞见，但代价是释放被困在里面的未知力量。
excerpt.en: An ancient "storm trap" is drifting freely through space, carrying a compressed cosmic storm within. Opening it would provide valuable insights into storm management and mitigation, at the risk of releasing whatever forc

excerpt.zh: §Y星尘风暴§!对§H[this.GetName]§!的影响导致了水过滤系统被许多不可溶的矿物泥浆阻塞了。我们必须改建出更强劲的过滤系统来解决这个问题。
excerpt.en: The impact of a §YStardust Storm§! on §H[this.GetName]§! has left water filtration systems clogged with an insoluble mineral slurry. We must re-engineer a more robust filtration system to address the issue.

excerpt.zh: 我们在§H[solar_system.GetName]§!星系发现了被宇宙风暴夹带着穿越星系的某种未知生物的遗骸。对待这具遗骸进行法医鉴定可以揭示更多信息。
excerpt.en: We have encountered the remains of an unknown creature in the §H[solar_system.GetName]§! system dragged across the galaxy by a cosmic storm. Forensic dissection of the corpse should reveal more information.

excerpt.zh: 三只被宇宙风暴从鲸群中带丢的缇扬奇幼崽在[this.solar_system.GetName]星系游荡。我们可以通过放大它们的叫声来帮助它们把鲸群吸引到这个星系中来帮助它们重聚。
excerpt.en: Three Tiyanki calves are lost and wandering the [this.solar_system.GetName] system, separated from their pod by a cosmic storm. We can help reunite them with their pod by boosting their cries to attract the rest of their

excerpt.zh: 虚空虫的生物学特性和繁殖模式值得进一步研究。
excerpt.en: The biology and reproductive patterns of the Voidworms warrant further study.

excerpt.zh: [cutholoid_under_radar.GetName]小行星不可貌相。我们需要派遣一支小有规模的军队前去，在[this.GetName]科研船永远离开我们之前将其救出。
excerpt.en: The asteroid [cutholoid_under_radar.GetName] is not what it seems to be. We should approach with a sizable military force and attempt to recover our science ship [this.GetName] before it is gone for good.

excerpt.zh: [cutholoid_under_radar.GetName]小行星不可貌相。我们有了合适的科技，可以将其整个捕获并在[this.GetName]永远离开我们之前将其轻易地救出。
excerpt.en: The asteroid [cutholoid_under_radar.GetName] is not what it seems to be. With the right technology, we could capture it entirely and easily recover our science ship [this.GetName] before it is gone for good.

excerpt.zh: 我们摧毁了一只躲在小行星中的巨型生物。收获它的尸体也许对我们很有价值。
excerpt.en: We have destroyed a massive creature hidden inside an asteroid. Harvesting its remains could prove valuable to us.

excerpt.zh: 岩居兽的小行星外壳是一件令人印象深刻的生物工程杰作。我们还有很多可以向它们学习的。
excerpt.en: The asteroidal shell structure of the Cutholoid is an impressive piece of biological engineering. There is more for us to learn from them.

excerpt.zh: 在[contact_system.GetName]发现了一具[met_critter.GetSpaceFaunaName]的尸体。对这些野生生物遗骸的研究将加深我们对这些太空生物的了解。
excerpt.en: The carcass of a [met_critter.GetSpaceFaunaName] was discovered in [contact_system.GetName]. Studying these remains in the wild will broaden our understanding of these spaceborne creatures.

excerpt.zh: 在[this.GetName]内的某处探测到了一个失踪已久的海盗§Y珍宝藏库§!。谁也不知道里面到底藏有多少宝贝……
excerpt.en: A long-lost pirate's §YTreasure Trove§! has been detected to be somewhere on [this.GetName]. Who knows what riches it may contain...

excerpt.zh: 有一支海盗舰队在追寻着[this.GetName]的§Y珍宝藏库§!！
excerpt.en: A pirate fleet is after the §YTreasure Trove§! on [this.GetName]!

excerpt.zh: 我们对轨道胶囊内包含的海图进行了初步分析，发现许多天体的位置并不在我们母星系内。还需要一些时间才能提取准确的坐标。
excerpt.en: Our initial analysis of the chart inside of the orbital capsule revealed the location of several celestial bodies not present in our home system. It will take time to extract the exact coordinates.

excerpt.zh:
§H星国图志§!引导我们来到一个粉碎星球。我们探测到一条非自然形成的隧道深深钻入了行星最大地壳板块。相信星图的下一部分就隐藏在里面，但需要仔细挖掘才能获取。

可以用工程船来建造必要的设备从而发掘出这块星图碎片。
excerpt.en: The §HCelestial Chart§! has led us to a shattered world. We detected an unnatural tunnel drilled into the largest slab of planetary crust. We believe that the next piece of our chart is hidden within, but accessing it wi

excerpt.zh: 从破碎行星的残骸中挖掘出胶囊后，我们需要破译其中的导航数据。这个过程需要交叉参照我们的制图数据库，并将标记的天体与已知星系进行比对。
excerpt.en: After excavating the capsule from the remains of the shattered planet, we need to decipher the navigation data within. This process will require cross-referencing our cartographic database and charting the marked celesti

excerpt.zh:
除了乙特人标本，我们还发现了一个用于保存标本的复杂展示柜的先进设计。

研究该蓝图中使用的技术可能会帮助未来的保护和展览工作。
excerpt.en:
Alongside the Ytterite specimen, we discovered an advanced design for a complex display cabinet that would aid in its preservation.

Researching the techniques used in this blueprint will likely aid future conservation a

excerpt.zh:
在探索宇宙的过程中，我们收集了无数独特的文物和文化奇观。这些标本将激励民众，使我们的展览成为第一个展示和保护所有星系知识领域的展览。

建造一个§H博物天枢§!正是为了这一目的。
excerpt.en: Throughout our exploration of the cosmos, we have collected countless unique artifacts and cultural oddities. These specimens will inspire the populace and make our exhibition the first to showcase and conserve all field

excerpt.zh:
位于[This.GetName]的地下基地对轨道轰炸具有很强的抵抗力，但只要有足够的时间和火力，我们舰队就能将其摧毁。基地被摧毁后，我们可以搜寻废墟，以回收§H星国图志§!碎片和其他贵重物品。

战术顾问提醒，这种做法可能会给黑针足够的时间呼叫增援。
excerpt.en: The underground base on [This.GetName] is highly resistant to orbital bombardment, but with enough time and firepower, it is possible to destroy it with our fleet alone. Once the base has been neutralized, we can search

excerpt.zh:
位于[This.GetName]的地下基地对轨道轰炸具有很强的抵抗力，但只要有足够的时间和火力，我们舰队就能将其摧毁。基地被摧毁后，我们可以搜寻废墟，以回收§H星国图志§!碎片和其他贵重物品。

战术顾问提醒，这种做法可能会给黑针足够的时间呼叫增援。
excerpt.en: The underground base on [This.GetName] is highly resistant to orbital bombardment, but with enough time and firepower, it is possible to destroy it with our fleet alone. Once the base has been neutralized, we can search

excerpt.zh:
[FromFrom.GetName]地下基地受到大量军队和安保无人机的保护。在行星表面部署军队将使我们能够迅速占领基地，给§Y黑针§!几乎没有反应的机会。

一旦我们控制了基地，就可以发掘星图胶囊以及海盗积累的任何其他不义之财。
excerpt.en: The underground base on [FromFrom.GetName] is protected by a significant number of troops and security drones. Deploying armies on the planet's surface would allow us to take over the base quickly, giving little opportun

excerpt.zh: 海盗过度依赖偷窃和改装技术，这导致他们的基地容易受到渗透。可以让一艘科研船从轨道上入侵[FromFrom.GetName]的网络，伪装成§Y黑针§!运输船，并声称受荷仁船长的命令，说服他们移交星图胶囊，避免不必要的流血事件。
excerpt.en: The pirates' over-reliance on stolen and repurposed tech has left their base vulnerable to infiltration. A single research ship could hack the network on [FromFrom.GetName] from orbit, masquerading as a §YBlack Needle§!

excerpt.zh: 我们从§Y黑针§!基地获取了星图胶囊，接下来的任务是解密其中的数据，并将新信息整合到§H星国图志§!中。
excerpt.en: With the capsule taken from the §YBlack Needle§! base, we are tasked with decrypting the data within and integrating the new information into the §HCelestial Chart§!.

excerpt.zh:
根据我们的调查，我们认为§H星国图志§!的下一部分隐藏在[this.GetName]的早已沦为废墟的定居点中。

鉴于其他胶囊的结构十分坚固，我们可以假设它在最近的轰炸中留存下来。
excerpt.en:
Based on our investigation, we believe that the next piece of the §HCelestial Chart§! is hidden somewhere within the ruined settlement on [this.GetName].

Given the sturdy construction of the other capsules, we can assum

excerpt.zh: 从斯密吉卜定居点废墟中发掘出胶囊后，剩下的就是解密里面的数据，并完成§H星国图志§!。我们很快就会发现§H奈斯船长§!的踪迹尽头等待着我们的是什么。
excerpt.en: After extracting the capsule from the ruins of Smeegibb's settlement, all that remains is to decrypt the data inside and complete the §HCelestial Chart§!. We will soon discover what awaits us at the end of §HCaptain Ness

excerpt.zh: 我们按照§H星国图志§!指引，来到了[this.solar_system.GetName]星系中一个被虫群寄生的§H星门§!。必须先处理这些生物，才能重新激活星门，看看另一边有什么。
excerpt.en: We have followed the §HCelestial Chart§! to an infested §HGateway§! in the [this.solar_system.GetName] system. These creatures must be dealt with before we can reactivate the Gate and see what is on the other side.

excerpt.zh: [this.solar_system.GetName]星系中虚空虫的尸骸显示出异常读数。我们的扫描仪似乎在一个垂垂死去的三头虫中探测到生命迹象。我们应该派遣一艘科研船去进一步调查。
excerpt.en: The remains of the Voidworms in [this.solar_system.GetName] are showing unusual readings. Our scanners seem to detect signs of life within one of decaying Troikas. We should send a Science Ship to investigate this furthe

excerpt.zh: [FromFromFrom.System.GetName]的星门处于休眠状态。当接近这座古老的建筑时，§Y星国图志§!提供了一系列关于这项失落技术的知识。理解这种古老的交通方式可能会在其他冒险中证明有用。
excerpt.en: The Gateway in [FromFromFrom.System.GetName] is inactive. When approaching the ancient structure, the §YCelestial Chart§! provided a series of insights in this lost technology. Understanding this ancient method of transp

excerpt.zh: 作为§H星国图志§!上的最终目的地，[this.solar_system.GetName]中的休眠§H星门§!可能是通往某个非常重要的地点。
excerpt.en: As the final destination on the §HCelestial Chart§!, the inactive §HGateway§! in [this.solar_system.GetName] likely leads to something of great importance.

excerpt.zh: 作为§H星国图志§!上的最终目的地，[this.solar_system.GetName]中的休眠§H星门§!可能是通往某个非常重要的地点。
excerpt.en: As the final destination on the §HCelestial Chart§!, the inactive §HGateway§! in [this.solar_system.GetName] likely leads to something of great importance.

records.en: Last Stand of the Black Needle

excerpt.zh: 在对[root.GetName]的恒星系进行大规模破坏性攻击后，黑针仍然维持着对§H奈斯船长的宝藏§!的封锁。他们已经耗尽了大部分资源，现在处于脆弱状态。如果我们在这里击败他们，他们的整个组织必然会崩溃，让我们可以自由地夺取宝藏。
excerpt.en: Following extensive sabotage attacks on [root.GetName] systems, the Black Needle have maintained their blockade around §HCaptain Ness's Hoard§!. They have exhausted much of their resources, and are now in a vulnerable po

excerpt.zh:
§H奈斯船长的宝藏§!近在咫尺了。

尽管它看起来被遗弃了，但建筑物的许多系统仍在运行。考虑到§H奈斯船长§!的传说性质，我们应该警惕预料之外的安全措施。

这个宝库的唯一入口在其中央舱口处有一个凹槽。我们可以将§H星国图志§!插入这里，打开这个神秘的设施。
excerpt.en:
§HCaptain Ness's Hoard§! is ours to take.

Despite its abandoned appearance, many of the building's systems are active. Given the alleged nature of §HCaptain Ness§!, we should be cautious of unexpected security measures.

excerpt.zh: 我们在寻找虚空虫疫的治疗方法方面取得了突破性进展。唯一需要的是处于活跃繁殖状态的虚空三头虫的生殖腺。
excerpt.en: We have made a breakthrough discovery in the search for a cure to the Voidworm Plague. All that is required are the reproductive glands of a Voidworm Troika in an active state of fertility.

excerpt.zh:
这种虚空三头虫的残骸可以收获其具有繁殖能力的生殖腺。

这些器官将极大地扩展我们对这些生物的生物学理解，并帮助我们彻底消灭虚空虫疫。
excerpt.en:
The remains of this Voidworm Troika can be harvested for their fertile reproductive glands.

These organs would greatly expand our understanding of the creatures' biology and assist in eradicating the Voidworm Plague onc

excerpt.zh:
在我们对新克隆生物进行训练的过程中，一只受伤的太空变形虫使用了一种新技术击败了对手。变形虫的鞭毛能够从训练伙伴的天然防御中吸取营养和物质，用它们来修补自身盔甲上的漏洞，并恢复战斗力。

对这种现象的进一步研究可能会揭示太空变形虫生物学的一个新元素，可以对其进行增强，从而开发出一种新的物种特异性突变。
excerpt.en: During our training process of newly cloned organisms, an injured Space Amoeba used a novel technique to defeat its opponent. The Amoeba's flagella were able to siphon nutrients and materials from its training partner's

excerpt.zh:
最近克隆的一支缇扬奇舰队被观察到正在进行交流，反复发出复杂的叫声。这些几乎无法察觉的声音似乎给附近的所有其他生物带来了安慰和平静。

对这种现象的进一步研究可能会揭示缇扬奇生物学的一个新元素，可以增强该元素以开发出特定物种的突变。
excerpt.en:
A recently cloned fleet of Tiyanki were observed communing together, repeatedly emitting a series of complex vocalizations. The barely detectable sounds seemed to bring comfort and calm to every other creature nearby.

A

excerpt.zh:
我们注意到一些虚空虫在成熟时会形成小的囊肿状生长物。进一步观察表明，带有这些难看水泡的样本通常比它们的同类更具繁殖力。

对这种现象的进一步研究可能会揭示虚空虫生物学的一个新元素，可以增强该元素以开发出特定物种的突变。
excerpt.en: We have noticed that some of our Voidworms tend to develop small cyst-like growths as they reach maturity. Further observation showed that specimens with these unsightly blisters are typically more fertile than their cou

excerpt.zh:
由于过度投喂，我们记录到了一只克隆岩居兽发生了剧烈的呕吐。从其胃部喷出的消化液作为浓缩抛射体非常致命，即使在离开该生物的躯体很长时间后还保有放射性。

对这一现象的进一步研究揭示了岩居兽的生理学中有一种新的元素可以用来增强物种特有变异过程。
excerpt.en: As a result of overfeeding, one of our cloned Cutholoids was recorded violently ejecting the contents of its stomach. The resulting digestive fluids proved to be quite deadly as a concentrated projectile, maintaining the

excerpt.zh: 在战斗测试中，一些我们的晶体实体在被摧毁后完美地分裂成两半。这些碎片保持着重要的生命迹象，并继续存活了一段时间。
excerpt.en: In combat testing, a number of our Crystalline Entities have split perfectly in two after being destroyed. These fragmented halves have maintained vital life signs and continued to live for a short time.

excerpt.zh: 我们从缇扬奇族母身上提取的遗传物质为我们提供了一些独特的见解，这将使我们能够进行一项实验性突变项目，该项目可以应用于任何太空兽群。
excerpt.en: The genetic material we have recovered from the Tiyanki Matriarch has provided some unique insight that will allow us to proceed with an experimental mutation project that could be applied to any Space Fauna.

excerpt.zh: 我们从虚空孳孽身上提取的遗传物质为我们提供了一些独特的见解，这将使我们能够进行一项实验性突变项目，该项目可以应用于任何太空兽群。
excerpt.en: The genetic material we have recovered from the Voidspawn has provided some unique insight that will allow us to proceed with an experimental mutation project that could be applied to any Space Fauna.

excerpt.zh: 我们必须调校视界刺针跃迁引擎，计算精确的坐标，让我们可以潜入河心超大质量黑洞。
excerpt.en: We need to calibrate the jump drive of the Horizon Needle and calculate the exact coordinates that will allow us to dive into the supermassive black hole at the galactic core.

excerpt.zh: 派出一支队伍去修正[root.location.getName]的重力变化，恢复其大气层。
excerpt.en: Send a team to rectify the gravitational changes on [root.location.getName] and restore its atmosphere.

excerpt.zh: 在寒冷环境居住的人口汇报了各种与义体植入体有关的疼痛症状。通过临床实验可以让我们获得更多数据。
excerpt.en: Populations living in freezing climates report cases of severe pains related to cybernetic implants. A clinical trial will allow us to gather more data.

excerpt.zh:
一场无法解释的宇宙风暴凭空出现，阻挡了通行。

为了继续前进，我们必须穿透它神秘的帷幕。
excerpt.en:
An unexplained cosmic tempest has materialized, blocking all travel.

To proceed, we must pierce its mysterious veil.

excerpt.zh:
塞塔娜的风暴既是一项技术奇迹，也是一件可怕的武器。

如果我们要在对抗她的斗争中有什么胜算，我们一定要学习更多，特别是因为她的图谋和她的宣称相去甚远。
excerpt.en:
Cetana's tempest is both a technological marvel and a formidable weapon.

We must learn more if we are to stand any chance against her, especially if her intentions deviate from what she has implied.

excerpt.zh:
塞塔娜委任我们从[Root.GetName]取回一个数据库，并警告我们不要尝试破译其中的内容。

这些数据的价值不言而喻，我们能冒着惹她不高兴的危险进行解密吗？
excerpt.en:
Cetana has tasked us with retrieving a databank from [Root.GetName], warning us to make no attempt to decipher its contents.

The significance of this data is veiled, but can we risk arousing her displeasure by uncoverin

excerpt.zh: 随着塞塔娜的风暴径直奔向[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]，在它到达之前我们几乎已经没有多少时间了。
excerpt.en: With Cetana's tempest speeding towards [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName], we will have little time to grab the databank before it arrives.

excerpt.zh: 其中一座召唤着女王注意力的信标坐落于这颗[this.GetPlanetMoon]上。
excerpt.en: One of the beacons calling for the Queen's attention is located on this [this.GetPlanetMoon].

excerpt.zh:
即便壁垒层层，但§H[solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系的前哨还是不如塞塔娜的核心领地戒备森严。我们可以用一支足够强大的舰队摧垮它的防御。对残骸场进行全面的检测有可能挖掘出关于塞塔娜计划的重要洞见。关键的挑战在于穿越风暴到达前哨。

§R这将引发一场战斗！§!

§G成功的掠袭会阻碍塞塔娜的计划。§!
excerpt.en: While heavily fortified, the outpost in the §H[solar_system.GetName]§! system is less guarded than Cetana's core territory. With a sufficiently powerful fleet, we can overwhelm its defenses. A thorough examination of the

excerpt.zh:
塞塔娜的运输舰队确保将关键资源运送到她的前哨。如果我们的舰队能抓到一艘，我们就能登船检查货物。

§R这将引发一场战斗！§!

§G成功的掠袭会阻碍塞塔娜的计划。§!
excerpt.en:
Cetana's Convoys ensure the delivery of crucial resources to her outposts. If we can catch one with our fleets, we can board the ships and inspect their cargo.

§RThis will start a battle!§!

excerpt.zh: 抟土之塑师不知用什么方法瘫痪了塞塔娜的泰坦。现在机会来了：如果我们想重塑塞塔娜，就必须做好[GetRitualGoalLoc]的准备工作。
excerpt.en: Somehow the Animator of Clay disabled Cetana's Titan. The chance is now: if we hope to reshape Cetana, we must prepare for the [GetRitualGoalLoc].

excerpt.zh:
整个星系受到了一个具有无比强大力量的实体的威胁，它被称为§R最终清算§!。它由纯能量构成，突然显现以来开始了一趟破坏之旅。

所有数据都表明该物体与我们之前见过的一切事物都截然不同。如果我们想应对这个威胁，就必须进行紧急研究来弄明白到底应该如何与之一战。
excerpt.en:
The galaxy is under threat from an immensely powerful entity known as the §RReckoning§!. Composed of pure energy, it materialized suddenly and began a campaign of destruction.

All available data indicate that this being

excerpt.zh:
尽管我们没能成功，但直面§R最终清算§!也给我们的研究带来了宝贵的数据。

将研究精力投入到该神秘能量生物上，我们就能找到它的弱点，从而发展出更有效的攻击手段。
excerpt.en:
Though we did not succeed, our confrontation with the §RReckoning§! provided invaluable data for study.

By dedicating research to this mysterious energy being, we can identify its vulnerabilities, and thereby develop mo

excerpt.zh: §Y[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§!做好了灵潜仪式的一切必要准备工作，随时可以代我们进入§H虚境§!。他们能为我们寻得何种洞见仍不得而知。
excerpt.en: The §Y[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§! have made the necessary preparations to perform a Delving Ritual and reach into the §HShroud§! on our behalf. Whatever insights they will guide us to are uncertain.

excerpt.zh: §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系内的灵能辐射等级突然提升，甚至在§H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!上都能感受到这种效应。我们必须近距离研究这种不断恶化的现象，不能再让它威胁到我们的人口了。
excerpt.en: Levels of psi-radiation in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system have suddenly increased, and the effects are being felt on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!. We must study this developing phenomenon up close before i

excerpt.zh: 我们祖先建造在§H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!的§H远古堡场§!是用来保护我们不受灵能辐射伤害的。§H灵能光环§!的入侵大大超出了它的防护能力。如果用上目前为止所学到的知识，我们应该就有能力提升其防御性能。
excerpt.en: The §HAncient Ward§! built by our ancestors on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§! was designed to protect us from psi-radiation. The incursion of §HPsionic Auras§! threatens to overwhelm its current capacity. By applying what

excerpt.zh: 在§H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!上的梦客圣所遗迹里，我们找到了一颗被紧紧包裹着的“茧”，它正在散发出极高等级的灵能辐射。我们必须进行现场调查来消除这个物体可能带来的威胁。
excerpt.en: Within the ruined Sanctum of the Dreamer on §H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!, we found a tightly sealed 'cocoon' emanating dangerous levels of psi-radiation. We must conduct on-site research to eliminate any thre

excerpt.zh:
我们已经做好了成立独立的§H“灵督城邦”§!以协助结束星系中灵能侵染行动的准备。

一旦成立，该机构可以为需要的人提供反灵能服务，并以此为我们赚取收入和物资。
excerpt.en:
We are prepared to construct an independent §H'Mindwarden Enclave'§! to further our mission of ending psionic infection throughout the galaxy.

Once constructed, this facility can provide anti-psionic services for those

excerpt.zh:
§H虚境§!中的无数实体都拥有着强大的力量。想要得到祂们最大限度的庇佑，必须先与祂们形成不可撤销的纽带。

然而我们看到了自己的实现方法。我们不仅可以将心灵与单一超主绑定，还能让[GetResearchers]找到从每个实体中汲取少量能量、甚至按照我们的意志重塑虚境的方法。
excerpt.en:
The entities within the §HShroud§! are many, each an accretion of great power. They expect an irrevocable bond before they bestow their greatest blessings.

Yet we see a way to forge our own path. Rather than binding our

excerpt.zh:
长距离遥感影像显示§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!系内最近出现了一次奇怪的能量流爆发，与我们[owner.GetHomeWorldName]上的远古堡场发生异常时产生的读数互相相关。

如果我们想理解这个现象，就必须去探索[exiled_system_border.GetName]系。
excerpt.en:
Long-distance imagery shows a recent burst of strange energy flows in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system, which correlates with irregular readings produced by our Ancient Ward on [owner.GetHomeWorldName].

If

excerpt.zh:
我们在§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上发现的灵能碎片蕴藏着诸多必须破解的奥秘。

阻碍我们的正是自身思维的局限。
excerpt.en:
The fragment of psionic energy we discovered on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! holds secrets we must unlock.

We are held back by the limitations of our own mind.

excerpt.zh:
我们在§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上发现的灵能碎片蕴藏着诸多必须破解的奥秘。

阻碍我们的正是自身思维的局限。
excerpt.en:
The fragment of psionic energy we discovered on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! holds secrets we must unlock.

We are held back by the limitations of our own mind.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[capital_scope.GetName]为着同一个目标汇聚一堂。

我们要深入§H虚境§!之中，让§R心声§!强大的力量可以认可我们，并与我们沟通。

我们称之为大灾。而其他人则叫祂清算。现在，祂将向我们揭示祂的真名，得知之后我们将成就伟业。
excerpt.en:
We have gathered on [capital_scope.GetName] with a singular purpose.

We will reach deep within the §HShroud§! and force the staggering power of the §RVoice§! to acknowledge and commune with us.

We have known it as the

excerpt.zh:
我们在[from.GetName]上侦测到了一处环境异常。它的大气带有我们认为与中世纪金属加工有关的各种污染的痕迹，然而我们的表面扫描却被一种理应在在机械星球上出现的奇异辐射所掩盖。

在重新校准传感器之前，我们不能指望收集到更多的数据。这是时间异常，还是其他物种被[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]同化的残余物？
excerpt.en: We have detected an environmental anomaly on [from.GetName]. Its atmosphere bears traces of the kinds of pollution we would associate with medieval metalworking, yet our surface scans are obscured by exotic radiation of

excerpt.zh: 在一个别无值得一提的星系中，有一座复杂的监测站孤零零地矗立着，它早已荒废到难以修复的程度。它在监测什么，它又为什么会聚焦在[fromfrom.GetName]中这样一个狭小的区域呢？
excerpt.en: Alone in a system devoid of other noteworthy phenomena is a sophisticated monitoring station, long since decommissioned and put beyond repair. What was it monitoring, and why was it focused on such a tightly enclosed reg

excerpt.zh: 一座属于[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]的信标将我们的注意力引向一座地下数据库，它深埋于行星的地下。我们建立了远程安全访问，然而解密和文件碎片整理需要花费一些时间。
excerpt.en: A beacon belonging to the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] has directed our attention to a data vault, buried deep under the planet surface. We have established secure access by remote, however decryption an

excerpt.zh:
在机械中枢的静态残骸上插着一个东拼西凑的存储介质，它围绕着一个被严密屏蔽的核心。该档案的各个部分是在不同的时期建造的，使用的材料均来自其他星球——或许是来自被机械同化的文明？

我们可以尝试解密档案，同时探测静态屏蔽核心，试图确定它们的总体意图。
excerpt.en: Plugged into the static remains of the Machine Nexus is a patchwork of memory storage media, surrounding a heavily shielded core. Each section of this archive was built in distinct phases, using materials sourced from ot

excerpt.zh: 我们正在尝试使用神经科技将我们的意识远程连接到噬天巨兽的神经系统。我们现在相信这是驯服这头巨兽的唯一方法。
excerpt.en: We are experimenting with neurotechnology in an attempt to remotely connect our minds with the Behemoths' nervous system. We now believe this is the only way to tame the beast.

excerpt.zh:
天巨兽的意识远比我们预想的要庞大和复杂；我们现在明白，单一个体的思想不足以整合。我们的思想虽然比大多数人优越，但并非生来就适应那样的身体。

第一步是将我们人口的个体思想与这头噬天巨兽连接起来。先形成一条脆弱的纽带，然后很快变为一股洪流——一股安抚巨兽暴怒的洪流。
excerpt.en: The Behemoth's consciousness is far more vast and complex than we anticipated; we now understand that a single individual's mind is insufficient for integration. Our minds, while superior to most, were never designed to

excerpt.zh: [GetInvadersLower]舰队的残留物带来了一个罕有的研究击毁。我们可以从中学到许多有助于生存的知识。
excerpt.en: The remains of the [GetInvadersLower] fleet provide a rare opportunity for study. We may learn much to ensure our survival.

excerpt.zh: [GetInvadersLower]的母星系；它们是谁？它们到底打我们什么主意？
excerpt.en: The home world of the [GetInvadersLower]; who were these people, and what did they want with us?

excerpt.zh: 从理论上讲，我们最近在噬天巨兽遗传学方面的突破可以扩展到进一步变异我们的创造物上。尽管遗传的稳定性仍是一个问题，但只要有时间和资源，我们有信心能创造出进一步的生物强化。
excerpt.en: Our recent breakthroughs in behemoth genetics could theoretically be expanded to further mutate our creations. Genetic stability is a concern, but with time and resources we are confident that we can bring about further

excerpt.zh: 我们与巨兽之交已有时日。彻底的转变已唾手可得，只待我们的一声令下。我们所即之处将是飞升之巅，所弃之物莫过于星域凡尘。肉体、重力，于我将再无挂碍。
excerpt.en: We have communed with the Beast long enough. The transference is ready, awaiting only our command. We stand on the cusp of ascension, poised to abandon the pitiful ashes of our planetbound dominion and rise beyond the ch

excerpt.zh: 噬天巨兽离开我们的星系后，便飘入虚空，最终消失得无影无踪。我们可以尝试解开这个谜团，但距离如此遥远，只能采用非常规方法。答案或许如同虚空本身一样模糊不清。
excerpt.en: After leaving our galaxy, the Behemoth drifted into the void, then vanished. We can try to unravel the mystery, but at this distance, only unconventional methods remain. The answers are likely as hazy as the void itself.

excerpt.zh: 一种非凡的类爬行物种在§Y[from.GetName]§!的剧毒大气中欣欣向荣，其秘诀就是一种可以将极端毒素破坏成有用养分的独特内器官。对这种有机体的进一步研究值得一试。
excerpt.en: A remarkable species of reptiloid thrives in the toxic atmosphere of §Y[from.GetName]§!, aided by a unique internal organ which breaks extreme toxins down into useful nutrients. Further study of this organism would be a

excerpt.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!的气态外层由一种生活在其核心上的单细胞生物独特的生化过程所维持。将这些生物消灭可以让气体消散，使其下的岩质行星得以宜居。
excerpt.en: §Y[from.GetName]'s§! gassy outer layers are maintained by the unique biochemistry of unicellular organisms which inhabit its core. Exterminating them would dissipate these gasses, leaving us with a colonizable rocky plan

excerpt.zh:
将物体送入§Y[from.GetName]§!的气态金属大气中可以形成天然镀层。

这一独特的过程非常高效，通过进一步研究可以进行复现并用于改进[Root.Owner.GetName]所有舰船船体的耐用度。
excerpt.en:
Sending objects into the gaseous metal atmosphere of §Y[from.GetName]§! results in a form of natural electroplating.

This unique process is remarkably effective and with further study could be replicated to improve ship

excerpt.zh: 研究§Y[from.GetName]§!上的超密度钻石后，我们确信其独特性质可以用于发展我们的激光科技。
excerpt.en: By studying the ultra-dense diamond storms on §Y[from.GetName]§!, we are confident that their unique properties can be used to advance our laser technologies.

excerpt.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!上的一座受阻的超级火山之下储存着超大量富矿熔岩。进行受控喷发之后我们就可以收获这些被阻碍的资源了。
excerpt.en: A blocked supervolcano on §Y[from.GetName]§! is holding vast reserves of mineral-rich magma below the surface. Conducting a controlled eruption would allow us to harvest these trapped resources.

excerpt.zh: 通过对§H[from.GetName]§!上火龙卷的形成条件更密切的研究，就可以在受控环境中得以复现这种现象好的一面。
excerpt.en: By studying the conditions behind the flaming tornadoes of §H[from.GetName]§! more closely, the benefits of this phenomena could be recreated in a controlled environment.

excerpt.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!上的大型动物能抵御熔融星球上的极端环境，深深潜入行星上无数熔岩池之中。

研究这些生物的甲壳可能帮助我们理解如何抵御极端热量。
excerpt.en:
The megafauna on §Y[from.GetName]§! are able to withstand the harsh environments of their molten world, and submerge themselves deep below the surface of the planet's numerous magma pools.

Studying these creatures' cara

excerpt.zh: 通过重利用§Y[from.GetName]§!上受损的行星推进器阵列，我们将这颗气态巨行星的氢气焚烧殆尽，暴露出了底下可开采的固态核心。
excerpt.en: By repurposing the damaged planet thruster array on §Y[from.GetName]§!, we can burn away the gas giant's hydrogen leaving behind a solid and exploitable core.

excerpt.zh: 我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]们通过研究§Y[from.GetName]§!上缇扬奇兽群的化石遗骸，旨在完全理解炼狱级核辐射对生物质的影响，并有可能发现全新的高级合金生产方式。
excerpt.en: By examining the petrified remains of the fossilized Tiyanki pod on §Y[from.GetName]§!, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] aim to fully understand the effects of chthonian-level radiation on biological matter, potential

excerpt.zh: 研究§Y[from.GetName]§!精准的轨道共振效应将会提升我们对舰船机动中行星引力弹弓效应的理解。
excerpt.en: Studying the perfect orbital resonance effect on §Y[from.GetName]§! will improve our understanding of planetary slingshot maneuvers on ships.

excerpt.zh: 通过催化一些从[from.Planet.GetName]取回的毒性繁育黏液，我们或许可以从中孵出生物体。
excerpt.en: By catalyzing some of the toxic gestational slime recovered from [from.Planet.GetName] we may be able to spawn a living organism from it.

excerpt.zh: §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上找回的残损方舟上收集有一些复杂的数学证明，被称为《历代志》。我们对其展开研究，只旨在进一步地了解邓德里人所寻找的天堂星球§Y新布拉图雅§!。
excerpt.en: By studying the "Chronicles", a collection of complex mathematical proofs recovered from the wrecked arkship on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!, we aim to learn more about the paradise planet sought by the Dendritians, §YNew B

excerpt.zh: §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上找回的残损方舟上收集有一些复杂的数学证明，被称为《历代志》。我们对其展开研究，只旨在进一步地了解邓德里人所寻找的天堂星球§Y新布拉图雅§!。
excerpt.en: By studying the "Chronicles", a collection of complex mathematical proofs recovered from the wrecked arkship on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!, we aim to learn more about the paradise planet sought by the Dendritians, §YNew B

records.zh: 修复退化的超空间航道

excerpt.zh: 如果我们能找到修复§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!中退化的超空间航道的方法，我们就能确认§Y新布拉图雅§!，这颗邓德里人所寻找的天堂星球是否存在。
excerpt.en: If we can find a way to restore the degraded hyperlane in §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!, we will be able to confirm the existence of §YNew Bratulla§!, the paradise planet sought by the Dendritians.

excerpt.zh: 追踪着与§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上的装置完全一致的通讯频率找到的这一位置，而这里又发现了一台受损的装置。进行研究可以取得对他们的破坏性环境改造能力更深入的洞见。
excerpt.en: An identical communications frequency to the one emitted by the construct found on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! has been traced to this site, where another damaged device has been located. Studying it will yield further ins

excerpt.zh: §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上找到的设施发出的通讯频率还指向这个地点，我们在这里又找到了一台受损的设备。进行研究可以取得对他们的破坏性环境改造能力更深入的洞见。
excerpt.en: The communications frequency emitted by the construct found on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! has also been traced to this site, where another damaged device has been located. Studying it will yield further insight into their

excerpt.zh: 我们在§Y[planet.GetName]§!找到了第四个还未引爆的环境改造装置。将其取回之后就能让我们完全理解这一科技了。
excerpt.en: We have located a fourth, as yet undetonated terraforming device on §Y[planet.GetName]§!. Recovering it will fill the gaps in our understanding of this technology.

excerpt.zh: 通过分析§Y[planet.GetName]§!上找到的这台装置的控制结构，我们就能复制这项科技为自己所用。
excerpt.en: By analyzing the control architecture of the device found on §Y[planet.GetName]§!, we will be able to replicate this technology for our own use.

excerpt.zh: 通过分析§Y[planet.GetName]§!上找到的这台装置的控制结构，我们就能复制这项科技为自己所用。
excerpt.en: By analyzing the control architecture of the device found on §Y[planet.GetName]§!, we will be able to replicate this technology for our own use.

excerpt.zh: 一艘巨大的方舟战舰在战斗中被摧毁，留下了一片广阔的残骸。其基础设施、引擎和船体的残余可能为打捞提供有价值的材料。
excerpt.en: A colossal arkship has been destroyed in battle, leaving behind a vast field of wreckage. The remains of its infrastructure, engines, and hull may yield valuable materials for salvage.

excerpt.zh: 我们的一艘方舟舰陷入黑暗无助漂流，它的各个系统都被紧急关闭了。只要派遣到位，我们的工程师就可以恢复供电，重新取得控制，使其恢复正常运作。
excerpt.en: One of our Arkships lies dark and adrift, its systems forced into emergency shutdown. Once brought alongside, our engineering crews can restore power, reassert control, and bring it back into the fold.

excerpt.zh: 冠铸秀已为前往赛场准备了专用虫洞。请在截止日期前将您的舰队送达指定地点，准备铸就属于您的传奇！
excerpt.en: The CFL has prepared a specialized wormhole to the competition grounds. Deliver your fleet to the designated location before the deadline and prepare to forge your legacy!

excerpt.zh:
没有人能独自守护星系。

在采取行动之前，我们必须赢得我们希望保护之人的信任。这种信任始于诚实、克制和外交。

我们将培养新一代特使，通过言行证明我们在此是为了提供帮助。只有齐心协力，我们才能建立足以抵御未来挑战的强大联盟。
excerpt.en:
No one defends the galaxy alone.

Before we can act, we must earn the trust of those we hope to protect. That trust begins with honesty, restraint, and diplomacy.

We will train a new generation of envoys to prove throug

excerpt.zh:
我们已经取得了信任。但我们必须培养信念。

既然星系与我们同在，我们必须给它的人民一些可以信仰的东西，一些即使在最黑暗的时刻也能经久不衰的象征。不仅仅是旗帜或口号，而是勇气、团结和坚不可摧的承诺的标志，我们将站在他们与风暴之间。

让每一个感性众生都看向这些象征，并记住：他们并不孤单。
excerpt.en:
Trust is earned. Faith must be nurtured.

Now that the galaxy stands with us, we must give its people something to believe in, symbols that can endure even the darkest hour. Not mere banners or slogans, but emblems of co

excerpt.zh:
星系中存在的威胁不容忽视。我们不能坐等黑暗降临。我们将谨慎而小心地展开一系列高风险行动，以揭示前方潜藏的危险。

§R这将触发终末危机§!
excerpt.en:
The galaxy holds threats too great to ignore. We cannot afford to wait for the darkness to reveal itself. With caution and care, we will begin a series of high-risk operations to uncover what dangers lie ahead.

§RThis w

excerpt.zh:
我们前期所作的大量工作已被证明是必要的，尽管我们也取得了成功，但这并不是终点。

星系浩瀚无垠，危机四伏。我们必须继续搜寻，确保没有威胁能逃过我们的监视。

这些实验是危险的，但如果邪恶仍然潜伏在黑暗中，我们别无选择，只能面对它。

§R这将触发第二次终末危机§!
excerpt.en:
Our early efforts have proven necessary, and though successful, they are not the end.

The galaxy is vast and full of danger. We must continue our search to ensure that no threat escapes our watch.

These experiments are

excerpt.zh: 艺术与科技相结合，创造出在黑暗中熠熠生辉的自由象征。
excerpt.en: Art meets technology to create symbols of freedom that will shine bright against the darkness.

excerpt.zh: 我们必须在该星系部署一颗间谍卫星，以履行我们的合约。
excerpt.en: We must deploy a Spy Satellite in this system to fulfill our contract.

excerpt.zh: 我们被委派走私关键任务物资，以支援间谍网络。
excerpt.en: We have been tasked with smuggling critical mission supplies to support the Spy Network.

excerpt.zh: 我们需要协助潜入该星系的一个恒星基地。
excerpt.en: Our assistance is required to infiltrate a Starbase in this system.

excerpt.zh:
坐标指向了一艘巨大飞船的残骸，其上层结构与标准的方舟舰设计相符。

初步探测结果表明发生了灾难性的内部故障。全面调查可能会发现与§Y塞拉伦涅§!恢复的记忆相关的线索。
excerpt.en:
The coordinates led to the remains of a massive vessel, its superstructure consistent with standard Arkship design.

Preliminary readings suggest catastrophic internal failure. A full investigation may uncover traces lin

excerpt.zh: 重建破碎的飞船并非易事，但这样做或许能揭示§Y塞拉伦涅§!的起源，以及她注定要继承的遗产。
excerpt.en: Rebuilding the shattered vessel will be difficult, but doing so may reveal the origins of §YSeralune§! and the legacy she was meant to inherit.

excerpt.zh:
祖传文献记载，在此坐标发生了一件至关重要的事情。他们称之为“显化之地”，据说这里是他们启动仪式以祈求神灵降临的地方。据说那是一个奇迹之地。初步扫描显示存在大幅磁偏转。

岁月流逝，此处已面目全非，但我们仍应前往调查，以探究显化之地所蕴含的精神意义。
excerpt.en: The ancestral writings describe a crucial event that occurred at these coordinates. Known to them as Emergence, this was where they initiated a ritual to invoke the deities. It was said to be a place of wonder. Initial s

excerpt.zh: 用我们祖先的话来说，在§Y[this.GetName]§!的国境范围内有一只“不眠之眼”。我们理解这应该是指一座轨道天文台。
excerpt.en: In the words of our ancestors, there is an 'Unsleeping Eye' within §Y[this.GetName]§!'s grasp. We understand this to be a reference to an orbital observatory.

excerpt.zh: 根据我们的圣典记载，§Y[this.GetName]§!曾是一座古老修道院的所在地。
excerpt.en: According to our sacred texts, §Y[this.GetName]§! was once the location of an ancient monastery.

excerpt.zh: 我们的祖先高度重视§Y[this.GetName]§!。如果我们正确理解了这些文本，一些非常重要的事情正在这里等待着我们。
excerpt.en: Our ancestors held §Y[this.GetName]§! in high regard. If we have understood the texts correctly, something very important awaits us here.

excerpt.zh:
我们检测到源自这些坐标的人工信号。奇怪的是，这里据说是我们其中一个神圣遗址。信号包含一段编码信息，我们已将其转录并翻译成语言。

“§Y崇拜已启用。和平现在可以开始。§!”
excerpt.en: We have detected an artificial signal originating from these coordinates. Curiously, this is where one of our Sacred Sites is purported to be. The signal contains a coded message which we have transcribed and translated

excerpt.zh: 据先祖们的记载，§Y[this.GetName]§!有一颗天然卫星，是追随我们信仰的长者们最终安息之所。
excerpt.en: According to the Ancestors' logs, §Y[this.GetName]§! has a natural satellite which serves as a final resting place for elders of our faith.

excerpt.zh: §Y[this.GetName]§!曾令我们的祖先感到恐惧。他们的传说中提到“潜伏在地表以下深坑中”的“危险而强大的野兽”。
excerpt.en: §Y[this.GetName]§! was feared by our progenitors. Their legends speak of a "dangerous and powerful beast" that "lurks in a pit below the surface".

excerpt.zh:
此地有一处神圣遗址，其名根据我们祖先的语言大致翻译为§Y镜子§!。

据说此地天界之间的界限异常稀薄，人们可能会遭遇来自我们宇宙之外的异界生物。
excerpt.en:
There is a Sacred Site at this location, its name roughly translated from our ancestral language as the §YMirror§!.

It is said that the boundary between celestial planes is thinner here, and one may confront other-world

excerpt.zh: 以太巨龙的鳞片散发出一种明显的能量，必须极其谨慎地对待。任何试图开展的采集行动都应小心进行，因为此类生物的残骸可能仍带有不可预知的特性。
excerpt.en: The Ether Drake scales radiate a palpable power that warrants extreme caution. Any attempt to collect them should proceed carefully, as the remnants of such a creature may still carry unpredictable properties.

excerpt.zh:
方舟舰的§H轴基挂载武器§!安装工作已导致舰船前部体产生危险的结构应力。

我们将派遣一艘§H后勤船§!，全面加固受影响的区域。
excerpt.en:
The installation of the Arkship's §HSpinal Mount§! has introduced dangerous structural stresses along the vessel's forward hull.

A §HLogistics Ship§! will be dispatched to fully reinforce the affected sections.

excerpt.zh: 影响方舟舰上人群的记忆迷雾将持续存在，直到我们绘制出§Y[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]§!的共振剖面为止。
excerpt.en: The memory fog affecting the Arkship's population will persist until we map the resonance profile of §Y[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]§!.

excerpt.zh: 蔓延于§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!水培舱室的入侵真菌物种已迅速适应了飞船的受控生态系统。若不加干预，其密集的菌丝网络恐将导致粮食产量大幅下降。
excerpt.en: The invasive fungal species spreading through the hydroponics decks of §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! has rapidly adapted to the ship's controlled ecosystem. Left unchecked, its dense mycelial networks threaten to significan

excerpt.zh: 我们将尝试与遍布§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!水培舱的入侵真菌物种进行沟通。如果不加以控制，其密集的菌丝网络将造成严重威胁并降低粮食产量。
excerpt.en: We will attempt to communicate with the invasive fungal species spreading through the hydroponics decks of §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!. If left unchecked, its dense mycelial networks threaten to significantly reduce food

excerpt.zh: 方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!的船员们长时间以来行为异常。报告显示他们的日常活动变得反复无常，其中几名船员表现出对某种事物迷恋，并且什么事情都藏着掖着的迹象。建议进行调查。
excerpt.en: The crew members of Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! have been acting abnormally for an extended period. Reports suggest their routines have become erratic, with several crew members displaying signs of infatuation and secrecy

excerpt.zh: 我们需要调查资源到哪里去了。
excerpt.en: We need to explore where our resources keep disappearing to.

excerpt.zh: 我们必须仔细扫描该物体，以确定其来源以及内部是否有任何东西在漫长的虚空漂流中幸存下来。
excerpt.en: We must carefully scan the object to determine its origin and whether anything inside has survived the long drift through the void.

excerpt.zh: 我们必须飞到指定恒星系并扫描逃生舱，以确定其乘员是否还活着。
excerpt.en: We must fly to the indicated system and scan the pod to determine whether its occupant still lives.
